sanitation_advance: Settlements are investing in improved sanitation measures, such as waste disposal and clean water systems. This will reduce the spread of disease, and improve the overall health of the population. The development of modern sanitation practices will make it possible for people to live in closer proximity without succumbing to disease.
manufactories_advance: Recent technological advances in mechanization have facilitated the rise of concentrated production facilities in the form of manufactories. These businesses have helped us greatly improve the rate and quality of production.
central_bank_advance: With the banking institution firmly established, the state can now charter a permanent central bank empowered to issue government bonds. These bonds allow the crown to raise large sums quickly from private investors, repaying them through steady interest rather than relying on estate lending alone.
lead_ore_dressing: Through the dressing process, lead ore is washed and crushed to remove impurities and separate the ore from rocks, clay and other minerals.
industrial_expansion_advance: The spread of manufactories lets the state oversee an ever wider web of production, allowing us to promote an additional industry across our realm.
powerful_statues: A prosperous country is the true sign of a strong ruler, but the people will only believe that a ruler is strong if they are depicted as such. To that effect, many rulers commission statues of themselves, often made out of stone or bronze, to project an image of strength and power to any who look upon their rendered visages. However, these displays of ego are not always effective, and sometimes only result in great amounts of materials being moved around.
absolute_rulership: Many people demand to be given a role in the government, but mostly because they want to be rewarded without expending much effort. The idea of absolutism has recently piqued our interest, as adopting it would empower us to dispose of those self-serving parasites and rule alone...
government_size_absolutism: Concentrating power in the hands of the rulers allows them to take direct action, but they still need people under them to help carry out those actions. Giving those subordinates no real power, while making them unfailingly loyal to the ruler, allows the Crown to host more of them without fear of infighting or discontent.
town_rights_abs_advance: As the place of our court, our capital should also bask in the glory and magnificence of our rule. No other town or city should come close to it in majesty and grandeur.
construction_speed_absolutism: Building construction has become more sophisticated over time, incorporating methods and techniques from a wide range of disciplines, commonly considered a type of engineering.
pop_promotion_speed_age_5: The bureaucracy is expanding to meet the needs of the expanding bureaucracy, which correspondingly increases our need for educated officials to join the administrative ranks.
rgo_size_advance_absolutism: Recent developments in economic thought have shifted the focus from the mercantilist ideals of value lying in trade towards the notion that value lies in the production process itself. As a result, production has been steadily improving and increasing.
lumber_improvements_absolutism: With the introduction of wind power to our sawmills, we are able to process timber into planks at a much faster rate than we could previously.
coal_improvements_absolutism: By streamlining the coal refining process, we can use it more effectively as fuel while eliminating side effects that would negatively impact other industrial products.
food_advance_absolutism: Until recently, land ownership and use was relatively common and free. However, there is now an increasing tendency to start a process of specific land delimitation, clearly determining the borders and size of fields exclusively dedicated to agriculture. With this kind of specified use, their production and exploitation can be greatly increased.
scientific_revolution_advance: Recent developments in mathematics, physics, astronomy, biology and chemistry have not only challenged, but completely changed our view of the world around us. Society is progressing at a greater speed than ever before, and more scientific breakthroughs are made every day.
newspapers_advance: The concept of announcements being announced or posted where the public may read them is certainly not a new one. However, as the Printing Press becomes more popular around the world, so does the demand for accessible information about politics, war, and the economy. The newspaper - a periodical publication describing current events - shall satisfy this demand.
scientific_mapping_advance: Recent improvements in the sciences of geography and cartography have allowed for more accurate depictions of land masses and natural features, both in terms of their relative sizes and their exact positions.
coke_blast_furnace: This is a new type of blast furnace, which uses coke instead of charcoal as its fuel. It is cheaper and allows us to build larger furnaces, although coke has the disadvantage of being less pure than charcoal, which is a problem yet to be addressed.
merchant_power_from_maritime_absolutism_: With the emergence of new ideas about commerce and economics, the local businesses have joined together to form a business network that can further their interests and protect their rights against political entities and foreign influences.
hollander_beater: For centuries, paper mills have relied on mechanical hammers to beat lumpen paper pulp, crushing the fiber to create the raw material needed to then create paper. Using local windmills for power, enterprising artisans have now devised a more efficient solution: the 'Hollander Beater', a vat containing a wind-powered horizontal roller with blades. These blades can shred as much pulp in hours as the old hammers did over days.
maritime_advance_age_5: As maritime trade expands, with our ships ferrying goods back and forth in greater quantities and to more distant shores than ever before, the need to maintain a consistent flow of commerce also increases. Organizing convoy trade fleets will allow a more stable circulation of trade ships.
the_constitution: A new philosophical concept called constitutionalism has been developed, wherein the government accepts legal limits to its power through established law rather than ruling by arbitrary decree. While some may find this idea intriguing, it is obviously not popular with monarchs...
ship_building_techniques_absolutism: The development of the wet dock, or floating dock, will allow our shipwrights to construct ships much faster than before.
power_projection_advance_5: As state power becomes increasingly centralized, rulers across the world have begun to envision themselves as absolute sovereigns over their respective territories. Like the sun that illuminates the entire world, they seek to be the sole source of authority, their will extending unchallenged across every corner of their domain.
jesuits_bark: Some native population of South America have been observed to use the bark of a specific tree to treat shivers. Thanks to the experiments of a Jesuit apothecary, this bark has been proven also effective for the treatment of malaria, and it is already known as 'Jesuit's Bark'. Distributing it to the affected population will greatly decrease the effects of the disease.
national_sovereignty: The many long wars in the first half of the 17th century have led to an international diplomatic system for which the territorial integrity of states is a cornerstone. States, rather than individual rulers or supra-national groupings, are the actors in the international arena, and no state has the right to intervene in the internal affairs of another.
naval_professionalism: Until the beginning of the 17th century, permanent navies were quite small, and even notable martitime powers mostly maintained only enough of a naval force to meet their immediate needs. Over time, however, many states have started moving in the direction of establishing larger professional navies. Unless we want to see our rivals overtake us in naval matters, we must strive to create a larger permanent navy with the proper administrative structures to support it. We should also ensure that a naval career can be a lifelong occupation for our officers.
measuring_the_world: The new sciences have given us a number of different ways to describe and measure the world around us. However, we cannot know all of the resources that could be at our disposal until we have thoroughly searched all our lands for minerals, counted every last subject, and assessed every last enterprise. Let us command out scholarly experts to conduct a thorough survey — first of our nation, then of the entire world!
diplomatic_range_age_5: The complexity of modern politics can no longer be handled by single envoys. To expand our influence even further and protect our interests in those faraway places, we will send skilled teams of expert diplomats to each country.
spy_construction_absolutism: As the various empires and institutions that make up our world continue to expand, we shall need to maintain and perhaps increase espionage if we wish to stay one step ahead of our rivals.
subject_loyalty_absolutism: We tolerate no dissent or revolt. Absolute loyalty is demanded from all subjects, whether they are part of the core citizenry or a conquered group.
improve_relation_impact_absolutism: Our ever-growing diplomatic corps necessitates our creating a permanent Foreign Affairs Ministry to manage and coordinate our many envoys and coordinate their efforts.
relations_absolutism_advance: As the world around us shifts to accommodate the wider scope of a truly global theater, so too must our diplomatic efforts keep up with this ever-growing need for security against foreign threats.
naval_doctrines_advance: Naval warfare has seen many changes in recent years, with ships and fleets both becoming larger and more specialized. As a result of this, different countries are starting to use a variety of tactics and doctrines, tailored to their strong points or their particular way of using their fleets.
military_revolution_advance: War never changes, but the manner of waging it does. Recent arms developments have proved that the old ways of fighting are obsolete, and armies have experienced a full paradigm shift. Adapting to those changes is the only way to continue being a strong military power.
improved_supply_lines: Modern warfare demands more and more resources for our armies, especially since the development of salvo fire and the widespread use of artillery on the battlefield.
artillery_vs_fort_age_5_absolutism: Gunpowder has made way for the creation of multiple different types of weapons. Cutting through lines of infantry does not require the same power as breaking down castle walls, and so a specialized type of cannon has to be deployed in sieges.
war_score_absolutism_advance: The power of the state is directly tied to its military capacity. The more populous a country is, the grander its army can become. We must take an aggressive approach toward annexing as much land as possible in peace treaties to seize the advantage over our neighbors.
correct_box_advance_absolutism: New tactics have developed, making for more flexible and coordinated infantry, cavalry, and artillery units on the battlefield, usually grouped as brigades.
anti_piracy_warfare: The rise of cutthroat, lawless buccaneers in the New World — and along the maritime routes leading to it — had made a great impact on our merchants and our trade. From now on, our merchant ships will form convoys with an accompanying warship to protect them, and will have on board a small military contingent to further ensure their survival on the high seas.
absolutism_agressive_advance: As various regions of the world are formally consolidated and resources become more limited, it is the right of the state to exercise an aggressive policy to satisfy the material needs of its people and expand its power. And while war should be seen as the last act of diplomacy, it is still a diplomatic play, as the state is above human restrictions such as morality and law.
supply_depot_advance_age_5_absolutism: Armies can now penetrate deeper into enemy territory and sustain themselves there for longer periods, making it necessary to build and maintain forward depots closer to them while being linked to rear supply lines.
line_infantry: With the invention of bayonets, each musketeer could also function as a pikeman. This allowed pikes to be removed from infantry equipment, and provided infantry formations with more firepower.
naval_morale_advance_5: The global expansion of trade and commerce demands permanent naval forces to protect national interests. Maintaining an established, ever-present standing navy will allow ships to operate more effectively together as a fleet.
gustavian_infantry: Gustavus Adolphus, ruler of Sweden, made several innovations to his infantry that improved their performance. His formations were narrowed and made rectangular to increase the number of muskets that could fire in each volley, and the attachment of small artillery pieces further increased their firepower.
country_unification_advance: The earlier we start integrating the administration of our subjects to follow the rules of our own, the easier the integration of other matters will be. Creating a permanent liaison with our subjects will make this process significantly smoother.
ostentatious_clothing: It is the right and duty of the ruling classes to display their power through their appearance. As such, they are wearing increasingly flamboyant attire, making use of the latest techniques to achieve vibrant and luxurious colors and patterns.
artists_advance_absolutism: Art has always been created in a number of different ways, but recent advances have allowed it to develop even further into a myriad of manifestations, as artists explore new media and techniques.
absolutist_court: Authority has become increasingly centralized in the person of the ruler. Courtiers and officials now serve as extensions of royal will rather than autonomous actors. This concentration of authority allows rulers to enact their wishes more quickly and efficiently.
cork_stoppers: Developments in bottle manufacturing have allowed wine producers to create bottles in standardized sizes, and as a result, they have been able to reintroduce the use of cork bottlestoppers. This is a much more efficient way to seal in the wine than with cloth stoppers, and means that it can now be transported much farther away than was previously possible. Perhaps we are now seeing the birth of a worldwide Wine trade..,
increase_control_area_advance: As our mighty country grows, we will need to keep a tight grip on our population.
army_movement_speed_absolutism: Field magazines are not new technology, but their use has been greatly popularized by the unparalleled growth of modern armies. The steady supply of ammunition they provide facilitates ease of army movement, and extends their operational range.
regiment_reinforcement_speed_absolutism: Standing armies have become the new standard of warfare, which in itself brings its share of challenges. The Marshal of Lodging, a new position within our military, shall focus on overcoming these challenges by organizing the logistics of our ever-growing forces.
surgery_advance: Barber-surgeons are developing more sophisticated techniques for treating injuries and illnesses, and the invention of new surgical instruments makes procedures safer and more effective. As a result, patients are surviving injuries and illnesses that would have been fatal just a few years ago.
new_world_advance: As the Florentine navigator Amerigo Vespucci says, the lands discovered by Columbus are not the Indies but, in fact, a whole New World unknown to our ancients and waiting to be mapped and claimed.
explorer_commisions_advance: Beyond our shores lie uncharted lands, ripe for the taking! We shall recruit brave explorers to set course for the unknown and bring back exotic goods. This is a vital — and possibly very lucrative — opportunity for us.
open_sea_exploration: The vast seas promise us great riches and new opportunities for trade on distant shores.
repair_at_sea_aod: While the latest advances in naval craftsmanship are pushing the boundaries of sailing as we know it, we need any crewmen on said ships to know how to fully exploit these new capabilities. Only training permanent professional sailors will allow them to correctly perform the necessary tasks to maintain these cutting-edge new ships.
merchant_power_from_maritime_discovery_a: The confraternities of merchants allow our traders to organize, share profitable trade route information, and join forces when buying and selling in foreign markets.
maritime_decay_advance_disc: The seas are constantly crossed by eager merchants searching for the best profit. This naturally evolves into certain routes becoming more established and frequented than others, with the most popular ones seeing a steady steam of ships sailing back and forth.
colonial_charters: These new documents will ensure the rights of our countrymen when they settle the untamed New World. They give our colonies the exclusive right of governing these new lands and regulate their relationship with the mother country.
colonial_policy_advance: The new lands and frontier territories that our people are colonizing require new forms of management and organization.
maritime_advance_age_3: As our knowledge of the world grows, so does the need to learn even more about it. From the far seas to the east to the new coasts in the west, the length at which we must sail has increased, and thus so has the need for a bigger fleet.
trade_range_advance_age_3: We have developed larger ships that require a smaller crew to sail, and which can travel farther without needing to stop. This should greatly increase the range of our trade efforts as a result.
coastal_trade_routes_advance: The safest way for any ship to sail is to do it close to the coast. Unless they actually have to cross the sea, there is no real need for our ships to sail away from the protective coastline, and it is still quicker traveling by ship than by land. As such, maintaining a constant flow of ships along our coasts will allow for easier circulation of goods and people.
ship_building_techniques_discovery: New building techniques for our ships will help us produce them faster.
port_cost_distance_from_capital_advance: Not every scallywag is worthy of being a captain; only the most experienced and skillful of them will lead our vessels. Such salty seadogs should be capable of safely finding their way back to port even in the fiercest of storms.
exploration_maintenance_advance: The key factor when building a ship is its capacity for resisting inclement weather and the relentless pounding of waves. By developing sturdier methods of ship construction, we can ensure that our vessels can sail for longer periods of time.
native_policy_advance: The new lands discovered by our daring explorers are usually inhabited by people we find strange and unsophisticated. It is time that we created an official policy to regulate encounters between our expeditionary forces and the natives of the lands they explore.
beat_to_windward_advance: Lateen-rigged caravels are highly maneuverable, allowing them to easily tack against the wind. This makes sailing through unfavorable weather and hostile seas much quicker.
plantation_buildings_advance: The mild climate and abundant fertile lands of the New World make the Colonies the ideal location for producing very profitable crops like Sugar and Tobacco.
naval_ambitions: With an extra boost to naval morale, our sailors will conquer the waves and rule the seas. Meanwhile, our colonists will be able to brave the darkest corners of the world, founding new settlements farther from home than ever before.
diplomatic_range_age_2: Maintaining an established network of skilled diplomats around us allows us to send envoys to countries even further away.
construction_speed_discovery: The standardization of plank and brick production using more modern techniques aims to enable easier construction.
printing_press_advance: The popularization of printing techniques this century has resulted in the wider spread of knowledge, as well as easier exchange of information, by speeding up the duplication of important manuscripts.
spy_construction_discovery: By hiring trustworthy individuals as informants and strategically positioning them in situations where clandestine information is shared, we can improve our capability to gather information about our enemies and their activities.
diplomatic_training: Our diplomatic playbook has been refined, and as a result, we have added excellent diplomats to our entourage in an attempt to bolster our foreign efforts.
formalized_relations: Establishing formal relations with neighboring countries of interest is crucial if we are to maintain a balance of power and promote our interests.
faceting: Master gemcutters have made a breakthrough in diamond-cutting by experimenting with diamond dust suspended in oil on their scaifs. This allows the artisans to cut stones in entirely new shapes, and to a much higher brilliance. The resulting technique, known as faceting, produces a stone of a pleasing geometric shape and with better optical qualities. As the new stones, and the technique for cutting them, spreads across courts and workshops, the demand for jewelry and precious stones increases greatly.
print_culture: With the invention of the printing press, the spread of knowledge has never been easier. New techniques and advances will reach every corner of our nation and make it grow stronger and richer.
artists_advance_discovery: Widespread usage of the printing press has created new opportunities for our people to share their artistic skills, and to distribute this art faster and more widely than ever before.
improved_book_binding: The blossoms of thought and knowledge must be watered by a steady supply of books if we are to prosper and cultivate as a people.
regulate_court_procedures: By applying a strict regimen and routine to our operations, we will reduce any potential excess cost, and run a frugal and efficient court.
crown_power_advance_discovery: As our ruler's authority becomes the dominant power in our domain, it highlights the need for a comprehensive government structure, as well as a proper bureaucratic corpus to manage it.
government_size_discovery: Our domain consists of many administrative sectors, and as we expand it, we must make the necessary adjustments to our government to account for this growth.
town_rights_aod_advance: From all settlements of our country, both rural and urban, none is more important than our capital. Being the place of our court and the source of our power, it clearly deserves some preferencial treatment compared to other settlements.
trade_through_owned_disc_advance: Merchants rarely stay still in one place, always trying to find the most profitable trades. Their constant coming and going is a common sight in our lands, and over time they have beaten their own paths to shorten the journey to their destinations.
lazaretto_advance: A small hospital in an isolated location, usually in the countryside, an island, or a patch of the coastline. Maritime travelers are quarantined there if they are suspected to be carriers of a contagious disease, limiting the spread of epidemics drastically in the location.
naval_morale_advance_2: Our sailors are becoming accustomed to longer journeys, using a new set of techniques and instruments, such as dry compasses, to improve their mastery of navigation.
basic_financial_instruments: Overseas trade is very risky, but also highly profitable. The development of financial instruments like letters of credit will help reduce that risk and increase our profits.
hire_artist_cost_modifier_advance_disc: Culture and the arts define the identity of any country. By proudly promoting our cultural achievements, we will leave a lasting impression on the entire world.
gov_reform_discovery_a: Our people stand at the threshold of a new era. In order to harness our internal capabilities, we must adapt our government and refine our administrative domain.
rural_rgo_disc_advance: Any settlement, no matter how small, will thrive as long as the land is rich and there are people willing to work it. Even the smallest village can become prosperous and bustling with activity over time.
power_projection_advance_4: Our presence at the diplomatic tables always conveys an air of grandeur and prestige. Our voice and influence shall resonate with all those with whom we engage.
pike_and_shot_advance: A new type of warfare has emerged on the battlefield: Pikemen form a defensive square, while arquebusiers fan out to the sides and front, retreating behind or inside the square in case the formation enters close combat.
matchlock_gun: Improvements to the weapons produced by our gunsmiths will also provide our hunters with better tools to bring home ample furs and wild game.
supply_depot_advance_age_3_discovery: The development and deployment of standing armies have increased the demands for weaponry, uniforms, and other military supplies, which should be stored in close proximity to our soldiers.
regiment_reinforcement_speed_discovery: Logistics are half the battle. As soldiers fight, their weaponry and armor will lose their durability, and possibly even break under the enemy onslaught. Establishing local supply depots, as well as employing other logistic methods, allows us to re-equip our soldiers in record time.
correct_box_advance_discovery: As our professional armies grow, the commissioned officers that lead them are commanding increasingly bigger formations. To assist them, we will create the rank of lieutenant. These officers take charge of transmitting orders from command, and also lead smaller units on the battlefield.
pike_square: Throughout the Middle Ages, the dominance of cavalry was challenged by disciplined pikemen. In battles such as Bannockburn or the Golden Spurs, the pikemen decimated the cavalry. A combination of improved training and discipline, and the addition of swordsmen to provide close combat support, has raised this formation to the peak of its efficiency.
supply_lines: The development of professional armies has changed the way war is waged. Logistics are now essential, and supply lines are absolutely necessary to keep armies fed and supplied with ammunition.
land_morale_attrition_cost_advance: It is common for armies to have to march great distances in order to reach their enemy. As such, long marches are a staple of our military training regimen, accustoming our fighters to walking long distances and still arriving fresh for the battle.
linked_armies_advance: Good coordination between the different units of an army is crucial for it to function well. Having an organized system to relay messages between our generals and their unit officials allows all our troops to work more cohesively and respond faster to any situation.
land_morale_movement_cost_advance_disc: An army on the move is vulnerable, and prone to disorganization. Training our troops to march in an organized and coordinated manner ensures that they will retain their battle formations, even if attacked while moving.
new_world_crops: The bountiful lands of the New World have provided many treasures to our country. One of the most important discoveries is that of the strange, exotic plants cultivated as food and spices by the natives of those lands. Growing those crops in our fields will provide our population with the dietary variety and novelty they crave.
rgo_size_advance_discovery: The discovery of new minerals and the invention of new tools has resulted in more efficient resource gathering and production line acceleration.
patio_process_advance: The Patio Process consists is a method of refining low quality silver and gold ores with a chemical solution based on mercury to catalyze the amalgamation reaction.
town_rights_enable: It is unquestionable that any substantial aglomeration of people and residences makes a settlement quite different from the countryside. Inheriting from the traditions of Roman self-administrated cities, we can provide such settlements with special laws and privileges, thus making the difference more clear and providing advantages for their populace.
rgo_logistics_discovery: If merchants and artisans can access the products they need locally, that would not only ease the burden of their work, but keep prices from being excessively high. To that effect, storehouses will serve as local distribution hubs to supply everyone's needs.
green_vitriol: Although not technically the same substance as Alum, Green Vitriol has been traditionally conflated with it in alchemical writings, and both have similar properties. As such, it is not uncommon to use one as a substitute for the other.
pop_promotion_speed_age_3: Traditionally, our artistocrats achieved their status through military service to their ruler. However, the demands of a growing state now necessitate members of the lower nobility being promoted to higher ranks, while people from other classes, such as merchants, are elevated as nobles.
blast_furnace: A more expensive method than traditional metallurgy, the use of blast furnaces allows us to further refine pig iron into cast iron by re-melting it with different quantities of iron, steel, limestone, and charcoal. Cast iron made into wrought iron this way creates an excellent material for making complex products such as cannon.
saiger_process_discovery: Improved processing and work methods will allow our Silver and Lead mines to prosper.
new_currency_demands: The discovery of new lands has also led to an increased flow of trade. This has in turn caused a rise in the demand for coins, and although the noble metal currencies made of Gold and Silver remain the main values, other lesser metals like Copper and its alloys have seen their use and circulation increased.
lumber_improvements_discovery: By dedicating a portion of land to the cultivation and harvesting of strong trees, we can increase the quality and quantity of our lumber production.
pharmacology_advance: Alchemists and physicians are exploring new compounds and chemical mixtures in their search for remedies. Some of these early pharmacists have developed treatments for common illnesses like fevers, colds, and digestive problems, and their methods show promise for the future. However, there is still much to be learned, and many of these new remedies can be dangerous if not prepared correctly.
confessionalism_advance: There are a myriad of different interpretations of what the Faith should be, and as such, there has been an increased interest among religious and secular authorities alike to clearly define the methodology of their specific confessions, enforcing their particular rules and views on all aspects of faith and life.
gov_reform_reformation_a: Current events have determined that rulers need to approach the management of the state more systematically, taking into account both the different estates of the country, and the distinct diplomatic actors that surround them.
crown_power_advance_reformation: While our ruler has a firm grasp over matters mundane, it is becoming a necessity that they also take control of heavenly concerns. Church and state must become one.
confessional_court: Court expenses can easily bankrupt even the richest nation. In order to achieve a good balance between luxury and sensible expenses, we can adopt small measures to reduce those costs without reducing the magnificence of our court.
artists_advance_reformations: In the wake of the Reformation, new forms of art flourish like blossoms on a vine. It has become easier for artists to gain recognition in their field, and also to find employment in the courts of the world.
early_modern_administation: Over time, it became apparent that a more centralized bureaucracy, with administrative bodies run by educated officials employed directly by the state, was a necessity to complete the ambitious projects of the Early Modern rulers.
town_rights_ref_advance: As our country grows, so does our capital, requiring constant revision and update of the laws affecting it. Only with a functioning capital, with laws and privileges perfectly suited to its size and importance, can our country continue growing.
pan_amalgamation_advance: The Pan Amalgamation is an improvement of the Patio Process that speeds up processing.
construction_speed_reformation: The writing of architectural treatises, which often compile centuries-old knowledge, allows for faster learning and dissemination of effective construction techniques.
generic_bureaucracy_4_advance: As governments grow, so too does the need for a more complex and efficient bureaucracy. By creating specialized departments to handle specific aspects of governance, we can ensure that our administration runs smoothly and effectively.
global_trade_advance: Goods have been moved across continents since antiquity, but all trade is now increasingly becoming part of a greater world network. It may still be early to speak of a truly global economy, but surely the first seeds have been sown.
merchant_power_from_maritime_reformation: The expansion of markets overseas — and the associated expenses and risks — require the creation of merchant associations that share the burden of trading in these new lands.
maritime_advance_age_4: Given the advances of the last century, it seems like the world has become smaller rather than bigger. Countries that had no contact until now are instead engaging in constant diplomatic and commercial relations. As a result, bigger and better fleets are needed to be able to maintain all those overseas connections.
global_trade_routes_advance: The world has become larger, thanks to so many new discoveries, but it has also grown smaller with the proliferation of international trade routes. With ships constantly carrying goods and people to and from far away lands, those distant shores actually seem closer than before.
leader_recruit_cost_advance: Leading troops is not an easy task. Strategy, tactics, mental insight — these are just some of the skills a successful leader must have. Founding officer training schools will ensure that more of our fighting men develop good leadership skills, and give us a bigger pool of expert commanders to draw from as well.
letters_of_marque: Piracy is an appalling act. They are naught but worthless thieves looking to profit from the suffering of others! Formally authorizing ships to raid our enemies, however, is another matter entirely, and could be extremely profitable for us.
sturdy_privateers: Privateers are always in the line of fire. If we wish to utilize their full potential, we must ensure they are not sunk after the first round of cannon fire! Making sure they only sail on the sturdiest vessels will be beneficial to us in the long run — and to the privateers themselves, of course, as they will live longer.
safe_exploration_techniques_advance: Heading into the unknown is always scary, but nowadays, there are few places that are truly undiscovered. While many places around the world have still not been fully explored, they are nonetheless known to us, and we have the knowledge and experience to reach them. With the wealth of knowledge our explorers have collected over their many journeys, we can confidently venture into uncharted territory.
imperial_ambitions: The great empires of the past are a source of inspiration for artists and poets alike, always spoken of with awe and admiration. If we want to generate the same reaction towards our own country, we should aspire to the same grandeur.
spy_construction_reformation: If we want to gather intelligence on our enemies, we must improve our skill in cracking and devising secret codes. We shall lull our enemies into a false sense of security by sending what appear to be only ordinary communications, which shall actually contain hidden, encoded information. A pity our enemies will not be clever enough to understand it!
trade_companies_advance: It has always been plain that money makes the world go 'round. With desirable new products constantly being discovered in distant lands, trade companies that specialize in distributing them are sure to reap enormous profits.
chartered_companies: The world is a big place, and in order to develop our global trade, we must take some serious risks. Luckily there are merchant in our country willing to do so, using mostly their own capital. By sanctioning such companies with a government charter giving them special rights to exercise government powers as well as monopolies in certain areas, we can control and encourage commercial development of everything from foreign trade networks to our colonial possessions overseas.
development_of_maritime_law: With more and more countries sending their subjects or citizens abroad on various trading ventures and with so many living so close to each other for so long times it has become absolutely essential to have at least a basic concept of common laws of the seas. With publications such as 'Mare Liberum' or the later 'De Dominio Maris Dissertatio', the foundations to an international law of the seas have been laid.
trade_envoys: With the recent increase in trade to and from faraway lands, our envoys have started joining trade expeditions to establish diplomatic contacts with countries that were previously out of our reach.
food_advance_reformation: New and improved crops can be introduced to increase agricultural productivity. Whether through selective breeding of existing varieties or importing superior foreign cultivars, we can significantly boost our food production.
artillery_institution_advance: The invention of gunpowder in Sòng China has led to the development of a new device that employs its firepower in warfare: the artillery. These weapons pose a serious threat to stone-built castles and other fortifications.
flintlock_gun: With the development of improved flintlock guns and special ammunition for hunting, our hunters will be even more capable of bagging their prey.
correct_box_advance_reformation: Professional armies have made it possible to create a new type of unit, the regiment, which not only is a permanent position for soldiers, but also a useful battle formation.
spanish_square: The Spanish Square evolved organically from the Pike and Shot formation. At its core was a traditional pike square, and at each corner, it had a group of arquebusiers. This way, they maintained the staying power of the traditional pike square and enhanced it with the firepower of the arquebus.
combined_arms_advance_reformation: Warfare is becoming increasingly complex, driven by the widespread adoption of standing armies composed of soldiers hired for permanent service. The introduction of new weapons, such as firearms and cannons, encourages an approach that balances and combines light and heavy infantry, cavalry, and artillery, supported by auxiliary units.
assault_ability_reformation: By delegating the responsibility of assaulting breaches to our finest and most disciplined troops, we will penetrate even the most formidable fortifications that our foes may hide behind.
supply_depot_advance_age_4_reformation: Generalized deployment of artillery for battlefields and sieges has created a high demand for the ammunition and gunpowder to fuel them, increasing the importance of storage depots.
mercenaries_reformation_advance: It is well understood that mercenaries do not work for free. By promising fair compensation and a share of the plunder, we can assure their loyalty more easily, and ensure the most skilled companies will be willing to work for us
maurician_infantry: The size and depth of the Spanish Square gave it staying power, but made it slow and cumbersome to maneuver on the battlefield. It also led to a large percentage of troops being inactive during battles. Maurice of Nassau, the Stadtholder of the Netherlands, reduced the total number of men in the formation to make it more mobile and reduced its depth, so it maintained the same firepower and shock value.
road_advance_1: The importance of trade and commerce is becoming more and more relevant, and so is the establishment of more complex road networks to facilitate and increase the movement of people and goods.
bole_smelting: A method where lead is smelted in the open air using the constant strong winds at the top of hills to blow fresh air into the melting ore.
slitting_mills: These are a new type of watermills developed for slitting bars of Iron into rods. This allows for more efficient development of Iron tools and machinery, as it allows casters to use rods that more appropriate for their needs compared to bigger bars, wasting less byproduct in the forging process.
pop_promotion_speed_age_4: The Age of Reformation and Confessionalism have renewed interest in organized confessions, and there is demand for more clerics willing to guide their flocks through these troublesome times. These confessional clergy make religious offices much more appealing to those people seeking certainty and spiritual guidance.
shared_products_procedures: The world has become smaller, and we have encountered a plethora of new peoples and undiscovered territory. Along with these discoveries, we have also come into contact with many new products and ways of utilizing them. Even the most specialized goods, like Alum, can be used in other ways in other places.
riches_of_foreign_coasts: Distant lands have brought to us many resources, but not only the lands themselves are rich. Coasts and seas are also plentiful, and the knowledge we have gained from foreign pearl divers allows ours to be more successful in their catches.
foreign_mining_techniques: Precious stones have been appreciated by humanity for millennia. By coming into contact with foreign peoples from faraway lands, we can learn not only about the types of Gems they value most, but also about the techniques they use to obtain them.
subject_income_reformation_advance: The financial responsibilities our subjects have towards us are clearly defined. However, tightening these contracts will ensure timely payments and lead to a healthier treasury.
rgo_size_advance_reformation: As we learn new and better methods of resource extraction, our production will skyrocket, making us richer in the process!
scientific_experimentation: Things happen for a reason. By understanding the explanation behind everything, we can learn what to expect when similar situations arise.
military_administration: The ever-increasing armies of the 16th century have imposed equally heightened demands on national administrations. By creating a permanent organization charged with military supply strategy and operation, and by keeping more troops on the rolls even during winter or peacetime, we will ultimately be able to field large armies more cheaply and to support those armies more efficiently.
lumber_improvements_reformation: Thanks to recent advances in toolmaking, our sawblades are sturdier than ever before and require less maintenance. This will make supplying adequate lumber for economic activities far easier than before.
power_projection_advance_3: The ability to project power beyond our borders is of vital importance to maintaining relevance on the regional stage. By studying the strategies of great powers past and present, we can elevate our nation's prestige everywhere and leverage that reputation to exert power.
war_score_reformations_advance: Victory on the battlefield is the result of more than just good execution of battle plans and war strategies — it is a divine intervention in our favor. Therefore, our right to conquer and annex new territories for which we have spilled blood is an extension of the divine will that champions our supremacy.
naval_morale_advance_3: The recent rise of long-range overseas commerce has accustomed our sailors to being at sea for long periods of time, making them resistant to the adverse effects of long journeys.
diplomatic_range_age_3: The current international situation requires that we set up permanent offices for our diplomats in neighboring countries. It is the only way to ensure that our interests are upheld in our region while we extend our reach beyond it.
regiment_reinforcement_speed_reformation: Use of gunpowder weaponry has become increasingly prevalent among our fighting forces. However, gunpowder is a troublesome material to work with due to its vulnerability to weather and external impact. A specialized flask will protect our gunpowder from the elements, allowing us to supply our troops more easily.
recruitment_improvements_reformation: For our country to create a formidable army, we must improve our recruitment efforts. With increased time and money spent on recruitment centers and activities, we will attract able soldiers with haste.
reformation_subject_opinions_advance: Contracts that define suzerainty over another state cover many different aspects. One such is the domestic trade obligations of the subject to their overlord. As global trade becomes more and more prominent, the expansion of these obligations becomes increasingly important.
renaissance_development: This era of thought, arts, and science will bring forth new waves of discoveries and inventions, allowing us to optimize our adoption of foreign institutions.
improve_relation_impact_renaissance: Diplomatic gifts have been exchanged since ancient times, as a measure of impressing or persuading foreign rulers by emphasizing the high status and enviable wealth of the giver. Gifts could range from fine cloth, to splendid jewelry, to astonishing animals such as giraffes or elephants.
late_feudal_relations: Feudalism is built upon the concepts of auxilium and consilium, or military aid and counsel, owed by vassals to their lords. Over this, this has created an intricate hierarchy of rank, privilege, and reciprocal duties.
medieval_military: Over the past centuries, land armies have become more professional and well-organized. Better systems are in place to support the mix of levies and professional soldiers that now dominate the battlefields, and the infantry is slowly but steadily gaining power, poised to overtake that of the cavalry arm.
naval_morale_advance_1: The advancements made in the field of sailing in recent decades have increased the expertise and confidence of our sailors, allowing them to navigate with confidence in coastal waters.
renaissance_subject_opinions_advance: In recent years, matters of culture, humanism, and natural philosophy have risen in prominence. This cultural influence extends not only to our own people, but also to states who have sworn allegiance to us, making our position as cultural overlords a valuable diplomatic tool.
grant_privilege_cost_modifier_renaissanc: By formally codifying the societal roles of each estate in written law, we will clarify their exact privileges and obligations. When rights and responsibilities are clearly defined, each estate knows exactly what it is owed and what it owes in return, and therefore it will be easier for us to grant new privileges without sparking rivalries.
rgo_size_advance_renaissance: Mills have been used since ancient times. However, we are now able to develop more modern and efficient wind and water mills, which in turn improve our production.
food_advance_renaissance: Agriculture is the foundation of most societies. Recent advances have improved the productivity of our fields and farms, creating valuable food surpluses.
war_no_cb_cost_modifier_renaissance_adva: The nature of war is strongly influenced by which actors are involved. Those with superior capabilities can wage war for longer periods, and thus inter-state wars are becoming increasingly more common.
global_nobles_max_literacy_advance: The nobles are increasingly changing their primary function from being warriors to courtiers in the direct service of their ruler, leading them to give more importance to intellectual matters than military concerns. This has created a demand for engaging literature that appeals to their aristocratic sensibilities.
global_burghers_max_literacy_advance: Members of our merchant class rely on their abilities to make a living, and those abilities in turn depend on their having had a thorough education in certain fields. Their increased wealth also increases their demand for any literature that might broaden their written culture.
global_clergy_max_literacy_advance: Clerics are required to be literate by the nature of their occupation, which centers around learning, interpreting, and spreading their religious doctrine. Therefore, their spiritual formation and overall efficacy relies heavily on their access to religious doctrine and teachings.
land_morale_recovery_renaissance_advance: Managing armies becomes increasingly more complex as they become less reliant on levies. A key aspect of this is improved organization of armies on the march, which helps the troops to be more prepared if a battle occurs.
merchant_power_from_maritime_renaissance: The rising prominence of long-distance trade has led merchants to innovate new ways of making the most of their activities through partnerships. The most common kind is having one partner invest a sum of money in the trading expedition, while the other does the traveling and procurement of goods to be sold after their return.
renaissance_urbanisation: Accounting for dedicated areas for resource exploitation during the planning phase will allow our urban centers to produce more goods than before.
renaissance_city_rights: By establishing that only our ruler can grant city rights, we centralize control over urban development and give our administration a clear overview of the state of our country.
blockade_tactics: Employing effective formations and patrols near enemy ports will make it easier for us to cut off their supply lines, shortening sieges.
recovery_efforts: War is a cruel mistress that leaves behind naught but wreckage and devastation. By concentrating our efforts on assisting our people as they return to ordinary life after so much horror, we can hasten recovery across the realm.
naval_initiative_ren: It is true that victory often comes to those who draw first blood. Exhaustive study and effective implementation of deployment tactics will permit us to mobilize quickly and take initiative in combat situations, helping us achieve that victory.
army_initiative_ren: The element of surprise, combined with landing the first strike, often determines the ultimate victor in an armed conflict. Boosting our military initiative is an excellent way to maintain a competitive advantage.
law_making_renaissance: New times mean new situations, and the laws that have been in place for generations may not be applicable to these new contexts. We should assign legal experts to continuously scrutinize and revise our laws, so that we can adapt them to our current times and needs.
subject_integration: Although having many countries serving us can be beneficial, only by gathering their different titles under our own will we be able to best utilize their resources. In the end, it is clear that a ruler with only one title will pale in comparison to us, with our splendid array of impressive-sounding titles.
rgo_construction_ren: Our country is nothing without its land and its people. Improving the infrastructure of our nation will benefit the common folk as much as it benefits us.
naval_repair_ren: Everyone knows that a hole in a ship's hull will inevitably lead to its sinking. With better building techniques, we can build a hull with more tightly jointed planks, making the ships less prone to leakage and holes in the hull much easier to repair.
construction_speed_renaissance: Freemasons rely on broader associations, known as guilds, to share and preserve their knowledge and experience in a system where veteran masons teach younger apprentices.
renaissance_advance: The waves of innovative thought and discoveries that permeate our realm must be harnessed and utilized if we are to remain at the forefront of technological innovation.
patron_of_art: Our quest towards cultivating a culturally sophisticated society begins here. Our artistic creations will go down in history as the most marvelous wonders of this era.
renaissance_sculptures: The Renaissance has brought with it greater interest in arts in all forms. It seems that nowadays no one is anybody if they do not have a piece of art adorning their homes! Sculptures are one of the most prolific forms of artistic expression, which has led to an increase in the number of quarries as demand for Stone has risen dramatically among the artistically inclined.
renaissance_thought: The notion of a noble oligarchy ruling over society is hardly new, having existed since at least Roman times. This system remains entrenched in the structure of many nations, and the idea is regaining popularity among those who matter...
government_size_renaissance: Rulers traditionally had a council of advisors to counsel them through making important decisions. Over time, our government has grown so complex that we need to establish more permanent advisory positions to help us deal with day-to-day governance.
chancery_records: The growing apparatus of chanceries requires another level of administration, since their bureaucracy is becoming even more complex to manage. This comes in the form of chancery records, an office established to keep all letters received at the chancery, as well as a copy of all the documents issued by its scribes and notaries.
crown_power_advance_renaissance: Traditional governance required rulers to negotiate with estates and balance competing powers. Modern theories of government, however, establish the ruler as supreme authority within the realm — above all other institutions, estates, and subjects, while bowing to no earthly power.
renaissance_court: The Renaissance has spread far and wide, and as a result, our court is attracting dedicated artists and scholars, creating the most splendid works ever made.
power_projection_advance_2: Although the old ideas about forging empires still linger in the minds of the rulers in this age, they have also begun to crystallize new ways of establishing their dominance over other countries and peoples.
anatomy_advance: Physicians are developing a more advanced understanding of the human body, which is leading to more effective treatments for injuries and diseases. This knowledge, largely gleaned from practical dissections of human cadavers, is also helping to improve surgical techniques and reduce the risks of medical procedures.
vibrant_court_advance: Great minds flock to our court from across the known world, bringing with them diverse languages, fashions, and art. As a result of this exposure, we have grown more accommodating of their foreign 'manners'.
banking_advance: Moneylending is old as time, but it is not without risks. We can minimize said dangers if we institutionalize those practices and see that money is loaned under controlled and fair stipulations.
merchants_and_trade: The patterns of trade had been seriously disrupted, possibly due to plagues and pandemics. Now trade is slowly beginning to recover.
standardized_coins: As wealth is created, more and more mints appear. While we have lived with many different currencies for years, official standards have to be set in order to avoid fraud caused by using lesser quantities of precious metals, or by rasping the edges of those coins.
pop_promotion_speed_age_2: The dream of most peasants — to escape poverty and climb the social ladder — is a reality within our society. By rewarding hard work, meticulousness, and the proper embodiment of our ideals, we will never have a shortage of capable and influential people.
trade_range_advance_age_2: As our economy grows, new opportunities arise. Whereas before short-distance trade routes were very profitable, longer-distance routes have recently started to bring in more money. Our merchant vessels are now sailing farther away for the best offers.
rudimentary_coastal_ship_repair: It is unavoidable that ships deteriorate while sailing. The beating of the waves and the bite of saltwater accumulate over time, damaging both the hull and ropes no matter how well-constructed the vessel. To alleviate this, sailors are used to performing regular maintenance on their ships to keep them in prime condition, and when more significant damage is received, even being able to keep it afloat until they reach a safe harbor.
maritime_advance_age_2: As commerce grows, so does the need to more quickly and efficiently transport greater quantities of goods. As such, those invested in maritime trade will spare no expense in building the bigger fleets they can afford.
diplomatic_range_age_1: Diplomacy between countries has always been important. However, the art of diplomatic maneuvering is growing in intensity and complexity, and it has become common to send our envoys ever further afield than before to expand our foreign relations.
spy_construction_renaissance: Espionage has been a valuable tool for empires since ancient times. Spycraft allows us to become better informed about both internal and external threats, and to monitor the activities of potentially dangerous states and actors. The Mongols were masters of this art, using espionage to prepare for and secure the success of their military campaigns.
rebellion_support: These are turbulent times, and not everyone is happy with who rules over them. By contacting these dissatisfied groups abroad, we may be able to turn them to our cause and persuade them to incite a revolt, which would be a devastating tool for destabilizing our enemies.
route_to_the_indies_advance: Trade with the Far East is essential to maintaining our way of life. However, the land route is slow and costly. If we could find a route over the seas, it would open up many business opportunities for our merchants.
pound_lock_canals_advance: We have carved into the very face of Earth in order to gain access to food, affluence, and better circulation of goods. The invention of special gates, called 'Mitre Gates', will assist us in providing the necessities for our people to grow and prosper.
expanded_aqueduct_system: The growth of our urban centers has created an increasing demand for reliable fresh water. If our towns and cities are to flourish, we must commit to greater feats of engineering and expand our aqueduct networks.
professional_armies_advance: The modernization of our armies is largely dependent upon the maintenance of our recruitment and organization centers. We must strive towards preserving a clear and robust military organization, cutting waste and redundancy.
gunpowder_advance: The usage of gunpowder on the battlefield will certainly have a positive impact on our performance and allow us to excel in military engagements.
recruitment_improvements_renaissance: The development of professional armies has increased our military capabilities. To sustain this, the state will need to improve its capacity for recruiting soldiers as well.
drill_army_advance: No longer shall we depend upon untrained levied men. If we are to defend our borders and smite our rivals, we must conduct regular and organized drills.
regiment_reinforcement_speed_renaissance: Professional armies are shifting the way warfare is conducted, as now it is based on permanent units that serve for long periods of time. Maintaining a regular flow of trained soldiers into those units is a challenge, but very much needed for their optimal operation.
supply_depot_advance_age_2_renaissance: No army can survive without supplies. Establishing permanent supply depots dedicated to providing for our fighting forces allows for a continuous feeding of the supply lines, keeping our armies always in peak condition.
correct_box_advance_renaissance: The development of professional armies has led to the appointment of permanent command positions, offices granted by direct commission from the ruler.
vaccination_advance: With the development of vaccines, physicians are able to provide the populace with immunity against deadly diseases. These vaccines are helping to reduce the spread of disease and prevent epidemics. By injecting a small amount of weakened or dead bacteria or virus into the body, the immune system is able to recognize and fight off the disease if it ever encounters it again.
enlightenment_advance: The last century has seen Rationalism and Empiricism gain ever-increasing popularity among the greatest minds of the age. The Light of Reason has been lit, and many will not rest until it has been brought to all corners of the earth.
artists_advance_revolutions: With the rise of the Enlightenment, the arts are flourishing in all forms and at all levels of society. New publications of music and literature are in particular leading to a broad developing interest in these arts.
war_score_revolutions_advance: Wars are always ugly affairs that bring suffering to both sides. Emphasizing this fact, and appealing to our opposition's reason and logic, will surely give us a significant advantage when negotiating the inevitable border changes.
spy_construction_revolutions: As new ideas and political systems raise their heads around the world, there must logically also arise those who protest the status quo. We will need to allocate resources to support these dissenting voices in our rival nations in order to extract valuable information and contribute to their destabilizing effects.
slave_trade_act_advance: The flow of workers to and from our colonies is a lucrative and sensitive affair. As such, we must invest in our legislative attempts to refine it.
separation_of_powers:
An incendiary, anonymous treatise on political theory has emerged. Despite efforts to suppress the text, it is spreading quickly across the world. It analyzes the nature of various forms of government, be they monarchies, despotisms, or democracies, and argues for a strict separation of the executive, legislative, and judiciary branches.

This separation would protect the people and limit monarchical, which is understandably a very popular prospect for many of our subjects. Despite the unfortunate implications for the ruler's authority, these ideas may well benefit our nation greatly.
power_projection_advance_6: Consolidation of countries into bigger nations has resulted in the formation of major powers that dominate huge portions of their homelands, and have every intention of extending their power even further.
rights_of_man: At the forefront of current revolutionary thought is the radical notion of equality for all. Philosophers from around the world have collaborated to create a document entitled the 'Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen', proclaiming that these rights are universal and should be enforced by law. It is likely that this will be ample fuel for popularizing the concepts of freedom and democracy, and we would do well not to lag behind other nations.
diplomatic_range_age_6: With every nation trying to expand its reach even farther, the world has become more interconnected than ever before. Only establishing permanent embassies all over the globe can allow this interconnectivity to sustain itself.
modern_bureaucracy:
In order to best utilize the lands and subjects we control, we must enlarge, reorganize, and professionalize our bureaucracy. We shall create organizations dedicated to administering specific aspects of the state, and thus eliminate the need for ad hoc solutions.

Let us consult with our universities to determine how to most efficiently rule and govern. Meanwhile, we shall encourage our young nobles to serve the state with a pen rather than a sword in hand.
quinine: Although the 'Jesuit's Bark' has been effective in treating malaria in the past, its consumption as dried bark powder leaves much room for improvement. By isolating and extracting the actual healing component from the bark, we can substantially increase the effectiveness of the treatment.
construction_speed_revolutions: The development of more advanced metallurgy of wrought and cast iron allows for more elaborate metallic structures, such as pillars and columns, which makes building construction much faster.
industrialization_advance: The Industrial Revolution has brought about permanent change — not just to commerce and business, but to the social fabric of many nations. Inventions such as the power loom and steam engine shall push the capabilities of mankind to its highest zenith yet.
hot_blast_furnace: The problems posed by the coke blast furnaces, especially the amount of impurities the coke creates in the final cast iron, has led to the development of the hot blast. It not only greatly reduces the use of coke, therefore improving the quality of the Iron, but also allows the use of raw mineral coal as fuel if available, which is a great step forward in Iron metallurgy.
repair_at_sea_aorev: This advanced form of careening is performed in deep coastal waters. Heavy cargo is shifted to one side of the ship to make it heel, allowing the crew to access the opposite side of the hull for repairs without needing to beach the vessel and wait for low tide as with regular careening.
merchant_power_from_maritime_revolutions: The frequent failures of chartered companies have led to the development of a new business model: limited companies, where shareholder liability is limited to their initial investment. This protection from unlimited debt makes such partnerships far less risky and more attractive to potential investors.
maritime_advance_age_6: Trade convoys are obviously a very juicy target for any pirate. Ships full to the brim with goods and coins are a booty that few will let pass through. Thus, providing those trade convoys with defense armament to deter those attacks is vital. Having the trade fleets be accompanied by frigates or any other armed vessel ensures their safety.
revolutions_subject_opinions_advance: The fires of revolution are no trifling threat. If we wish to guarantee the loyalty of our subjects, we must suffocate any notion of uprising in its cradle by appointing trustworthy governors and removing any cause for unrest.
revolutions_agressive_advance:
The international diplomatic theater thrives on a balance of power between the nations. Wars of aggression are frowned upon and, if won, might lead to coalitions forming and uniting against the winner.
Through clever usage of diplomacy and interpretation, however, we can make our enemies appear as the aggressors against us, justifying our warmongering and gains from it in the eyes of the public.
subject_income_revolutions_advance: The world around us is undergoing tremendous change in all sectors. We can capitalize on this instability by formalizing tributary arrangements with subject nations in exchange for supporting them. Sovereign protection, it turns out, has a price.
urbanization: The new opportunities and security offered by life in our emerging cities are drawing more and more people off of rural farms and into cities, where they are eager to take up industrial jobs created by the new, modern factories.
joint_stock_companies: As trade grew, so did the associated risk. New ways of accumulating capital and managing this risk needed to be developed. In joint stock companies, the burden of enterprise was shared among their many shareholders.
insurance_companies: A further reduction of risk came with the development of insurance. By paying a small fee to an insurance broker, merchants could protect themselves against catastrophic losses. This reduced risk of investment led to a subsequent flourishing of trade.
the_gold_standard: The ongoing trade deficit between Europe and China has caused a shortage of silver bullion not only in Europe, but all over the world. Switching from silver to gold coinage will allow new coins to enter circulation and encourage trade to flow in ever greater amounts.
superior_ship_design: Building ships that are slightly faster than those of our opponents, even if the amount of this extra speed is so negligible that it is of no military significance, can still fill our crews with confidence and make our enemy wary of taking us on in an even fight.
road_advance_2: We have constructed rudimentary road networks, but those are quickly showing us why we need to advance our transportation systems. By expanding our road network, we will be able to circulate goods within our territory more easily.
levee_en_masse_advance: Warfare is an ever-evolving concept, having been studied and improved upon for generations and generations. To satisfy the need for expansion and provide the fuel necessary to fulfill these ambitions, new nationwide conscription laws will be drafted. We shall raise armies of young, unmarried recruits, the size of which will leave an indelible mark upon history.
long_rifle: With specific long rifles designed for hunting, our hunters will have a reliable tool for procuring food and furs.
military_tactics_advance_6: With artillery being mobile enough to accompany the rest of the army on the battlefield, its influence is no longer limited to whatever is in firing range. Semi-autonomous artillery formations led by artillery officers can instead be deployed where they are most needed.
napoleonic_warfare: The wars of this age are decided on the battlefield, not in endless sieges. By drilling our soldiers relentlessly and committing them to bold, concentrated assaults, we can shatter the enemy in a single decisive engagement and win the war outright.
combined_arms_advance_revolutions: The regular use of combined arms over several centuries has led to the dominance of this type of warfare. Light infantry and cavalry have the role of weakening and disorganizing enemy forces, while simultaneously screening and protecting their own. Heavy infantry and cavalry bear the brunt of the fighting, seeking decisive charges to rout the enemy, while artillery and auxiliary forces support them from a distance at the rear.
corps_organisation: Traditional armies relied on furious discipline to maintain order in the ranks. By appealing to unit pride, however, we can reach even higher levels of discipline.
march_to_the_sound_of_the_guns_advance: With the steady growth of our army, our logistical needs have changed. Our generals will adopt 'march to the sound of guns' doctrine — ordering dispersed forces to move toward battle independently when they hear fighting. This enables rapid reinforcement without having to await orders.
recruitment_improvements_revolutions: With potential threats emerging from across a wider geographical expanse than ever before, we need to expand our military recruitment accordingly. By offering incentives to volunteers while also pressing criminals into service, we can rapidly mobilize forces to meet any danger.
regiment_reinforcement_speed_revolutions: Modern standing armies are grander than any military force of the past. Tactics are executed by the tens of thousands, and the casualties pile up in unprecedented numbers. Our new military training techniques should offset the high death toll of modern warfare by readying hundreds of soldiers for battle at the same time.
army_movement_speed_revolutions: Paying fair prices for the food and supplies our army needs while moving through a region instead of raiding accelerates our movement through the area, as the peasants themselves will bring their goods to the collection points we establish.
siege_ability_revolutions: Artillery has become so central to modern warfare that specialized officers trained in gunnery techniques and tactical deployment are now essential on the battlefield.
assault_ability_revolutions: Our armies willingly march into the mayhem of cannon fire and dust, carving a path for our troops to take the enemy's forts. Despite advances in artillery and new fortification techniques, our skill in assaulting enemy walls remains unrivaled.
artillery_vs_fort_age_6_revolutions: The need for a weapon that fills the niche between the direct fire of siege cannon and the indirect one of the mortars has led our military to develop new howitzers.
supply_depot_advance_age_6_revolutions: The operation of multiple armies on longer campaigns has put extra stress on our supply systems, making bigger, rapidly constructed depots even more important to sustain them.
correct_box_advance_revolutions: The growth of armies and their deployment in longer campaigns has created a need to assign designated officers to planning and logistics, focused on effectively coordinating the different corps on the battlefield.
advanced_anti_piracy_warfare: In our age of discovery and humanism, there is no longer a place for the thievery and violence that pirates inflict on the high seas. More and more nations are banding together to face this common threat to the well-being and prosperity of all, and have sworn to put an end to this scourge.
public_punishments: Life at sea is full of dangers, and thus the punishments need to be harsh. If wrongdoing is not thoroughly deterred, we will quickly run into trouble. Over time, a system of highly public punishments has evolved, and now the time has come to formalize those proceedings. This will greatly enhance discipline at sea.
impulse_warfare: The introduction of light infantry troops has led to a significant change in warfare. Skirmishers are deployed forward in loose order to distract and harass the enemy before the main infantry attack, which is typically delivered in either a line or a column formation.
enlightened_court: The values of the Enlightenment are ever-present in any modern court, and with them comes the presence of the most intellectual and learned people. Thanks to these illustrious and enlightened courtiers, much more can now be achieved with far less effort.
crown_power_advance_revolutions: After unifying all the powers under the iron fist of our leader, subjects across the nation have suddenly become aware of a sense of belonging. Whatever region our monarchs rule, they are part of the nation and its people all the same.
government_size_revolutions: With the establishment of official forms of popular representation, the government is better able to address important issues than ever before.
town_rights_rev_advance: As the source of our government, our capital is the heart of the nation itself. This fact alone makes it special, and more privileged than the rest.
rotherham_plough: The basic plow in use in Europe has been unchanged since Roman times. Now, thanks to an improved design, the same plow can be made much lighter, reducing the strain on draft animals and thereby getting more work out of them.
cupola_smelting: Using a cylinder-shaped furnace, this method provides a cheap and efficient process of smelting iron, with the unique ability of continuous smelting.
pop_promotion_speed_age_6: The expansion of capitalism has given birth to a new age of social mobility, in which wealth is replacing the traditional hierarchies as means of determining social status. Everyone, from business moguls to clerks to industrial laborers, is eager to buy their way into the upper strata.
rgo_size_advance_revolutions: Steam as a means to power a machine has been understood since antiquity. However, its potential had never been fully realized until recently, when the latest advances in physics and mathematics allowed the creation of more sophisticated steam engines, which in turn can power more complex machines. This allows for increased productivity in all fields.
coal_improvements_revolutions: For the production of coke, a vital part of iron processing, we need many beehive ovens. With improved construction techniques and better usage of bricks, we will be able to accordingly raise the quality of the produced coke.
written_alphabet: What is a society but the sum of its legacy? A written alphabet, therefore, is but the first step towards immortalizing our culture, as well as the foundation of building an educated, well-functioning society.
cultural_traditions_law_advance: Ancient tradition is the foundation of many cultures and civilizations. While progress is what will drive us to greatness, our traditions will always serve us as the reminder of our origins, and as a source for the strength and unity of our people.
cultural_acceptance_advance: It is apparent that as we absorb other peoples into our nation, the foreign traditions they bring with them may cause friction with our own. One way of resolving this is to simply tolerate such foreigners as if they were our own kinsmen, and not to attempt to subdue them to our culture.
mapmaking: Accurately drawing the borders and landmarks of a country is much more than art — it helps us collect information about other nations for strategic purposes. By knowing where important places are exactly, we can not only better coordinate attacks, but also gain more knowledge about our own territory. As the elders often say, knowledge is power.
colonies: Be it by sending our own people to settle in new lands, by imposing our rule over the natives in our overseas holdings, or through a mix of both, establishing a colony creates a foothold for our power that will let us further expand our control — and borders — in these unclaimed territories.
codified_laws: Statutes and regulations are the backbone of any well-functioning society. If we are to hone our efficiency and internal capabilities, a set of robust codified laws is of vital importance.
distribution_of_power_advance: Distribution of Power determines how authority is divided among the ruler, administrative bodies, and estates. The state is a complex and fragile entity — a well-balanced power distribution ensures stability, while giving any single institution too much power risks breeding tyranny or administrative paralysis.
subjects_advance: Granting our subject nations some autonomy over local governance keeps them from revolting while ensuring they continue to provide tribute to the realm.
taxation_advance: Operating a civilized society implies the maintenance of a central authority, and that authority must be supported through some form of currency. By extracting taxes from our subjects and citizens, we will be more productive and better able to achieve great things for our people.
state_administration_advance: Taxing our population is only feasible as long as we know who lives where and what local customs and laws apply to each person. We must establish a comprehensive administration to properly manage our realm.
legalism_advance: Laws and rules mean nothing if they are not compiled, standardized, and made understandable to every member of our society. By codifying clear legal standards and enforcing them uniformly, we will ensure that the principles of order and justice reach the furthest corners of our realm.
medieval_administration: With a military elite in place to govern our society, the next stage of development is to build a literate class of administrators. Typically, these roles will be filled by drawing from the clergy.
pest_house_advance: A small hut outside the of the borders of a community, where the sick and diseased are confined against their will to avoid the spread of plagues to the rest of the citizens.
