banking_country_traditions: While many seek wealth in the opportunities of trade and commerce, our state fills its coffers by offering entirely fair and highly affordable loans.
hospital_advance: Hospitals were first established during the Middle Ages to provide care for the sick, poor, and disabled. Typically run by religious orders, these hospitals offered a range of medical services, including basic nursing care, herbal remedies, and eventually, surgery. They were often located near churches or monasteries and had separate wards for men and women. Despite limited medical knowledge, these hospitals played a vital role in offering sanctuary, comfort, and some form of medical treatment to those in need during a challenging period in history.
agriculture_advance: The land is generous, and provides us with abundant crops and resources. But in order to advance our society and become a prosperous nation, we must learn how to shape and tame the land, and to extract the best possible treasures from it.
windmills_advance: Windmills come in various shape and sizes, as well as diverse sails structure and mechanisms, but they all serve to harness the power of wind to crush grain. As a result, the nutritious value of crops can be greatly improved, and transformed into a wider range of prepared foods.
aqueduct_system: Through carefully laid stone channels and gravity-fed conduits, this construct secures a steady supply of fresh water. While simple in construction, these works mark the first step toward organized urban water management.
alchemy_advance: The art of alchemy involves the creation of potions and elixirs using a combination of herbs, minerals, and other natural ingredients. While not always reliable, the use of alchemy can sometimes produce remarkable results in treating various ailments.
apothecary_advance: An apothecary is a place where medicines can be found and dispensed. These come from a variety of sources, including herbs and other natural remedies, but also from more exotic materials, such as animal horns or mercury.
city_building_advance: Developing our urban centers has become central to national prosperity, and is a cornerstone of the urbanization movement. By systematically constructing infrastructure and specialized buildings within our cities, we will fuel our economic growth.
ranching: Cattle breeding led to the ability to raise entire herds of horses, which in turn has made it possible to breed the best animals for travel, war, and many other tasks.
horse_riding_advance: The domestication of horses has revolutionized the way people move and transport goods. Additionally, the use of horses in combat provides mounted warriors not only with a faster way of moving, but also a higher ground from which to attack their enemies — or even to crush them under the weight of their mounts.
feudalism_advance: Feudalism is a political system that is based on service or labor in exchange for holding and working land. It is a collection of rights and obligations to which each member of a structured societal model is bonded.
trade_caravans: Lucrative trade routes have crossed our territories since ancient times. Our people are used to interacting with long caravan trains of merchants trading in goods from lands far away.
mining_advance: Quarrying has been a basic economic activity since the dawn of humanity. The widespread use of metalworking only increased the importance of prospecting and mining different types of minerals and metals for the development of complex societies.
metallurgy: Metallurgy, the art of manipulating and working metal, stands as one of the defining capabilities of advanced civilization. Metal tools and weapons are far superior than their stone counterparts, enabling both workers and soldiers to operate with better efficiency.
mining_law_advance: This law determines who owns the mining operations in our country.
bronze_working: Bronze is an alloy of Copper and Tin, discovered and developed to make much more durable tools and weapons, as it also more ductile and easier to work with than Copper.
iron_working: Iron is a key material for the production of different types of tools and weapons, making it vital for village blacksmiths as well as large manufacturing chains.
local_smelters_advance: Mother Earth is abundant in metal resources, but little can be done with them unless they are smelted first. As such, smelters tend to be established near where the metals are extracted, to prepare them for easier transportation and further processing elsewhere.
advanced_mining: The development of more advanced and durable tools has made possible to further expand mining operations for new minerals and metals.
fine_metals_mining: The discovery and development of new metal alloys has made it possible to extract and exploit new fine metals on a larger scale, making the process highly profitable compared to other types of mining.
faster_levy_recruitment: All male peasants are required to be proficient with a spear or bow and to train regularly, so as to be a competent soldier if ever they are called to arms.
ship_building_advance: The seas hold many adventures, much wealth, and commercial — as well as expansionist — opportunities.
trade_advance_age_of_trad: As trade routes were revived and expanded during the Middle Ages, new mercantile practices began to appear. One such were trade fairs, large-scale events held annually in towns and cities where merchants and traders from different places could meet and broker deals.
more_merchants_age_of_trad: The formation of guilds has shaped our economy for a long time. While they are common organizations amongst our artisans, the same cannot be said for our merchants. We should encourage our traders to form similar guilds in order to streamline our mercantile ambitions.
organized_religion: Religion plays a major role in every society, yet not every faith has the same structure. An organized religion has its rituals and belief systems systematically arranged, and follows defined doctrines.
scholasticism: Based on Aristotelian logic and the writings of the early Christian Fathers, scholasticism aims to spread knowledge by emphasizing religious dogmatic beliefs and traditions.
guilds: A guild is an association of merchants or craftsmen who have come together for mutual protection, aid, and for the pursuit of their own interests. Guilds establish monopolies of their goods and trade, and set standards for the quality and price of trade goods.
industry_promotion_advance: With established guilds and a network of merchants in place, the crown can actively encourage the growth of chosen industries, directing investment and craft toward the trades it wishes to see flourish.
peasant_connections_advance: Our merchants have established connections to the rural settlements within and beyond our borders. As a result, they are able to secure better prices for food than would otherwise be expected.
construction_speed_traditions: Our construction efforts should never rest and leave our villages and towns idle. Employing a master mason, who will oversee and plan our construction work, we can make significant improvements in expanding our country.
diplomatic_capacity_traditions: Regular diplomatic endeavors require paperwork and detailed documentation of our contacts.
rural_rgo_traditions: We must tame the far reaches of our country in order to expand our economic capabilities. Not only will we provide more space for our people, but we can optimize their contributions to our country.
meritocracy_advance: Merit is not exclusive to the upper echelons of our society. It can be found everywhere, even among the humblest individuals. By creating standardized exams that measure this merit, effort, and overall competency, we can find intellectual jewels hidden in plain sight, and properly appoint them for the betterment of our nation.
educated_bureaucrats: The officials running our administration are not illiterate and lazy heirs to their parent's seats, but rather educated and talented individuals who have earned their positions through effort and merit. An administration like this will undoubtedly run more smoothly and efficiently than any other.
efficient_bureaucracy: Bureaucracy is the oil that makes the wheels of our administration turn smoothly. With the appointment of efficient bureaucrats that have both talent and the will to properly fulfill their tasks, we will ensure the seamless operation of our government structures.
right_to_rule: Our administration is centered around the premise that the most talented people should be assigned to appropriate posts. As such, the ruler should be the most gifted member of the realm, as befits someone who leads an entire country. In the unfortunate case that the ruler might be lacking, we will need people skilled at 'embellishing' the truth to communicate the ruler's extraordinary competence, be it through imposing statues, astonishing paintings, or exalting verses.
smooth_administration: Having an administration composed of the most talented and suitable individuals in our realm helps our country run smoothly and our authority to flow uninterrupted, regardless of any circumstances in which we may find ourselves.
efficient_logistics: Logistics and communications are what allow us to properly administer our entire territory. To facilitate better communication between our provincial governors and the central rulership, we need a well-established network of roads for our messengers to travel upon.
province_governors: Our provinces are not ruled autonomously, nor by any local nobles hungry for power. Instead, governors appointed by our central administration are the ones responsible for extending our authority into every settlement in our country.
appointed_chain_of_command: Having talented military experts leading our men into battle, rather than entrusting that duty to inept nobles who only were put in leadership roles because of their blue blood, make our armies work more efficiently. The result of that is that we can more easily command larger forces.
temporary_appointments: Having our court members serve a position for life carries the inherent risk of them amassing undue power and influence. They also tend to dedicate less effort to their tasks, due to being given excessive responsibilities. To avoid this messiness, we can establish a system of temporary assignments. That way, officials are assigned to the positions they are best qualified for, but can be reassigned with ease should they grow too complacent in their roles.
non_inheritable_offices: Having our court officials pass their offices from father to son is a plague on our administrative system! It does nothing but cause apathy and rot to blight every branch of our authority. All offices should from now on be assigned to those best able to fulfill the required duties, regardless of their lineage.
abacus_advance: Abaci may be ancient technology, but it is precisely thanks to proper accounting tools and ledgers that we are able to keep accurate accounts of our wealth. Without these tools and the talented experts who know how to use them, we would be blind to the actual richness of our country.
power_projection_advance_1: As the countries grew and states consolidated during the High Middle Ages, their ambitions also grew, leading to attempts at creating and recreating empires in their regions.
ledgers_double_checking: A lack of rigor in accounting is what allows corruption to thrive, and rots countries from within! To avoid this threat to our administration, we must ensure that any changes in our treasury are fastidiously accounted for.
talented_traders: Just as we staff our administration with talented officials, we need to ensure our commercial infrastructure is managed by skilled professionals. Having only the brightest minds overseeing our trade operations will keep products moving and revenues flowing without interruption.
government_sanctioned_celebrations: Our people are always eager to celebrate any good tidings, be they in honor of our country or to mark days on the calendar. Instead of letting them hold these joyful gatherings on their own, we should have our administration organize grand public celebrations, so that we can show our people we care about them while fostering a greater sense of unity between them at the same time.
cathedral_advance: A cathedral is one of the largest and most important types of Christian temple, where the Bishop has a cathedra, or seat. While a church can be beautiful and detailed, a cathedral is majestic, of enormous dimensions, and adorned with the finest and most intricate details.
medical_school_advance: Specialized sites for medical training, these schools are where scholars go to learn about the human body, diseases, and how to treat and prevent them.
construction_center_advance: This allows more constructions to be done at the same time in an town or city.
local_governor_advance: A seat of regional authority that extends the reach of the state to its most distant lands, expanding its influence beyond its immediate surroundings. When connected to the capital by the road network, they act as hubs for governance and administration.
mint_advance: The Minting Office is the main manufacturing building which creates the currency of the state. Different metals enter the office to be forged into coinage for the public.
counting_house_advance: The Counting House is an office which keeps track of the financial books of the businesses of the town. Appointments and correspondences related to businesses related to payments are handled as well.
merchants_quarters_advance: Bustling with traders, these quarters house shops and storage, serving as the economic heart where deals and exchanges flourish.
colonial_administration_advance: Overseas colonies are often hubs for the exchange of a wide variety of goods and products. As a result, the administrative dependencies also flourish, supporting and regulating the activities of colonial traders.
grand_marketplace_advance: This is a grand place of commerce, where deals and exchanges flourish.
commerce_center_advance: This lively center of commerce is where goods from near and far are exchanged for gold. This is the beating heart of the local trade.
port_authority_advance: The Port Authority oversees maritime traffic, enforcing regulations, collecting tariffs, and ensuring the safe flow of goods and business through the harbor.
silk_production_guild_advance: Feeding Fiber Crops to silkworms lets our guilds spin Silk of our own, freeing our realm from dependence on the long trade routes of the Silk Road.
porcelain_kiln_advance: Porcelain is a type of ceramics characterized by its strength and translucence due to the vitrification of the materials caused by high temperatures. The Porcelain Kiln specializes in the creation and decoration of such wares.
lacquerware_guild_advance: Combining sap from lacquer trees in multiple layers, gives the produced items their signature glossy finish, in a Lacquerware Artisans' Guild. Such sought-after high quality items include furniture, ceremonial boxes, and more. Lacquerware is highly valued for its beauty and resilience.
scriptorium_advance: A specialized center where scribes meticulously copy manuscripts, the Scriptorium produces a variety of texts of religious, legal or even literary nature, in an effort to preserve and disseminate knowledge.
paper_guild_advance: Paper is the cornerstone of every realm, as it is used in every aspect of it, from administration to education and even trade. Thus, the Papermakers' Guild ensures the proper standard of production and volume, as well as a unique technique that involves the soaking, pulping or pressing of basic supplies such as linen, cotton or other plant fibers.
gun_smith_advance: Dedicated to the production and maintenance of firearms, the Gunsmith produces various quality firearms as well as related components such as barrels, locks, and triggers.
unlock_handgonners_advance: Handgonners wield a new type of gunpowder-filled weapon that fires deadly lead shells, wreaking havoc on enemy lines, though they need to be fully protected as their handgonnes are very slow to reload.
cannon_maker_advance: A guild specialized in crafting and assembling cannons. These powerful weapons are essential for sieges and defense.
slave_center_advance: Properly managing bonded labor within our realm is imperative to the continued affluence of our people.
weapon_workshop_advance: The ever-increasing demand of weapons both for our armies and our hunting operations requires us to increase the capabilities of the Weaponry production.
naval_supplies_workshop_advance: Naval Supplies play a vital role in the supply and upkeep of our maritime ambitions. With bigger production spaces we will be able to maintain our position and increase our output.
paper_workshop_advance: Paper is a necessity for all types of advanced accounting, administration, and diffusion of knowledge. The Paper Workshop specializes in the creation of new Paper with lump, Fiber Crops and Lumber.
printing_press_shop_advance: Utilizing easily produced and replaceable parts the Printers Shop will reduce both our cost in labor and materials to produce and spread written documents among our population.
beer_workshop_advance: Brewed in larger workshops with ample storage for the process of fermentation, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks than before.
saltpeter_workshop_advance: With the increasing demand for gunpowder by our forces, a reliable production of artificial Saltpeter is a necessity.
distillers_workshop_advance: By distilling in larger workshops with ample storage for aging, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks.
tanning_workshop_advance: The production of Leather has refined and allows for a wider scope of produced hide materials and increased output.
cloth_workshop_advance: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.
fine_cloth_workshop_advance: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Fine Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.
tools_workshop_advance: With the expanding of our economy, no longer can our people rely on artisan-made tools. The establishment of proper workshops for the production of tools for our population and business has become a necessity.
pottery_workshop_advance: Pottery is a staple in all population, from simple storage vessels to ornamentation objects. Streamlining its production in specialized workshops will serve to satisfy the people's need for pottery.
glass_workshop_advance: Glass is a vital part of the every-day needs of our entire population. The increased capabilities of the Glass Workshop will ensure that our efforts will not grind to halt.
dyes_workshop_advance: Dyes and pigments can be created from a variety of sources, but they need to be processed in a certain manner, usually only known to a selected people.
furniture_workshop_advance: With the rising wealth of our burghers so rises their demand for goods like Furniture. Shifting the production into larger workshops will ensure more Furniture can be produced.
cannon_workshop_advance: The ever-increasing demand of artillery for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Cannon production.
guns_workshop_advance: The ever-increasing demand of guns for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Firearms production.
naval_supplies_manufactory_advance: Similar to the Naval Supplies Guild, so does the Naval Supplies Manufactory focus on the production of Naval Supplies. Thanks to its increased dimensions, the output of available supplies for the ship construction is significantly higher.
firearms_manufactory_advance: Often described as the lifeblood of our military production complex, the Firearms Manufactory produces firearms of many shapes and sizes such as pistols, rifles, and more.
cloth_manufactory_advance: Cloth represents the various fabrics and clothing made from wool and linen. The Textile Manufactory specializes in the production of Cloth from various materials such as Wool, Cotton and Fiber Crops.
printing_manufactory_advance: The introduction of new printing techniques allows printers to produce more Books than before.
putrefaction_works_advance: Saltpeter is a valuable chemical compound which finds its uses as a fertilizer, salt for meat processing and as key ingredient for gunpowder. The Putrefaction Works serves as an alternative way to gain Saltpeter for cases where mining operations are not available.
fine_cloth_manufactory_advance: Fine Cloth is traditionally a marker of status for the elites and wealthy classes. The Fine Cloth Manufactory focuses on the crafting of these valuable textiles using Cloth or Silk.
perfumery_advance: Cultivating flowers and extracting their essence, the Perfumery produces a luxury good for the wealthy.
glassworks_advance: Refinement of traditional Glassblowing techniques and the addition of new materials make it easier to mass-produce Glass.
dyesworks_advance: A dedicated and expanded dyes production will ensure that our population gets access to as much variety of pigments and colors as they desire.
porcelain_manufactor_advance: The production of Porcelain is the result of long alchemical experiments, allowing an alternative to the expensive import from overseas.
tannery_manufactory_advance: Advancements in chemistry make the process of tanning animal hides significantly shorter and produce higher quality Leather
pottery_manufactory_advance: The growing demand for commercialized ceramics has led to the creation of economies of scale. The production of manufactured goods using a common, organized workflow, renders pottery-making no longer a craft profession.
furniture_manufactory_advance: Artisanal carpentry might not be enough to meet the demand for furniture, especially in urban environments filled with bourgeoisie eager for more specific products. Organizing furniture manufacturing in larger workshops might be necessary to meet this growing demand.
distiller_manufactory_advance: A center of production where the secrecy of an old time guild is drowned by the great demand for increased amounts of distilled goods. This need has shaped a new and modern system of production that prioritizes quantity and profit.
brewery_manufactory_advance: The necessity for huge amounts of brewed drinks is resulting in more centralized centers of production where the old artisanal process has been systematic and mechanized.
winery_manufactory_advance: The ever-growing demand for refined fermented drinks has led to the creation of vast production centers where tradition meets industry. Ancient methods of wines are scaled up to serve bustling cities and far-reaching trade networks, ensuring no cup is left empty.
lacquerware_manufactory_advance: Refinements of the process of painting and applying the lacquer make Lacquerware cheaper and quicker to produce.
iron_foundry_advance: Tools made from Iron will be sturdier than any other known production while not requiring the same time-consuming crafting process.
weapon_manufactory_advance: Various weapons such as swords, pikes, and bows make up the core Weaponry of every army. Using various materials, the Weaponry Manufactory creates melee and simple ranged weapons of all types.
cannon_foundry_advance: In a Cannon Foundry cannons are cast and assembled from molten metal. Key for equipping armies with artillery, enhancing a state's military capabilities.
paper_manufactory_advance: The increasing demand for Paper due to the printing industry forces innovative methods to up the production of Paper as well.
printing_mill_advance: New techniques involving the usage of chemicals and more durable print plates allows the mass production of Books.
paper_mill_advance: Utilizing Cloth made from Cotton, a Paper Mill will be able to produce higher quantities of paper.
putrefaction_mill_advance: By increasing the quantity of our boilers for the process of concentrating the Saltpeter and improving their reliability, we will be able to increase the production of gunpowder for our troops without the reliance on costly imports.
tannery_mill_advance: With the use of new chemicals and more efficient production methods, our Leather production will be unrivaled.
naval_supplies_mill_advance: The steady increase in trading across the globe requires more Naval Supplies than ever before and dedicated mills are required to supply it.
brewery_mill_advance: Large Breweries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.
distiller_mill_advance: Large Distilleries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.
iron_mill_advance: Utilizing blast furnaces, the Iron Mill will produce Tools at much higher quantity than any other method available.
textile_mill_advance: Powered by Waterwheels, a Textile Mill can mass-produce Cloth at rapid speed.
fine_cloth_mill_advance: Powered by Waterwheels, a Fine Cloth Mill can mass-produce Fine Cloth at rapid speed.
steel_mill_advance: An increase in the reliability of our furnaces and production process made it possible to produce Steel on an economically beneficial scale.
pottery_mill_advance: The growth in the supply generated by manufactured ceramics has led to its ultimate logical consequence: the development of mass production, in which industrial workers are now responsible for producing the ceramics.
glass_mill_advance: Dedicated Glass Mill industries will be able to increase our production of Glass further than ever before. By rolling molten glass on iron tables, we will not only be able to increase the size of our produced Glass but also significantly speed up the manufacturing process.
dyes_mill_advance: Only by extensive manufactories dedicated to the production of various dyes, will we be able to satisfy the increasing need for pigments and fancy colors.
furniture_mill_advance: Rising social wealth generates a growing demand for manufactured goods such as furniture. The only way to continue increasing supply may be to produce them in factories using industrial methods.
weapon_factory_advance: Military importance has increased much more in recent years. As such, better and new methods of producing armament for our soldiers are needed, and entire factories dedicated for such purpose are being established.
firearms_factory_advance: The rising demands of protecting our borders come with an increase in the production and demand quotas from our military production complex. This need is met by the Firearms Factory where large quantities of guns are made.
gun_factory_advance: A large-scale factory where cannons were manufactured in bulk. Its expanded production capacity is a great way to facilitate the growing needs of our military forces.
armory_advance: The development of Professional Armies has created the need of getting new sources of manpower for our armies. The Armory can be built in towns and cities to increase it.
training_fields_advance: The Training Fields can be built in rural location as another source of manpower for our armies.
barracks_advance: The Barracks are a more efficient way of increasing the manpower we need for our armies by replacing the Armory in towns and cities.
regimental_camp_advance: The Regimental Camp is a more efficient way of increasing the manpower we need for our armies by replacing the Training Fields in any rural location.
conscription_center_advance: The Conscription Center is the most efficient building increasing the manpower needed for our armies. It replaces the Barracks in towns and cities and the Regimental Camp in any rural location.
dock_advance: A dock is the most basic shore infrastructure that allows for the building and repairing of boats.
protected_harbor_advance: Some places are more naturally suited to serve as a harbor than others, but with the proper infrastructure those conditions can be improved anywhere.
dry_dock_advance: It is a port building that provides the necessary infrastructure to construct and repair boats in isolated dry basins that can be flooded at will. This ease of access to the hull of the ship improves in great measure the efficiency and capacity of the building process.
shipyard_advance: The Shipyard expands the capabilities of our port to new heights, increasing the number of vessels that can be serviced and built while also augmenting the amenities for the crew of those ships.
grand_shipyard_advance: This massive port infrastructure is a sight to behold, with innumerable vessels and sailors coming and going at any given time. Its ability to build and repair whole fleets make it a pinpoint for our expanding maritime power.
naval_base_advance: A whole section of the coast has been enclosed and specialized for the construction and maintenance of our grand fleet. This small city of sailors, craftsmen, and engineers is capable of building entire navies by itself, making it one of the most important strategic centers of our country.
coastal_fort_advance: As the threat of pirates and hostile fleets approaches, a set of rudimentary coastal fortifications are called for, to protect us from invasions.
naval_battery_advance: The natural evolution of defensive warfare has culminated in the development of intricate coastal defenses, ready to repel even the heaviest of hostile invasions.
castle_advance: A Castle is usually a fortified residence of the nobility or the headquarters of a military order. However, the Castle here serves first and foremost as a defensive structure protecting the location from invading forces.
bastion_advance: Due to the advances of Artillery, the Castle is no longer sufficient to withstand the power of gunpowder. The Bastion negates the advantage of the cannon thanks to its superior design, offering them a greater passive resistance and more space for ranged defenses.
star_fort_advance: Unlike its predecessor, the medieval Castle, the Star Fort is a very flat fortification composed of many triangular bastions at its corners and an additional ditch. This allows the defenders to counter enemy Artillery while still being able to keep climbing infantry at bay.
fortress_advance: The Fortress is the most advanced defensive structure, created by military engineers to withhold the power of the most advanced artillery. They are complex compounds, made of interconnected bastions and casemates, which are designed to maximize the defensive firepower.
library_advance: These secular institutions are studying and meeting places for scholars and the wealthy, where they can research many topics and learn about philosophy, mathematics, religion, and science. They can be independent but will often be linked to the patronage and influence of a University.
confucian_school_advance: These learning institutions focus their efforts in the education and training of government officials in the Confucian ideals.
confucian_academy_advance: Private learning schools for elite-class students who are learning the Confucian teachings and ideals to pass the national service examinations.
university_advance: A center of thought and innovation, the University is home to bright minds of scientists and men of letters alike, all eager to promote growth and literacy.
opera_house_advance: Magnificent and ornate buildings specialized in the display of opera performances and usually built thanks to the patronage of wealthy and influential individuals.
theater_advance: A building used by artists to perform plays, concerts and other theatrical works.
royal_court_advance: The pinnacle of the state, the Royal Court is the center of the monarchs power and splendor.
republican_assembly_advance: The heart of our republic, the Republican Assembly is an incredibly vital institution, allowing us to be governed by noble virtue and excellence.
order_headquarters_advance: Establishing loyal Orders will undoubtedly increase our local defensive capabilities and make it easier to recruit able-bodied fighters.
weapon_guild_advance: An association of craftsmen responsible for the production of various weapons, guilds such as this are a pillar for state defense, supplying the common soldier with arms tailored to specific martial needs and volume.
chancery_advance: A chancery is a bureaucratic office that medieval rulers developed for governing their domains as societal changes made them more complex and increasingly difficult to manage. The main function of a chancery is to write, send, and receive documents related to the management of these domains.
art_school_advance: Dedication to the aesthetic crafts, and the refinement of our artists, must be properly cultivated by the establishment of art schools. Each shall be an incubator for gifted individuals to commence their artistic careers and bring glory and splendor to our nation!
admiralty_advance: The Admiralty is tasked with the protection of our maritime interests. With military and civil administration both represented in one, the balance of interest will be fairly represented.
war_college_advance: The War College serves as a place where veteran officers educate and train the coming generation of generals, ensuring the superiority of our army.
tax_assessor_advance: The Tax Assessor enforces the will of the ruler to collect the proper amount of taxation.
supreme_court_advance: Supervising the law of our country, the Supreme Court is the central institution to dictate and enforce our law.
arts_academy_advance: Art is the life-breath of humanity, and what turns the world from a bland existence into a vibrant canvas full of wonders and possibilities. We must foster greater artistic curiosity among our people.
entrepot_advance: Located at the heart of a bustling and vibrant market, the Entrepôt is the best place for our mercantile efforts to flourish.
trading_hub_advance: A vital point across our trade network, the Trading Hub constitutes a great place to sell and purchase many exotic and local goods.
customs_house_advance: Our realm is home to a lively market, with many merchants importing fascinating goods from far-away lands. The regulation of such goods and the control of this flow, falls under the jurisdiction of the Customs House.
stock_exchange_advance: An important meeting place of brokers, merchants and investors, the Stock Exchange greatly facilitates business and the flow of shares in joint-stock companies.
clearing_house_advance: The exchange of payments and advanced transactions are some of the principal conducts of business within our realm. The Clearing House offers the environment to further increase our grip across the trade that flows through our realm.
house_of_parliament_advance: A building to house a permanent parliament, to keep it central and under better control.
fortress_church_advance: The Fortress Church is a building with a dual purpose. It serves its community as a normal church with all its religious functions, but is also used in case of sieges as a defensive building.
early_council_hall_advance: A ruler cannot be in all places of the country at once. By delegating governance to local authorities, the authority of the court can be made manifest even in the most remote parts of our country.
council_hall_advance: Any form of local governance needs a proper place for its gatherings and adequate function. A building of sufficient size and equipment and with a big enough debating chamber are crucial.
modern_council_hall_advance: The growth of towns and cities and the increased governmental needs consequently require an expansion of the building housing the local authorities, to be able to continue performing their function adequately. The increased size of archives and registers are all to serve as an expansion of the authority of the court itself.
unlock_footmen_advance: The backbone of every army, footmen comprise the majority of our marching troops, eager to sustain a frontline and defend our home from prospecting invaders.
unlock_archers_advance: Archers support our footmen with ranged fire, allowing them to advance towards enemy lines when attacking and also helping them better protect their position when defending.
unlock_feudal_levy_advance: A Feudal Levies is formed by peasants that are drafted in times of war as part of their duty towards their feudal lord, and have some military training. These levies are to eventually be replaced by professional armies.
unlock_men_at_arms_advance: Armored footmen outfitted with a medley of hand-to-hand weapons, Men-at-Arms are heavy melee infantry who can break through enemy formations.
unlock_crossbowmen_advance: Crossbowmen are a type of ranged fire unit that harness the increased firepower of crossbows, a much more powerful, albeit slow-reloading, projectile weapon.
unlock_reformed_crusader_knights_advance: Adapting to the changing warfare, the Crusader Sergeants have adopted new tactics and refined weaponry. With these adaptions they will retain their status as the elite foot forces of the Military Orders, side by side with the Order Knights.
unlock_peasant_levy_advance: A Peasant Levy is formed by commoners summoned for military service by their Lord. The men are meant to bring their own equipment to battle, so the quality of newly created units can vary greatly.
unlock_halberdiers_advance: Halberdiers are units of soldiers that wield polearms, such as halberds, which are used for close combat, both offensively and defensively.
unlock_early_arquebusiers_advance: The arquebus is the evolution of the handgonne, making it a more reliable type of gunpowder weapon as it is easier and faster to reload, making it ideal for deploying larger gunpowder fire units.
unlock_matchlock_levy: The development of the matchlock arquebus makes it possible to arm large numbers of soldiers with gunpowder weapons on a scale that was not possible in the Middle Ages.
unlock_arquebusiers_advance: A pike-and-shot formation consisting of a core of troops armed with firearms and protected by a phalanx of armored pikemen, the Arquebusiers are a formidable unit that cannot be easily countered.
unlock_pikemen_advance: Pikemen are footmen armed with pikes, allowing them to form dense formations that easily confront enemy cavalry charges, thus negating the power of cavalry on the battlefield.
unlock_flintlock_levy: The flintlock musket has replaced the matchlock arquebus as the primary infantry weapon, providing greater and more accurate firepower while being easier to use and maintain.
unlock_hunters_advance: Hunters are light infantry designed to attack enemy formations from long range as they approach, attempting to disorganize them and make their own firepower much less effective.
unlock_musketeers_advance: The musketeers are the elite fighting force of the royal household. Being a musketeer is a position of great prestige and only nobles with years of military service are allowed to join the company's ranks.
militiamen_advance: The generalization of muskets as the main firearms during the 17th century allows local Militiamen units to be deployed as reserve and support units for the main armies on the battlefield.
unlock_sharpshooters_advance: Sharpshooters are a type of light infantry unit made up of the best marksmen, who use rifles with a longer range, making them better at skirmishing and disrupting enemy formations while maneuvering.
unlock_fusiliers_advance: Fusiliers are the backbone of our armies, armed with a modern ranged rifle and a bayonet that can be attached to it and enables the possibility of massed charges into enemy ranks.
unlock_grenadiers_advance: Evolved from earlier units equipped with explosives, these Grenadiers serve as elite vanguards for our armies. While the grenades from which their name comes are no longer their sole focus, their superior training makes them excellent assault troops.
conscription_advance: Reluctant soldiers obligated to fight, massed Conscripts can overwhelm a trained army through numbers alone.
unlock_horsemen_advance: Lightly-armored fighters mounted upon swift horses, bands of Horsemen have the mobility to harass, charge, and pursue.
unlock_armored_horsemen_advance: Horsemen who are more heavily armored, usually with some form of mail or full plate, to charge headlong into enemy ranks.
unlock_crusader_knights_advance: In a knightly order, its members are required to be proficient in combat, and serve the order's interest in battle. Thus, the Crusader Knights are the best mounted soldiers any order can offer.
unlock_cavalry_advance: Cavalrymen are light cavalry, sometimes armed with ranged weapons, used to attack enemy lines, although they may sometimes be ready to charge into close combat.
unlock_heavy_cavalry_advance: A heavier type of cavalry, fully armored and trained for shock charges, thanks to its heavy armor and armament, which should lead to the disruption of the enemy line.
unlock_lancers_advance: Strong cavalry armed with a lance, these shock troops are meant to break through enemy lines and devastate our foes' forces.
unlock_light_lancers_advance: Light Lancers are a type of light cavalry more focused on shock combat, as they use a charging lance, also wearing some degree of armor. However, they base their success on the battlefield on maintaining a high degree of mobility.
unlock_pistoleers_advance: Pistoleers are light cavalrymen armed with pistols, a type of gunpowder weapon that is easier to carry and handle on horseback, but can also be used as a melee weapon, thanks to its heavy, reinforced grip.
unlock_heavy_lancers_advance: Heavy Lancers are the heaviest type of shock cavalry possible, and feature fully armored armor and the finest shock lances. Their charges are designed to completely disrupt the enemy formation, and they are also much more protected from enemy fire at range.
unlock_hussars_advance: The hussars were originally light cavalry troops originating in Central Europe that were used for scouting, but with the decline of the old feudal army they were switched over to professional regiments.
unlock_gallop_cavalry_advance: Gallop Cavalry is a shock unit that charges the enemy with long cavalry sabers, protected with a certain degree of armor, which is a good balance between mobility and forcefulness.
unlock_light_dragoons_advance: Light Dragoons are a type of light cavalry that can move, dismount, and shoot at the enemy with the rifles they carry, but are also armed with cavalry sabers, which allow them to charge the enemy if the opportunity arises.
unlock_cuirassiers_advance: Keeping up with the changing times, Cuirassiers are heavy cavalry that have discarded lances in favor of pistols and sabers as their primary weapon.
unlock_camel_1_advance: Lightly-armored riders mounted on swift camels, Camelry excel in the arid wastes of the desert, harassing enemies and exploiting their superior mobility on open terrain.
unlock_camel_2_advance: Camel Archers are camel-mounted bowmen who use the height and stability of their mounts to rain arrows upon enemy formations, then break off before they can be caught.
unlock_camel_3_advance: The Mehari ride swift racing camels bred for speed and endurance, acting as fast-moving scouts and skirmishers capable of crossing vast desert stretches that would exhaust horse cavalry.
unlock_camel_4_advance: Camel Pistoleers are camel-mounted cavalry armed with pistols, combining the endurance of their desert mounts with the firepower of gunpowder weapons to strike at enemy formations and withdraw before they can retaliate.
unlock_camel_5_advance: Organized into formal regiments, Camel Cavalry are drilled camel-mounted soldiers who combine firearms with the desert-crossing endurance of their mounts, forming the backbone of armies operating in arid regions.
unlock_camel_6_advance: Camel Dragoons are modern camel-mounted soldiers trained to both ride and fight on foot, using their mounts' exceptional endurance to traverse desert terrain that would be impassable to conventional cavalry.
unlock_houfnice_advance: It is believed modern howitzers have their name from the Houfnice artillery developed by the Hussites in the 15th century. These short-barreled guns were mounted on wagons and used on the field of battle to fire balls and canisters in support of the infantry.
unlock_falconet_advance: The Falconet is a light cannon developed in the 15th century as an evolution of the similar falcon, being more mobile while firing smaller caliber shots.
unlock_chambered_cannon_advance: The 16th century did not only see improvements in artillery maneuverability but also in the attempts at standardizing the size and weight of artillery pieces.
unlock_royal_mortar_advance: From the second half of the 17th century the use of artillery on the battlefield became more widespread. The troops were now able to move their field guns with much more ease and speed.
unlock_flying_battery_advance: Artillery is devastating on the battlefield, but completely useless if the enemy does not enter its firing range. A Flying Battery has the capability of relocating itself to where it is most needed and quickly redeploy before any enemy's retaliation.
unlock_supply_carts: The Supply Carts are the lifeline of any army wanting to venture outside home territories. They provided food to the men and the animals, extending the distance the army could travel before stopping to forage what can be very hostile lands.
unlock_supply_convoy: The transition from feudal levies to standing armies in the Discovery is allowing longer campaigns, creating the need to supply those soldiers for longer periods. That comes from the more organized Supply Convoy.
unlock_baggage_train: The generalization of standing armies in the Reformation is further developing the supply needs of their soldiers, the use of a Baggage Train that follows the advance of the armies becoming commonplace.
unlock_wagon_train: The growth in the size of armies during the Absolutism is making their logistics increasingly complex, making each army dependent on its own Wagon Train to maintain its combat performance in the field.
unlock_logistics_corps: A strict operation consisting of supply trains and an efficient bureaucracy, Logistics Corps represent the pinnacle of military organization during the Revolutions to support vast armies.
unlock_early_carrack_advance: The early carrack was the first European vessel that could sail on the high seas of the Atlantic Ocean. The design of this late medieval ship combined the features of Germanic longships and Arabic merchantmen. It was less maneuverable than the caravel, but because of its larger size, it could carry provisions for long voyages, cargo for trade, and guns for self-defense.
unlock_carrack_advance: The design of the carrack, a late medieval ship, combined the features of Germanic longships and Arabic merchantmen. It was less maneuverable than the caravel, but because of its larger size, it could carry provisions for long voyages, cargo for trade, and guns for self-defense. Some carracks such as the English vessel 'Henri Grâce à Dieu' weighed more than 1,000 tons, had large fore and aft castles, and could be considered as the greatest warships of their time.
unlock_galleon_advance: A large, usually three-masted sailing ship originally designed as a warship but later on used primarily for trade and commerce.
unlock_twodecker_advance: Two-deckers were warships that held two fully-armed decks with guns. Other guns could also be carried additionally on the forecastle or the quarterdeck, but only the batteries of the two main decks formed a continuous battery.
unlock_threedecker_advance: Three-deckers were warships that held three fully-armed decks with guns. Other guns could also be carried additionally on the forecastle or the quarterdeck, but only the batteries of the three main decks formed a continuous battery. Three-deckers were considered ships of the line, that is strong enough to participate in the line of battle.
unlock_ship_of_the_line_advance: Some alterations to the standard Three-decker design, these ships will serve as flagships and the pride of the navy. While they are expensive to operate, these ships are potentially able to win combats on their own, due to their sturdier hull and superior firepower.
unlock_war_galleon: Refocusing the design of the Galleon towards duties of warfare, the War Galleon will give us a great advantage in naval warfare.
unlock_baochuan: The Bǎochuán is a large vessel designed to transport goods and protect the trade on sea. They are capable of long distance voyages, bringing treasure and tribute from far away shores to our lands.
unlock_barque_advance: The Barque was a small sailing ship, originally used for trade. Adapting these for warfare provided a smaller and faster alternative to the larger carracks.
unlock_caravel_advance: The caravel was a small, very maneuverable ship which could sail with high precision on long discovery journeys. Although designs varied, a caravel had a foresail, a square mainsail and a lateen mizzen. Its smaller size limited the number of guns onboard, but it also meant that this light ship could explore shallow coastal waters and estuaries. Vasco Da Gama, Cabot, Columbus and Magellan used caravels during their late 15th century and early 16th century voyages.
unlock_pinnace_advance: With the increasing overseas trade, there was a need for a fast escort vessel to provide a safe journey. The Pinnace was developed for this. It was a smaller, leaner warship with one gun deck, and it provided protection from piracy in dangerous waters.
unlock_frigate_advance: As time passed, the frigate evolved. It became larger and heavily armed, sometimes with two gun decks. The frigate's combination of speed and firepower meant that it could outrun any ship with more guns and outgun any faster ships. The fleet built by the Commonwealth of England in the 1650s consisted almost exclusively of frigates.
unlock_heavy_frigate_advance: The heavy frigate was introduced by the British in the 18th century as a larger variant of the frigate in terms of both size and power of its guns. Having more and bigger guns meant an increase in their firepower and resulted in ships of individually greater force. Heavy frigates became the standard frigates during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.
unlock_bomb_ketch: The Bomb Ketch is a specialized light ship to carry out shore bombardments. Sacrificing most of their cannons in exchange for mortars able to carry out heavy bombardment of stationary targets along the shoreline, these vessels can trivialize the siege of coastal fortifications.
unlock_dhow: A common trading ship in the Indian Ocean, the Dhow is a capable vessel for trading in the region, despite its small hull size.
unlock_traditional_galley_advance: Galleys of various forms have dominated the seas for millennia, and many remote shipwrights still construct them in the traditional ways. The skill of ship construction is passed down from generation to generation, although with little innovation.
unlock_m_galley_advance: With roots back to the ancient ships of antiquity, the galley remained the prime choice for Mediterranean naval warfare until the 16th century. The galley was primarily propelled by oars, usually about 25 pairs manned by up to three men each. This meant that they were less dependent on wind gauges compared to sailing ships, and their maneuverability made them a feared adversary. Eventually, the galley went out of regular use with the introduction of more advanced oceangoing men-of-war, but remained useful in shallow waters until the 18th century.
unlock_war_galley_advance: War galleys are galleys used for war. They are long and shallow, propelled mainly by oars, although they generally also included some kind of sail. Used since ancient times, their presence was commonplace in the seas and oceans during the Middle Ages thanks to their higher maneuverability. Being used for boarding rather than long-range engagements, projectile weapons and guns were concentrated on the front of the ship, leaving the protection of the weak spots of the sides and the rear to the ability to out-maneuver their enemies.
unlock_galleass_advance: The galleass was an adaptation of the large merchant galley to counter the increasing use of man-of-war. Larger than the galley, the galleass had about 32 oar pairs, each oar manned by up to five men. As an answer to the men-of-war's armament and higher sides, the galleass had forecastles and aftcastles and gun decks above the rowers. This extra weight meant that they also had to rely more on sails, and were slower and less maneuverable compared to galleys. Like the galley, the galleass went out of regular use with the introduction of more advanced oceangoing men-of-war, but remained useful in shallow waters until the 18th century.
unlock_xebec_advance: A two or three-masted small vessel widely used in the Mediterranean from the 16th century onwards.
italian_galleass: The galleass was an adaptation of the large merchant galley to counter the increasing use of man-of-war. Larger than the galley, the galleass had about 32 oar pairs, each oar manned by up to five men. As an answer to the men-of-war's armament and higher sides, the galleass had forecastles and aftcastles and gun decks above the rowers. This extra weight meant that they also had to rely more on sails, and were slower and less maneuverable compared to galleys. Like the galley, the galleass went out of regular use with the introduction of more advanced oceangoing men-of-war, but remained useful in shallow waters until the 18th century.
unlock_archipelago_frigate: The Baltic Sea can be a dangerous place to navigate with warships. Its treacherous shallow waters require ships to operate with a small draft, otherwise risking loss of navigation and effectiveness. The Archipelago Frigate, a sailing ships equipped with oars, is well suited for the waters of the Baltic and will grant an edge in swiftness and lethality to the navy.
unlock_cakradonya: A large and heavily armed ship, propelled by oars and two or even three sails, the Cakradonya will dominate the seas of Indonesia.
unlock_galiot: A fast variant of a galley, the Galiot is well suited for the waters of the Mediterranean Sea, being able to navigate both shallow and deep sea.
unlock_sekibune: Build from cider or fir wood, the Sekibune sacrifices a sturdy hull for increased speed and maneuverability.
unlock_atakebune: Serving as larger variants of the Sekibune ships, the Atakebune is able to staff a larger crew than before. Sometimes equipped with iron or copper plates mounted on the hull, they improve on the survivability of the previous types as well.
unlock_long_fada: The ships of Ireland and the Highlands are most capable at projecting our presence over our coastal possessions, protecting merchant vessels and at the same time, serving as adequate warships in times of need.
unlock_long_fada_2: An improved Long Fada, the Great Long Fada is a larger vessel with more oars and a bigger crew, able to carry out longer voyages and project more power over the seas.
unlock_barbary_fusta: A slender, swift galley favored along the Barbary Coast. Carrying little more than a token armament, it relies on speed and shallow draft rather than firepower, and can be levied from our coastal communities in times of war.
unlock_cog_advance: The cog was a small ship widely used in medieval Europe. Characterized by having a single mast with a square sail, and constructed with overlapping planks, it was an evolution of the Viking merchant ships. Their construction made them more suitable for navigating the North Atlantic than the Mediterranean vessels, while their simpler rigging required fewer people to operate. It was used extensively by the Hanseatic League until eventually replaced by the hulk.
unlock_hulk_advance: The hulk was a type of European ship, the predecessor of the carrack and caravel, that originated in the Low Countries as a river boat, and was used predominantly as a cargo vessel, although it could be also used in war. It was constructed with a single mast with a square sail, and with a castle on both ends of the ship. Capable of rivaling the cog's carrying capacity, the hulk was the main trade ship used by the Hanseatic League.
unlock_flute_advance: A cargo ship developed in the Netherlands in the 16th century, it was built to maximize cargo space and crew efficiency. And it became one of the most commonly used ships in the 16th and 17th centuries. The standard design wasn't armed but when needed it could be armed with cannons and serve as auxiliary vessels.
unlock_brig_advance: The brig was a small ship used for trade or war, characterized by having two square-rigged masts. When used for war, they were small vessels with 10 to 18 guns, but it was their speed and maneuverability what made them valuable assets. Their full square rigging also made them more suited when traveling along trade winds, when they would sail downwind for long periods of time.
unlock_merchantman_advance: Merchantman is a type of ship used for commerce carrying goods or passengers. They would generally include some armament to protect themselves from pirates and privateers, especially if engaging in long travels, in which case they could even be heavily armed.
unlock_eastindiaman_advance: The Eastindiaman was a general term for all ships operating for any of the East India Trading Companies. Being able to carry both passengers and goods, they were built at first to carry as much as possible. They were still armed to defend themselves against pirates, so they could also participate in war engagement, but trade was always their main function.
integrate_area_advance: Our administration is improving, and as such, we can afford the manpower to integrate larger sections of land into our country at once.
send_people_to_colonial_charter_advance: New lands mean new opportunities — and new resources to exploit. By encouraging our population to settle abroad and take advantage of these abundant resources, we will reap enormous benefits.
send_people_to_the_colonies_advance: A whole new world lies open before us, and that means our people are dreaming about what their lives could be in these distant lands. We should encourage these thoughts, embellishing stories of gold and glory to be found in the unexplored territories, so that our people will be eager to settle these new lands for us.
study_institutions_advance: It is not a shame that others know what we do not, but it is never to our benefit if we do nothing to remedy that ignorance. By actively studying and learning from the discoveries of others, we can better improve our own knowledge of the world.
reduce_inflations_advance: Some may think that if we need more money, the only thing we need to do is mint more, but that is neither sustainable nor wise. By keeping strict control over our minting industry, we can keep our inflation in check, and possibly even reduce it.
direct_domestic_migration_advance: Our administrators have learned that the wealth of a realm is not only in its land, but in the hands that work it. By organizing the flow of pops from the crowded heartlands to the underdeveloped marches, we can shape our own demography to fit the needs of the state.
direct_domestic_migration_middle_kingdom: The Son of Heaven is responsible for the well-being of all under heaven. Where the old heartlands are crowded and the borderlands lie empty, it is the duty of the imperial court to move households from one to the other, so that every field is tilled and no region bears more mouths than it can feed.
pop_promote_actions_advance: It is said that chaos is a ladder for those seeking higher status. For us, this ladder comes not from chaos but from order, as we have systematized pathways allowing our people to improve their social standing through merit. We not only permit such advancement; we actively encourage it.
alleviate_concerns_advance: No country benefits from its neighbors being constantly vigilant of its movements. We must employ active diplomacy to immediately deflate any tensions that may arise, so that our neighbors have no reason to be concerned about us.
nation_state_advance: Uniting as a single culture under a single flag is a powerful, moving idea. By fostering a sense of national identity, we will ensure the loyalty of our subjects and citizens to our cause.
counter_espionage_action_advance: We cannot expect to perform well in either the diplomatic or military spheres if our secrets can easily be leaked to any foreign country. We must keep stronger control over how our information flows to quickly plug any possible leakage.
pacify_population_advance: At some point, people may be discontent with our leadership — it is practically unavoidable. However, these grumblings will not grow into anything major as long as we do not let them fester. If we actively seek out those who raise their voices against us, we can nip any agitation in the bud before they have the chance to rally others around them, and thus keep the general populace content. Or at least complacent.
settle_the_frontier_advance: We are surrounded by weakly defended territories ripe for the taking! Let us send out some adventurous courtiers to enforce our authority in these unclaimed lands.
fort_limit_1_advance: Official castellans are appointed to manage local strongholds and their garrisons, marking the first organized framework for the administration and maintenance of fortresses.
fort_limit_2_advance: Regional wardens coordinate multiple castles along frontier marches, establishing supply routes, reporting chains, and mutual defense between neighboring strongholds.
fort_limit_3_advance: The Crown centralizes oversight of fortifications under a formal bureau in the capital, consolidating records, funds, and maintenance orders into a single administrative authority.
fort_limit_4_advance: Professional inspectors travel the realm to evaluate garrisons, stores, and walls, enforcing consistent standards and ensuring the reliability of each fortified place.
fort_limit_5_advance: National standards for construction and repair are introduced, enabling efficient planning, shared designs, and predictable maintenance across our network of fortresses.
fort_limit_6_advance: Comprehensive mapping and logistical integration link every fortress into a coherent defensive system; an achievement of bureaucracy, science, and state power working in unison.
paper_guild_fiber_pulp_maintenance_advan: Utilizing fiber plants like hemp or paper mulberry, paper production will become widely available across the world. While cheap to produce, this paper is lacking in quality.
paper_guild_cloth_maintenance_advance: Rag Paper, made from cotton unfit to be processed or otherwise used, set new standards for quality and durability.
paper_guild_wood_pulp_maintenance_advanc: Using widely available softwood, paper will be easier and cheaper to produce than ever before.
monarchy_reform_traditions_advance: Authority cannot be entrusted to just any individual. Concentrating power and influence in the hands of the ruler will help them create order and stability throughout the realm.
republic_reform_traditions_advance: Dissemination of power is a cornerstone belief of any healthy republic. Robust laws enforcing elections by lottery will ensure stability and reduce corruption.
national_assemblies_advance: An assembly composed of representatives of the entire nation. Depending on the type of government, it may have all the powers of government, or only legislative ones.
monarchy_royal_court_advance: The traditions and the culture of the court play a significant role in the stability of the Monarchy. These customs will ensure the safe transition of power from ruler to heir, and limit the court intrigues significantly.
theocracy_divine_cause_law_advance: While monarchies and republics may be content to simply exist in the world, a Holy State requires a deeper, more spiritual calling. This Divine Cause shall guide our hand towards a glorious destiny.
theocracy_nature_of_our_faith_law_advanc: Religion is the pillar of our entire society, and as such, the nature of our faith plays a role in all facets of our culture. No major decisions can be made without carefully considering the religious perspective of taking these actions.
steppe_horde_tribal_religious_values_law: The religious values of our tribe dictate not only how we live, but how we treat those who do not share our beliefs and traditions, both within and outside of our territory.
steppe_horde_tribal_cultural_identity_la: As time progresses, so does our understanding of our culture and identity. We no longer have to fear neighboring tribes; we have tamed the wilderness and have become its master. Now it is time to embrace who we are as a people.
steppe_horde_tribal_modernization_law_ad: The time has come to discard our old ways and embrace a position in the larger world. No longer seen as a mere tribe, we shall officially become a country, one that represents and defends our people and the way we live.
tribal_religious_values_law_advance: The religious values of our tribe dictate not only how we live, but how we treat those who do not share our beliefs and traditions, both within and outside of our territory.
tribal_migration_law_advance: Our people do not permanently occupy out lands. Instead, we travel freely, as fate and our people's needs dictate.
tribal_cultural_identity_law_advance: As time progresses, so does our understanding of our culture and identity. We no longer have to fear neighboring tribes; we have tamed the wilderness and have become its master. Now it is time to embrace who we are as a people.
tribal_modernization_law_advance: The time has come to discard our old ways and embrace a position in the larger world. No longer seen as a mere tribe, we shall officially become a country, one that represents and defends our people and the way we live.
nobles_rights_laws_advance: The position of the Nobility is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
burghers_rights_laws_advance: The position of the Burghers is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
clergy_rights_laws_advance: The position of the Clergy is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
crown_rights_laws_advance: The position of the Crown is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
peasants_rights_laws_advance: The position of the Commoners is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
intelligence_agency_advance: The intelligence agency is an organization within the state which conducts spycraft activities such as espionage, cryptography, and providing security from internal threats.
recruitment_law_advance: Battles cannot be won with no soldiers on the field! Recruiting fighters is an absolute necessity. As time goes on, how we recruit soldiers may change, and our forces will adapt to it as needed.
mercenary_market_law_advance: Mercenary companies are raised from the common folk of our lands, whether we hire them ourselves or not. How we treat foreign powers who come recruiting on our own soil, be they rivals or friends, is a matter of policy.
battle_leadership_law_advance: An army is only as good as its leadership. An incompetent general can be the bane of their nation, while a military leader of great prowess will be known and feared on every battlefield.
army_doctrine_law_advance: Army doctrines represent skillsets in which our army can specialize. The longer we work under these doctrines, the more entrenched they become in our military culture, and the more skilled we become at them. Over time, this can lead to powerful benefits for our glorious forces.
bureaucracy_law_advance:
In order to best utilize the lands and subjects we control, we must enlarge, reorganize, and professionalize our bureaucracy. We shall create organizations dedicated to administering specific aspects of the state, and thus eliminate the need for ad hoc solutions.

Let us consult with our universities to determine how to most efficiently rule and govern. Meanwhile, we shall encourage our young nobles to serve the state with a pen rather than a sword in hand.
cabinet_laws_advance: The cabinet is the highest office in the government and our ruler's personal advisors. Cabinet ministers and secretaries enjoy special privileges and rights.
economical_policies_law_advance: A nation's economic policy sets out specific economic objectives and means to achieve them, and makes decisions and creates regulations for taxation, spending, currency, trade, and more.
legitimization_of_power_law_advance: A monarchy can only survive as long as its subjects believe in the legitimacy of their ruler. There are many ways in which rulers justify their power. As time goes on, new political philosophies will arise which explain the need for a strong government in their own ways.
foreign_cultural_law_advance: As our state grows in size, so does the complexity of our social structures. Cultural unity within our state is no longer a given, and we now require policies to establish and maintain internal peace.
road_building: The transportation of goods, troops, and people is vital to our nation's survival. By developing a basic road network, we will be able to at least connect our people and assist them in their daily endeavors.
paved_road_advance: The road has a solid paved surface which is much better for travel.
modern_road_advance: The road has a modern flat surface and is of good quality.
railroad_advance: The road has been upgraded to a rail connection, massively increasing travel speed and logistics.
global_supply_limit_modifier_advance_2: Land warfare is becoming more dependent on supplying bigger and bigger armies. Therefore, better organization of our supply carts would lead to an increased operational capacity.
standardized_pikes: A pike is a remarkably simple weapon to make, but to get the full benefit from their use, the entire formation must be wielding weapons of similar length and blade.
standardisation_of_calibre: With artillery's growing importance on the battlefield, the number of firearms kept increasing. But because each gun was made separately, it also required great effort to resupply. In 1544, in an effort to mitigate this, Emperor Charles V declared that there would be only five calibers of guns, while King Henry II of France set the standard of calibers at six.
global_supply_limit_modifier_advance_5: How far an army can march is a consequence of its logistics. With proper study and planning, armies can withstand longer and more distant campaigns.
global_supply_limit_modifier_advance_6: Planning the logistics of warfare has become increasingly complex, as the growth in average army size has made it possible to field several armies at once for long-term campaigns, involving hundreds of thousands of soldiers for multiple years.
innovativeness: Natural curiosity, and the desire to understand our world and how it functions, is what pushes us forward. Our people are eager to gain knowledge, and it is this spark in their minds that will ignite progress for our nation.
empiricism: Things are what they are because we can feel them, see them, and overall experience them with our senses. It is by using this empirical evidence that we come up with newer ideas.
court_accounting: The court is the symbol of our country, and its prosperity shall represent that of the nation. However, this does not mean that the court can spend more than the country can sustain; there should be proper accounting for what is spent at court.
debt_and_loans: Debt is sometimes simply unavoidable. However, an organized debt market will allow us to float loans at a lower interest rate.
benefits_for_mercenaries: Mercenaries will always look out for themselves first, so we need to ensure that any we hire remain with us. By properly looking after our mercenary companies, they will stay loyal for longer and require less direct monetary compensation.
organised_mercenary_recruitment: Money is not the only limiting factor when it comes to recruiting mercenaries. The other bottleneck is finding mercenary companies who actually wish to serve with us. Thus, we must ensure our system allows every company to join us.
state_efficiency: Despite our focus on country-wide affairs, we must not neglect our local state legislators and bailiffs.
church_attendance_duty: Adopting a mandatory church attendance policy will emphasize the importance of our religious values and beliefs, and will minimize the costs of maintaining law and order.
deus_vult: Join the battle cry of the Crusades — 'God wills it' — and crush the heretics!
early_anti_piracy_warfare: The proliferation of pirates, brigands, and robbers in the waters along our trade routes has forced our merchants to band together and form Merchant Leagues, which facilitate the protection of their boats during long journeys.
dynamic_court: A truly innovative court is one where any person may rise to prominence. We must strive to make sure that old traditions, as well as prejudices around one's birth or level of wealth, do not hinder the development of our court or act as a barrier to talented people wishing to serve our state.
missionary_schools: Although there is no shortage of people willing to spread the word of the true faith, most of them ultimately do more harm than good. However, establishing specialist schools to properly train missionaries will ensure we have more people who cannot only spread the faith, but do so successfully.
preaching_missions: Establish missionary expeditions that will ensure that our population worships the one true faith.
organised_construction: Upgrading our government's infrastructure is a costly business. However, if we structure the process correctly, we can do it for less expense.
organised_mercenary_payment: Mercenary captains are a canny lot. They will try to coax two commanders in the same army into a bidding war over their services. We must streamline our mercenary recruitment process to prevent this sort of trickery, and to ensure we are always in the best position during negotiations.
expansionism: The world is huge, and we should not grow complacent with our position in it, for our neighbors will not necessarily do the same. We shall set our sights on expanding our borders and making ourselves stronger, lest we risk being swallowed up by growing neighbor states.
faster_colonists: You cannot simply send colonists out to the New World and expect them to just build a colony. There is first a time-consuming process of preparing the expedition with everything they will need to survive in their new home. We can speed this process up, now that we have some prior experience.
additional_merchants: Colonies are no good to us unless we can bring their riches home to the mother country. We must expand our merchant class to ensure that this happens.
efficient_mining: We shall issue a decree to refine every aspect of metal mining within our domain, in an effort to regulate its presence in our markets.
efficient_construction_plans: Our efficient building strategy allows us to complete complex work orders without taking any half measures.
expanded_infrastructure_network: Our national road network is a vital part of our commercial and administrative success. As such, we should care to maintain and improve it.
divine_supremacy: It is of the utmost importance that we rid our nation and its surrounding borders of the non-believers that plague our lands.
devoutness: Religion is one of the most important bulwarks of our rulership. By making grand displays of our religious devotion in public, we will inspire the people to follow suit, and this proliferation of piety amongst our people will strengthen our rule.
religious_tradition: The strength of our faith, and the impressive public displays of piety and worship we stage, are admired by other countries both near and far. This is a clear reflection of the prestige and glory of our realm.
advanced_bureaucracy: Allows us to increase our tax revenues by adopting a more bureaucratic administrative system governed by state officials.
national_bank: By establishing a central authority for financial matters, we will have better control over our nation's economy.
competetive_merchants: To bring the focus of our trade home, we must be able to beat competition from other countries. We need to ensure that our legal system gives our merchants every possible advantage.
humanist_tolerance: By striving to create a more tolerant society, and attempting to solve our social and religious problems in more rational ways, the risk of civil disorder will be diminished.
cultural_ties: Different cultures have different customs, and for some reason, they tend to resist attempts from their rulers to change said customs. We can turn this weakness into a strength by incorporating local leaders into our system of government and having them carry out our will in a way that will be palatable to their people.
ecumenism: Determining how to deal with the heretics in our realm is always tricky. Although the good, old-fashioned fire-and-sword approach will solve most problems eventually, diplomacy can also succeed. By encouraging dialogue between the various sects, we can reduce misunderstandings and promote peace in the realm.
formalized_officer_corps: Traditionally, our military officers come from the nobility, but we do not have enough people in that estate to fill the necessary roles. However, there are many skilled members of the lower classes in our armies who would do nicely — we should consider promoting some of them as professional officers.
religious_unification: There is only one religion that is true, and thus it is our duty to unite all the faithful under the sole guidance of God.
centralized_government: If we centralize the state, then we will find it easier to advance the ideas and agenda of the center over the other regions.
economic_ideas: The economy and wealth of a country should serve the government, not the opposite way around. As such, it is in the state's best interests to accumulate the lion's share of resources, both as a show of our power and in order to better carry out our will. Only with this system can our nation truly prosper.
additional_colonists: The New World is many things, but the most important thing of all is that it is empty. Well, no one important lives there, at any rate. By letting people know of the boundless opportunities that await them in the New World, we will encourage more people to go forth and settle there.
additional_diplomats: The drive to expand our country means we must also expand our diplomatic reach. We must ensure that our diplomatic service is properly staffed.
bookkeeping: Sometimes money is short, and we need to borrow. Lenders always worry that they will not be paid back. By maintaining meticulous records, we will be able to ensure that everyone gets reimbursed, which will allow us to negotiate lower rates of interest.
civil_servants: Establishing a civil service of eager young bureaucrats will ensure that we can quickly adapt to new advances in administration and governance.
local_traditions: Governing a large nation means ruling over diverse peoples, each with their own customs and traditions. By incorporating these traditions into our official code of laws, we will create a happier and more loyal populace.
