humanism: Mankind is the highest creation of our Lord, and thus it is natural to place it in the center of Creation. Every aspect of human nature has to be preserved and encouraged, from its well-being to its propensity for free will and exploration.
formal_administration: Correct procedures and a well-oiled administrative apparatus result in a prosperous country, for without a proper administration, anything that the state attempts to accomplish will just remain fruitless. We will formalize and standardize our administration, so that the will of the state flows through it naturally to all corners of the nation.
optimism: Victory is not just won on the battlefield, but also in the drawing rooms. Our advancement of reason helps our people shrug off the effects of temporary setbacks, and prepare instead for our inevitable victory.
indirect_rule: Sometimes the best way to get people to do what you want is to let them believe that they have had a choice in the matter. A system of indirect rule like that will reduce the unrest in newly acquired provinces, giving them the impression that they have more self-determination than they truly do.
smithian_economics: By opposing mercantilism and restricting the state's influence in economic matters, we shall support a free market that will increase our overall production efficiency.
nationalistic_enthusiasm: Giving our troops adequate support is vital to national defense. With our excellent administration, we are able to secure generous discounts on our military supplies.
improved_shipyards: To defend our interests around the globe, we will require a strong navy. We must ensure our shipyards can produce ships as quickly as possible to replace any losses we may suffer.
legislative_efficiency_idea: The most important factor in efficient government is getting the right advice. We must ensure that we are as inclusive as possible when it comes to advisors, so we can maximize the number of different viewpoints we are presented with.
benevolence: Our nation is a bastion of tolerance and enlightenment. By ensuring that all other nations know this, we can foster better relations abroad.
fort_logistics: By ordering our system of fortifications in an organized manner, both construction-wise and logistically, we may save some coin on maintaining it in the long term.
regulation_bureau: A legislative body whose jurisdiction involves the maintenance and promotion of inflation-related laws as well as the local administration of our provinces.
integrated_elites: By bringing the ruling elite of our subject nations into our government, we can significantly streamline the process of integrating their provinces.
marcher_lords: By granting considerable autonomy to vassals in border regions, these 'Marcher Lords' will be able to raise large military armies to support us in our wars.
claim_fabrication: Claiming something as yours is easy; persuading everyone else that your claim is valid is much harder. By spreading our diplomatic net wide, we can ensure that the people who matter know that we have staked this claim.
shrewd_commerce_practice: Allows us to make use of more refined trading practices, giving our merchants the upper hand over our competitors.
merchant_traditions: A steady flow of trade and commerce is a sure sign of a healthy economy. With our merchants focusing on keeping the trade flowing, we can establish a tradition of and reputation for lively commerce, making it easier to attract foreign trade to our nation.
privateers: Waging war on enemy commerce is at the apex of naval warfare. We shall encourage the crustiest, saltiest seadogs we can hire to strike at the heart of the enemy's trade, which should help refill our own coffers quickly.
experienced_diplomats: Sometimes it is simply enough for people to believe that we are powerful. We have worked hard on our diplomatic service to ensure that our word carries extra weight.
benign_diplomats: The art of diplomacy is an intricate one. Being good with words is not enough, as one's overall presence and demeanor are crucial to how the words themselves are interpreted. By having our diplomats focus on making a good impression, we will be seen more favorably by other countries.
tribute_system: Strengthen our income by establishing a formalized system of yearly tribute from our vassals.
influence: Ending a war requires negotiations between the two opposing parties, and sometimes one party proves itself too stubborn to accept defeat. In such cases, the art of diplomatic pressure — and gently reminding them of their potential imminent annihilation — shall motivate them to accept our generous terms more easily.
quest_for_the_new_world: Allows us to join the nations set to explore the world outside their borders, or strive to be the first nation to circumnavigate the globe, by commencing a quest for the New World.
overseas_exploration: Establishing colonies in distant lands is nearly always a one-way trip for those involved. Even if strange new diseases do not take you or unforgiving terrain does not starve you, the amount of time it takes to sail back means you will most likely never come home. While these realities are discouraging to some, if we remind people of the potential riches to be gained from colonial life, we can encourage them to settle lands further afield despite the dangers.
overseas_trade: News of the discovery of distant lands has reached our nation, and our merchants are already preparing to expand their trading operations. These unexplored territories are filled with prosperous markets dripping with wealth, like so much ripe fruit waiting to be collected.
colonial_ventures: Enables us to send more colonists to uncharted lands.
exploration: Our naval superiority allows us to project power well past our own horizons, extending a natural claim to distant lands as our own by right of discovery.
foreign_embassies: Diplomacy is a delicate balancing act that requires us to balance the needs and desires of multiple entities at the same time. Maintaining embassies in other countries that report to us on a regular basis will give us the information needed to better weigh our diplomatic options.
efficient_spies: Most peasants would happily sell their own mother for gold, but there are some with skills and talents that we in the government might find very useful for...ah, statecraft. Although finding these worthy commoners is difficult, through experience we are learning to separate the wheat from the chaff.
vetting: Because so many of our government positions are held by those seeking to advance themselves, we sometimes find that those who run our administration are susceptible to bribes from foreign powers. Running some simple background checks will weed out the officials most prone to corruption.
merchant_adventures: This allows us to make use of the numerous traders lusting for fame and fortune, eager to offer their services for a chance to search and explore new trade routes.
ships_penny: Ships are expensive to build and maintain. By imposing a ship's penny — a small tax levied on trade or port activities — we can ensure our fleet remains strong without draining our treasury.
audit_checks: While we work to infiltrate other nations, we must be vigilant of poisonous ideas spreading around our own courts. Assembling an audit team to ensure our ministers are acting in the state's interest should help root out any rotten elements.
cabinet: By establishing an executive council, we are able to assemble our most skilled diplomats.
grand_banquets: No important matter can be discussed without an accompanying meal, and the more important the matter is, the more indulgent the meal should be. Having regular grand banquets allows us to constantly and properly discuss all matters that need consideration.
fast_negotiations: Sometimes the key to closing a trade deal is to be the quickest one. We must ensure that our merchants can always successfully close their deals.
trade_manipulation: At those key choke points where trade supremacy could go one way or another, edging out the regional competition is crucial to expanding our trade income.
diplomatic_influence: By focusing on diplomacy, we can increase the power we wield on the world stage, and win many friends and potential allies.
free_trade: Our leading merchant families wish to secure trade privileges as their exclusive preserve, but we are unwilling to do so, and will therefore allow the growth of the merchant class.
land_of_opportunity: By portraying our colonies and the surrounding unclaimed lands as places where anyone can make their fortune, we will rapidly increase emigration to our colonial holdings. This means the nation will spend less money encouraging people to go there.
free_colonies: Only so many people are willing to move abroad to expand our great colonial empire. However, the promise of a plot of land to farm in freehold will encourage many more people to seek their fortunes abroad. The nice thing about this is that there is plenty of land for everyone!
grand_navy: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful navies the world has ever seen.
agent_training: We have many covert operations planned, but lack sufficient agents to carry them out. Establishing a training method for our spies will help bolster the ranks of operatives available for dangerous missions.
dip_choice_subject_opinions: Continued communication with our subject nations through dedicated emissaries will positively impact our relations, strengthening the core of our domain and ensuring the loyalty of all countries that stand under our banner.
state_propaganda: As with a man, a nation's reputation is everything, and the establishment of an official propaganda service will ensure our good name is not smeared by the lies of our enemies.
formal_diplomacy: At a time where power is shifting from the hands of powerful individuals towards control by a centralized authority, it is wise to build bridges and open channels of communication between us and our neighbors. Diplomacy is key, and more so than ever in the face of these rising powers.
diplomatic_corps: Through the establishment of a professional diplomatic corps, we will ensure that the hard-earned knowledge of senior diplomats is passed on to the younger generation.
national_trade: Cloth, wool, and other sought-after commodities have made their way across the world. At an age where a nation's commerce reaches faraway shores, we must make sure our merchants always have the advantage!
national_trade_policy: By adopting a national trade policy, we can strengthen our commercial presence and increase the effectiveness of our trade.
vice_roys: Makes it possible for us to establish Viceroys, therby improving the administration of our colonies and increase the amount of money they generate.
sheltered_ports: It is an unfortunate fact that ships tend to be damaged during battle, and equally unfortunate that the damage can rarely be repaired at sea. To alleviate this problem, we will create a system of sheltered ports along our coastline where our ships can patch themselves up.
naval_fighting_instruction: Allows our naval veterans to devise new methods to improve our navy's efficiency in blockades.
merchant_marine: Let every merchant ship fly our emblem with pride and know that our navy will always be there to protect them, if needed.
global_empire: Our commitment to our colonial empire has transformed attitudes towards working in the colonial administration. No longer seen as a haven for fortune-seeking freebooters, it is now regarded as a prestigious career for the brightest and best. This shift is reflected in more efficient tax collection.
buffer_states: There is nothing worse than arguing with one's neighbor. If we want to avoid border tensions, having other states act as a buffer between us and our potential enemies will allow us some breathing room.
flexible_negotiation: You can never quite predict what could be gained during peace talks, so we should enter with all options open.
overseas_merchants: To expand trade, we need to extend the rights of citizenship to people who live abroad, support our trade, and are of the right social class.
postal_service: With communications being what they are, it is difficult to ensure that our diplomatic dispatches arrive in a timely fashion. Creating a network of post offices and courier rest stops will make it easier for our voice to be heard in distant lands.
additional_loyalist_recruitment: Naturally, there are those within our subject nations who recognize our divine right to rule. By recruiting and aiding these enlightened individuals, we can strengthen our grasp on these territories.
morale_recovery_rev_dip_choice: No army can exist in a permanent state of action; all soldiers need time for rest and recovery. By establishing guidelines and procedures for them to rest, without permitting any laziness, we can keep our troops in prime condition.
merchant_power_from_maritime_rev_dip_cho: Merchant ships have become a common sight in our waters. Our traders have so many vessels going back and forth that they have effectively formed their own fleet.
sea_hawks: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements, and thereby increase our Naval Tradition.
tolerance_idea: Every human was created equal to the Creator, and therefore we understand that their beliefs, even if wrong, can be accepted as a means to eventual conversion to the one true faith.
glorious_arms: The sight of our glorious and prestigious army will make all adversaries tremble in fear.
battlefield_commisions: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements and thereby increase our Army Tradition.
finest_of_horses: How steadily those troops take the ground! How beautifully those cavalry form! Fine horses with well-trained riders are a hallmark of any modern fighting force, and ours are particularly impressive.
regular_levy_training: Levies are by definition not the best-trained troops, but that does not mean that we have to send a bunch of untrained rabble to war. Assigning them proper instructors from our most proficient units will allow them to learn from the best, and a mandatory training period with them will make them ready — and eager — to fight.
open_levy_standards: What makes a man willing to fight and die for his country? Is it his faith? Loyalty to his nation? Or is it simply a desire to protect his family? In the end, the answer does not matter, as everyone has the duty of serving under our banner.
enforced_service: The principle of volunteering underpins our whole army structure, but sometimes there are simply not enough willing conscripts. We should force — erm, encourage people to volunteer.
naval_glory: The awesome sight of our glorious navy will make all adversaries tremble in fear!
boarding_parties: By teaching our naval officers to lead boarding actions against enemy ships, we can gain an edge in naval combat even when fighting superior enemy navies.
marine_regiments: Marines are military units that specialize in amphibious operations. They can be used in raiding shores and boarding enemy vessels, while still seeing action on land.
military_drill: Allows us to invest in military training and thereby improve battle formations, weapon handling, and our army's morale.
administrative_leadership: A military leader must not only know about military matters. Logistics, supply administration and allocation, monetary expenses, and similar topics are all also critical concerns for any successful military campaign.
improved_manuever: Tactical positioning is a vital skill for any commander. The ability to maneuver troops effectively around the battlefield will give us a significant edge.
quality_education: The most crucial time for any army comes after battle. Win or lose, troops are most vulnerable when they are exhausted. We must ensure that our troops are highly trained and can recover easily from combat, lest our enemies take advantage of us in moments of weakness.
naval_drill: The confusion of combat can leave a warship unfit for action for a long time. A well-drilled crew will recover much faster than an ordinary one.
the_old_and_infirm: Our veteran sergeants are some of the most despicable and corrupt men imaginable, but that does not mean they are useless. Rather than leave them to be beggars on our streets when their service ends, we can put these old dogs to work. We shall make them into drill sergeants and quartermasters so that their unique skills can be put to use.
improved_rams: The concept of outfitting warships with rams goes back thousands of years, but great advancements in metallurgy have been made since then, and we should take advantage of these to create sturdier rams.
oak_forests_for_ships: The more punishment our ships can take, the more they can dish out. Let us ensure that we have a ready supply of the finest seasoned oak for our warships.
naval_cadets: By promoting the navy as the ideal career choice for second and third sons of the aristocracy, we can create a professional corps of naval officers to oversee our gunnery crews.
adaptability: There is what is ours, and what is part of our ancestral domain that will never be surrendered. A bit of flexibility in defining these 'ancestral' borders will lead to more land being accepted as our rightful territory, and should the worst happen, the whole world will know our crusade to recover it will be just.
defensive_mentality: There are those who think that attack is the best form of defense, but that is foolish. Let our enemies come to us instead; we shall counter with incredible zeal. Our troops will defend their homes tenaciously, and our fortresses will withstand sieges for longer.
cultures_capacity_mil_choice: A country's expansion will inevitably result in it bringing other cultures into its fold. Thus, if we want to further expand our borders, we need to be prepared to become more multicultural.
supply_trains: While on campaign, attrition is our most formidable foe, and the key to defending our men against it is a well-planned and efficiently run logistic network capable of providing ample support and supplies.
expanded_supply_trains: Investing more resources into our supply trains will allow our army to operate for longer periods of time in hostile territory.
camp_followers: Warriors obviously make up the bulk of our armies, but no army can consist of fighters alone. Without the extra entourage of people transporting food and equipment for the army, it would not be able to feasibly go anywhere. By organizing and structuring these camp followers, we can greatly increase their usefulness and efficiency.
engineer_corps: Allows us to gather the greatest technological minds our nation has to offer, and make use of their unrivaled services.
defensive_army: The rise of many powerful states around us has hastened our need for a robust defensive force, as we intend to maintain our territorial integrity. Knowledge of our homeland's native terrain, hidden paths, and regional tactics will see us through this turbulent period.
garrison_conscription: By conscripting our able young citizens for our garrisons, we can ensure that we have enough guards to defend our borders.
copper_bottoms: Wood may be the ideal material for shipbuilding, but it tends to deteriorate over time. By fitting our ships with copper sheathing below the waterline we can reduce this deterioration, allowing them to better withstand long journeys.
rgo_logistics_mil_choice: Having proper storehouses to hold the products required by local businesses is a must if we want those enterprises — to say nothing of the entire economy — to function smoothly.
repair_at_sea: Ships are undertaking longer voyages than ever before, made possible by new technical advances. This means more complex repairs are needed, but ports with adequate equipment and skilled craftsmen are not always available. Our sailors must be trained in the art of careening — deliberately beaching vessels to expose the parts that need cleaning or repair. This is the only way our fleets can maintain seaworthiness far from their home ports.
improved_foraging: Traditionally, we were unable to fight effectively in lands that did not supply enough food. However, our troops have become better at acquiring food in the wild, making it possible for larger armies to fight.
discipline_drills: During combat, only three things matter: firepower, manpower, and the discipline to combine the two. Regular military drills and exercises shall elevate our to a new standard.
absolutism_control_decline_advance: Absolutist rulers not only demonstrate their power in court, but also through an administrative apparatus that may spread throughout the country.
offensive_army: The era of gunpowder and military innovations is upon us, and with it comes a renewed interest in and vitality to the conduct of warfare. To further our glory, we must diligently ensure high standards for our offensive armed forces.
superior_firepower: The use of massed firepower to disrupt the enemy before delivering a coup de grâce is one of our army's strengths, and we will make sure that our leaders know this.
grand_army: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful armies the world has ever seen.
regimental_system: By organizing our armies into regiments tied to distinct geographical areas, we allow them to put down roots in local communities. Then, we need to raise additional battalions for these regiments, recruitment will be faster thanks to these regional ties.
private_to_marshal: Every private has a marshal's baton in his back. Well, perhaps not exactly, but for those who distinguish themselves in battle, promotion and rewards will follow. The troops know this and are inspired by it.
escort_ships: Corvettes are a class of small warships that are designed to escort friendly vessels and harass the enemy, relying on speed and maneuverability rather than massed firepower.
bayonet_leaders: Men who are well-led will follow, so we must ensure that our officers lead from the front.
national_conscripts: Increases our military numbers by making military service compulsory for those eligible.
massed_battery: Let us mass our artillery in a single grand battery. Its destructive power will blast a hole in the enemy lines!
mass_army: We have, up to now, been very selective about who can serve as an enlisted member of our military. We only took the poorest and most desperate — basically, the people no one else would miss. Now, though, we shall open up the ranks to everyone who wishes to serve and has no significant wealth to speak of.
the_young_can_serve: How old does a boy have to be before he is a man? How old must he be before he can die for his country? Some rulers are squeamish; We, on the other hand, are an equal opportunity butcher.
press_gangs: Life at sea is hard and unforgiving, and not everyone is keen on a naval career. By legalizing the impressment of sailors and other skilled seafarers, it will be easier to crew our ships, speeding up the process of commissioning ships as well.
superior_seamanship: Enables us to transform our navy into a supreme naval force with top-class vessels and highly skilled captains and crew.
improved_logistics: The modern art of war nowadays clearly differentiates between amateur officers who talk about tactics, and professional officers who actually study logistics.
land_morale_movement_cost_rev_choice_mil: Our armies on the march is a sight to behold. Their training and discipline shines when they march in unison into battle, unfazed by any previous long march.
port_cost_distance_from_capital_choice_m: Maintaining regular patrols along all our coasts will ensure that our administrative authority is felt everywhere, even in the farthest regions.
unlock_legionaries_1_advance: The Early Legionaries uphold the oldest traditions of drill and discipline. Spears, broad shields, and firm cohesion let them stand fast even as the battle twists around them.
unlock_legionaries_2_advance: Legionaries trained in the refined arts of close combat, carrying throwing spears and short swords. Their strength lies in steady formations and a military culture of relentless practice.
unlock_legionaries_3_advance: The Reformed Legionaries are hardened infantrymen, equipped with the best armor and weapons, who form the core of our armies.
unlock_legionaries_4_advance: The Heavy Legionaries are elite infantrymen, equipped with the finest armor and weapons. Like the heavy armored legions of ancient Rome, these troops will be the hammer with which we will smite our enemies.
unlock_legionaries_5_advance: The Guard Legionaries embody the highest standard of soldiering within the legions. Selected from the finest cohorts, they are trusted with critical missions and the protection of the state's highest institutions.
unlock_legionaries_6_advance: These Imperial Legionaries stand at the apex of centuries of military evolution. Masters of equipment and doctrine alike, they serve the lifeguard whose presence alone can steady wavering lines.
unlock_varangians_2_advance: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.
unlock_varangians_3_advance: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.
unlock_varangians_4_advance: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.
unlock_varangians_5_advance: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.
unlock_varangians_6_advance: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.
unlock_byzantine_cataphracts_2_advance: The Late Medieval Cataphracts are mail-clad riders and horses alike, thundering into battle behind long lances and dense shields. Their shock charges and iron discipline are a frightening sight for our foes.
unlock_byzantine_cataphracts_3_advance: These Reformed Cataphracts blend old Imperial drills with newer tactics, combining lances with bows and sidearms. They fight as a flexible heavy cavalry corps, able to harass at range and then finish off their foes in close combat.
unlock_byzantine_cataphracts_4_advance: The Heavy Cataphracts ride in layered armor that deflects most missiles and blades. Organized into wedges of elite fighters, they break enemy lines with repeated charges that few formations can withstand.
unlock_byzantine_cataphracts_5_advance: Chosen from the finest lancers, the Guard Cataphracts serve as the mounted guard of the throne and our capital. Their presence in every battle is both a weapon and a symbol, rallying our troops and terrifying our foes.
unlock_byzantine_cataphracts_6_advance: The Imperial Cataphracts are the culmination of centuries of cavalry tradition: armored veterans, superbly mounted and drilled to perfection. They serve as the Emperor's personal guard, able to decide campaigns with a single, well-timed charge.
uc_bey_advance: The Uç Bey is an army based that serves as a frontier lord under strong Turkic leadership. Tasked with defending borders, leading raids, and expanding territories, these semi-autonomous leaders command loyal Ġuzāt warriors driven by religious fervor, plunder, and land grants, making them crucial to frontier stability and expansion. They can only be created through the Create Uç Bey action, and they get the Uç Bey Government reform and Always allow army levies, while having greatly reduced payment obligations compared to a normal Vassal but costing increased diplomatic capacity and giving their overlord more Monthly towards decentralization. A Uç Bey keeps its own religion, which its overlord cannot convert or enforce.
heirs_of_rum: After surviving a turbulent period, and winning the struggle to dominate our neighboring Beyliks, the time has finally come for us to restore the borders of the once-great Sultanate of Rûm!
seljuk_roots: We are surrounded by enemies on all sides, making a strong military an absolute necessity. Fortunately, we are not weak people. From the irregular Ġuzāt and the Akıncılar raiders to the Sipâhi of the Ottomans, the world has come to fear and respect our military might. Let us build an army worthy of an empire, inspired by our glorious traditions and history, honing our might through the ages.
fratricide_succesion_advance: It is a type of heir selection of a Monarchy in which the new ruler ascends to the throne once he has demonstrated that his fortune is superior to the fortunes of his rivals, usually through the elimination of each one of them.
splendor_of_anatolia: Our region is home to some of the most impressive madrasas and mosques in the entire Muslim world. With their meticulous attention to detail and abundant talent, our artisans shine with unmatched prowess.
persian_in_the_court: Persian has served as our administrative language for quite some time, a legacy stemming from our ancient roots. This has helped us transcend the social and cultural barriers that often arise in highly diverse nations like ours.
akinji_cavalry: Our light cavalry regiments often raid and sometimes even settle in neighboring territories. Known for their courage in battle, they lived and operated as raiders on the frontier, often the first line of response against incursions from our rivals and perfectly positioned to attack and rout enemy trade routes.
crossroads_of_commerce: Our support the flow of commerce, information, and people from China to Europe across our lands. This proximity to important trade routes has unleashed a flood of affluence throughout our nation.
suez_canal_advance:
Survey and begin construction of a channel through the Isthmus of Suez, opening a direct route between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea.

Unlocks the Construct the Suez Canal decision, which requires us to hold both Suez and Tinnis.
panama_canal_advance:
Survey and begin construction of a channel through the Isthmus of Panama, linking the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

Unlocks the Construct the Panama Canal decision, which requires us to hold Panama.
colonial_tradition: Our state was formed and shaped by the ambitions of the 'founding fathers,' the first colonists to come over from the old country. Many of the customs and traditions they brought with them have influenced our own society in this new and strange world.
colonial_heritage: As a colony, we bear the heritage of our mother country's imperial ambitions.
founding_fathers: This refers to all the politicians, soldiers, diplomats, and others who played an influential role in establishing their nation by winning their country's independence and creating a new system of governance.
colonial_militia: In the absence of regular garrisons, colonial militias played an important role in local conflicts and border raids against native tribes and other colonies. They were typically made up of adult male citizens who were usually expected to provide their own weapons and equipment.
new_frontiers: The movement to push the colonial frontier further and further inland in the New World, by establishing everything from small trade stations to full settlements with large areas of cultivated land.
continental_trade: While the New World colonies had to import a lot of manufactured products, they also became a major supplier of raw materials for markets in Europe.
free_thinkers: The belief that every man is entitled to both freedom of thought and freedom of speech is widely held in our colonies. Without these rights in place, there could be no such thing as civil liberty.
manufacturing_center: Our citizens are the power base of our overlord's trade empire. Foreign goods are delivered to us, which we then mold into finished products.
colonial_assembly: Much of the legislative power over taxes and government spending has been moved into colonial administrations.
liberty_heroes: Many leaders of the New World independence wars possessed not only the necessary military skills, but also the charisma needed to encourage morale, hold the army together, and be an inspiration to the people.
colonial_ambition: Many of our people settled in the New World to start a new life; to discover the wonders beyond the sea and make an untamed continent their home. Their ambition is ours as we push further and further into the unknown.
students_of_foreign_courts: Members of our royal dynasties are accustomed to journeys abroad. They have spent much of their upbringing as students of illustrious courts far away from home, in the pursuit of a thorough education in matters of statesmanship.
wagenburg: During the Hussite Wars, our armies relied on wagon forts called Wagenburg to win battles against superior forces. While we may not always deploy wagons, the principle remains: infantry sharpshooters fighting from prepared defensive positions become our standard doctrine.
bohemian_imperial_standing: Our place within the Holy Roman Empire is one of prestige, grandeur, and authority. Few members wield as much soft power as us, due to our capable diplomats and alliance networks.
urbanization_decrees: As part of our efforts to modernize Prague, we will issue grants encouraging prominent figures to relocate their business to the capital while offering privileges to attract skilled and wealthy foreign immigrants. This influx of talent and capital will transform our Prague into a thriving, cosmopolitan metropolis.
bohemian_crystal: There are very few workshops in the known world with the capacity to craft glass and crystal with the same quality and clarity as ours, let alone rival our superior production techniques.
fortified_towns: Through the ravages of the Hussite Wars, and in an effort to safeguard our faith and people, we funded many fortified towns. Since then, we have gained great expertise in erecting fortifications and engineering impenetrable defenses.
hussite_traditions: Through struggle and brotherhood, the adherents of our faith withstand all external conversion pressures. Our unshaken religious roots, stemming from ancient teachings, ring true to the hearts of all those who seek to protect their beliefs and live in peace alongside their fellow Christian faithful.
kutnohorian_deal: The nobility will always be rather sensitive about protecting their privileges. It would go far towards winning their loyalty if said privileges were to be guaranteed forever.
bohemian_thaler: For years, the standard currency in our country has been the groschen, a coin made of silver and used all throughout the Holy Roman Empire. The discovery of new sources of silver allows us to create another kind of bigger coin, the thaler, also called 'toler' or 'daler', which will become strong and influential enough to dominate all trade and become a new standard.
bulgarian_orthodox_patriarchate: The restoration of the Bulgarian Patriarchate in 1235, confirmed by the Council of Lampsacus, established Tarnovo as a sovereign spiritual rival to both Constantinople and Rome. By the 14th century, the Patriarchate functioned as the ideological spine of the Asen and Shishman dynasties, utilizing its autocephalous status to provide divine legitimacy that transcended the political fragmentation of the realm. From its seat on Tsarevets Hill, the Church managed an expansive administrative network of eparchies and monasteries, such as the Zograf Monastery on Mount Athos, which served as repositories for the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic.
legacy_of_ivan_asen_ii: The reign of Ivan Asen II marked a new height of Bulgarian power, diplomacy, and economic expansion. His legacy endures as a foundation for a strong and centralized state.
bul_the_bastion_of_tseverets: The capital of Tarnovo, perched upon the cliffs of Tsarevets and Trapezitsa, is arguably the most formidable fortress in the Balkans, symbolizing the power of the Asen dynasty. By continuously expanding the complex of palaces, patriarchal cathedrals, and triple-layered walls, we have created an administrative center that is immune to sudden coups or sieges. This architectural dominance projects an image of imperial stability that cowers the local Boyars and convinces the populace that the 'Third Rome' has truly moved to the banks of the Yantra.
kvn_karvunan_maritime_heritage: Karvuna has built its power upon the sea rather than the fertile plains, drawing upon a mix of Bulgarian, Greek, and Italian sailors. By fortifying the limestone cliffs of the coast, we will create a series of naval bases that will allow us to dominate the Black Sea trade routes between the Danube delta and Constantinople. This maritime focus will provide us with a unique identity within the Bulgarian world, prioritizing naval superiority and trade over the traditional feudal concerns of the interior.
vid_the_stronghold_of_baba_vida: The fortress of Vidin, situated at a strategic bend in the Danube, serves as the ultimate gateway between the Bulgarian lands, the Hungarian plains, and the Serbian mountains. Under the Shishman dynasty, the castle of Baba Vida has been transformed into a sophisticated riverine citadel capable of withstand long sieges and housing a permanent garrison of elite troops. This focus on defensive architecture ensures that Vidin remains a sovereign bastion, even when the rest of the Bulgarian heartland is under threat, acting as a 'Western Shield' for the nation.
reformation_of_the_bulgarian_patriarchat: The spiritual heart of the Bulgarian world will undergo a rigorous and profound transformation under the iron-willed guidance of our Patriarch. Recognizing that the survival of the nation depends upon the purity of its faith and the precision of its holy texts, the Patriarchate will initiate a sweeping linguistic and liturgical reform centered at the Holy Trinity Monastery of Tarnovo. By purging the Church Slavonic manuscripts of centuries of scribal errors and corrupt localisms, we will establish a new, standardized orthography that will become the gold standard for the entire Orthodox Slavic world, from the Danube to the Volga.
revival_of_the_literary_schools: Under the direct patronage of the Shishman Dynasty, the nation has undergone a spectacular cultural growth, positioning itself as a true Third Rome and the primary guardian of Orthodox high culture. By funding the reconstruction of the Patriarchal Cathedral and the royal palaces of Tsarevets, the state has gathered a new generation of master iconographers, hagiographers, and architects who blend traditional Byzantine aesthetics with a unique, emotive Bulgarian realism. This school of thought does not merely produce religious icons; it serves as a powerful instrument of imperial propaganda, codifying the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic and producing the Manasses Chronicle to legitimize the Tsar's claim to the Byzantine heritage.
bul_the_chancery_of_the_asens: At its peak, the chancellery in Tarnovo was the most sophisticated diplomatic hub in the Orthodox world, producing intricate Slavic charters that influenced the courts of Serbia and Russia. By professionalizing the class of Logothetes and scribes, the Tsars will ensure that every land grant and international treaty is meticulously recorded and legally binding. This administrative rigor will allow the state to extract taxes more efficiently and manage its complex network of vassalage with a degree of central control that is rare in the late medieval period.
kvn_looking_for_friends: Given our small land area, our rulers understand the need for powerful friends and trade partners. By granting these allies exclusive trading rights in ports like Varna, the Despotate will gain access to modern Western naval technology and financial credit, as well as potentially powerful naval protection against our enemies. This alliance will transform Dobruja into a cosmopolitan trade hub, where the wealth of the Silk Road will be exchanged for the grain and furs of the north.
vid_the_western_connection: Positioned at the crossroads of cultures, the Tsars of Vidin have maintained closer ties with the Catholic West than any other Bulgarian rulers, often marrying into Hungarian and Wallachian nobility. This diplomatic flexibility allows Vidin to survive as an independent state, utilizing Western military technology and courtly traditions to distinguish itself from the rest of Bulgaria. By acting as a bridge between the Orthodox and Catholic worlds, Vidin becomes a center of trade and intellectual exchange that enriches the local treasury and the army.
bulgarian_the_danubian_river_merchants: Leveraging their position as the gatekeepers of the Lower Danube, Bulgarian merchant families have established a sophisticated trade network connecting the Black Sea to Central Europe. By utilizing shallow-draft barges and fortified river ports, they have managed to bypass the expensive and dangerous overland routes, controlling the flow of salt, grain, and timber across the Balkans. This riverine expertise has turned the Danube into a Bulgarian artery of wealth, funding the rise of a new urban elite that we can tax so they keep their privileges.
bul_the_boyar_council: To prevent the internal strife that plagued the 14th century, we will evolve into a 'Consultative Autocracy' where the most powerful Boyars are integrated into a permanent State Council. This body will serve as a high court and a military planning board, ensuring that the interests of the landed nobility are aligned with those of the crown. This political stability will allow us to maintain a large standing army and avoid the devastating civil wars that have historically left the empire vulnerable to its neighbors.
bul_the_hesychast_state_philosophy: The spiritual teachings of Grēgórios Sinaítēs have moved from the hermit's cell to the halls of power. By adopting Hesychasm, a philosophy of inner stillness and divine light, as the unofficial state ideology, we foster a populace that is deeply pious and resilient. This shared spiritual identity acts as a powerful deterrent against the influences from our enemies, making the Bulgarian subjects immune to foreign conversion or subversion.
kvn_the_condotta_of_varna: As a maritime state with a relatively small land population, Karvuna has refined the art of 'contract warfare' by formalizing a permanent Condotta with the Italian maritime powers. Under this arrangement, we provide them with fortified warehouses and naval bases in the Black Sea, and in return, the Italians provide a professional corps of heavy crossbowmen and expert siege engineers for the Despotate's defense. This symbiotic relationship allows Karvuna to punch far above its weight in land battles, utilizing Western tactical innovations and professional discipline to defend its coastal strip while the native Bulgarian sailors dominate the waves, effectively outsourcing its land defense to the most skilled mercenaries in the Mediterranean.
vid_the_order_of_the_danubian_dragon: To ensure the loyalty of the border nobility and create a professional officer corps, the Tsars of Vidin will establish a local knightly order modeled after the Western European Societas Draconistrarum. Members of this order will be granted estates along the Timok and Danube rivers in exchange for maintaining a state of perpetual readiness and providing a heavy cavalry core for the Tsardom's defense. This institution will hopefully bridge the gap between the old Bulgarian Boyar traditions and the chivalric standards of the West, fostering a high level of military discipline and personal loyalty to the crown and prevent internal fragmentation.
fortress_of_the_balkans: We have recognized that spiritual purity alone cannot halt the encroaching craze of the world. To survive, the state has pivoted toward a doctrine of total territorial fortification, transforming the Balkan Mountains into an impassable granite wall. By reinforcing our lands with tiered stone redoubts and permanent garrisons, the nation has created a strategic depth that forces any invader into a lethal war of attrition. This policy ensures that the Bulgarian heartland remains a sanctuary of Orthodox stability, where the flame of our people's heart is shielded behind a ring of iron and stone that no storm can easily douse.
bul_the_silk_and_rose_guilds: Utilizing the fertile Thracian plains and the unique climate of the Rose Valley, we have established state-protected guilds for the production of luxury oils and silk. These high-value, low weight goods are perfect for overland export to the courts of Europe and Asia. The wealth generated by these guilds allows the state to build a massive gold reserve, making our economy one of the most stable and credit-worthy in the entire Mediterranean basin.
bul_the_bulgarian_gunpowder_foundries: Drawing on the iron mines of the Balkan mountains and the expertise of Saxon miners, we will establish the first major domestic gunpowder industry in the region. These foundries will produce heavy siege cannons and early handguns, allowing the Bulgarian army to transition away from purely feudal cavalry toward a more modern, infantry-heavy force. By controlling the production of saltpeter and iron, we will ensure that our walls remain the most dangerous obstacle for any would-be conqueror in the Balkans.
kvn_the_cosmopolitan_code_of_karvuna: To maintain its status as the premier trade hub of the Black Sea, we will promulgate a revolutionary legal framework known as the 'Code of Karvuna', which will grant extraterritorial rights and religious freedom to recognized merchant nations. Regardless of their faith or origin, any merchant operating within our ports will be judged by a commercial court of his peers rather than by local feudal lords. This atmosphere of legal predictability and tolerance will attract a massive influx of capital and expertise, turning Karvuna into a huge hub where the wealth of the silk and spice roads will be reinvested in the state's roads, arsenals, and armies.
vid_the_mining_grants: Vidin needs to expand its influence into the mineral-rich Timok valley, granting charters to Saxon and Ragusan miners to extract silver, lead, and copper. This industrial base will provide the Tsardom with the metal needed for modern currency and the production of high-quality firearms, making Vidin a self-sufficient military power. The wealth from these mines will also allow the Tsars to maintain a professional army.
bulgarian_the_bulgarian_cloth_industry: The Bulgarian towns will be transformed into the industrial heartland of the peninsula through the specialized production of Aba (a durable, thick woolen cloth) and Gaitan (decorative braid). By organizing the local weavers and shepherds into powerful, self-governing guilds, our merchants will be able to secure massive state contracts for the outfitting of the regional armies and the growing urban middle classes of the Mediterranean. This economic surge creates a merchant aristocracy that will signal the transition of the Bulgarian people from a rural peasantry to a sophisticated, proto-industrial society with the financial power to dictate terms to their neighbors.
bul_the_grand_academy_of_the_yantra: The intellectual legacy of the 14th-century Tarnovo Literary School is revived in the 17th century through the creation of a modern state university. This institution focuses on civil law, engineering, and the translation of Western scientific texts into the Bulgarian vernacular, creating a class of bureaucrats who are as capable as any in Paris or Vienna. This modernization of the elite will ensure that we can manage a complex, multi-ethnic empire while maintaining the cultural purity of its Bulgarian core.
bul_the_standing_drilled_infantry: Moving away from seasonal levies, we have established the first permanent 'Regiments of the Lion'. These infantrymen are trained year-round in the use of firearms, following a rigorous drill based on the successes of neighbor models but adapted for Balkan terrain. This professional infantry core give us a reliable tool for offensive warfare, capable of out-marching and out-shooting the traditional armies of our neighbors.
kvn_the_black_sea_admiralty: Karvuna will establish a permanent, state-run Admiralty to oversee the construction of modern deep-water warships and the training of a professional officer corps. Shifting away from small galleys, we will begin building frigates and small ships-of-the-line capable of projecting power as far as the Aegean and the Sea of Azov. This naval modernization will ensure that we remain a major maritime player, capable of defending our trade interests against our enemies.
vid_vidins_custom_houses: As the trade between the upper Danube and the Black Sea grows, Vidin has become one of the most important custom houses on the Lower Danube, regulating the flow of European luxury goods into the Balkans. By implementing a sophisticated system of tariffs and warehouse laws, the state will be able to fill its coffers without placing a heavy burden on its own agricultural population. This trade-heavy economy will allow Vidin to modernize its infrastructure, building paved roads and stone bridges that connect the Danube to the interior of the Balkan Peninsula.
bulgarian_the_bulgarian_national_awakeni: Driven by the writings of monks like Paisius of Hilendar, the Bulgarian people have rediscovered their imperial history and linguistic pride, sparking a massive educational and political rebirth. This movement has moved beyond local grievances to demand a centralized, modern state that can take its place among the great powers of Europe. The result is a highly motivated and literate populace, ready to serve in a modern bureaucracy or a national army, fueled by the conviction that the glory of the Tsars is not a memory, but a future.
bul_the_imperial_restoration_doctrine: We have fully embraced our role as the natural leader of the Balkan peoples, articulating a formal doctrine for the reunification of all former Bulgarian lands. This fate is backed by a modern, professionalized army and a sophisticated diplomatic corps that seek to play the Great Powers against one another. The belief in a 'Greater Bulgaria' becomes the central pillar of the state, driving a policy of aggressive expansion and cultural assimilation that seeks to restore the empire of Simeon the Great.
bul_the_bulgarian_census_bureau: Knowledge is power. We have instituted a decennial census that records every person, unit of livestock, and hearth in the empire. This precise data allows for the most efficient taxation and conscription system in the Balkans. By knowing exactly what the nation can provide, we can plan long-term campaigns with a level of logistical certainty that ensures our armies are always well-fed and our coffers never empty.
kvn_the_free_port_of_varna: To cement our position as the premier commercial hub of the Balkans, we will declare Varna a free port, exempting international merchants from most traditional duties in exchange for a flat transit fee. This policy will attract a massive diaspora of merchants, bankers, and insurers, making Varna the 'Venice of the Black Sea' and the financial capital of the Bulgarian world. The resulting wealth will allow us to maintain a professional army and a world-class navy, ensuring that our coastal state remains a wealthy and independent power in an age of giants.
vid_the_codex_shishman: To finalize the transition from a medieval feudal state to a modern, centralized monarchy, the Tsardom will promulgate the Societas Codex Shishman, a comprehensive legal reform that unifies the disparate local customs of the Western Balkans. This code will establish a professional judiciary independent of the local landowners and standardize the weights, measures, and currencies used throughout Vidin's trade network. By providing a predictable and fair legal environment, we will ensure the growth of a loyal urban middle class and the stability of the state's tax revenue. This administrative modernization will make Vidin a beacon of 'Enlightened Despotism' in the East, where the rule of law is as ironclad as the walls of Baba Vida itself.
bur_between_two_realms: We can consider ourselves to be both members of the traditional lands of the Holy Roman Empire, and of the realm of France. While this can complicate feudal relations, the situation has molded us into adept diplomats, able to skillfully play both sides to our own advantage.
bur_knightly_prowess: We occupy a prestigious position within the feudal system of France. Therefore, it is only right that our troops are seen as a reflection of the Burgundian spirit.
golden_fleece: One of Europe's foremost chivalric orders. Being a Knight of the Golden Fleece is a mark of great status, and reflects well upon us.
promote_estates_general: Burgundy is a feudal creation with various parts conjoined under different conditions, which has created strong local identities. By promoting a central assembly, we give a forum for these interests, promoting a smooth and uncontested rule.
reform_the_feudal_army: The feudal levy system has proven slow and unreliable in this new age of professional warfare. Inspired by the French model, we will replace our scattered vassal hosts with salaried companies, skilled officers, and integrated armies. A disciplined core of professional soldiers will form the backbone of a modern and adaptable army.
compagnie_d_ordonnance: Our reliance on feudal levies has proven inadequate for the demands of modern warfare. The creation of permanently contracted cavalry units, the Compagnies d'Ordonnance, provides us with a reliable and professional military force directly loyal to the Crown.
influence_of_the_burgundian_towns: The traditional Estates General favors the clergy and nobility, but the rising wealth and political importance of towns can no longer be ignored. By refining its structure to reflect the growing strength of the merchant class, we ensure more balanced governance while preserving the privileges of the other estates. A stronger urban voice will also enhance our administrative capacities and speed up the rate of urbanization.
create_the_regimental_system: To ensure consistent recruitment and sufficient supply of fighters, we must establish a formal regimental system. This reform will allow us to organize manpower more effectively, centralize command structures, and reduce dependence on local nobles and foreign mercenaries.
bur_rich_soil_of_burgundy: The lands of Burgundy are well-suited to growing plants and herding animals. Grapes are particularly apt for local growing conditions. With skilled cultivation, it should be easy to foster an agricultural industry.
cha_go_tram_huong: The resinous heartwood of our native trees, known as agarwood or Trầm Hương, is treasured not only for its enchanting aroma but also for its spiritual and medicinal properties. Across the seas, nobles and monks alike covet it for incense, perfumes, and offerings. By protecting our forests and refining our harvesting methods, we can turn this rare natural gift into one of our most prized exports.
my_son_sanctuary: Within the lush valleys of central Champa lies the sacred temple complex of Mỹ Sơn, where for generations our kings and priests have performed solemn rites to Śiva, protector of our realm. These towers are carved with devotion and adorned with sacred symbols, connecting us to our ancestors and the divine. As long as incense burns in their sanctuaries, the soul of Champa shall endure.
cri_genghisid_legacy: Our forefathers rode with Genghis Khān as he ravaged the known world. We have kept our military traditions alive, and continued to be ruled by Khāns who claim descent from the Genghisid line.
cri_slavers: There is a fortune to be made from the Slaves trade; unwitting Christian believers who fall into our grasp fetch a high price in Turkish, Arabian, and Italian markets.
cri_steppe_commanders: Crimean cavalry commanders have mastered the art of mobility in steppes warfare, using speed, flanking, and ambush to outmatch slower European armies.
cri_free_cattle_grazing: We place no restrictions on pastoral farmers for the grazing of their great herds of horses and cattle. Herders are free to go about their business as they wish, able to traverse the steppe safely and trade freely.
cri_devshirme_of_the_steppes: Crimean elites mimicked aspects of Ottoman military-administrative practices, blending Turkic and Muslim systems to manage manpower and military efficiency.
hin_sepahi: Neglecting the importance of the infantry has been the downfall of many would-be conquerors. We must ensure that our troops are equipped with the most effective firearms and drilled in tactics that can adapt to any foe.
hin_united_india: The many people, cultures, languages, and nations that make up India shall be finally united under a single banner. Only with common understanding and a carefully fostered unity among all our people can we strive towards greater ambitions.
hin_ganga: Many Hindu faithful worship the river Ganges as a goddess that brings purity and redemption to the faithful. We implore pilgrims to visit the river banks to bathe in the sacred waters. Through Gaṅgā, our nation is made pure.
hin_persianate_court: Foreign languages and noble customs have richly influenced the courts of India for a long time. We should utilize these connections to invite the most capable advisors to serve under our guidance.
hin_gunpowder_empire: Our mastery of gunpowder warfare has brought us glory and helped us found our great state. This dominance would be impossible without fostering firearms production for our troops.
hin_sufism: Muslim princes across the world compete to attract the wisest Sufi teachers. As our renown has grown, more of these Sufis have joined us. Towns are founded wherever they settle, often in previously inhospitable regions, and the local people are inspired to convert through the wisdom of the Sufis.
hin_administration_of_india: Governing a state as large as an entire subcontinent is no easy task. We will need to develop a robust system of administration in cooperation with local princes to get the most out of our production and to ensure widespread stability.
hin_indian_empire: No ruler, be they Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, or Jain, has ever succeeded in conquering the entirety of the subcontinent. We shall be the first universal rulers of India!
hin_rocketry: Iron-cased rockets have yet to be widely adapted for military purposes, yet their explosive power surely has tactical applications. We should experiment with this technology and test it on the battlefield.
hin_industrialization: Conditions in our economy are ideal for rapid industrial growth. With new technology we can ensure better conditions for our local production, particularly in the textile industry. Our focus on new methods means that our state can ensure steady industrial expansion.
hun_composite_light_cavalry: Made up of horse archers as well as swift horsemen, our light cavalry is the backbone of our military force. Our mounted forces have shown their mettle time and time again, and will inevitably lead our forces to glory once more.
hun_castle_warriors: The Castle Warriors, one of the most select classes in our society, are duty-bound to provide military service to their local ispáns in royal castle districts. Stalwarts from the earliest days of our nation, these privileged landholders hold a unique position, actively defending their realm while cherishing their hereditary rights.
hun_multi_culturalism: The Carpathian Basin is home to more than just Hungarian people. Slovak, Ruthenian,Cuman, and Carpathian German people, among many other different minorities, call our realm their home. Given this diversity, it is only natural that our government proficiently absorbs and adopts these different cultures into our state.
hun_renaissance_knowledge: The peasants consider their ruler a just one because they are officially protected from having excessive demands and other abuses heaped upon them by magnates. The ruler of Hungary is a true Renaissance prince: a successful military leader and administrator, an outstanding linguist, and an enlightened patron of the arts.
hun_reformed_coinage: To pay for our new professional army, we will need a steady stream of revenue. Reforming the coinage to standardize weights will make this much easier, because we shall know exactly how much people need to pay.
hun_found_the_black_army: Inspired by the writings of Julius Caesar, Hungary shall maintain a corps of professional soldiers. These warriors will be so fierce that our enemies shall whisper terrified tales of 'The Black Army' to their children at night!
hun_hungarian_hussars: Drawing inspiration from the storied legacy of King Matthias I Corvinus' cavalry, this idea introduces the 'Royal Hussar Regiments,' granting a formidable edge to Hungary's light cavalry forces. With their swift and fearless charges, these regiments are a symbol of Hungarian martial prowess, proving indispensable on the battlefields of Europe.
hun_hungarian_reformation: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Our realm has been threatened by outside powers for long enough. By joining the Reformation and abandoning the duty of following the Pope like a lapdog, we can break at least one of the shackles oppressing us!
hun_the_catholic_shield: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Yet, the hearts of the faithful remain strong. God and His loyal servants will withstand this heretical madness.
hun_realm_of_many_religions: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Alas, the Reformation has split families apart, made former friends into enemies, and threatened the very stability of many nations. However, our realm knows better than to fall victim to this theological quarreling. We are a people and a realm of many religions, after all.
hun_bulwark_of_christianity: With Turkish power rising in the south, it falls to the people of Hungary to defend faithful kingdoms from the Turkish threat. Let it be known that we will not flinch from our sacred duty!
hun_revolutionized_military_tactics: As military technology advances, so do battlefield tactics. It is imperative to the survival of our state that we keep pace with the ever-evolving nature of land warfare.
hun_curtailed_peasantry: Hungary is not blessed with protective natural frontiers. The wild plains that first brought our ancestors here were perfect for launching raids into the West, not for defense. If Hungary is to defend itself, we will need resources. The best solution is to allow our magnates to bind the peasants more closely to the land, ensuring greater productivity.
hun_strengthened_towns: Towns are key factors in producing the wealth Hungary needs to grow and prosper. If we ensure the operations of our townships are protected from the power-hungry machinations of the nobility, they will continue to bring in trade, which we can tax.
hun_hungarian_unity: Although our subjects have faced many external threats over the years, the spirit and will of the Hungarian people remains unbroken. Unifying Hungarian hearts is greatly inspiring to our patriotic soldiers, who will defend our homelands to the last man.
ilk_restore_yam: The Yäm, our ancient system of relay stations and messengers, once connected the furthest corners of the Mongol world. By restoring this vast network across Persia and beyond, we ensure that our orders are swift, our envoys safe, and our dominion responsive, just as it was in the golden days of the Khans.
ilk_ilkhanate_resurgent: What was once broken is now reborn. Our banners fly once more across Persia, invoking awe and fear in equal measure. As word of our rising power spreads, the world will remember what it means to be ruled by a true Īlkhān.
ilk_persian_arts_and_architecture: Our ancestors ruled with the sword, but their greatness was measured in palaces, libraries, and minarets. Let us follow their example and fund not only walls and roads, but mosques, gardens, and schools as testaments to Īlkhānān grandeur.
ilk_descendants_of_genghis_khan: The blood of the Khāghān runs through our veins. Let no man forget that our rule was ordained on the steppes and sealed by conquest. Our horsemen remain unmatched, and our banners bear not just a name, but a birthright.
ilk_new_roots: The days of pure steppe conquest lie behind us. We have sown ourselves into the soil of progress and reformation. From that soil, a more stable, sophisticated state shall grow. Though our hearts may still beat to the rhythm of the open fields, our future lies in lasting institutions, not fleeting raids.
ita_connect_the_interior: While the terrain of our lands allows for swift transportation and travel along the coastline, the interior of the Italian peninsula is much harder to traverse in many places. Connecting not only interior locales, but also coast with coast, will ensure easier mercantile operations and improved maneuverability of our troops.
ita_increased_recruitment: Italy is a desired possession for many foreign rulers. If we want to defend our country, we must expand recruitment for both our land and sea forces. Since Italy is vulnerable to invasions both from across the alpine passes and our vast coastline, we must ensure the army and navy are well-prepared to face any conqueror looking to disrupt the peace of the peninsula.
ita_flourishing_urban_centers: Our lands are blessed with many highly urbanized areas. This not only offers us ample opportunity to manufacture goods, but their mercantile connections also enable us to ship them to foreign markets for our profit. Clearing any obstruction to expanding these industries will guarantee their continued success.
ita_influence_over_the_clergy: With its close proximity to the Holy See, Italy has a long tradition of powerful and talented clergy in the service of the faith. Regardless of where our religious matters will take us, we should maintain good relations with our clergy.
ita_enduring_hardship: Foreign interest in Italy has many times turned our lands into the battlefield of stronger countries. Sustaining our people during these times of need is a difficult task. Establishing secure locations to shelter our population during conflict will ensure their support during even the most dire wars.
ita_attractive_migration: The fertile, mild land of our peninsula is a popular place for people from bordering countries to seek their fortunes. While many of our cities already rely on labor from seasonal migrants, we should increase our efforts to settle these people into our lands permanently.
sons_of_the_salur_tribe: The Karamanids trace their ancestry to the Salur, one of the major Oghuz tribes. Known for both their leadership and valor, the Salur legacy shapes our state's identity and our claim to represent the Turkmen of Anatolia.
mehmed_beys_firman: Meḥmed I issued a decree demanding that only Turkish be spoken in courts, dervish lodges, assemblies, and public squares. This act rejected Persian and Arabic dominance in elite circles and laid the groundwork for a uniquely Turkmen cultural policy.
karamanid_cavalry: Cavalry has always been the cornerstone of Turkmen warfare. Our riders, trained from a young age and mounted on hardy Anatolian horses, uphold the proud traditions of steppe warfare with discipline and striking force.
home_of_the_whirling_dervishes: Konya, our spiritual center, is home to the followers of Mevlânâ Jalāl ad-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī. Their sacred practice — the sema — symbolizes the soul's journey toward divine truth. Their presence deepens the mystic traditions of our realm and reinforces our Sufi roots.
symbol_of_catholicism: Jerusalem is the holiest city in Christendom, the very place of Christ's Passion and Resurrection. By asserting Catholic supremacy over these sacred grounds, we become the spiritual beacon of the Latin world and a pillar of the true faith.
protectors_of_jerusalem: We stand on the frontlines of Christendom, surrounded by unbelief. It is our sacred duty to shield the Holy City and strike fear into the hearts of heathens who would dare usurp it.
rites_holy_sepulchre: In the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, the ancient Latin rites are once more performed in full splendor. These solemn rituals, honoring the death and resurrection of Christ, reinforce our divine mandate to rule this land and spread the teachings of our faith.
latin_patriarch: Rome has reinstated the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, once exiled and forgotten. Now restored, the Patriarch shall strengthen our influence in Rome and reinforce our role as guardian of the Church's interests in the East.
latinate_integration: Our realm is a crucible of noble blood from around Europe, zealous pilgrims, and old Levantine stock. Through careful governance, we shall weave together this diverse heritage into a Latin Christian society, where faith and culture go hand in hand.
kon_bakongo_confederation: Before the rise of our realm, the people of this region governed themselves through clan councils and provincial alliances. What we now call Kongo emerged from centuries of interwoven relationships, where loyalty to the land and kin outweighed loyalty to borders. Uniting this patchwork into a centralized realm was no small feat, but we did it and we will keep it together yet.
kon_lineage_lukeni_lua_nimi: All things must begin somewhere, and for our kingdom, that beginning lies with Lukeni lua Nimi. He was more than a conqueror. Indeed, he was a founder, the father of our realm. His bloodline commanded respect, not just for its ancestry, but because it reminds the people who first dared to dream of a unified Kongo.
kon_european_contact: The strangers came from the sea with beards, books, and barrels of wine. They brought with them strange gods, stranger languages, and an entire ocean of opportunity. Our emissaries have learned their customs, their intentions, and — most importantly — how to turn their need for allies into our advantage.
kon_cultural_syncreticism: The influx of foreigners and cultural exchanges have made an impact on our society. However, we have not abandoned our own ways. We call upon deities by Kikongo names, we proudly wear our religious insignia, and our ceremonies echo with both drums and hymns. This is a vibrant example of our clarity, and the gods seem to agree.
kon_study_european_firearms: The musket may not make a man brave, but it certainly makes him fearsome. Let those in Europe boast of their superiority; we will buy their weapons, master their drills, and soon enough the only thing distinguishing our soldiers from theirs will be the color of their flags.
kon_transatlantic_slave_trade: Prisoners and laborers are needed overseas to operate our many worksites, plantations, and mines. While this is far from a noble endeavor, none can deny the profitable nature of these exploits.
settle_the_islands: Across the scattered isles of our homeland lie countless shores awaiting our touch. By strengthening our presence among these islands, we secure the wealth of our people: new trade posts, new harvests, and new communities bound by the waves that unite us.
people_of_the_sea: We are a people shaped by wind and tide. From childhood, we learn the ways of the monsoon, the pulse of the straits, and the call of the open ocean. Our sailors carry this knowledge into every voyage, earning renown across the archipelago for their courage and mastery.
malay_merchants_in_every_port: From the bazaars of Arabia to the harbors of East Asia, our merchants are a familiar sight. Their presence forms a vast network of cooperation, easing the establishment of our enclaves abroad and extending our reach into every great entrepôt of the world.
expert_hagglers: Wherever our traders land, be it the coasts of South Asia or the markets of distant China, they are respected for their sharp tongues and keen judgement. Navigating both seas and bargains with equal finesse, they ensure that our trades are never at a disadvantage.
agreements_sea_nomads: The Sama and other sea-wandering peoples have long lived upon the water itself, drifting between islands with unmatched skill. Through knowledge-sharing or agreements of mutual respect and shared opportunity, we shall ensure safe passage and swift repairs.
masters_of_spice: Trading in cloves holds much wealth for us and our people. By securing the lands and seas from which these spices flow, we stand at the center of a trade that spans the world, and no merchant can ignore the allure of these goods.
orm_a_vast_emporium: It has been said that Ormus is 'a vast emporium where there were peoples and goods of every description from all parts of the world' or that 'If all the world were a golden ring, Ormus would be the jewel in it'. Our realm's identity is inseparable from commerce. Indeed, ships from Gujarat, Arabia, and even China anchor in our ports, exchanging spices, Gems, Silk, and stories.
hormuz_toll: At the narrowest point of the Persian Gulf stands Ormus, the gatekeeper of east-west maritime trade. No vessel passes without our knowledge — or without paying our fee. For centuries, this toll has not just made us richer, but shaped our diplomacy and how we project power across the vast seas.
gate_of_the_persian_gulf: Ormus controls the strait that links the Indian Ocean to the interior of Asia. Whoever holds this vital passage dictates the rhythm of maritime traffic. Our command of these waters must be absolute, lest our influence be diminished.
moqarrariya: For generations, our realm maintained peace with the mainland through the ancient tribute system known as Moqarrariya. Rather than depending on custom and negotiation, let us codify these tributes into formal pacts — securing fresh water, overland safety, and long-term stability through reliable diplomacy.
develop_qeshm_and_ormuz: Though dry and rocky, the islands of Qeshm and Ormus have sustained urban life thanks to careful provisioning and rich trade. With proper investment, their ports and workshops can flourish further, turning them from logistical hubs into centers of innovation and productivity.
ormuzi_navy: The Persian Gulf is crossed daily by our fleets — be they traders, patrols, or armed escorts. But to match the ambitions of those who envy our position, we must expand and modernize. Let Ormus become more than just a trading post: a maritime arsenal.
mint_of_the_gulf: Ormuzi coinage circulates from Basra al-Hamra to Bengal, trusted for its purity and weight. By institutionalizing our mint and expanding our issuance, we reinforce our financial sovereignty — and claim fiscal supremacy over the Indian Ocean.
rom_spqr: The Senate and the people of Rome are the eternal foundations of our state. By invoking this ancient authority, we remind all that Rome rules not merely by force of arms, but by the will of its citizens and its institutions.
rom_pax_romana: Peace under Rome does not mean the absence of war, but the triumph of order. Through enforcing our laws and building extensive road systems, as well as the might of our armies, we will bring stability and prosperity to every corner of the Empire.
rom_restore_the_legions: The Legions were once the pride of Rome, feared and respected across the world. To restore them is to also revive the discipline, organization, and indomitable spirit that our great empire is built upon.
rom_revival_of_arts_and_culture: Rome was as much a center of culture as it was an Empire of conquest. By sponsoring poets, scholars, and architects, we will rekindle the creative flame that once illuminated the ancient world.
rom_new_corpus_juris_civilis: Our jurists shall compile and refine our laws into a comprehensive body, drawing on the wisdom of Justinian and the Republic alike. In doing so, we will assure justice for all Roman citizens.
rom_bread_and_circuses: The people must be kept happy and sated, for discontent breeds revolt. By putting grain on their tables and providing diverting activities such as games and public festivals, we shall win their loyalty and strengthen the state through their patriotism.
rom_citizenship: Citizenship is the lifeblood of Rome, binding peoples of every province into a single political body. Extending these rights ensures integration and the promise of advancement for all who serve the empire.
rom_all_roads_lead_to_rome: The Roman road system is the envy of the world. It binds our empire together, speeding merchants, messengers, and soldiers alike, with all paths converging in the Eternal City.
rom_provincial_governors: Our more remote provinces cannot effectively be ruled from Rome only. By placing competent governors in the outlying regions, we will guarantee that our laws are followed and taxes paid promptly in even the most distant lands of the empire.
rom_imperium_sine_fine: Rome's destiny knows no bounds. From the Pillars of Hercules to the edges of the earth, we will expand our dominion without end, bringing civilization wherever the Imperial Eagle soars.
rom_triumphs: A triumph is more than a mere procession. Indeed, it is the living memory of conquest, paraded through the streets of our greatest cities. Such ceremonies inspire loyalty, awe, fear, and ambition in equal measure.
rom_roman_architecture: From aqueducts to amphitheaters, Roman engineering leaves behind monuments that endure for centuries. Our mastery of stone and arch will show the entire world that Rome's greatness is eternal.
sca_unified_scandinavia: The union of Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland under one crown has turned the North from a battleground of competing kings into a centralized power. With unified administration and increased cooperation among the estates, we can assert stronger control over the realm.
sca_legacy_kalmar_union: Though the Kalmar Union dissolved in conflict, it established a precedent for shared Nordic sovereignty. Drawing upon this legacy, we reaffirm our authority and remind our subjects that unity brings strength, not subjugation.
sca_sound_toll: Control over the Øresund grants us the right to impose the Sound Toll on all foreign ships passing through the Danish straits. This ancient privilege turns geographic advantage into tangible wealth, strengthening our dominance over northern trade.
norwegian_heritage: Norway's rugged coastlines and maritime traditions have shaped a people skilled in seafaring, fishing, and navigation. The legacy of Norwegian fishermen and shipbuilders fuels our naval endeavors and bolsters the lifeblood of our coastal communities.
