This commercial primacy keeps the city the beating heart of Andalusian trade even as the formal Indies monopoly waxes and wanes.
tol_fabrica_nacional: The royal arms works of Toledo grows into a great Fábrica Nacional de Armas, its water- and steam-driven shops turning out the swords, bayonets, and firearms of the modern conscript army in industrial quantity. The old handcraft of the espaderos is reorganized into standardized production lines feeding the arsenals of the nation. This factory makes the city the armory of the modern state and carries its steel tradition into the industrial age.
chg_legacy_of_chagatai: The legacy of Genghis Khān is ours through his son Chagatai. All shall tremble before us as we reclaim his glory!
chg_chagatai_riders: The horses of Genghis Khān trampled and conquered territories stretching from Europe to China. As his heirs and successors, our cavalry will instill fear of the same thing happening into our enemies.
chg_the_mountain_khanate: We lie sheltered between Balkhash Lake and the Tiānshān Mountains. It is a harsh and unforgiving land, one which our people know how to use as a weapon against would-be invaders.
chg_border_wars: Surrounded by people that would oppose us, we face a constant struggle to maintain our borders. Our ever-vigilant soldiers have plentiful opportunities to hone their skills in battle, giving birth to a combat-hardened warrior people ready to reclaim the legacy of the Great Khān.
chg_sons_of_chagatai: We can trace our line back to Chagatai Khān, the second son of Genghis Khān, who once ruled these lands and established a powerful Mongolian successor state. Although a long time has passed since then, we can still claim considerable legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of our fierce ancestor.
chg_tradition_of_conquest: Conquering people can be a tricky business; not everyone is ready to accept our enlightened government. Still, we have discovered that there are easier ways to bring people into our empire than building a mountain of skulls — something that our ancestors never learned.
chg_scheming_court: The constant power struggles between the various princes, nobles, cities, and tribes in the Chagatai Khanate have produced a nation of highly adept schemers. If we can put aside our quarrels and channel this energy towards outsmarting our enemies, it would be a great boon to our people.
chg_glory_of_conquest: Let it be known that boy cannot be a man unless he has ridden first with our invincible host, that he can take no wife until he has taken another man's wife, that he is not worthy of a hut until he has burnt down someone else's. Let service in our armies be the only route to manhood.
chg_unrelenting_horde: Our armies shall march like the great hordes of Genghis Khān. Our troops shall trample our enemies under our hooves like blades of grass of our native steppes. All shall fear the power of our armies!
baihua: Our domain stretches well beyond the horizon. The emergence of a common written language among our subjects will surely bridge the gaps between us, elevate our culture, and reduce conflict based on misunderstanding and linguistic differences.
zaju: Typically consisting of four acts, this brilliant display of dance and music is a colorful expression of the artistic heights that our society has achieved.
successors_of_genghis_khan: From the days of total conquest to the vast expanses of Genghis Khān's great Empire, our people descend from generations of earthshakers. Our people are the ones destined to author history.
confucian_influences: If we are to manage our realm properly, our advisors shall find great wisdom about administration in Confucian teachings, which emphasize meritocratic selection of officials, attention to administrative detail, and other foundational advice for creating a healthy and prosperous government.
chi_bureaucracy_advance: Our realm rests upon a tradition of sophisticated administrative institutions, from the Central Secretariat that coordinates all civil governance to the Censorate that holds our officials to account. We shall make this legacy of imperial administration the foundation of our state.
extensive_canal_works: The many rivers that cross our domain have tremendous economic potential. By constructing extensive canal networks, we can connect waterways to inland settlements, making transportation easier while also providing a reliable water supply to our people.
tributary_system: A system of subjugated local warlords and other rulers who send us regular gifts of allegiance in recognition of our overlordship. To refine and centralize this system would help us tighten our grip and squeeze more out of them.
zhongshu_sheng: One of the most vital branches of the Three Departments and Six Ministries, the central secretariat is responsible for the drafting and codification of many Imperial reforms and decrees.
lijia_system: Under the Lǐ Jiǎ system, we are able to exercise control over our borderlands through the allocation of settled armies. By granting land and agricultural rights to our stationed troops, our borders will be safer and our authority shall be affirmed.
yulin_tuce: Tax evasion is a timeless problem that even plagued our ancestors, but we may have found a solution: By compiling registers for districts and provinces, we will keep better track of the taxes owed to the central government by every plot. This taxation is largely determined based on the grain yield of every plot that undergoes survey.
weisuo_system: Many would-be conquerors eye our lands with covetous intent. If we are to defend our territory, we must set up a garrison system, aimed at rapidly responding to hostile invasions. Through the recruitment of local troops, our defensive prowess will be supplemented through supplies and more efficient logistics.
grand_coordinators: Maintaining control over our territories, policymaking, and military operations is vital for the continuation of our dynasty. Through the creation of Grand Coordinators, a body of high-ranking officials who can coordinate governance across our vast empire, we will succeed in cementing our position through effective stabilization of internal and external matters.
the_censorate: Parallel to other institutes within our administration, this branch of our government is in charge of preventing corruption. The censors are tasked with keeping palatial intrigues and malfeasance in check, often seen as the eyes and ears of the Emperor.
the_tea_trade: A staple beverage of our society, Tea has come to dominate social gatherings, becoming the choice drink of many. This will undoubtedly lead to not only new varieties being cultivated, but a production boom as well.
tu_bing: In our quest to shore up our border defenses, it has become apparent that we must create a system of recruitment centered around local soldiers and stalwarts. These fighters will be a valuable addition to our military capabilities, and shall be kept separate from the Wèi Suǒ system.
tusi_titles: Titles granted to warlords and local strongmen, these administrative positions are used to quell unrest and keep the rural populace under central control.
salt_monopoly: The Salt monopoly was once our most important revenue source, but previous Emperors abolished it to encourage free trade. It is time to return the Salt trade to state control.
reform_the_grand_secretariat: Considered the de facto highest institution in our nation, the Grand Secretariat has served our rulers for centuries. Wielding immense influence over administrative affairs, this body of cabinet ministers must undergo a reform to further increase its effectiveness.
grand_military_parades: Our illustrious military history of our people is a great source of inspiration and pride for our people. By conducting elaborate parades to showcase our armies, we will decisively demonstrate our martial experience and unparalleled strength.
silver_standard: By turning most obligations towards the central government - from poll taxes to the labor obligations of the peasants or the tributes of local officials - into a single silver payment, the amount of which is based on the population and cultivated land in each prefecture, tax collection will become easier and our income will increase.
nine_garrisons_of_the_great_wall: In order to defend against the vicious barbarian onslaught, we must do more than simply repair the Great Wall. The Nine Garrisons are militarized garrison towns along the Wall that will not only help to defend the most important passes, but also improve the overall logistical situation on our northern border.
the_red_cannon: The red-haired barbarians from Europe may be uncivilized and ill-mannered, but they do know how to make artillery and firearms of good quality. Importing and duplicating their weapons will give our army a significant advantage against all invaders.
woodblock_printing: The production of elegant illustrations, artworks, and books using this printing method has captivated our people's attention, and our master printers constantly strive to perfect their techniques. Woodblock printing has become part of our culture and, with recent improvements to and expansion of our literary production, will further elevate our prestige.
green_standard_army: The Green Standard Army, a military force mainly composed of ethnic Hàn soldiers, coexists with our Eight Banner armies. Originally formed by surrendered troops and recruited on a voluntary, long-term basis, they attract individuals from socially disadvantaged backgrounds. Used as a police force post-consolidation, they will play a crucial role in local military governance, while Bannermen will be reserved for emergencies and sustained resistance.
great_tax_reform: Our wealthy nation has ample coin and bounteous, fertile fields, but all this abundance requires comprehensive taxation. The Great Tax Reform enables more efficient revenue management, which should guarantee a healthier budget for our realm.
junji_chu: Also known as the Grand Council, the Jūnjī Chù is tasked with overseeing military affairs. As the most important privy council, it has come to overshadow the Grand Secretariat that held sway over previous dynasties. Despite its crucial role, this council will retain an informal nature within the inner court, with its members holding other official roles besides their councilorship.
jingdezhen_porcelain: Our Porcelain industry is emblematic of the prosperity and tradition of artisanal excellence alive in our Empire. By perfecting the already-superior Porcelain production techniques of Jǐngdézhèn, we will spread our cultural influence far and wide.
sanxitang: The Hall of Three Rarities is our most splendid repository of rare, valuable objects and works of art. Through the generous patronage of our ruler, it has flowered into a venue for academic discussions, lectures, and even cultural events, promoting intellectual exchange and scholarly pursuits.
monuments_to_greatness: In our people's many millennia of existence on this planet, they have endured thousands of catastrophes through sheer tenacity. This innate steely strength has come to be recognized as a defining feature of our society. We showcase our resilience in the strength of our army and the divine beauty of our art.
ten_great_campaigns: The Ten Great Campaigns are aimed at expanding our influence both inside and outside our borders. To achieve that, we will draft a huge army to crush any resistance that we might find in our way. We shall choke the life out of any rebellion before it has the chance to raise its head, and our glory will be eternal.
cir_tribal_elections: We will elect a nominal leader of our people, who will act as our representative but will not meddle with the oversight of local lords.
cir_mercenary_employment: Our lands have again and again been raided by foreign powers, and our people enslaved. Some of these slaves, used as soldiers, have advanced in their new lives, accumulating power and wealth of their own. With some convincing, we could convince them to return to our lands, and protect it from future invasions.
cir_horsemen_of_the_steppe: Our position at the edge of the steppes has resulted in multiple mounted invasions of our homelands. If we want to ensure our independence, we will need to raise a great host ourselves, and expand our influence over the steppes, securing our heartland.
cir_city_and_fortress: Our settlements lie unprotected, and are easy prey to any invader. As these settlements grow, however, we can directly incorporate the hilly terrain into our defensive lines, enhancing their protection. If necessary, we can even create the elevated terrain required ourselves.
cir_grand_prince_of_circassia: To unify our people, we shall elect the greatest of our lords as the Grand Prince, who will serve as an inspiring leader for our troops.
cir_multireligious_society: Our lands are frequented by many Catholic, Muslim, and Orthodox people, who frequently engage in trade with our population. We should foster a collective tolerance between all our subjects, to promote peace and stability.
croatian_the_glagolitic_lithurgy: Our culture is defined by the unique privilege of the Glagolitic liturgy, which makes ours the only land in the Catholic world where the Mass is sung in the native Slavic tongue. This tradition bridges the gap between the Latin cities and the Slavic heartland, creating a unified cultural identity. By preserving this ancient script, our people maintain a secret language that reinforces their distinctiveness, providing a sense of national pride that resists assimilation by both the Italian and Germanic cultural spheres.
cro_maritime_connections: This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.
cro_the_bashka_tablet: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. Even under foreign kings, the Croatians see themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, and that pride keeps our culture vibrant and proof against decay from outside.
svn_the_marturina_tax_system: We have formalized the Marturina (marten pelt tax, also known as Kunovina), a unique and ancient Slavonian tribute system that provides the Ban with a store of wealth that is valuable and easy to carry. By standardizing the value of these pelts against the Royal Mark, we have created a stable currency for the region that holds its value. This fiscal reliability allows the Banate to maintain a professional guard and build extensive wooden and stone river fortifications along the vulnerable Drava crossings without burdening the peasantry with excessive grain taxes.
cro_influx_of_foreign_knowledge: The coastal cities have become vibrant centers of the Renaissance, where scholars and artists blend classical Italian influences with a distinct Slavic sensibility. This intellectual movement produces great thinkers who contribute to European science, poetry, and philosophy, proving that Croatian culture is at the forefront of the modern era. The patronage of wealthy merchant families allows for the construction of magnificent cathedrals and palaces, turning our coast into a beacon of high culture that attracts the finest minds of the age.
cro_legacy_of_the_trpimirovic: We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.
cro_the_banovac_silver_denar: We have asserted the right of Monetaria, establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.
svn_the_slavonian_sabor: Our people are governed under the scrutiny of the Slavonian Sabor. This legislative independence allows the Slavonian nobility to address the specific needs of the inter-river plains, such as drainage projects and the regulation of grain markets. By having a dedicated assembly, the Banate can react quickly to regional crises and negotiate directly for tax exemptions, ensuring that Slavonia's agricultural wealth is used primarily for Slavonia's own defense and improvement.
cro_trade_posts: The cultural soul of Croatia has reached a literary peak with works like Judita by Marko Marulić, the 'Father of Croatian Literature'. By using biblical allegory to describe the contemporary defense of our lands, Marulić has provided the nation with a high culture blueprint for survival. This literature creates a bridge between the Renaissance urbanite and the frontier soldier, unifying all classes under a shared heroic mission and ensuring the preservation of the Croatian tongue as a language of high art and theological debate.
cro_antemurale_christianitatis: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the Antemurale Christianitatis (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.
cro_the_croatian_press: We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.
svn_the_alluvial_grant_lands: The fertile silt between the Sava and Drava is our greatest asset. By granting tax-free plots in exchange for clearing the heavy riverine brush, we are turning the flooded plains into the primary grain basin of the North. Such harvests can feed a massive standing army, so that the Kingdom's defenders eat well even through the most grueling winter blockades.
croatian_the_peasants_revolts: The crushing weight of feudal obligations in the face of constant war caused peasant revolts in the past. The peasantry rose not against us, but against the 'unjust' nobility who failed to protect them while demanding excessive tithes. Though these revolts have been usually brutally suppressed, they have left a lasting legacy of social consciousness and have transformed the relationship between the classes, forcing the state to eventually moderate its tax demands to maintain internal stability.
cro_reliance_on_adriatic: To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks, refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps them constantly on the defensive.
cro_the_jesuit_academy: Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This reform ensures that our administration is led by educated men capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.
svn_the_oak_staple_rights: Slavonian Oak is now the most sought-after timber in the Mediterranean for its iron-like resistance to water rot. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of mature oak to the Venetian shipyards, we have secured a strategic economic lever over the maritime republics. This trade does not just fill our coffers; it ensures that the very foundations of Venice's palaces and the hulls of their galleys are physically composed of Croatian soil, giving us a unique diplomatic influence over the 'Queen of the Adriatic'.
croatian_the_cravats: During these convulsed years, the world has taken notice of the distinct, elite light cavalry regiments from the Croatian Military. Beyond their legendary mobility and ferocity, these horsemen have introduced a unique sartorial innovation: a functional, knotted cloth worn around the neck to secure their shirt collars and provide protection from the chafing of breastplates. This cravat (a name derived from the French mispronunciation of Croate) has rapidly transcended the battlefield to become the height of Parisian and European fashion. By transforming a rugged military necessity into a hallmark of fashionable dressing, our culture has achieved a subtle but permanent victory. This sartorial dominance ensures that the image of the Croatian officer is one of both tactical lethality and unparalleled gallantry.
cro_baroque_pietas: Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.
cro_the_national_garrison_system: To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.
svn_swamp_drainage_projects: By investing in large-scale hydraulic engineering projects to drain the vast marshlands of the riverine areas, we unlock thousands of acres of new, fertile farmland. These reclaimed lands will be soon settled, swelling the population and tax rolls of the province while draining away the sources of disease. This transformation of the landscape not only strengthens our economy but also creates a more navigable and defensible terrain, removing the natural barriers that once hindered our own internal communications.
croatian_the_illyrian_movement: Over the last few years, our nation has witnessed the explosion of the Illyrian Movement, a cultural and political revolution that seeks to unify all Croats under a single banner. This movement effectively aims to unify the disparate regions of our nation into a single, cohesive political and cultural national body. By standardizing the grammar and orthography, we will transform our medieval nation into a modern one, ensuring that the Croatian name, language, and statehood will never again be forgotten or suppressed.
cro_the_royal_council_of_croatia: We have established the Consilium Regium in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the Triune Kingdom. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.
cro_uniting_the_coast_and_the_inner_land: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.
svn_the_slavonian_grenadier_regiments: Our infantry units are reorganized into elite grenadier regiments that are renowned across the continent for their physical stature, rigorous discipline, and unwavering bravery under fire. These specialized shock troops are trained to lead the charge into the heaviest enemy fire, using their grenades and bayonets to break the lines of even the most formidable opponents. The presence of these 'Slavonian Giants' on the battlefield serves as a powerful psychological weapon, boosting the morale of our own troops while striking terror into the hearts of those who face them.
cth_merchant_legacy: The Phoenician trade fleets of Tyre, Sidon, and Carthage knit the Mediterranean into a single commercial system for half a millennium, and the silver shekels of Cartagena paid the Iberian, Numidian, and Balearic mercenary captains who fought our wars under Hamilcar and Hannibal. Our maritime law inherits the customs of the Punic admirals, our recruiting agents follow the same captains' itineraries through the western Mediterranean, and our paymasters draw on the same model of paying cash for service that spared Punic citizens from the battlefield. The combined commercial and mercenary inheritance gives the restored Carthage merchants of great reach and an economy that can pay for armies, as no younger trading nation could build from scratch.
cth_cothons: The ancient cothon of Carthage was a circular military harbor with two hundred and twenty sheltered berths, dry docks, and a central island for the admiral's command, capable of fitting out a full fleet in days while remaining invisible from the open sea. Our shipwrights are reconstructing this same engineering on the harbor floor, drawing the Phoenician diaspora of Gadir, Lixus, Mogador, and Tharros back to the home cities to crew the hulls as they leave the slipways. These restored cothons give Carthage swift shipbuilding and a deep pool of sailors that no rectangular European arsenal can match.
cth_legacy_of_hannon: Hannon the Navigator sailed beyond the Pillars of Hercules in the fifth century before Christ, founding seven trading posts along the Atlantic coast of West Africa and pushing south past the limits of all subsequent classical voyaging. His periplus survives in Greek translation and still describes harbors, river mouths, and offshore landmarks that our captains can verify on every voyage south. A documented blue water tradition hands our Carthaginian explorers a route book and a pattern of logistics that no European nation can claim to inherit from antiquity.
cth_punic_global_trade: The ancient Punic colonies at Gadir, Lixus, and Mogador stretched our reach a thousand miles beyond the Pillars of Hercules, and our modern Carthaginian commerce now reaches across every sea opened by the great voyages. Our agents staff the emporia of Asia and the Americas, our convoys carry oil, wine, and manufactures to every navigable port, and our brokers settle bills in every major exchange from London to Goa. A planetary commercial reach carries Carthage far across the colonial seas, with an export network that the Phoenician founders of our line could scarcely have imagined.
cth_sufet_rule: Ancient Carthage was governed by two annually elected Šūfeṭīm (sufetes) drawn from the great merchant families and accountable to a senate of three hundred and a popular assembly. Our restoration of this dual-magistrate constitution combines the proven stability of the Punic model with the legal innovations of the modern republican age. A deep republican lineage lends Carthage a constitutional legitimacy older than that of any upstart Italian or Dutch republic.
cth_breadbasket_of_rome: The hinterland of Carthage (the fertile plain of the Medjerda, the slopes of Cape Bon, and the olive groves of the Sahel) earned our region the title of horreum imperii under Roman rule, supplying a third of the imperial grain dole, the bulk of its olive oil, and the cheap amphorae wines that Roman commentators sneered at but bought by the shipload anyway. Our agricultural treatises by Mago the Carthaginian taught the Roman estates how to graft fig trees, press olives, and train drought-resistant vines at industrial scale, and the great rural villas of antiquity now form the foundations of our new mechanized presses, threshing yards, and wine cellars. This Punic-Roman agricultural inheritance, restored under modern industrial conditions, gives Carthage olive and Wine yields that no fresh plantation in the Mediterranean basin can match.
dah_children_of_the_panther: Our ancient legends state that our royal line is descended from the union of a princess and a panther. This ancient and mystical tale will enhance our prestige and fame.
dah_migan_mehu: The Migan and the Mehu are the ruler's two chief ministers. One oversees the north, the other the south; one oversees justice, the other commerce. Together, they bring stability and prosperity.
dah_slave_hunts: While raiding the surrounding territories, we obtain slaves who cannot only be employed economically or bartered to our neighbors, but who can serve in our armies. In this way, we will increase the number of fighters that can be called to arms.
dah_lagredis: By secretly placing male courtiers disguised as royal wives in the harem, they will be able to act unseen as the king's eyes and ears, especially in matters of palace intrigue.
dahomey_amazons: A corp of female warriors, recruited from among the king's wives. They have earned their reputation as mythological Amazons due to their ferocity in battle and the fear they strike in the ranks of their opponents. These Dahomey Amazons are entirely devoted to Dahomey and its interests.
dah_yovogan: As more and more foreigners are coming to our shores, we should establish a new office in our government to study and learn from their ways, so that we may benefit from this exchange of cultures.
dah_dahomey_palaces: Building a sprawling palace complex in our capital would be an elegant, yet imposing demonstration of our power. Any who may consider taking up arms against us will surely be deterred by the sight of our sumptuous palaces.
dai_lang: The Vietnamese countryside is built upon the enduring strength of the làng, autonomous villages that embody the principle: 'customs of the village outweigh the laws of the king.' In a land of rugged mountains and winding rivers, these communities govern themselves, raise local militias, collect taxes efficiently, and uphold royal authority at the grassroots.
nghia_quan: Throughout our history, the Nghĩa Quân — 'righteous militias' — have risen in defense of our land during times of great peril. Composed of farmers, scholars, and local patriots, they stood against foreign invaders and internal tyranny alike. Though irregular in nature, their valor and devotion to the country have made them a formidable force when mobilized.
dan_levy_recruitment: Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.
dan_old_naval_traditions: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.
dan_rulers_of_the_north: The rulers of Denmark have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.
dan_reliance_mercenaries: Denmark cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.
dan_rentekammer_advance: By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the Rentekammeret, we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.
dan_royal_danish_navy: Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of Europe.
dan_danish_orthodoxy: In the tumultuous religious landscape of Europe, we must set Denmark on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.
dan_expanded_dockyards: Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself Danish. The waters around Copenhagen are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.
dan_danish_legislation: The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the Danske Lov.
dan_danish_agriculture: While the Danish terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.
dan_royal_life_guards: The Royal Life Guards are an elite Danish regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.
dan_scanian_regiment: The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.
dan_admiralty_college: With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard Danish sovereignty.
dan_trading_economy: We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.
dlh_origin_of_hindustani: The Hindustani language developed from Apabhramsa — a Middle Indo-Aryan language — and emerged as the contact language of Delhi. As Hindustani has influences from Persian, Arabic, and Turkic but also Old Hindi, diplomacy with the Muslim world and the Hindu world becomes an uncomplicated task.
dlh_indo_persian_culture: Persian has been the dominant language of the court ever since the first inception of the Dehlavi Sultanate. As such, the influence of Persian has synthesized with local Indian cultures.
dlh_turkic_conqueror_roots: Although we call India our home, the ancestors of our state were of Turkic origins. Their early successes as conquerors and rulers from the days of the Mamlūk dynasty, as well as the achievements of the following Khalji dynasty, inspire our military and diplomats alike to push the borders of Delhi into every corner of India.
dlh_revert_ghiyath_reforms: The foolish economic decisions of Ghiyath al-Din have brought nothing but financial ruin to the state of Delhi. We must revert his madness and restore the usage of gold and silver for our coins.
dlh_restore_the_delhi_empire: The Dehlavi Sultanate once encompassed nearly all of India. It must rise again!
dlh_reintegrate_former_provinces: The once vast Dehlavi Sultanate has lost most of its former possessions, but we have not forgotten the means of administering them. As we work towards restoring our past glory, we will remind local rulers of their duties to the Sultan.
dlh_textile_innovation: The thriving textile industry in Delhi makes our nation a hotspot for related technological innovations. As early adopters of the cotton gin and worm gear roller, we know the importance of staying ahead of the curve in these matters. We must now ensure that the spinning wheel is adopted as widely as possible.
dlh_afghan_nobility: Much of the Dehlavi nobility is drawn from the ranks of the Afghan community, a people with a long history of conquest and rule in northern India. Though at times a political hindrance, their martial skills are beyond question.
dlh_grand_trunk: The Grand Trunk Road runs from Kābul in Afghanistan to the coast of Bengal. Many of the most important trading cities along its route are part of our empire, and so it falls to us to ensure that the road is well maintained and free of banditry.
dlh_cosmopolitan_religions: India is a massive subcontinent with several religions present. In order to ensure stability within our realm, we should expand the rights of the different faiths, and secure the loyalty of their worshippers.
dlh_revive_the_tughlaq_architecture: During the height of the dynasty and the most stable period of our state, great architects and artists of grand vision constructed mosques and tombs in the unique Tughlaq style. As the decades went on and our power was challenged by internal issues, the resources for maintaining this architecture faded. It is time to revive it, and re-establish Delhi as an empire of art and wonders.
dlh_throne_of_india: For centuries, every great Indian empire has been ruled from Delhi. It is the seat of conquerors and our birthright. All must know that Delhi is once again home to the rightful ruler of all India!
dlh_hindustani_identity: Foreign ideas of nationalism and cultural identity have reached India. While the cultural diversity of India will remain high, it is clear that our geography, as well as the values of Islam, give us all a sense of unity in the form of a Hindustani identity.
english_tradition: The bravery and discipline of English foot soldiers has been witnessed from the shieldwalls of Northumbria to the darkened skies of France. Inspired by the lion-hearted spirit of our kings and the stoicism of the common man, our infantry fights with the ferocity of the Anglo-Saxon warriors before them.
english_heritage: Our island protects us from outside enemies, but that will not matter if we do not protect the surrounding waters. By being true masters of our surrounding seas, we will keep a firm control on those who threaten our land.
magna_carta_advance: The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.
unlock_early_longbowmen_advance: The powerful martial longbow, originally deployed with great impact against armored English knights in the Welsh valleys, has been adopted into the military doctrine on either side of the border.
unlock_longbowmen_advance: The Longbowmen excel not only due to their powerful warbow but also their years of training on the archery fields.
unlock_late_longbowmen_advance: Small innovations in equipment and organization result in continuous devastating volleys that shatter all but the most heavily armored formations.
royal_navy: Beginning around 1495, the Tudor monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.
secretaries_of_state: The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.
eltham_ordinance: The Eltham Ordinances represented England's first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.
sick_and_hurt_board: This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.
british_bill_of_rights: A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.
navigation_acts: These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.
inigo_architecture: The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in England.
sailing_and_fighting_instructions: Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.
coke_smelting: The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in Iron and Steel production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. Iron and Steel are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method promises greater yields and cheaper upkeep.
eng_red_coats: Life in the English army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.
eng_experimental_riflemen: Elite marksmen equipped with the long-range Baker Rifle and trained to screen the main force in small independent pickets, Experimental Riflemen represent a modern vision of infantry combat formations.
english_ambition: A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.
water_frame: The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.
the_ark_of_the_covenant: We are the only nation to house the sacred Ark of the Covenant after it was secretly taken by Menelik I with divine assistance thousands of years ago. It is hidden away from public view, lest someone attempt to steal our sacred national treasure. Replicas of the Ark are placed in every single one of our churches as a reminder that our rule is blessed by God.
roof_of_africa: Our people have inhabited the highlands for generations, enduring extreme conditions that have made us resilient and strong. This gives us a significant advantage over our enemies whenever we engage in conflict.
solomonid_claim: Our rulers' forefathers are descended from the monarchs of Aksum; from the bloodlines of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. We have deposed the Zagwe monarchs in order to legitimize our rule and firmly establish the kingdom being restored to its rightful dynasty.
nagusa_negast: Our ruler is the king of all kings; the heir to the pedigree of the kings of Aksum along with that of the first ruler, Menelik I, the son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. All of our kings are descended from the Solomon dynasty, and the line of inheritance need not be from father to son.
a_permanent_capital: For centuries, our nation has lacked a permanent capital, with the court following the rulers wherever they desired. While this approach has its advantages, in order to effectively govern our vast nation we need to establish a strong central authority in a proper permanent location.
external_friends: Our envoys to Rome and Iberia, looking for military support, were quite successful — in fact, they put us on the map. These endeavors to find allies should continue.
eternal_crusade: As a Christian nation, we find ourselves surrounded by Muslim adversaries who seize every opportunity to attack us. To ensure our survival, we must be prepared to fight back immediately.
prester_john: People from Europe have been looking for Prester John for centuries, and are convinced that our ruler has to be him, somehow, as we are fellow Christian worshippers. There is no reason to point out that they are wrong, however, as they are now happy to share their ideas with us.
an_iron_fist: Our region is diverse in cultures and religions, and the only thing that keeps it united is not compassion, but a powerful ruler, capable of dealing swiftly and decisively with any attempt at revolt.
a_true_ethiopian_church: External influences have their uses, but exposure to them can alter the nature of our beliefs. In order to maintain our identity, we must secure the domestic primacy of our own Tewahedo Church.
origin_of_coffee: It is from our lands that Coffee comes, as we have the perfect growing conditions. While it can be cultivated in other places, ours is revered for its quality and exported by the ton. We have to make this a way to channel wealth into our nation.
a_modern_nation: Despite our apparent isolation, we are well aware of the innovations happening around the world, and we waste no time in implementing these modernizations in order to maintain a competitive advantage over our rivals.
cawa_advance: The Ç̌äwa serve as Ethiopia's noble feudal warriors, recruited and appointed for the Emperor's army service. They are a professional soldier class, renowned for their ferocity.
a_renaissance_cawa_advance: A better structure system allows the Ç̌äwa to be better trained and become a mighty force for Ethiopia.
a_discovery_cawa_advance: The introduction of gunpowder makes the traditional bows and javelins obsolete, but gives a new edge to the Ç̌äwa.
a_reformation_cawa_advance: The discipline of the Ç̌äwa Regiments gets further improved, making them fight more coordinated, inflicting deadly volleys to their enemies.
a_absolutism_cawa_advance: The Ç̌äwa adapt a line formation, marching side by side and firing in order. When the first line in combat reloads their firearms, the second takes their position to fire, just to be replaced by the next one in a continuous motion.
a_revolutions_cawa_advance: The most modern version of the Ç̌äwa. These fighters have reached the highest point in discipline and effectivity, becoming the terror of their enemies.
french_tradition: Our diplomatic maneuvers are renowned for their complexity and finesse, and our skilled envoys emulated across the continent. Yet only a fool would become complacent now; we could further refine our diplomacy through measures such as cultivating networks of informants and perfecting the art of negotiation. Let other nations muddle through yesterday's techniques while we pioneer tomorrow's.
french_heritage: The aristocrats of our nation have always provided the best soldiers for our armies. Their well-trained fighters will serve our nation and defeat our enemies in the name of righteous glory!
french_language_in_all_courts: For a long time, Latin has been the language of cultural exchange in Europe... but to be honest, that language is nearly as dead as the ancient Romans who spoke it. We need to find a new lingua franca, and nothing says 'lingua franca' like French.
elan: Cultivating the doctrine of attack is the hallmark of our army. Our men must fight with élan, spirit and vigor, giving us a clear edge on the battlefield.
estates_general: According to some, the Estates-General have existed since 1303. Over time, its form has shifted from being a council of royalty appointees to one of elected representatives. This change in structure has given the Estates-General, and the taxes levied by them, greater legitimacy.
fra_gendarmes: Reliance on a levy system has exposed our government to great risks, and has proved to be severely limiting. We should recruit heavily armed cavalrymen and pay them a fixed salary in order to create a standing army.
fra_integration_of_new_territories: Our influence over other states is undeniable. Why not use this persuasive power to incorporate them directly into our country?
fra_reliance_on_privateers: Direct competition with other maritime powers could be detrimental to our finances. We should empower our mercantile fleet to plunder and seize the merchant ships of our enemies. This will not only ensure a healthy income for our state, but also disrupt the maritime economies of our rivals.
fra_reformation_of_taxation: The intendants responsible for collecting the taxes of the people shall not be appointed by the estates, but by our ruler directly. This way, we will ensure these officers will be loyal to the ruler alone, and gather all of the rightful tribute owed.
fra_school_of_fontainebleau: As a nation much enriched by the Renaissance, we should invest in the creation of a unique, distinctively French aesthetic. By inviting foreign artists to our realm and sponsoring a school for artist training directly, we will be able to brand any artistic works produced as identifiably French.
vauban_fortifications: Our genius in fortification does not represent a radical departure in their design; rather, the innovation comes from the placement of the fortresses. By taking maximum advantage of local terrain, even the most basic fort requires more effort and supplies to take.
the_philosophes: We are proud to be the home of so many of the most renowned philosophers of these enlightened times. These thinkers produce a constant stream of groundbreaking ideas, which are stimulating advances in all fields, from the most trifling to the most vital.
fra_expansion_of_france: We trace our nation's lineage back to the empire of Charlemagne, and can therefore claim all those lands to be part of our rightful territory. With the support of dedicated courts, we will be able to identify and re-claim all of this long territory.
liberty_egalite_fraternity: With all men declared to be equal under our new laws, adherents of other beliefs are finally allowed full participation in our government, and may thus now contribute to our national progress.
fra_code_civil: We must replace the chaotic patchwork of laws governing our state with a single, unified legal code that applies to our entire population. This Code Civil will serve as the foundation of our government and establish a just system for everyone in our realm.
french_ambition: When measured against our adversaries, our need for military reform becomes painfully apparent. By introducing modern drilling techniques, we can transform our troops into a disciplined force capable of destroying any foe in combat.
geo_legacy_of_saint_george: Our association with the legendary Saint George is well known through both the Christian and Muslim worlds. As he bravely faced and slew the fearsome dragon, so will our soldiers face our enemies in battle.
geo_bagrationi_dynasty: A dynasty so old that its origins are shrouded in mystery, kings and queens of the Bagrationi house have ruled Georgia ever since the 9th century, first as its princes and then as monarchs.
geo_georgian_golden_age: Georgia enjoyed a cultural and religious Golden Age that was brought to a sudden stop, due to the Mongol invasions. That period witnessed the peak of our cultural achievements, but we will now return to it, and achieve even greater heights.
geo_legacy_of_tamar: Tamar was one of the greatest rulers our nation ever had. Her military and cultural successes are legendary, and the mere utterance of her name still stirs reverence in all Georgian hearts.
geo_david_the_builder: Considered the greatest ruler in the history of our country, King Davit the Builder brought Georgia to its pinnacle. He built a powerful, culturally influential kingdom, and a beacon for Christianity and the Georgian people.
geo_georgian_titles: 'King of Kings, strong and invincible, majestic and protector of the holy kingdom of the Abkhazians, Iberians, Ranis, Kakhetians, Armenians, Shahanshah and Shirvanshah, of the East and the West, of the South and the North, of both countries, of two thrones and crowns, the godlike Suzerain and the Sovereign of the Throne.' The titles of our ruler are numerous, and all at court shall respect them!
geo_georgian_numismatics: Our country has a rich tradition of minting coins, inscribing them not only in Georgian but also in Arabic and Persian, as they serve as currency for trade through our country and those that neighbor us.
geo_beacon_of_christianity: Georgia has been a haven for Christianity in the Caucasus for centuries, even after being surrounded and isolated by followers of Islam. The ardent faith of our people is a source of inspiration for all our religious brethren.
geo_georgian_principalities: Our regional administration is divided into many different principalities and territories. Delegating authority this way allows us to exert our rule more effectively.
geo_georgian_resilience: Our country has been torn apart, by external and internal influences, more than once in its long history. However, like the phoenix of legend, it has risen from the ashes and established itself as a presence to reckon with each time. The resilience of our people is commendable.
glh_kipchak_khanate: Our great country is also called the Kipchak Khanate, ruling over all the territories of the Cuman-Kipchak Confederation. With such swathes of land under our command, the armies we can gather will be innumerable.
glh_legacy_of_jochi: After Genghis Khān died, his son Jochi also passed not long after. However, his presence and legacy are still felt in our country, to the point that we are still known as the Ulus of Jochi. Warriors flock to our banners to uphold that legacy.
glh_legacy_of_the_golden_horde: We were one of the main constituent parts of Genghis Khān's empire, and we represent the main political force in Eastern Europe and the Steppes. The world shall tremble before us!
glh_perso_mongol_administration: Our ancestors refined our administrative system over the centuries, and they were not shy about incorporating the ideas and methods of the cultures they subdued. Our current system of administration is in part based on traditions dating back to the Great Genghis Khān himself, and in part on what we have adopted from Persian and Muslim bureaucrats in the lands conquered.
glh_tatar_traditions: Our empire may no longer be ruled from horseback, but our armies remain masters of the mount. Over the centuries, we have stayed true to our origins, ensuring that few can match the skill of our riders. As we go forward and adopt new technology and tactics when needed, we build on the strong organization and martial traditions of the Mongol Empire.
glh_secure_the_trade_routes: Not all riches in this world originate in our territory. Trade is the source of all wealth, and the Golden Horde has always protected merchants. By ensuring the safety of anyone who wishes to move goods through our country, we can ensure a steady stream of furs, silk, spices, and other necessities to our cities. Whether they choose to sell their goods to us or not, their mere presence will generate wealth for our people.
glh_religious_pragmatism:
Constraining, inflexible doctrine has never won many admirers among the Tatar hordes. When the Great Öz Beg Khān adopted Islam, it was the faith of a Sufi Shayḵ or a zealous Qāḍī that he invited into his lands.

Centuries of tradition and loyalty are what we would rather build our state upon. Religion has a part to play, but we would prefer to see our country thrive than to fall apart in the chaos of forced religious homogeneity.
glh_modernization_of_steppes: It was long ago that Genghis Khān's armies first seized control of the steppes. Our country has since surpassed our ancestor's every expectation, and now we stand as a global power on our own merit. We shall now begin the process of modernizing our territories, so that one day we shall be the beacon of all the world.
gra_razzias: The ḡazwa (a fast mounted raid into Christian territory for cattle, captives, and plunder) has been the lifeblood of the frontier emirates since the Umayyad century. Our raiders cross the Sierras at night in companies of fifty to two hundred, sweep through poorly garrisoned vegas, and retire before the Castilian mesnadas can muster a response. This raiding economy keeps the Christian frontier impoverished and dependent on our terms, while drawing slaves, livestock, and tribute into Granada.
gra_skillful_envoys: The survival of the Nasrid emirate for two centuries past every other taifa rests not on armies but on the agility of our envoys at the courts of Castile, Aragon, the Marīnids, and the Genoese. The kātib al-sirr, our secretary of secrets, maintains a permanent cipher correspondence and a network of merchants doubling as informants from Tunis to Toulouse. This diplomatic skill plays Christian kingdoms against each other through six successive Castilian successions and three Marīnid invasions, buying our emirate decade upon decade of survival.
gra_nasrid_art: The artisans of al-'Andalus have inherited a millennium of Umayyad and Almohad refinement in stucco, tilework, and muqarnas vaulting. Their works at the Alhambra and the Madrasa Yūsufiyya of Yūsuf I draw masters from Fez and Cairo to study the Granadan style, and our pottery, silks, and inlaid weapons command premium prices across the Mediterranean. Our craftsmen keep the state in funds even as our territory contracts.
gra_banu_nasr: We descend from the Banū l-Ḵazraj tribe of Yaṯrib through the lineage of Sa'd ibn 'Ubāda, a ṣaḥābī and companion of the Prophet Muḥammad. Our founder Muḥammad I ibn Naṣr, having served first as ally to Ferdinand III, secured the territories of Granada, Jaén, Almería, and Málaga as a tributary emirate after 1238. This dynastic legitimacy, rooted simultaneously in Arab tribal genealogy and prophetic association, gives the Nasrid throne a sacral authority that no Berber successor dynasty in al-'Andalus could ever claim.
gra_expand_qanahs: The Qanāh (the buried gravity-fed aqueduct inherited from Persia through the Umayyad caliphs) turns the dry plains of the Vega into orchards and silk mulberry groves. We extend the network from the Sierra Nevada snowmelt down through the Albaicín, Almuñécar, and Almería, with water rights enforced by the ancient Tribunal de las Aguas. Fed by these canals, our fields bear richer harvests than those north of the Sierra Morena and support a crowding of people found nowhere else in al-'Andalus.
gra_muttavia_armies: The Muṭawwi'a, religiously motivated volunteers from the wider Islamic world, have been coming to Granada since the late thirteenth century to fight a defensive jihad on the last Andalusi frontier. North African Berber riders, Turkish archers passing through Ifriqiya, and Mamlūk-trained officers from Cairo accept Nasrid coin and the promise of paradise to swell our ranks beyond what our small population could ever raise. This pool of volunteer reinforcement lets a kingdom of three hundred thousand subjects field armies whose ferocity surprises every Castilian commander who has not faced them before.
gra_expand_the_frontier: For two centuries the Nasrid territory has contracted under the pressure of the Castilian advance, but our recent consolidation of the Alpujarras and the coastal sierras has finally produced a defensible heartland. We now possess the manpower, fortifications, and treasury to push north into Jaén and east into Murcia, reversing the strategic pattern set since Ferdinand III took Córdoba in 1236. This recovery of the frontier transforms us from a besieged remnant into an offensive power capable of reclaiming the lost cities of al-'Andalus.
gra_adaptative_trade: For three centuries Granadan merchants have stood astride the only legal trade channel between the Christian Mediterranean and the gold caravans of the Sahara, exchanging Castilian wool and Genoese silver for Sudanese gold dust at the entrepôts of Málaga and Almuñécar. The Portuguese rounding of Cape Bojador now threatens to bypass us entirely, so we will charter new partnerships with the Wattāsid sultans of Fez and tighten Genoese commercial privileges at our ports. This reorientation of our trade lets the Nasrid economy survive the opening of the African coast that would otherwise have ended our centuries of commercial advantage.
gra_modernized_economy: The old Andalusi economy of silk, sugar, and almond exports must adapt to a Mediterranean dominated by Genoese banks, Atlantic competition, and the new global trade routes. We will reform the muḥtasib market regulations, invest in modern textile workshops at Málaga and Almería, and replant the sugar plantations of the Costa Tropical along Italian and Madeiran technical lines. This economic modernization keeps us competitive against Christian neighbors who otherwise enjoy unrestricted access to the new Atlantic silver and spice trades.
gra_a_strong_rule: Three generations of Nasrid succession crises (the dethronements of Muḥammad VI, Muḥammad VIII, and Muḥammad IX) have made factional warfare between the Banū as-Sarrāj (the Abencerrajes) and the Banū l-'Aziz the defining feature of court politics. Under a strong emir, the rival clans are confined to ceremonial offices, the Alhambra guard is renewed with loyal Mudejars, and the great vizierate is reserved for men of demonstrated competence rather than blood claim. This dynastic consolidation ends the internal bleeding that has cost us more cities than every Castilian campaign combined.
gra_ghazawat: In an age when monarchies measure themselves by enlightened ministers and standing armies, our state declares each campaign a Ḡazawāt, a sanctified war binding ruler and subject in a single religious and military project. The 'ulamā preach mobilization in every Friday sermon, and the militias of the Albaicín, Antequera, and Loja drill weekly under emiral charters that promise paradise to those who fall on the frontier. Faith in holy war fills Granada's militias with a zeal that the secular monarchies of Europe rarely know.
gra_a_new_golden_era: Al-'Andalus was once the intellectual heart of the Islamic world, producing Ibn Rushd's commentaries on Aristotle, az-Zahrāwī's surgical compendium, and Ibn Ṭufayl's philosophical novel Ḥayy ibn Yaqẓān. We will refound the Madrasa Yūsufiyya in Granada, recall scholars from Fez and Tlemcen, and translate the new Spanish and French scientific works into Arabic for the use of our physicians and astronomers. This intellectual revival proves that the lamp of Andalusi learning has only been dimmed, never extinguished, and gives our state an influence over minds across the Maghreb that no Christian neighbor can replicate.
grl_ivory_trade: The tusks of the walrus and the pelts of the arctic fox are among the finest goods that Greenland can offer the world. Our merchants brave the cold waters to bring these treasures to the markets of Europe, and in doing so keep our colony alive and prosperous.
grl_memory_of_vinland: Our forefathers sailed westward from these icy shores and discovered Vinland, a land of plenty far across the ocean. The memory of those voyages lives on in our sagas, and we know the route our ancestors took. Let us sail west once more and reclaim what was once ours.
grl_western_outpost: The shores of Vinland are within our reach. We have the knowledge of the route, the ships to sail it, and the will to endure the crossing. Let us establish a permanent presence in the west and use Greenland as the launchpad for a new era of settlement.
grl_masters_of_the_hunt: The Greenlandic waters teem with whales, seals, and fish. Our hunters have perfected the art of reading the ice and the tides, and their mastery of the sea keeps our people fed and our ships manned. There is no finer school for a sailor than the waters of the north.
grl_royal_charter: The crowns of Europe have recognized Greenland as a land worth investing in. A formal charter organizes our trade under royal authority, attracting merchants from across Europe and ensuring that the wealth of the north flows through Greenlandic ports rather than around them.
grl_charts_of_the_north: Generations of Greenlandic navigators have mapped every current, ice shelf, and hidden passage in the waters around our shores. This knowledge, compiled into charts of unmatched precision, makes Greenland an indispensable partner for any expedition venturing into the northern seas.
austrian_tradition: Our rise to power has made us the target of much envy, and the rival houses of the Holy Roman Empire vie for our position as the protectors of the south-eastern border. Despite these circumstances, we pride ourselves on executing diplomatic maneuvers unrivaled by any others.
austrian_heritage: The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the Holy Roman Empire and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.
hab_expert_mountaineers: Our people are highly adapted to traverse the obstacles of our country, from the high peaks and passes of our mountains to the wide rivers of our valleys.
austrian_marriage_policy: 'Let others wage war; you, happy Austria, marry! For what Mars gives to others, Venus gives to you — kingdoms.'
habsburg_dominance: Given our location at the center of all Europe, we must adopt a highly flexible attitude towards external diplomacy. Alliances and rivals can shatter as easily as they are formed, and our diplomats must be trained to cover every possible position.
austrian_military_flexibility: Only well-rounded tactics of artillery shock, cavalry charges, and unyielding infantry recruited from the can lead us to victory.
edict_of_restitution: A bit of bookkeeping will help us to weather any religious strife that could befall our realm. This harmless edict will surely not spark any further conflict.
austrian_court: Maintaining our diplomatic relations requires time and effort, and committing too many people to diplomatic missions could negatively affect our efficiency and damage our reputation. The Austrian Court's streamlined approach ensures we deploy the right envoys at the right times and still gather the information we need without overextending our diplomatic resources.
geheimrat: The Geheimer Rat is an elite advisory body composed of high-ranking nobles and officials, serving as the central institution for guiding our political, military, and administrative decisions.
hofkriegsrat: Our war council can only function with a proper bureaucratic structure. Only when we know every detail about our troops and logistics can we defend our realm from hostile intruders.
military_border: Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.
austrian_ambition: Our rulers must receive the best education possible to live up to the ideal of the enlightened monarch.
austrian_state_industrialization: Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.
wiener_klassik: Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.
multicultural_empire: Austria is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.
imperial_artillery: The rapidly changing nature of warfare urges us to modernize our troops and tactics. In order to stay ahead of our foes, we shall make our artillery the pride of the Imperial army.
hes_form_the_militia_army: Our strategic position within the Empire makes us an attractive staging ground for other princes' armies whenever outside threats arise. However, hosting foreign troops hurts our finances. To prevent this costly burden, we must raise our own troops and put them into service of the Empire.
hsa_holpfennige: Originally minted between the cities of Lübeck and Hamburg, the Hohlpfennig was a hollow currency developed as a countermeasure to rampant debasing, during an era where each mint had different standards regarding the concentration of silver on each coin. As a means of conducting transactions, the currency will smoothen our trade activities and bridge the gap between foreign markets and our merchants.
hsa_the_cog: The Hanseatic Cog is the pride of our trade fleet. Originally conceived during the late 12th century, it has been redesigned and improved continuously over the next hundred years. Characterized by its bulbous shape, single mast, square sail, stern rudder, and flat bottom, it revolutionized cargo transportation. Its design facilitated navigation in shallow waters, making it highly practical for trade. With a modest crew, a cog could efficiently transport substantial cargo, providing the Hanseatic League with a distinct edge in commerce over its rivals.
hsa_hanseatic_ties: Our League is home to a great many cities and merchant guilds, all with their own agendas and endeavors. In order to maintain our prosperity and expand our reach, we must take a keen interest in diplomatic efforts.
hsa_seal_of_the_hansa: In markets across Europe, from London to Novgorod, our merchants are famed for their affluence. Our ability to mobilize great trade fleets and bring dozens of cities into a perfect symphony of profit and exchange of commodities is second to none.
hsa_hanseatic_shipwrights: At a time when Europe is enveloped in war, with rulers desperate for expansion pressing claims in all directions, they look to us to build grand fleets that will allow them to fulfill their ambitions. Armed with centuries of accumulated shipwrighting knowledge, and some of the best timber on the continent, our ship-building process is unparalleled!
hsa_hanseatic_fortifications: The Burgtor is more than a gate. It is a statement of power and permanence, raised at the entrance to our greatest cities to announce that the wealth of the Hansa is well protected. Where our merchants travel and prosper, the fortifications of the Hansa shall stand to safeguard them.
hsa_draft_merchant_privileges: The merchants who conduct business under our seal carry with them tremendous influence and purses brimming with coin. As such, solidifying their privileges in foreign and domestic markets will only further increase our capacity for profitable business.
hsa_mastery_of_the_sea: Our maritime traditions have linked our fortunes to the mighty sea. To reap all the benefits we possibly can from our marine resources, we must learn to harness the awesome power of the sea — and to treat it with the proper deference. This will have tremendous effects on our trade activities.
hsa_exchange_of_ideas: Our traveling merchants who carry our business abroad are excellent resources of foreign knowledge. Whenever they return to our shores, they bring innovation and inspiration in their wake.
hsa_global_reach: The widespread adoption of trade on a global scale has shaken the mercantile world to its core. It is now customary to do regular business with foreign traders from all corners of the world, and our treasury has benefited as a result.
hsa_hanseatic_treasury: A strong economy is but one result of our prosperity. With ample coin and overflowing coffers, we have established ourselves as robust and dependable creditors.
hsa_regularized_contributions: The many entities within our League must be brought under our firm control in a bid to standardize their monthly and annual contributions to our treasury.
the_hansa_bank: Following our new system of contributions, we can underwrite a bank for members to use. Backed by the resources of the League, a letter of credit from the bank will be as good as cash. This, as well as other financial instruments, will give our merchants an edge over those in other countries.
hsa_reform_the_hanstag: In times of troubles and evolving thought, our central institutions for assembly and deliberation must adapt to deal with emerging challenges and new paradigms.
hsa_concept_of_mercantilism: Over the past centuries, we have worked tirelessly to integrate our dealings into the global scale of trade. Now, more than ever, we must protect our own merchants, lest we fall victim to factionalism and external competition.
chasqui: The chasquis are the messengers of our state. Chosen from the fittest and most durable runners of our country, these agile men carry Quipu strings, messages, gifts, and other kinds of information, and deliver them to the target recipient. The spread of ideas, as well as the bulk of our diplomacy, rests on their shoulders.
mitma: In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.
inc_vertical_economy: No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.
military_mita: The mit'a is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every ayllu must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.
warachikuy: The warachikuy is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.
tambo_advance: The Tambo is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the Tambo varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.
inc_tambo: Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect tambo way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.
quipu: A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.
llama_michis: Llamas have many functions in our society. They act as beasts of burden, as sacrifices, provide meat and wool, and even give us fertilizer for our crops with their dung. Controlling the breeding and use of llamas through government michis, or herders, we ensure that the llama population is strictly monitored. This will provide an opportunity for the llama population to increase
drafted_hatun_runas: The Hatun Runas are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.
adapted_incan_army: Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.
ira_sasanian_heritage: Before the Islamic Conquest of Persia, the region was home to the Sasanian Empire, which once ruled from Caucasia in the West to the Kirthar Range in the East. Many of its great cultural accomplishments have shaped our cultural and artistic identity.
