ira_islamized_persia: The Islamization of Persia has been a lengthy process. It is not yet completely finished, but our religion has still become one of the major pillars of our national identity. Many of our ancient traditions have been combined with the teachings of Islam, and now make up our current core culture.
ira_shahnameh: The Šāhnāme - the Book of Kings - is an epic poem, and a national treasure of the Farsi people. Describing the historical and mythical past of the empires which once occupied Greater Persia, its stories contribute to the Farsi culture in uncountable dimensions.
ira_persian_plateau: The great plateau at the heart of our realm does not result in a weakness for us but instead turns into our strength. As the origin of great empires, our people have for countless generations crossed its great plains and the rugged mountain ranges surrounding it, like the Zagros or the Alborz. The same terrain that exhausts foreign armies is where our soldiers, our merchants, and our administrators thrive. We will use this familiarity to move across our lands and govern them with an ease that no outsider can match.
ira_restoration_of_cities: The Mongol invasion of Persia was catastrophic for the entire region. Population centers of magnificent size were reduced to mere rubble. But it is finally time to rebuild what was once destroyed, and restore the awe-inspiring empire of Persia.
ira_improved_silk_road: A system of upgrades to roads and bridges, a system of guards to protect the roads — for a small fee — and a chain of Caravanserai for rest and refreshment. All these improvements will help the merchants as they traverse the Silk Road, and also provide revenue for the state.
ira_promotion_of_irrigation: As a consequence of the Mongol invasion of the past, Persia is somewhat depopulated compared to the earlier empires which claimed these lands as their own. Promoting the practice of irrigation should help our people develop the agriculture needed to boost the local population and help us recover from the death toll of past conflicts.
ira_persian_horses: Horses play a fundamental role in our society. Many of our people are raised alongside their steeds, which is reflected in both the care our horse breeders take and the durability of our cavalry.
ira_spread_of_persian_influence: Persian is an ancient language with a history longer than the lifespan of many empires. Even the Muslim conquest could not diminish the core of the Persian identity, and many other states try to imitate our culture.
ira_persian_rug_production: Persia has long been famous for its beautiful carpets and rugs. However, when the Mongols devastated the empire, much of this cultural heritage was lost. For Persia to fully recover its tumbled glory, we must regain our economic strength, and restoring this legendary ancient industry is the first step in that direction.
ira_safaviyya_order_hall: The Ṣafawiyya Order Hall is a building dedicated to the Sufi order of the Ṣafawiyya. While highly religious in nature, the building also serves as the military training grounds for the Kızılbaş.
ira_the_qizilbash: The Kızılbaş - the Red Heads - are a Shia military movement founded by the Ṣafawiyya. Guided by their religious convictions and deep ties to Sufism, these warriors are primed to fight for our state and to form the core of our army.
ira_the_qurchi: While the Kızılbaş are the backbone of the Persian military, the Qurchi are the royal bodyguards enlisted from their ranks. Instead of being given land, these soldiers are paid from the royal treasury.
ira_religious_state: No matter what the official faith of our state is, Persia will always be an inherently religious country. Every aspect of our life is guided by religious principles, and even the government itself acts with our core beliefs in mind when dealing with matters of morality and justice.
ira_the_ghilman: The Ḡilmān are a military unit made up of formerly Christian slaves with Caucasian origins. The Ḡilmān undergo strict military training and are well-practiced in the usage of firearms, making them an essential part of the national army. They serve as a counterbalance to other influential branches of the military.
ira_encouraged_art: Persian art is highly in demand. Collectors from near and far travel here in droves to purchase our exquisite creations. We should offer state support for our talented artists, as this trade in aesthetic goods is extremely lucrative.
ira_nazir: The Nāẓir, or overseers, are territorial administrators, and represent the eyes and ears of the Šâhanšâh. All actions of the court are supervised by the Nāẓir, and courtiers are promoted on their command. Even the Grand Vizier must work in association with the Nāẓir.
ira_the_tofangchi: The Tofangchi are our musket corps. Although firearms have been in use for a while, their presence in our ranks is highly irregular, as many of our fighters prefer to use their traditional weapon of bow and arrow. The regiments of the Tofangchi aim to change this, as they are trained in the use of modern weaponry.
ira_the_tupchi: The Tupchi - artillery-men - are a specialized military unit that focuses on the usage of cannons and siege weapons. Similar to the Tofangchi, the Tupchi are an example of modern warfare exercised by the Persian Empire.
ira_religious_unity_policy: The time of great religious divides has come to its end. In these turbulent times, Islam cannot afford any more in-fighting. We shall advocate for a policy of internal and external religious unity, and come to peace with what we used to consider heresy.
ira_afsharid_navy: Although our lands are located mostly in the highlands of the Zagros Mountains, Persia does have coastal possessions. While past dynasties might have paid little attention to the maritime protection of the empire, our people are more aware of the sea, and our sailors are eager to defend our coasts.
ira_jazayerchi: The Jazāyerchi are the elite musketeers of the empire. Equipped with heavy flintlock muskets with superior firepower and accuracy and exposed to constant drilling, the Jazāyerchi manage to overcome even the most one-sided odds in battle.
kbo_fixed_military_camps: By establishing permanent military camps at strategic locations throughout our domain, we will ensure our army suffers fewer casualties from attrition and can be mobilized quickly when needed.
kbo_permanent_sieges: Our armies are experienced with siege machinery, but adopting mobile artillery that can maintain sustained fire would secure our victory whenever we attack an enemy's walls!
kbo_iron_helmet_musketeers: As warfare tactics advance, so must our strategy. By adapting foreign innovations and techniques like formations, lines of fire, and new gunpowder recipes, we will surely be victorious!
kbo_council_clan_heads: Delegating administrative duties to local clan heads may mean relinquishing some of our central authority, but our advisors insist that we shall reap great benefits in return.
kbo_ribat_fortifications: Used throughout the Muslim world, these small fortifications have provided protections to caravans, commercial hubs, and isolated communities alike.
khm_religious_flexibility: Our country has lived through tumultuous times as royal patronage shifted between both Hinduism and various branches of Buddhism. We must promote the chosen faith throughout our country to breed stability, and trust that our ruler has chosen the true path for our people.
khm_royal_procession: Our rulers excel at creating dazzling processions, events of glorious splendor that very few others can rival. These extravagant demonstrations of our national wealth confirm the power and brilliance of the ruler and the astonishing riches of our nation. The glittering procession of elephants, treasure, and the royal guard will strike awe and respect in the hearts of our people, winning their unbroken loyalty and admiration.
khm_ballista_elephants: Elephants are impressive creatures and tower over any other animal we have seen. It is time to utilize these qualities to strike fear into our enemies by using these majestic animals in warfare. Elephants are also able to carry great weight, allowing us to mount war machines on them. Constructing double-stringed crossbows and equipping our elephants with them will create a tool that will allow us to dominate the battlefields better than ever before.
khm_great_builders: Our great cities are home to many barays and canals, primed to store and disperse water throughout the area. Constructing and maintaining this network of waterways with skill will ensure our population will thrive even during the unstable monsoon seasons.
khm_recruitment_of_peasants: We will need to reinforce our army with new recruits, which are easily found among the peasant class. With some training, we will be able to ensure the ranks can be refilled at any time by capable soldiers.
khm_foreign_production_skills: While our own people are not familiar with silk-weaving and prefer other fabrics, we are lucky that foreign artisans have settled in our cities and established their own weaving workshops. We should adopt this approach for other industries by directly inviting foreign artisans to bring their skills here, and thereby universally expand our production.
khm_utilize_the_rivers: Our rivers provide an excellent way to transport goods harvested and produced in our inland territories to our harbors, which are connected to foreign trade routes. Utilizing this transport network will also connect our cities and make communication between them faster.
khm_champa_mercenaries: In the past, we both fought with and alongside the fierce warriors of Champa. If we can secure the service of their most capable leaders in times of conflict, we can ensure our own forces are trained and well-rested, ready to leap into battle as fresh reinforcements.
khm_restore_angkor: The great city of Angkor was once a brilliant example of our architectural genius. Due to external pressures, we had to abandon our construction efforts, but we should connect to the roots of our society and start constructing new monuments to our splendor again.
khm_modern_navy: We cannot allow others to dominate the seas and control the trade our state depends on. Let us create a new, modern naval force capable of taking on any pirate or rival navy in South East Asia.
khm_invest_in_irrigation: While our existing water reservoirs meet our current agricultural demands, we could easily support more people if we were to dig new barays in other parts of our country, creating the foundations for new urban hubs.
khm_protection_from_raids: Our lands are frequently threatened by invasion, and our precious Angkor lies especially vulnerable to siege. We must invest into a comprehensive system of fortifications, with sufficient garrisons to withstand any invading force, so that we can protect our people and national treasures from foreign conquest.
khm_old_grudges: Our people were humiliated in the past by being forced to bow to foreign invaders. While not every defeat can be avoided, we use these old rivalries to spur our people to fight harder and longer on the battlefield, burning to erase the shame of these ancient humiliations.
defense_of_the_faith: We have been driven from Acre and Cyprus, but the Order of the Hospital of St. John will retreat no further. In pagan times, a Colossus stood sentinel over the harbor of Rhodes, but today, the greatest fortifications the world has ever known have taken up the guard!
assistance_to_the_suffering: Our Order is named the Knights Hospitaller for a reason: we were originally the protective force of a pilgrims' hospital in Jerusalem. Though Jerusalem is lost to the Saracens, we still provide medical aid to those in need, including our brave knights, who heartily return to the battlefield much faster than most armies.
reconquista_of_the_sea: In our frequent clashes with fierce foreign corsairs, the thought has occurred to us that these scurvy dogs might have the right idea about looting and pillaging the coast, but they are preying on the wrong targets. Piracy may be a vile sin in peacetime, but in times of war, it is known as 'privateering,' and that is another thing altogether.
friends_in_need: Our Order was formed by faithful souls from every nation in Christendom. This fact, combined with our need for external support to fulfill our missions, have made us adept at recruiting helping hands for our cause. We will take advantage of our omnipresence in Europe to reach the ears of powerful rulers, and sway them to our side.
scourge_of_the_corsairs: The famed Turkish privateer Hayreddin Barbarossa fought many legendary encounters against the Knights, but he was hardly the only corsair we have encountered. Turkish raiding and looting of all of Southern Europe, tolerated by the Barbary states and funded by the Turks, must end. The Knights will do their job protecting innocent sailors at any cost.
crusader_tradition: Knights of our Order were present in the wars against Saladin and defended the last Outremer Crusader outpost, Acre. If any among us needs inspiration to do heroic deeds, they need to look only at what the Knights of the Order of the Hospital of St. John have accomplished in the past. The name Knights Hospitaller is truly eternal, as is our famed courage in battle.
ecumenical_defenders_of_christendom: The Reformation has harmed our cause as knights from Germany and Scandinavia have started murmuring questions about the nature of the Communion Host, but the always-present Turkic threat has a way of making such disputes seem minor. Perhaps we should focus on defending the realm, and debate theology once the Saracen threat is safely at bay?
a_neverending_crusade: As long as any faithful Catholic is in danger of religious persecution, our mission is not over! Be it during a pilgrimage to the Tomb of our Lord and Savior, or while crossing the seas and fending off corsairs, we will never stop training and never rest, ready to leap into combat at a moment's notice.
inspired_builders: While our Order's principal duty is to fight, we serve our people in other ways as well. Over the centuries, we have developed the art of rapid construction, erecting buildings and fortifications with remarkable speed. We will use this expertise to make our capital into both an impregnable fortress, and a dynamic center of culture.
the_right_hand_pope: As time goes on, and the Crusades start to fade from the memory of our people, the importance of having the Pope's ear increases. We ingratiate ourselves until we are the closest confidantes to the Supreme Pontiff. Naturally, our devotion to his service will benefit us enormously — and why not enjoy our hard-won privileges?
a_brand_new_world: The world evolves, and those who fail to adapt are forgotten by history. Our Order has endured for over half a millennium, and we will not fade away now! Our mortal bodies will eventually join the Creator, but our Order must first become immortal. We will transform ourselves into the most modern nation of our age, strengthening ourselves from the very core.
an_order_with_state: While some nations are often described as an Army with a State, we, on the other hand, have always been an Order with a nation, ever since our acquisition of Rhodes from the Greeks. Nevertheless, we cannot help but admire how efficiently they have harnessed their resources to become a formidable nation. Inspired by their success, we will implement reforms to ensure our military can confront any adversary with confidence.
koa_norman_heritage: Our administrative and military template descends from the Norman Kingdom of Africa established by Roger II of Sicily in the twelfth century, the brief Latin-Christian realm that spanned from Mahdia to Tripoli for a generation before its collapse. Our court chancellery preserves the chartered protocols, and our knights' fee system inherits the Norman-Sicilian feudal arrangements adapted to North African territory. Our castle architects build the squared tower keeps that the Norman engineers introduced to the Maghrebi coast. The Norman-Sicilian inheritance hands our restored Kingdom of Africa a ready pattern of rule that no purely Maghrebi successor could build from scratch.
koa_latin_episcopate: The ancient Latin Church of North Africa, the bishoprics that once numbered nearly seven hundred sees from Augustine of Hippo's day and produced the great Donatist controversies and the foundational Latin theology, gets restored under our patronage as a working Church that actively converts the surrounding populations. Our archbishop of Carthage convenes the provincial synods, and missionary preachers move through the countryside in adapted Berber and Arabic vernaculars. Cathedral rebuilding programs at every major town anchor the steady conversion of Muslim and pagan Berber communities to the Latin rite. The restored Latin episcopate raises a Church in our Catholic Maghreb that grows and wins converts, linking us directly to the foundational age of Western Christianity.
koa_papal_endorsement: Our Kingdom receives formal papal endorsement: the bull confirming our title as the rightful Christian sovereign of the Maghreb, our right to investiture by the Holy See, and the indulgences extending to all our subjects supporting the kingdom's defense. Our court receives the apostolic legate on a fixed protocol. Diplomatic letters to fellow Catholic sovereigns carry the papal seal of legitimacy, and our crown invokes the papal mandate at every formal ceremony. Papal endorsement gives our Latin-Christian realm a diplomatic and religious legitimacy that no Muslim successor can challenge from within its own theology.
koa_military_orders: The Knights Hospitaller, the Order of Malta, and the Templar-successor orders integrate into our Kingdom's defensive structure: the heavily fortified commandery network that anchors our coastal and inland defense, the standing brotherhood of warrior monks that the maritime Catholic powers send us as continuous reinforcement, and the integrated system of fleets and fortresses that turns prize-captured Muslim ships back against the corsair states. Our grand masters and commanders sit on the royal council, and resident knights garrison every major fortified position. Papal endowments fund the orders' permanent establishments. The union of military and religious orders gives our Kingdom a defense beyond what a purely feudal levy system could provide on its own.
koa_feudal_estates: Our feudal land tenure system (the chartered fiefs granted to crown-loyal nobles, the manorial estate organization with its dependent peasantry, and the chain-of-command that runs from crown through magnates to local lords) gets imposed on our North African territory in adapted form, replacing the older tribal and tribute arrangements that the prior Maghrebi regimes had used. Our chancellery surveys the estates and confirms each fief's bounds, and magnate courts mediate inter-estate disputes. Our peasant tenant class settles into the manorial routines that the agricultural calendar of the cool season economy of grain and vine prescribes. The feudal and administrative system gives our Kingdom a structure of land tenure and loyalty, unlike the unsettled tribal landscapes around us.
koa_catholic_mission: Our mature missionary network (the Franciscan and Dominican preaching orders, the mission schools that teach Latin alongside the regional vernaculars, and the apostolic vicariate residences that anchor mission stations along the coast and into the interior) develops the depth that generations of conversion work have built up. Our seminaries train native Latin-rite clergy from converted families. Endowments support the convert protection charters that guarantee judicial standing for new Christians, and vernacular catechisms circulate through every parish school of our realm. The missionary network supplies our Kingdom with trained clergy and secures the religious and cultural project of the prior centuries.
kol_peace_in_the_city: Not so long ago, our city was nearly torn apart in the struggle between our burghers and our clergy. We must ensure that this conflict cannot repeat itself, and that every member of both our court and the city council cooperate in preserving Cologne as a central hub on the Rhine.
kol_school_of_painting: Our city is home to many capable painters and craftsmen skilled in the art of bringing images to life through the media of wood, stone, and especially glass. With the support of a strongly established artists' guild, they will thrive under our sponsorship and illuminate our city to new glory.
kor_fortresses_of_goguryeo: Korea was home to many kingdoms in the past. However, the influence of one kingdom in particular is still felt today: Goguryeo, the precursor to Goryeo. Goguryeo has left us many legacies, including its stone fortifications and castle-building techniques, which are still in use to this day.
kor_korean_artisanry: Korea has always had artistic traditions, but art has truly blossomed since our national unification, thrusting us into a golden era of cultural achievement. Among our many accomplishments, the artisanry of our people shines as a beacon of skill and refinement.
kor_korean_barracks_advance: Our armies need a steady supply of troops to keep them in prime condition. Having local centers of recruitment and training will allow us to have easily available reserves.
kor_metal_movable_type: Movable type is an ancient printing technology first used by the Chinese people many centuries ago. But it is the Goryeo dynasty who developed the metal form of movable type, streamlining the printing process. We can now print books with unparalleled efficiency.
kor_court_poetry: Our aristocracy puts great emphasis on the cultural development of their spirit and mind. Literature, such as poetry in Classical Chinese, is seen as greatly valuable by the court. The nobility and ruling class alike are enthusiastic about the cultural impact of the written word.
kor_gunpowder_engines: Our forces have been aware of gunpowder's tactical value for centuries. Through reverse-engineering Chinese designs and the innovations of Choe Museon, we have mastered both gunpowder production and the construction of machines that employ it for military use.
kor_korean_gunnery: As gunpowder technology advances, so does our ingenuity, and as a result we have devised a new defensive system. Although simple in concept and execution, installing cannons in our fortifications will increase their defensive capabilities tremendously.
kor_hwachas_advance: The Hwacha deliver devastating firepower through their barrages of rocket-powered arrows or iron-headed bolts. Their maneuverability forces them to take a more defensive role in battles.
kor_early_turtle_ship_advance: The Gwiseon Turtle Ship is a Korean warship which utilizes oars and sails to outmaneuver other types of galleys, while also being equipped with light Chongtong - Korean firearms.
kor_grand_code: To ensure proper, stable governance, we must first codify exactly how the government will work. This will be the basis for our nation's first written constitution.
kor_hangeul_alphabet: The Korean language is so fundamentally different from any form of Chinese that the use of Chinese characters renders all except the most highly educated people illiterate. Our new alphabet is more scientific, and will allow all our people to be able to read and write in their own language.
hyanyak_system: Agriculture is the bedrock of our economy, and therefore efficient village management is paramount. To this end, we will implement the hyangyak system, which establishes self-governance for villages. These agreements establish behavioral standards, dispute resolution regulations, and other civil procedures aimed at creating stable, self-reliant communities.
kor_border_defense_council: Our borders are constantly threatened, both by barbarians from the north and pirates from beyond the seas. To ensure our armies are always ready to meet every threat with swiftness, we will establish a council of officers dedicated to controlling and securing our borders.
kor_geobukseon: Defending our coastlines is vital to our survival, and as a result of this vigilance, we have developed the ingenious 'turtle ship'. These heavily armored behemoths will ensure that no enemy ship penetrates our coastal holdings.
kor_panokseon_advance: The Panokseon is a multi-deck warship with greater size and firepower than the usual Geobukseon Turtle Ship. While still relying on oars, the sails of the Panokseon allow it to reach a greater speed comparable to galleys for its size.
kor_hopae_system: The hopae is an identity tag system requiring all Korean people to carry proof of their name, birthplace, status, and residence. This allows authorities to quickly verify identities, and to track a person's movement, if needed.
kor_korean_cannon: Although we are already quite experienced at using gunpowder and cannon, we should not stop making technological advancements. By developing smaller, but more durable cannons, as well as inventing more efficient methods of reloading, we will revolutionize our artillery and greatly benefit both our army and our navy.
kor_daedongbeop: A new set of reforms that will gradually introduce previously ignored improvements into the tax system. The tribute tax levied against households will be replaced with a unified tax on arable land, and the tax on goods will be limited to a quota which lets enterprising peasants and wholesalers make and sell surplus goods. This will result in lower taxes for the peasantry, increased revenues for the state, and an overall rise in commerce.
krs_kurdish_tribes: Having asserted our authority over all Kurdish tribes, we will be able to call upon their experienced, hardened warriors to defend our country.
krs_legacy_of_the_kurdish_dynasties: Our people have established several great dynasties, ruling territories from Egypt to Iran. Tying our own state to the glory of past rulers will allow us to be a unifying symbol for the Kurdish people, and make our rule seem more legitimate in the eyes of our subjects.
krs_kurdish_quarters: In the times of foreign rule, many of our people established predominantly Kurdish quarters in cities. While these areas prospered even under distant rulers, we can now utilize their wealth directly, and better guarantee a prosperous future for our people.
krs_kurdish_horses: Our homelands are surrounded by many would-be conquerors, hungry to subjugate our people. While our native terrain can slow down hostile armies, it also makes it difficult for our own troops to respond to threats swiftly. A strong cavalry, however, will allow us to quickly react to any threats, no matter how many there might be.
krs_kurdish_mercenaries: Our people have long served as hired swords for foreign lords, gaining valuable combat experience in their service. With our own country now established, it is time to call those experienced fighters under our banner.
krs_kurdish_warrior_poets: Our rulers must not just be capable warriors; they must also be educated in the matters of fine art and effective administration. By writing texts and documenting their reigns, our leaders will pass the knowledge and history of our people down through generations, ensuring no valuable insight is lost.
land_of_many_religions: Our people coexist with fellow men and women of many faiths. This diverse social composition is embedded in our legal frameworks and beliefs. Together, we are stronger!
migrant_opportunities: Mercantile opportunities and the promise of a better life are some of the reasons as to why our towns and settlements tend to receive constant waves of immigration. Many men and women relocate to our lands seeking their fortune, and their presence and contributions increase our fortune in turn.
warlord_dukes: Over two remarkable centuries of warfare, Lithuanian warlord dukes transformed a loose federation of tribes into a unified warrior state. They mounted fierce resistance against the aggression of Catholic holy orders, while simultaneously conquering vast territories in the East. These legendary achievements continue to inspire our military leaders today.
two_realms: Due to the size of our realm, our jurisdiction falls under two distinct frameworks: To the north lies the core of our territories, proudly embracing our cultural traditions and social mores. However, our southern and eastern regions often diverge to a certain degree from our central norms. To respect such diversity will strengthen our nation as well as our position on the geopolitical stage.
chacery_slavonic: To help connect our people across our vast realm, we need a unified language, and require many literate members of the clergy to spread it. The development of such a language to record our history and maintain our administrative apparatus is not only a sign of national pride and prestige, but also a means of creating a distinct government, separating us linguistically and culturally from our neighbors to the east.
supremus_dux_lithuaniae: If we are to defend ourselves against our aggressive Polish and East Slavic foes, we must project strength! Establishing the title of Supreme Duke of Lithuania will decisively assert our authority, especially against the growing power of our nobility and others who seek to violate our sovereignty.
ties_with_the_holy_see: Years of negotiations with the Holy Father have resulted in our embracing Catholicism, with the blessing of our Polish neighbors and the Pope himself, during a turbulent and unique Christianization process. After our struggle to seek our spiritual identity subsided, it is clear that we have become a beacon of Catholicism, a shield against the heathens and heretics that threaten our society.
patriarchate_of_lithuania: The abolition of Romuva, a faith embraced by our ancestors, has shaken the very foundations of Lithuanian society. Yet, in order to secure a brighter future, we have chosen the path of Orthodoxy and fully celebrate our new identity. But if we are to be successful in that, the religious authorities of our newfound Orthodox faith must maintain autonomy from foreign patriarchates in order to avoid external interference.
statutes_of_lithuania: Statutes of Lithuania are a set of three different legal reforms which aggregate, unify, and update the laws of the realm. Known for harsh punishments and the introduction of the death penalty, these statutes are in line with many contemporary Western penal codes. Each crime is supposed to be punished the same regardless of the class of the person committing it, but in practice, the peasants were often at a disadvantage compared to how members of other estates were treated.
lithuanian_renaissance: Lithuania experienced a Renaissance in the late 15th and early 16th centuries. Inspired by the ideas of the Reformation and influenced by the Italian Renaissance, there was a prolific flourishing of education, arts, architecture, and literature during this era. This period will also see the creation of a written form of Lithuanian and, subsequently, the first works of Lithuanian literature.
columns_of_gediminids: The coat of arms that hangs on our banners originates from one of our most celebrated dynasties, the Gediminid family. Many of their brightest have led our nation through turbulent times into ample prosperity with careful statesmanship and capable guidance. The columns of such great leaders symbolize the strong foundation and tenacity of our country and our fellow men and women.
LIV_crusader_forts: The many fortifications in our territories owe their construction and funding to our numerous Crusader bands. Flanked by sturdy walls, these fortifications will serve and protect our people for years to come!
LIV_a_order_knights: Our nation is founded on the strong backs of the brave Christian men who have joined our order as knights. Their martial prowess will compensate for our low numbers, compared to those of the Pagans surrounding us, as will the light and strength of our faith.
LIV_a_order_knights_2: The knights of our order have proven their valor and skill in battle time and time again. By promoting the most capable among them to bannerets, we ensure that our armies will always be led by the best.
lva_baltic_forestry: Our forests are a vital resource, providing timber for construction and fuel for our fires. We must manage them wisely to ensure their continued abundance.
lva_baltic_forts: Our network of forts and castles scattered across the landscape provides a first line of defense against invaders. These strongholds allow us to monitor and control key routes through the Baltic.
lor_mining_tradition: Our lands are rich in ore and coal. Extracting these resources could make us a rich country and lay the groundwork for our grand ambitions.
lor_cultural_diversity: Our territory is home to many different peoples and cultures. Establishing a single state to govern this diverse population will not be easy, but we must. Only then will we be worthy successors to the Lorrainian state from which we descend.
lor_three_bishoprics: Lorraine is home to many bishops with powerful supporters abroad and within the Church itself. Cooperating with them will be useful when making our voice heard within the broader Church. Having the support of the bishops will also help us to pacify the population more easily.
lor_between_great_powers: Our lands were once an important part of Lotharingia, one of the Frankish kingdoms. If we do not want to fall into irrelevance, we will need to secure our diplomatic position and establish lasting alliances.
lor_fortified_cities: We occupy vital crossing points on several rivers, which we must defend at all costs if we want to secure our independence. To this effect, we must modernize the large bridge castles of our cities, and construct large citadels at strategic points.
mai_diadema_regni: Our beloved city has been described as 'Diadema Regni', the Crown of the Empire, a moniker we strive mightily to maintain. Maintaining this distinction will help us remain above other Imperial cities in terms of our prestige and political influence.
mai_city_and_archbishop: The citizens of Mainz have prospered under the extensive rights granted to them by Adalbert of Mainz in the early 12th century. These rights, carved into the bronze door of the Cathedral, will serve as a reminder of cooperation between the separate powers within the city, both the clergy and the citizenry.
mai_leader_rheinish_league: When the Rheinish League was active, we naturally assumed a position of leadership and guidance for the other members. Although the League itself has disbanded, we must do everything we can to maintain our influence over our former associates.
mai_zealous_fight_against_heretics: Our country's religious unity must be defended against any threat. If we provide our armies with moral guidance in the form of military chaplains, they will be much more motivated to defend our beliefs.
mai_vicar_of_mainz: To ensure our lands are governed reliably, even in the absence of our ruler, we should instate a vicar. Empowered with extensive rights, the vicar can rule with our best intentions and remind the common folk of our presence at all times.
mai_mainz_kingdom: While celebrations on Ash Wednesday are a common occurrence, they hold especially deep roots in our country. While the public celebrates the Fastnacht, or carnival, with masquerade and excessive feasts, our court will engage in a special event. During the carnival celebrations, we will redistribute the roles of our court per lottery, with even the ruler having to participate. This custom of swapping roles, called Mainzer Königreich, will spread far beyond our borders and help expand our cultural legacy.
mai_center_of_printing: By expanding our already-growing printing industry, we can become the leading producer of books in Europe.
mai_garrison_of_the_rhine: Defending our borders can be a difficult task, especially considering the river splitting our land in two. We must build an extensive network of garrisons and fortifications that can withstand our enemies.
maj_bubu_and_jala: Some of the most efficient fishing techniques are employed in local fish traps, known as Bubu. Woven soft wood, such as bamboo, they are tended to by experienced fishermen in strategic locations such as river mouths and employed intricate techniques to maximize their catch.
maj_home_of_the_sea_nomads: Used widely across the entirety of the Indonesia, the Kabang is a versatile ship of medium size and often crafted from a single piece of wood. Beyond its role as transport of people and goods, it has come to be synonymous with sea nomads. These folk consist of populations of peasants and fishermen who used the tide and monsoons to migrate from port to port, making a living off the sea.
maj_jong_advance: The Jong has proudly served our people for a long time. Its characteristic number of masts and hull are made of thick wood, making it the perfect vessel for a combination of ferrying goods across long distances, as well as troops.
foreign_architectural_influence: In our many conquests across Indonesia, we have encountered many new and incredible forms of art, all of which could be adopted and refined by our people to further our legacy. By introducing new techniques and sponsoring artists, our culture will come to exemplify the artistic achievements of our region.
maj_bajang_ratu: A ceremonious gate of magnificent proportions, the Bajang Ratu follows the architectural design of a candi bentar, or split gateway. Using high quality red brick, the gateway is to be one of the tallest constructs across the Majapahit domain. Its usage is vital, as the structure is used for grand ceremonies of religious and political nature.
maj_late_karambit_warriors: Armed with rudimentary armor and their trademark blade, these warriors rely on mastering speed, ferocity, and fluent movements. They excel on close combat where the karambit's curved blade is extremely efficient at slashing, hooking, and gutting opponents. The adoption and proliferation of new formations and combat maneuvers has turned these warriors into a fabled armed force, feared throughout the archipelago.
maj_sumpah_palapa: The head of our military directly answers to our ruler, and holds enough influence and power to shape the future of our realm. To ensure they understand what an important role they have been given, they are required to swear a special oath, one that underlines our dreams of conquest and bolsters our spirits.
maj_the_magic_arrow: One of the most prominent muzzle-loaded cannons of our era is the Cetbang. Armed with a cylindrical short barrel, it delivers a devastating blow with tremendous power. Such is its popularity, that it finds use in many aspects of our conduct of warfare, from protecting our ports to being the main armament of our warships and armies.
maj_maritime_silk_road: Our geographical position, complemented by our growing influence, has led to us presiding over the extensive and profitable trade network that carries Silk and from East to West.
maj_restore_candi_shrines: Scattered throughout Nusantara are a series of temples known as candi. We should restore these temples wherever we find them to renew our people's faith.
maj_the_ghali: The people that populate the Madura Strait have come to serve in our navy. Their naval prowess and great shipbuilding skills have given rise to a new kind of vessel, the Madurese Ghali. A large ship, it is used for offensive and voyager-adjacent tasks, as it will soon comprise the backbone of our fleet.
maj_island_colonies: Contact with our neighbors in the archipelago has shown us clearly that the raw resources and unclaimed lands are ripe for the taking, promising to become secure and prosperous under our control.
maj_preservation_of_javanese_history: The history of the Javanese people is an integral part of our cultural identity. To protect this identity, we must preserve the traditions upon which we built our great country.
epic_of_sundiata: The Epic of Sundiata tells of the legendary campaign of Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Malian Empire and hero of our people. His story has passed from generation to generation, and has always been a great source of inspiration to our people.
kouroukan_fouga_advance: The Kouroukan Fouga is the basic constitution of Mali. It covers every aspect of living, from simple family life in the villages all the way to the sovereignty of the Mansa.
gold_of_bure: The twin gold fields at Bambuk and Bure are renowned as the largest gold deposits anyone has ever heard of, and they belong to us! Bure's gold mines in particular produced fantastic wealth that famously destabilized the entire Egyptian economy through inflation when Mansa Mūsā visited there. Our economy, though, is used to a constant influx of gold, and is more difficult to inflate.
reclamation_of_land: The Sahara is not static. It can wax and wane depending on rainfall, and the habitable belt known as the Sahel, where we reside, can grow or shrink accordingly. A major drought could render much of our kingdom useless desert, an addition to the Sahara where no one reigns but death. However, in good years, we might reclaim some of the marginal lands from the Sahara and make it productive again.
accounts_of_the_atlantic_voyage: According to the legendary Mansa Mūsā, his predecessor started a journey across the Atlantic Ocean in hopes of discovering the furthest limits of the ocean. While some among the ruling class consider this endeavor a shameful abdication of duty, others see this as inspiration to explore corners of the world previously unknown to man.
mandinka_warrior_spirit: Whether pagan or Muslim, Mandinka men have been the greatest fighters the Sahel has ever seen. The courage of our troops is admirable, as is their pride. When the Mansa raises an army, not only is it the largest in all the Sahel, it is the best!
markets_for_salt: In our kingdom, Salt is worth its cost in gold. But south of us, in the great forests of the Ashanti and the Yoruba, salt is worth considerably more than gold. Luckily for us, we have our own supply of Salt, and enough gold to obtain as much as we could ever want. Perhaps we could find yet more markets of people for whom Salt is more valuable than gold?
west_african_slave_trade: Even before our Empire existed, the great Wagadou, the Ghana Empire that preceded us, sold Slaves across the desert to the Arabs. We have followed suit all these years, supplying the Arab world with a vast number of Slaves. Now the Europeans clamor for even more Slaves to work their holdings in the so-called New World. We have had little report, but the amount of Slaves they demand is truly stunning, and they keep coming back, sometimes even raiding our shores and abducting our subjects. The time has come to impose order on this trade and restrict the Europeans to select commercial ports where they will purchase, not steal, Slaves.
kele_koun_advance: The Kèlè-Koun, or 'war-head', are the commanders of infantry fighting for Empire, called the Kèlè-Bolo, or 'war-arm'. Unlike the Ton-Tigi, the feudal lords of Mali, the Kèlè-Koun are not necessarily part of the Nobility. The Kèlè-Koun have jonow, 'slaves', serving as carriers of the weapons and equipment until their inclusion in the Sofa battalions.
mandekalu_levies: The Mandekalu Levies are the backbone of the Malian military. Freemen of the Empire are called to arms in times of war, and it is a great honor for them to participate in these battles with their own weapons.
sofa_levies_advance: Originally, all soldiers in the Kèlè-Bolo levies are horon, or 'freemen', but the latest developments in Mali have forced the inclusion of jonow, 'slaves', to serve in the army as fighters instead of weapon-bearers. These slave warriors would thereafter be known as 'Sofa', protecting fortifications as part of garrison forces.
farari_corps_advance: The Farari Corps are the elite of the Malian military. Commanders in their own right, they are highly respected for their experience and bravery.
barid: Under Baybars, our barīd reached a sophistication unmatched in the Islamic world: relay stations with fresh mounts at fixed stages, carrier pigeons for the most urgent dispatches, and intelligence agents posted along every route. Word of a frontier raid can reach the capital in a matter of days, and our orders return just as swiftly.
karimi_merchants: Formidable traders that primarily deal in spices, these mercantile giants have profited greatly from the flow of exotic goods that trail their origin as far as the shores of India and beyond.
mamluk_soldiers: Well-trained elite troops, these men have been honed to represent the best our people have to offer. Raised as slaves purchased from foreign masters, they are disciplined and taught our religious and military doctrines as they are expected to form the core of our standing army. Oftentimes, they come equipped with heavy armor and sturdy spears. Their unique helmets and presence in the battlefield is a terrifying sight for our foes.
mamluk_halqah: Auxiliary units that often accompanied their Mamlūk counterparts, these light and quick troops will offer great support to their parent forces on the battlefield.
reform_the_mamluk_corps: The later Mamlūk troops are categorized by a renewed attention to detail and discipline. A series of military reforms are set in place, to restore the old standards and retrain our standing armies.
kashif: Our Sultanate is enormous, and therefore we must make wise, careful choices about its administration. To employ particularly learned individuals as local governors is a brilliant move, one that should eventually tip the geopolitical scales in our favor.
royal_mamluks: The Royal Mamluks are the elite core of the Mamluk army, serving as the Sultan's personal guard. Handpicked and rigorously trained, they are renowned for their loyalty, exceptional combat skills, and unwavering dedication.
red_sea_trade: The spice trade flowing through the Red Sea is a key source of our wealth, and we must seize full control of it. By threatening to burn down any Red Sea ports outside our authority that accept spice traders, we can capture the lion's share of this lucrative commerce. We may not win many friendships with our aggression, but we shall have gold enough to comfort us.
masters_of_the_nile: The heart-vein of our Sultanate is the river Nile. Traversing our nation, its touch creates our most fertile lands, and its life-bringing waters of the river channel prosperity and ample wealth throughout our domain.
indian_networks: Our merchants deal in goods from the markets of Alexandria, to the shores of Aden, and as far away as India itself. These extensive networks of contacts, business, and capital have positioned us at the forefront of maritime commerce.
study_foreign_gunpowder_techniques: The great empires of Europe and the East have made groundbreaking advances in the use of gunpowder and its military applications. To study their ways and make the according improvements to our own armaments would greatly strengthen our own military.
port_customs: Designating our ports as official merchant zones for incoming cargo is a move that will certainly increase the mercantile significance of our territory, albeit at the expense of our neighbors and foes alike.
secure_mediterranean_ports: Our ports across the Mediterranean Sea are some of the most affluent in the entire region. Merchants from every corner of the known world travel to Alexandria and Cairo to deal in spices, Silk, and precious stones. The creation of a merchant navy to facilitate and protect our maritime avenues would therefore be a wise idea.
mohe_ancestry: Our people descend from the Mohe tribes of the Amur forests. Their traditions of hunting, herding, and hardy frontier life shape our society.
warka_ties: Our ties with the Warka have given us great knowledge in hunting and gathering food. Through these practices, we ensure our people stay fed, even during long winters.
shadow_of_ambition: The unification of the Jurchen tribes is but the first step in our ambitious rise to power. Soon, our name will strike fear and awe across the entire continent.
niyamniyan: The tradition of the Five Noble Talents involves riding, archery, military command, loyalty, and discipline. These aspects of our martial society form the backbone of our proud culture.
southern_campaigns: China is home to immeasurable wealth, prestige, and knowledge. Under the rule of a weak dynasty, it falls upon our shoulders to seize power and return the prosperity and splendor of these lands.
foreign_learning: From foreign scholars and texts, we shall adopt new administrative, military, and scholarly practices, accelerating the pace of our technological development.
meissen_lion: The Meißen Lion, also known as the Markmeißnische Löwe, holds a special place in heraldry. Representing the Wettin dynasty's symbol of power, an armored black lion with a red tongue gazes to the left on a golden field. Its image appears in various forms, including on painted tombstones, ensigns, helmets, coins, and seals, symbolizing the affiliation of the city of Meissen to the Mark Meißen and adorning the coats of arms of numerous towns and communities. Some link it to the recolored Thuringian lion.
a_mining_heritage: For centuries, mining has shaped our landscape, economy, and culture. Significant Silver discoveries in the region have attracted miners and traders from diverse regions, fostering the Ore Mountains' growth and expanding our realm's significance and development.
meissner_groschen: The Meißner groschen will serve as our national currency. This coin is based on the Prague groschen, which we will replace. This new large groschen will mark the beginning of a new era in the history of our coinage and will let us better control its influxes.
a_resilient_soul: Our people are truly resilient, embodying unwavering determination in the face of challenges. They weather adversity with unwavering spirit, finding strength in unity and a steadfast commitment to their shared values. Their indomitable resilience propels us forward, enabling us to overcome any obstacle that comes our way. We will always emerge stronger and more determined than ever before.
saxon_court: The Saxon Court is a pillar of Electoral Saxony's government, alongside civil and military administration. Court regulations define the responsibilities and daily routines of officials, while the court itself is composed of both nobles and peasants serving the ruling family in governance and administration. Traditionally, each adult member of the ruling family maintained their own household court, but we will now create a single, permanent court in our capital, attracting the finest minds in the realm.
a_tolerant_society: Religious infighting and intolerance plagues other lands, but we stand firm against allowing such strife to fester in our realm. Regardless of the diverse faiths our subjects hold, this nation shall be built on the strong pillars of tolerance and brotherhood, fostering a harmonious coexistence among all communities. United by a common vision, we will be forging a nation where respect and understanding flourish, paving the way for a prosperous future.
furstenschule: As the Reformation takes hold and the state assumes control over religious administration, a new responsibility arises for the emerging state: education, which was previously the duty of the Church. We will found princely schools at Pforta, Grimma, and Meissen using former monastic properties. Thus, the state will take on a significant role in shaping the educational landscape, fostering knowledge and intellectual growth for the future leaders of Saxony.
bonded_by_loyalty: Our valiant armies never waver! They demonstrate exceptional morale and loyalty, standing firm whether defending our realm or supporting allies. With indomitable spirits, they will press forward even in desperate circumstances, refusing defeat until physically unable to continue.
meissner_porcelain: Saxony is the first country in Europe to produce Porcelain, which will bring wealth and prestige to the Wettin court.
saxon_baroque: Dresden and Leipzig, among other locales, have gained international recognition for being centers of Saxon Baroque culture. Magnificent architecture, like the Dresdner Hof, epitomize the grandeur of Saxony, while Johann Sebastian Bach's work has transformed Leipzig into a city of music and thriving highbrow culture. The region boasts unique expressions of culture, including handicrafts from the Ore Mountains and culinary traditions like the Dresdner Christstollen.
retablissement:
After tumultuous wars, a new era dawns upon Saxony — the remarkable Saxon Rétablissement. Amidst the ruins of our past, our nation will rise like a phoenix, rebuilding its shattered economy and charting a path toward prosperity. Driven by a blend of visionary state reforms and disciplined spending, our nation will emerge as a commercial hub.

With unparalleled administrative prowess and a strategic focus on economic growth, this resolute transformation will mark a pivotal moment in history, shaping the destiny of Saxony well into the future.
saxon_industrialization: Saxony's successful early industrialization is evident, with a highly developed industrial sector compared to other regions. The manufactory system, producing mainly for export, has flourished and will make Saxony a leading state in Germany's industrialization process. The emergence of smaller commercial landscapes and trade will be instrumental in promoting the region's economic growth and connections to other markets in Europe.
mge_pax_mongolica: Having unified all Mongolian territories under our banner, the stability and prosperity our people will be able to enjoy has not been seen since the times of the great Genghis Khān.
mge_all_under_a_khan: Genghis Khān unified great swathes of territory under his banner. Having unified those territories again under the authority of a single Khān, all people in our empire shall swear allegiance to us.
mge_ghostly_horses_of_the_plain: The prowess of Mongolian horsemen is renowned across the entire world. Our enemies shake in terror at the sight of a dust cloud in the distance, fearing that it might signify our cavalry's approach!
mge_yeke_mongol_ulus: As the original Mongols, we restored the Yeke Mongol Ulus, the Great Mongolian State, resurrecting the glory of Genghis Khān's great empire. Given the slightest chance, our people will emulate the exploits of the Great Khān and reclaim his legacy, reuniting the once-vast territories of the Mongol Khanate.
mge_life_of_steppe_warrior: The steppe is a foreboding and unforgiving place for the unprepared. We are accustomed to living in this harsh environment, and as such our people are sturdy and have a knack for survival. We will ensure that all of our soldiers share these skills, and are thus able to more easily survive extreme situations.
mge_multicultural_empire: The territories of the great Mongol Empire are home to many different peoples, all unified under the glory of the mighty Khān.
mge_improved_yam_system: The system of yam posts all over our empire have facilitated communication and logistics since the times of the great Genghis Khān. After re-establishing and improving this system, our messengers can cross the massive expanse of our empire at speeds that were not even thought possible before.
mge_mongolian_mobility: Each of our soldiers typically maintains three or four horses, allowing them to change each time their mount becomes tired, and thereby travel at high speed for days without stopping. Furthermore, their extra mounts provide them with food reserves through mare's milk as well as horse meat, making our armies far less vulnerable to starvation than other, so-called civilized nations' armies. This allows us to outmaneuver our enemies with ease, covering a staggering amount of territory in shorter periods than they had believed to be possible.
mge_kheshig: The Kheshig once formed the formidable bodyguard of the Great Mongol Khān. Their descendants will continue to protect the Khān of Mongolia as they ride into battle.
mge_glory_of_the_khan: The extraordinary Genghis Khān amassed a huge army like never before seen. We are heirs to his glory, and therefore our army will outstrip even the greatest Mongol hordes of the past.
melaka_tree: As legend goes, the timid mouse deer sought refuge in what would later become our domain. Our beggining is humble, as little more than a fishing village clustered beneath the shade of the Melaka tree. From these roots shall grow a people that will one day shape the entire region.
orang_laut: Long before our rise, the Orang Laut roamed the straits as masters of wind and tide. Now, by learning their ways and employing a select few, we guide traders through the narrow waters and shield our coast from pirates. Such vigilance ensures that all who sail to Malacca arrive safely.
congregation_of_merchants: From Arabia to China and the coasts of South Asia, merchants of every shore converge upon Malacca. Drawn by fair laws, secure waters, and bustling markets, they will form a great congregation that enriches our ports and carries our name across the seas.
connections_with_china: Our envoys have secured recognition from China's most prestigious sovereigns. Tribute and goodwill flow between us, granting us prestige, protection, and a privileged place in the vast network of their trade.
control_the_malacca_strait: The narrow Inner Strait of Malacca is the backbone of our maritime commerce. By controlling this vital strait, we channel the wealth of nations into our harbors and establish ourselves as the unrivaled gatekeepers of the east-west trade.
shahbandar: To manage the vast tide of merchants arriving at our ports, we appoint a Shāhbandar as the authority to oversee customs, resolve disputes, and organize the foreign quarters. This office brings order to our bustling entrepôt and will strengthen our role as the crossroads of the seas.
moroccan_sharifian_descent: Our dynasty claims direct descent from the Prophet Muḥammad through Ḥasan ibn 'Alī, a sharīfī lineage that the Idrīsid founders carried west of Egypt in the eighth century and that we now invoke as the sacral foundation of our throne. No Berber dynasty (Almoravid, Almohad, Marinid, or Waṭṭāsid) could match the prophetic genealogy that our court genealogists publish, certify, and recite at every bay'a ceremony. This sharifian descent secures the loyalty of the ulema and lifts the standing of our court before every Muslim peer.
mor_atlas_strongholds: The mountain ranges that crown our territory (the High Atlas, the Middle Atlas, the Anti-Atlas, and the Rif) are the reason no foreign empire has ever held Morocco in lasting submission. Our Amazigh mountain clans have garrisoned the passes since the Roman attempts of Pliny's day, and our network of qaṣbah fortresses at Telouet, Aït Benhaddou, and the high valleys lets us hold defensible ground against any invader. This fortified geography makes Morocco the only kingdom whose interior cannot be conquered by sea or by Saharan crossing.
first_fleet_of_the_med: The fleet of the al-Muwaḥḥidūn caliphs at Marrakesh, sustained by tribute payments from the Italian maritime republics under Ya'qūb al-Manṣūr and command-coordinated from the imperial capital, established Moroccan naval supremacy in the western Mediterranean for two centuries. Our sultans inherit not only the docks at Salé, Asilah, and Larache but the doctrine of strategic centralization: fleets dispatched against single objectives at the order of Marrakesh, rather than the dispersed privateering that any coastal corsair captain could mount on his own. An imperial command tradition lets our navy operate as a coherent strategic instrument, which fragmented coastal corsair fleets could never be.
mor_marinid_takeover: The Banū Marīn, Zenata Berbers from the eastern plateaus, supplant the failing Almohads at Marrakesh and rebuild the imperial state around a reformed makhzen chancery at Fez al-Jadid, a streamlined dīwān of provincial governors, and a court ceremonial purged of Almohad religious and doctrinal overreach. The dynastic transition consolidates a leaner, administratively coherent imperial throne than the sprawling caliphate it replaces. The Marinid reorganization gives our court a centralized government that works, as the Almohad inheritance alone could not have provided.
sle_idrisi_atlantic_port: The twelfth-century geographer al-Idrīsī, writing for the Norman court at Palermo, names Salé among the principal Atlantic anchorages of the western Maghreb, its quays, granaries, and customs houses described with the care reserved for cities of consequence. Our merchant houses inherit a port whose Almoravid and Almohad predecessors built the docks and curtain walls that the late medieval shipping still uses. Medieval prominence has left our crown a developed Atlantic emporium, beyond the reach of lesser Maghrebi ports.
tet_strait_lookout: Our coastal watchtowers and signal fires above Tetouan guard the eastern approach to the Strait of Gibraltar, the narrowest natural gateway between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic. Almohad and Marinid garrisons have manned the heights here for generations, watching the Iberian shore and the passing galley traffic of every Mediterranean power. Our watch on the strait tells our court of every fleet that approaches our coast from either sea.
moroccan_bay_a: The bay'a is the formal oath by which the ulema of Fez, the urban notables, and the tribal qā'ids pledge allegiance to a newly acclaimed sultan, a covenant renewed at each succession and at every great political crisis. The act binds rulers and subjects in mutual obligation: the sultan undertakes to defend the faith and the customary law, while the assembled representatives undertake to support the state with their levies and their tax compliance. This consent-based legitimacy stabilizes our succession and dampens the centrifugal pressures that the absence of consultation would otherwise unleash.
mor_marrakesh_fez_axis: Our imperial throne rests on two capitals: Marrakesh holds the ceremonial prestige inherited from Almohad caliphal claims, while Fez al-Jadid serves as the administrative and religious heart of the realm. Each capital governs its own half of our territory through its own dīwāns and military command, while the sultan circulates between them on a yearly ceremonial circuit asserting central authority across the kingdom. This arrangement of two capitals carries our reach further across our territory than any single-seat Maghrebi state can hope to match.
mor_marinid_madrasas: Marinid sultans endow a network of imperial madrasas across Fez and the surrounding cities (the Bū 'Ināniyya, the 'Aṭṭārīn, the Bū 'Ināniyya of Meknes, the Ṣahrīj, and the Miṣbāḥiyya), each with mosque, library, hospice, teaching staff, and student stipends paid from the sultanic treasury. The graduates staff the qāḍī benches, the chancery scribes, and the sermon givers of the kingdom, binding the religious establishment to the imperial throne through shared training. This sultan-funded scholarship makes our state more learned and draws reformist scholars from across the Muslim world to our court.
sle_early_privateer_charters: Late-Marinid sultans issue the first formal letters of marque from our docks, authorizing Salé captains to seize Aragonese, Castilian, and Genoese shipping under royal license. Our shipmasters learn the techniques of Mediterranean prize hunting from refugee Andalusi captains, and our coastal galleys begin returning with captured cargoes and ransomable crewmen. This early state-licensed privateering lays the groundwork that later corsair republic constitutions make law.
tet_riffian_levies: The Jbala and Rifian mountain clans, whose villages crown the heights above Tetouan, supply our garrison with light-armed irregulars accustomed to ambush, raid, and rapid retreat across broken country. Each clan confederation maintains its own muster customs, weapons traditions, and chain of command under chiefs who hold their levy obligations as a hereditary contract with the city. The Rifian levies form a flexible auxiliary corps for our standing forces, one that the lowland Maghrebi cities cannot easily field.
moroccan_andalusi_refuge: Successive waves of Andalusi exiles settle in the cities of our coast: Tetouan rebuilt by the Manẓarī family, the Andalusi quarter of Fez, the Hornachero corsair colony at Salé, and the silk weavers of Chefchaouen. They bring with them the gunpowder craftsmanship, banking expertise, urban architecture, and cuisine of their lost peninsula, knowledge our older merchant houses immediately absorb. The refugee influx revitalizes our cities and brings the crown a class of skilled burghers, loyal to the realm that gave them sanctuary.
mor_sadi_sharifian_emergence: The Banū Sa'd, descended from the Prophet Muḥammad through Ḥasan ibn 'Alī and long settled in the Drâa Valley as a family of sharifian local notables, emerge in the early sixteenth century as claimants to the sultanate against the failing Waṭṭāsids. Their dynastic mission, to restore unified Moroccan-Arab imperial authority under a sharifian crown, wins them swift support from the ulema of Fez and Marrakesh, the trans-Saharan caravan masters, and the urban Andalusi exile communities. This dynastic emergence lets our envoys claim the prestige of prophetic descent across the courts of the Muslim Mediterranean and the Saharan trade world.
mor_chichaoua_sugar: Our sugar plantations and refining mills at Chichaoua, the Sus valley, and the Tadla plain transform Moroccan agriculture into an industrial export complex that holds every stage under one hand: sultanic charters grant tax-exempt status to the cane plantations, royal mills process the cane into refined loaves, and the imperial treasury takes a share at every stage. Our sukkar al-Maghribī reaches European bookkeepers, druggists, and confectioners through the Atlantic ports, commanding premium prices over Madeiran and Brazilian competitors. This sugar industry, held in royal hands from cane to loaf, generates revenue our central treasury draws upon directly and gives the Moroccan crown a luxury export advantage no other Maghrebi state can match.
sle_atlantic_corsair_charters: Our captains operate under formalized state charters that exempt their crews from regular naval discipline while obliging a fixed share of every prize to the treasury, a contractual privateering system that draws ambitious sailors from across the Mediterranean and Atlantic worlds. The corsair guilds at Salé train successive generations of skippers in the techniques of swift ship interception, signal flag deception, and prize court litigation. This tradition of organized privateering keeps our fleet at sea year after year, as occasional state fleet expeditions cannot.
tet_andalusi_quarter: After 'Alī al-Manẓarī refounds Tetouan with the first wave of Andalusi exiles arriving from al-'Andalus, the city's Andalusi quarter rises as a transplanted Nasrid neighborhood, its tiled fountains, courtyard houses, ironwork balconies, and silk weaving workshops carrying the patterns of lost al-'Andalus into Maghrebi stone. The Granadan exile families monopolize literacy, banking, and the religious establishment, and their schools train clerks and scribes for the urban administration. With this exiled culture transplanted here, Tetouan reads and writes as no other Maghrebi port does.
atlantic_trade_routes: The Portuguese and Castilian rounding of Cape Bojador has opened a new Atlantic shipping system that runs along our entire coastline, from Tangier through Salé and Larache down to Mogador and Agadir. We host European factors at the funduq an-Naṣārā in our Atlantic ports, take customs duties on every vessel that calls for water or repair, and re-export goods inland to the Saharan caravan markets. Our western coast gives our state a lasting commercial advantage over the wholly Mediterranean Maghrebi states to our east.
foreign_politics: Morocco's strategic position controlling the western Mediterranean gateway and the Atlantic re-supply route makes us the indispensable diplomatic counterweight for any European power seeking advantage against another. Our envoys at foreign courts negotiate as equals; the Sublime Door of Marrakesh receives ambassadors, signs commerce treaties, and arbitrates disputes between Christian princes who would never accept such mediation from any other Muslim sovereign. This unique diplomatic standing gives the Moroccan throne influence in European affairs that no other Maghrebi or sub-Saharan state can match.
mor_dhahabi_golden_age: Our court under great sultans of the imperial heyday, the era subsequent generations remember as the dhahabī or golden age, accumulates wealth on a scale no later Maghrebi state can equal. Gold flows in from the Saharan termini at Sijilmasa, Walata, and Timbuktu; refined sugar departs the Atlantic ports for European confectioners; ambassadors arrive from courts across Christendom and the Sublime Porte seeking alliance or commerce. Sustained prosperity fills the treasury, and subsequent reigns draw upon it to fund military campaigns, religious endowments, and dynastic ceremonies that lesser states cannot afford.
sle_bou_regreg_republic: The corsair captains of Salé and Rabat, exhausted by Sa'dī mismanagement of their interests, proclaim the autonomous Republic of the Bou Regreg in the early seventeenth century, a sovereign commonwealth bound by its own dīwān of elected qā'ids and its own power to make treaties. Our republic concludes commerce agreements directly with the Dutch States-General, England, France, and the Italian commercial republics on terms no Maghrebi monarchy can match. As a sovereign corsair commonwealth, Salé holds a constitutional standing recognized across the Atlantic and western Mediterranean.
tet_andalusi_banking_houses: Our Jewish-Andalusi merchant banking houses at Tetouan (the Cazes, Pariente, Naḥon, Bendelac, and Toledano lineages who carried Toledan commercial paper customs into exile) finance both the corsair fleet and the regular Mediterranean trade. They maintain correspondent relationships with Livorno, Genoa, Marseille, Amsterdam, and the Sephardic communities of every Mediterranean port. Through this network of banking houses our treasury borrows on terms that purely Muslim merchant capital alone could not offer.
moroccan_malhun_poetry: Our urban poets, the shuyūkh al-malḥūn of Fez, Meknes, Marrakesh, and Salé, compose and perform the sung poetry tradition that distinguishes Moroccan-Arabic culture from every other Arab poetic school. The qṣīda and grīḥa forms set vernacular Darija verse to the rhythmic patterns of Andalusi-Maghrebi music, treating themes of love, satire, mysticism, and dynastic politics in a register accessible to every urban household. This popular literary tradition spreads across our cities and oasis caravans alike, giving our peasants and burghers a cultural medium that sustains the prestige of Moroccan-Arabic identity long after individual rulers fade from memory.
jaysh_armies_advance: Our sultans have granted military estates to the jaysh tribes, chiefly the Banū Ma'qil and Banū Ḥassān, in exchange for permanent cavalry service to the throne. These warrior clans hold their lands tax-free and answer the sultan's call with their full mounted strength, providing the mobile striking force that the makhzen deploys against rebellious cities and Sahel raids. This integration of pastoral Arab tribes into a feudal military system gives Morocco a standing cavalry reserve at no fiscal cost to the central treasury.
mor_sherifian_inviolability: The constitutional doctrine of sharifian inviolability holds that our sultan, descended from the Prophet through Ḥasan ibn 'Alī, cannot be challenged on the same footing as a mere governor or qā'id. Provincial revolts may topple individual ummāl, urban risings may unseat hated tax collectors, and tribal confederations may resist particular royal commands, but the sharifian crown itself remains constitutionally sacrosanct in the eyes of the ulema and the bay'a-bound notables. This deep dynastic legitimacy lets our state weather provincial unrest that would topple monarchies dependent on purely secular authority.
sle_christian_captive_market: Our captive markets at the docks of Salé and Rabat receive the European prisoners taken by our corsair fleet, ransomed back through the Trinitarian and Mercedarian friars who arrive with Genoese letters of credit and silver chests. The auction master, the ransom broker, the slave keeper, and the chaplain-translator form a tightly organized trade that supports our entire corsair operation. This traffic in captives lowers the cost of every privateer expedition the treasury commissions.
tet_naqib_al_ashraf: Our local naqīb al-ashrāf, the syndic of the sharifian-descended families of Tetouan, convenes the city's prophetic lineage notables, certifies their genealogies, mediates inheritance disputes, and represents their collective interests to the imperial throne. The council holds tax exemptions, ceremonial precedence at urban festivals, and the right to be consulted in disputes between the qāḍī and the makhzen-appointed governor. This standing sharifian council tradition stabilizes our urban governance through the legitimate channel of prophetic descent.
moroccan_nahda_maghribiyya: Our Moroccan branch of the Nahḍa gathers in the Salafiyya circles of Fez around 'Allāl al-Fāsī and Abū Shu'ayb al-Dukkālī, in the Tangier-based Arabic press of Lisān al-Maghrib, and in the Tetouan–Fez bilingual periodicals that bring European thought into the western Maghrebi conversation. We recover the medieval manuscripts of Ibn Khaldūn, al-Maqqarī, and the Marinid chroniclers from foreign libraries, reissue them in critical editions, and standardize Moroccan classical Arabic against the centralizing pressures of foreign administrative languages in our schools and registries. This intellectual renewal binds our scattered elite into a shared modern identity that no centralizing foreign administration can easily fragment.
mor_imperial_modernization: Successive nineteenth-century sultans pursue a continuous program of administrative, fiscal, and military modernization: recruiting foreign technical advisors, restructuring the makhzen chancery, modernizing the imperial arsenals, and standardizing tax collection across the realm. Each reform faces resistance from entrenched tribal and ulema interests, but a slow habit of reform and adjustment gradually emerges and persists across changing sultans. This sustained adaptation lets our crown promote technicians, engineers, and modern administrators into positions of state authority while every source of revenue yields more to the treasury.
mor_makhzen_taxation_reform: The traditional patchwork of kharāj, 'ushūr, zakāt, and city guild gharāma taxes is repeatedly reorganized into more efficient consolidated forms: the unified per capita tertib on the rural plain, the standardized urban tax, and the regularized Atlantic-port customs assessments. Our merchants come to know what they will owe, our Jewish-Andalusi banking houses at Tetouan and Mogador refine their lending terms accordingly, and our treasury captures revenue that previously leaked through the cracks of overlapping exemptions. Continuous fiscal modernization gives our crown the wealth to fund modern armies and public works, beyond what purely traditional tax regimes can bear.
sle_atlantic_legal_commerce: The shifting naval balance against corsairing pushes Salé to pivot toward legitimate Atlantic trade: exporting Gharb-plain wheat, leather goods, beeswax, and Saharan caravan products through formal contracts with foreign merchant houses across the Atlantic basin. Our banking offices switch from the ransom broker model to commercial discount lending, and our shipyards begin building peaceful cargo carriers. The port master adopts standardized customs assessments. This commercial transition lets our treasury sustain its revenue base as the privateer era closes.
tet_andalusi_press_revival: Our late period printers and lithographers at Tetouan revive the publishing of Granadan-Andalusi classical works (the dīwāns of Ibn Zaydūn, the prose of Lisān ad-Dīn ibn al-Khaṭīb, the Tunisian-Andalusi muwashshaḥāt of Ibn Sahl) alongside reformist Arabic newspapers connecting the western Maghreb to the broader Nahḍa current. Literate peasants migrate to Tetouan's print quarter to apprentice as compositors, binders, and engravers, swelling our burgher class and drawing fresh families from the rural hinterland with every issue our presses turn out. This revival of the press opens a steady promotion ladder from countryside to city and gives our urban centers a migration draw that no rural-anchored Maghrebi state can match.
mos_skilled_tax_collectors: Our position as the collector of tribute for the Golden Horde has given us many years of experience in gathering tribute... and in retaining some of the profits for ourselves.
mos_dynastic_ties: The lands of Russia have been ruled by one dynasty since time immemorial. We should utilize our position among our peers and our blood ties to take a leading role.
seat_of_metropolitan_bishop: The Russian people need firm religious guidance. We have historically cooperated well with the Church, and expanding this relationship would benefit us all. If we can move the seat of the Metropolitan Bishop to Moscow, we will be able to strengthen the bonds between our faith and our state.
pomestnoe_voisko: By redistributing plots of confiscated lands to noble cavalrymen, we can build a new class of soldiers to defend our principality.
strength_of_the_boyars: The Boyar class is in many ways the foundation of Russia, but just as we need to strengthen the Boyars, we also need to control them. We must protect seats for the Boyars in the Duma, but also to make sure that they are dependent on us to further their influence.
zasechnaya_cherta: In order to withstand the constant threat of Tatar raids, our ancestors have built a line of tightly positioned and well-defended forts. As our state grows larger, we should keep expanding this 'Abatis Line' to ensure our people are always protected from foreign attacks.
hurricane_hardy: The designs of Feodor Apraksin are robust and resilient, enabling ships to weather most storms that Mother Nature is able to conjure. The innovative construction greatly contributes to any burgeoning maritime ambitions.
preobrazhensky_semyonovsky_imperial_guar: The 'Toy Army' is organized into elite companies, forming the Imperial Guard which protects the interests of the monarchy. They are frequently involved in court ceremonies, parades, and other significant events, showcasing their importance beyond their military duties.
mos_patrol_the_territories: Governing the vast expanse of Russia is no easy task. We should establish local recruitment centers to make drafting levies into our armies easier.
imperatorskiy_moskovskiy_universitet: The Imperial University is dedicated to the study of philosophy, medicine, and law, and plays a significant role in Russian education and research. It is established as part of educational reforms conceived by polymath Mikhail Lomonosov, emphasizing the importance of scientific inquiry and innovation.
