mug_zamindar_system: The Zamindar are feudal rulers who govern our territories autonomously or semi-autonomously. While they are owners of the land they administrate and part of our nobility, in the end, they serve as internal vassals to the Crown itself.
mug_mughal_ibadat_khana: The Ibadat Khana - House of Worship - serves as a meeting place for spiritual leaders of diverse religions to engage in discussions and debates on religious teachings. It aims to foster understanding among different faiths, leading to the conclusion that all religions share a common goal.
mug_mughal_architecture: A great empire demands equally monumental buildings. In our cosmopolitan realm, architects are already creating marvelous edifices that will awe generations to come. Our dynasty should be at the forefront of this movement, creating great architectural works such as the world has never seen.
mug_fatawa_e_alamgiri: The Fatawa-i-Alamgiri is a sharia-based compilation, serving as the primary legal code regulating various aspects of life in our empire. It is one of the most comprehensive collections of Muslim laws, ethics, military strategies, economic policies, justice, and principles.
mug_an_indian_padshah: Though we came to India as foreigners, we now rule as Indian Padishah, embracing local traditions while transcending divisions of caste and creed. As our realm is one of many faiths and cultures, our administration will draw talent from all communities, giving everyone — regardless of caste, religion, or culture — an equal opportunity to serve our great house and glorious realm.
nav_transatlantic_whaling: For four centuries the fishermen of San Sebastián, Bermeo, and Lekeitio have hunted the Biscay right whale in the Cantabrian Sea, perfecting the harpoon, the try pot, and the open boat pursuit. Pressed by overhunting close to home, our crews now sail to Newfoundland and the Strait of Belle Isle, building seasonal txalupa tryworks at Red Bay and trading whale oil to England and the Hanseatic League. Our long-range whalers keep the Basque coast present in the Atlantic decades before any other European fleet ventures regularly into North American waters.
nav_shipbuiling_experts: The shipwrights of Pasaia, Mutriku, and Lekeitio have built whaling ketches, herring busses, and trans-Atlantic cargo carriers for foreign clients since the thirteenth century. The Navarrese Crown charters our arsenals to standardize hull designs based on local oak, Pyrenean iron fittings, and construction methods that allow rapid replacement of damaged vessels. With so many yards at work, Navarre alone among the Iberian Crowns can launch fully equipped war squadrons within a single season of warning.
nav_memories_reconquista: At the Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, Sancho VII the Strong of Navarre broke the Almohad center personally with his knights, taking the Caliph's golden tent chains that now adorn the royal arms of Navarre. Though landlocked by the later rise of Castile and Aragon, every generation of Navarrese knights is raised on the legend of Sancho's charge and committed to fight in every major Christian campaign on the peninsula. The Crusader legend lends the Navarrese Crown a sacred standing on the Iberian Peninsula that its small size could never earn alone.
nav_fearless_seamen: The Basque coast offers little arable land between the Pyrenees and the sea, and our coastal communities have long looked to the Bay of Biscay for their livelihood through fishing, trade, and piloting. Sailors from Bilbao, Pasaia, and Bayonne crew the merchant fleets of half of Europe: Juan de la Cosa pilots Columbus's Santa María, Juan Sebastián Elcano completes the first global circumnavigation, and Andrés de Urdaneta charts the Pacific return route from Manila to Acapulco. This concentration of navigational talent makes the Basque-speaking ports the indispensable training grounds of Iberian seamanship.
nav_a_renaissance_realm: Straddling the Pyrenees, Navarre receives Renaissance humanism through two channels: the universities of Bordeaux and Paris from the north, and Salamanca and Alcalá from the south. The court of John III d'Albret and Catherine of Foix corresponds with Erasmus, hosts the philosophical lectures of Pedro de Atarrabia, and supports the first Basque-language publication, Bernart Etxepare's Linguae Vasconum Primitiae. This intellectual openness produces a small but cosmopolitan elite uniquely suited to mediating between French and Castilian humanism.
nav_always_ready: Sandwiched between Castile, Aragon, the Crown of England in Gascony, and a hungry France beyond the passes, Navarre has never enjoyed the luxury of unprepared peace. The Pyrenean Cortes de Navarra maintains a permanent inventory of stored grain, beacon towers along every pass, and a rotating militia summoned by village criers from one valley to the next. This perpetual readiness allows a kingdom of two hundred thousand souls to mobilize within forty-eight hours of any incursion across its mountain frontiers.
nav_people_of_the_sea: From the ports of Bilbao, Pasaia, and San Sebastián, Basque-speaking crews fill the lower decks of every great Iberian voyage of discovery in proportions far beyond what our small population would suggest. Our pilots draft the first charts of the Newfoundland banks, our boatswains rig the Manila galleons, and our gunners man the heavy ships of the Spanish armadas in disproportionate numbers. Whoever holds the Basque ports can crew a navy for distant oceans from our harbors alone.
nav_chartered_councils: The Foruak, known as Fueros in Castilian usage and corresponding to the body of customary laws governing each Basque province, guarantee local self-government in exchange for loyalty to the Navarrese Crown. Each historical territory elects a Diputación Foral responsible to its general assembly, the Junta General, while remaining within the wider royal administration. Through these councils the Crown draws taxes and soldiers without provoking the violent fueros-defending revolts that have wrecked rival Iberian centralization projects.
nav_basque_ferocity: At the Battle of Roncesvalles in 778, a Basque ambush annihilated the Frankish rearguard of Charlemagne and killed Count Roland of Brittany, a feat that has lived in European memory through the Chanson de Roland. The Catalan Company under Roger de Flor, recruited largely from Navarrese and Aragonese mountaineers, carved a path of terror through the Byzantine Empire in 1303 and held the Duchy of Athens for three generations. This reputation for ferocity precedes our infantry into every theater, granting Navarrese commanders a psychological advantage before the first volley is fired.
nav_an_industrious_folk: The mountain valleys of Bizkaia and Gipuzkoa hold the richest iron deposits in western Europe, worked since Roman times in small water-powered forges called ferrerías. Our smiths produce a Biscayan steel of such hardness that the swords of Toledo, the harquebuses of the Tercios, and the anchors of every Spanish galleon depend on Basque ironmasters. This economy, which mines, smelts, and forges within a single chain, gives the Basque country an industrial weight out of all proportion to its population.
nav_mercantile_expansion: Navarrese merchants have built commercial networks along the Pyrenean wool routes between Castile, Aragon, and the French Atlantic ports since the early Middle Ages. Through the consulates of Bayonne and Tudela, our trading houses now handle the export of Castilian merino to Flanders, the import of English cloth to inland Iberia, and the exchanges of silver and spice at the Bordeaux fair. Thus a landlocked kingdom of mountains holds a stake in every major continental trade artery from the Channel to Granada.
nav_navarrese_defense_force: With Spain consolidating to the south and France pressing its absolutist ambitions to the north, Navarre cannot rely on improvised levies and Pyrenean valleys alone for its defense. We will establish the Tercio de Navarra, a permanent regiment quartered at Pamplona and recruited from each of the kingdom's six merindades according to fixed quotas. This standing professional infantry doubles our peacetime military strength and provides the trained cadre around which a wartime army of conscripts can be rapidly built.
nav_shipyards_ironworks: The shipyards of Pasaia, Orio, and Mutriku and the ironworks of the Deba and Cadagua river valleys form a single industrial belt sustained for centuries by Pyrenean charcoal and Vizcayan iron ore. We modernize the forges with Walloon and Swedish hammer techniques, lay down keels on Dutch designs at the Real Astillero of Pasaia, and contract Manuel de Cosío to design the new fleets of three-deckers for the Crown. This industrial complex remains the only place in Iberia capable of producing first-rate ships of the line from raw ore to launch within its own region.
nav_adept_traders: The mercantile houses of Pamplona, Tudela, and Bilbao have built fortunes on the Castilian wool trade, the Atlantic cod trade, and the long-distance commerce in iron and arms supplied to every major European power. We extend their reach through the Royal Trade Privileges, granting Navarrese merchants reduced customs in every Spanish American port and consular protection in the Hanseatic cities. This international commercial network channels a disproportionate share of Atlantic and Mediterranean trade returns through our small kingdom's treasury.
nav_the_national_military_academy: To replace the apprenticeship-based officer corps of the old Tercio de Navarra, the Crown has founded the Royal Military Academy of Pamplona under the direction of veterans of the Italian campaigns. The curriculum combines fortification engineering on the Vauban model, modern artillery science, and the tactical theory of the new linear infantry formations. This professional officer school standardizes military doctrine across the Navarrese army and produces a generation of trained commanders for the king's broader Iberian forces.
nav_royal_basque_society: The Real Sociedad Bascongada de los Amigos del País, founded at Bergara by the Count of Peñaflorida and a circle of Basque nobles, is the first modern learned society on the Iberian Peninsula. Its Seminario Patriótico at Bergara teaches modern chemistry, mathematics, and economics to the sons of the regional gentry, and it produces Fausto and Juan José Elhuyar who isolate tungsten for the first time in history. Through it the Basque provinces stand at the vanguard of science and economics in the wider Enlightenment of the Spanish monarchy.
nav_efficient_bureaucracy: The Cámara de Comptos Reales of Pamplona, founded as the first permanent royal exchequer on the Peninsula, has produced the longest continuous fiscal archive in Iberia. We modernize its procedures with Enlightenment-era double-entry bookkeeping, a numbered file system inspired by French royal practice, and the appointment of trained jurists from the University of Oñati to the senior accountancies. Under these methods the Crown gathers its revenue from the kingdom with great precision.
nav_riflemen_march: The introduction of the rifled musket and the percussion cap requires a new tactical doctrine of skirmishing in dispersed open order, a fighting style for which the Pyrenean terrain has trained the Navarrese infantry for generations. The Royal Academy of Pamplona is developing the Marcha de Cazadores, a fast-pace marching cadence and dispersion drill that lets entire battalions advance under cover while maintaining unit cohesion. This drill makes Navarrese light infantry the model for every Iberian army adapting to the realities of rifled weapon warfare.
netherlandish_protoindustry: For a long time, our land has been home to bustling towns and cities with a higher concentration of craftsmen than our neighbors. This focus has made us a highly productive nation.
brb_the_four_quartiers: The Four Quartiers are the four provinces into which the core of Brabant is divided. Each quartier is formed by a satellite of large and smaller towns, some walled and others not. They all work in perfect synergy like a well-greased engine, filling our coffers with great riches.
fla_cloth: The Flemish Cloth industry is the envy of the world. Merchants come from far away to sell their Wool in Flanders, where we manufacture the best quality Cloth.
frisian_trading_traditions: Long before the counties south of us developed their own routes, our ancestors dominated coastal trade in Europe, from the Baltic to Biscay. We must revive this ancient maritime expertise to reclaim our rightful position.
gel_warring_spirit: Some may call us bellicose, but that is only because they fear our might. A well-trained standing army is essential for survival in this chaotic age. Our adversaries will soon learn to respect our hardened spirit.
hai_expert_embassadors: Our rulers have always been skillful with their words, and their diplomatic acumen has established their influence far beyond our national borders. As time goes on and geopolitical pressures intensify, we must start cultivating friendship with other nations for protection while expanding our sphere of influence.
hol_sailors: A land of sands and flooded terrain, the people of Holland have always looked at the sea as their natural second home, where bountiful resources and glorious adventures await those brave enough to pursue them.
lie_athens_north: Liège has been a cultural center for centuries, the home of the most celebrated scholars in the region and the envy of our rivals. But we shall not allow ourselves to become complacent; we shall never stop improving our institutions.
lux_destined_rule: The great Luxembourg dynasty, whose very name is derived from that of our nation, is now the most important family in Europe. This has to be a sign from Heaven, and we will use this divine benediction to further extend our influence.
utr_city_churches: Utrecht, often called the City of Churches, is home to the iconic Dom Tower. The spiritual center of the Netherlands and the seat of the Bishopric of Utrecht, it has been a beacon of faith since antiquity.
a_dynamic_society: Our lands are a haven for the bold. Those looking to better their lives will find opportunity here, and we will in turn capitalize on the talents of these ambitious individuals to strengthen our nation.
brb_brabantine_rights: As other nations have, it is time to codify the liberties of our subjects, in order to identify and safeguard their rights and motivate them to continue working towards a better future for our country.
fla_flemish_renaissance: As one of the most prosperous regions on the continents, much of the wealth we have created naturally flows toward artistic patronage. Flemish merchants commission master painters to create art that, while perhaps not practical, casts light over even the cloudiest of days. With dozens of our merchants actively hiring artists and commissioning new pieces, we are creating a distinctive Renaissance of our own.
frisian_resisting_invader: Surrounded as we are by enemies, our people are accustomed to aggressively defending their lands, fighting so fiercely that many would-be invaders turn tail and never return. Those who cannot escape us can take comfort in the thought that their blood shall nurture the Frisia soil.
gel_healthy_economy: We have expanded our borders not only by the sword, but through careful financial planning, which allowed us to purchase influence over desirable territories — or to buy them outright. With continued wise budget management, this economic trend should be sustainable.
hai_frontier_march: As a border province of the Holy Roman Empire, Hainaut has developed a rough-and-ready spirit, born from centuries of frontier conflict. This spirit makes our people naturally inclined towards taking defensive action, which we can exploit to our benefit.
hol_maritime_warfare: As a maritime nation, our sailors are accustomed to naval combat, whether against members of rival nations or pirates attempting to plunder our trading vessels. In any case, our navy must be prepared to face any enemy at any time.
lie_devoted_land: As part of one of the biggest dioceses in the area, there is no doubt as to the depth of devotion our people hold. We will show the world that our faith in God is as strong as our faith in our nation.
lux_fortress_europe: The impregnable position of Luxembourg, with the formation of the Bock acting as a natural fortress, is incredibly strong. Our enemies would perish in any attempt to usurp our holdings. We shall learn from nature, and construct all our fortresses so as to use the local terrain to their advantage.
utr_blessed_land: The Pope himself influences the election of our Prince-Bishop, challenging the traditional five-chapter election format that we had before. This is clear proof that our land has been divinely blessed!
an_early_urbanization: The Low Countries have traditionally had a high rate of urbanization, which has allowed us to achieve power beyond what most might expect. We should accelerate this trend by creating a robust network of prosperous settlements that can help us create a wealthier future.
brb_land_culture: With the foundation of the University of Leuven, Brabant has placed itself firmly at the center of culture in the Netherlands. Students from all over Europe come to our lands to study and share their knowledge.
fla_prospering_agriculture: As our cloth, luxury goods, and financial industries face growing competition, it is becoming obvious that we need to manage our land use better. By creating regional granaries, we further diversify our economy, and bolster our food stores against famine or poor harvests.
frisian_legend_grutte_pier: There are stories in our lands about a pirate who was seven feet tall and strong as an ox. These tales inspire many to take to the seas and do what our ancestors did best: loot unguarded coasts.
gel_expand_kwarteers: As in the case of Brabant, Guelders has traditionally been divided into four quarters. This system of provinces arranged around a strong central city has proven to be an efficient way to govern our nation, and we should apply this system to new regions that join our realm in the future.
hai_bustling_towns: Our lively urban settlements are full of potential. With just a little effort, we can make them and their hinterlands incredibly wealthy, allowing us to thoroughly tax them.
hol_trading_spirit: Our country is surrounded by the sea, so it is only natural that we would brave the roiling waves in search of trading ports and enriching goods to bring back.
lie_inspiring_mecenas: Our nation inspires artists from across Europe, who come here to create their masterworks. We will spare no expense to support these artists and attract new talent, establishing ourselves as a hub of arts and culture.
lux_heirs_john_blind: John the Blind, the heroic King of Bohemia and Count of Luxembourg, was born in our humble realm. He died in the Battle of Crécy at fifty, having charged headlong into combat despite his blindness. His brave, honorable death will inspire our soldiers for centuries.
utr_skilled_diplomats: Given the growing influence of our neighbors, our nation's survival depends on our ability to find loyal, powerful allies who will support us in our times of need.
dutch_education: While our people always enjoyed superior literacy rates at all levels of society, this advantage is becoming more apparent in the world taking shape before us. Only those with a limited understanding would not take advantage of and increase this edge.
platoon_fire: Standard volley fire involved each rank delivering its volley in one go to maximize firepower. But we have developed a different system of firing by platoon, with the idea being that one part of the regiment would always be firing at the enemy while others reloaded and got ready for the next volley. This removed time between attacks that the enemy could use to recover or otherwise gain an advantage.
dutch_golden_age_art: the Netherlands has historically been at the forefront of technological and cultural advancements. We must continue to patronize inventors, artists, and writers to maintain our edge over other nations.
a_trading_hub: Our nation is blessed with a well-established hub of cities focused on trade, and adventurous sailors willing to bring riches from all over the world back home. These seafarers will be an excellent way for us to trade with other nations and make significant profits.
concentration_power: For too long, our nation has been unevenly governed by multiple Stadtholders across different provinces, with the most powerful acting as Primus inter Pares among their peers. It is time to make the position hereditary and concentrate authority in a single ruler.
a_fortified_border: Our borders are not well-defended by natural features, as is the case in some other nations. However, we have wit and wisdom in abundance, enough to construct the mightiest fortifications possible to deter our enemies and protect our families.
nor_seaborn_country: The Norwegian people have always chosen to traverse the country by boat, whenever it is convenient. This makes our people adept sailors, ready to man our navy whenever necessary.
nor_bounties_of_the_sea: The Norwegian land cannot provide our people with enough food to sustain themselves. We will look to the sea to feed our people instead. Fortunately, the waters of the North Sea provide us with plenty of fishing grounds.
natural_seamanship: With the growth of our fishing industry, we have also seen a corresponding expansion in the number of sailors in our realm. We should take advantage of this and recruit some of them to our navy, as seamanship is just as important as the ship itself.
call_of_our_forefathers: Long ago, our illustrious forefathers sailed forth and established colonies in the North. Our sagas even tell us that they reached a new world and established Vinland. We must follow in their footsteps.
pioneer_spirit: In days gone by, our people would brave the high seas to establish colonies on distant shores. Let us rekindle this adventurous spirit in our people so that they sail forth again!
nor_shipbuilding: The expansion of our fishing industry has also led to an expansion in shipbuilding. We have a ready pool of trained shipwrights at hand to expand our own production process.
write_new_sagas:
Keen minds preserve knowledge
Known from ages past
Sung in the sundown
Sagas are our inheritance
Encouraged by the establishment
Each country will have its own
nor_merchant_tradition: The ports of Norway have long been a desirable destination for merchants from all around Europe. It is time that we not only host foreign merchants in our ports, but benefit from the trades of northern Europe ourselves.
birch_bark_manuscript: Writing and reading are fundamental pillars of our society. Religious texts, as well the details of our history, need to be written down so that future generations can learn of our cultural achievements. We have an abundant supply of birch trees in this nation, and their papery white bark will become our parchment.
novgorod_first_chronicle: The Novgorod First Chronicle details the history of our country, from the days of the legendary Varangian chieftain Rurik up to the present. It is a cultural heirloom that is proudly handed down from one generation to another.
ushkuiniks: The Viking-like Ushkuynik pirates were once a useful tool to suppress our competitors. Unfortunately, we were forced to stop using them due to foreign intervention, mainly from Moscow. We should begin funding them again, and send these pirates to plunder farther shores — that will show everyone who the true masters of the North are!
northern_center_of_arts: Novgorod is an important cultural center in Europe. Epic tales are told of our's literate and intellectual population, intricate religious art, and grand architecture, increasing the prestige of our flourishing city and indeed the whole nation.
city_of_churches: There are over eighty Orthodox churches in Novgorod, and some are the largest landholders in the principality. Their wealth and religious prestige allows the Church to significantly influence the population in many areas, and our citizens are more pious as a result — in a good way.
reforms_of_the_posadnichestvo: The Posadnik is the highest administrative position in our towns and cities, and is a more significant role than that of a mayor. As their city grows, so do the responsibilities, influence, and number of Posadniks in the administration.
novgorodian_fur_trade: Fur, the silken gold of Russia! While other states gain their wealth from trading in Gold and other rare metals, our source of income comes from the high-quality Fur the motherland provides us with.
grand_dukes_army: Leading troops is the most important duty for the Grand Duke, who is appointed to rule over the Veche Republic. Under such strong and experienced leadership, our armies will become far more deadly in battle.
baltic_shipyard: We shall build a grand shipyard on the eastern coast of the Baltic Sea, and dominate overseas trade!
defenses_of_novgorod: The Republic of Velikiy Novgorod is the target of many external threats. But be it the western heretics from Scandinavia, the rampaging Germans to our southwest, or even other Russian powers to our south; they all shall all crumble at the feet of our unbreakable fortifications.
heirs_of_rollo: The legacy of Rollo, the Viking founder of Normandy, continues to define our ruling house. Such a prestigious line has led to strengthened legitimacy and respect from our peers.
norman_law: Our state is governed by its own customary legal code, the Coutume de Normandie. By enshrining noble privilege, decentralized power, and property rights, this legal tradition ensures local stability while asserting our distinct identity.
trade_ports_in_the_channel: Our position along the English Channel allows us to flourish as a commercial gateway. By investing in our port towns and merchant infrastructure, we can dominate regional trade while minimizing the cost of overseas operations.
the_exchequer: Our legislative body must remain distinct from any outside influences, in an effort to preserve our cultural identity and independence. Inspired by Anglo-Norman fiscal institutions, our parliamentary procedures will surely bolster crown revenue and improve administrative oversight.
frontline_in_the_caroline_war: During the long conflicts between France and England, we stood as a strategic battleground. The pressures of war forged a hardened officer corps and traditions of battlefield excellence that endure to this day.
omani_tradition: Our nation is at the back of the ample and hostile deserts of Arabia, but the sea to our east allows us to circumvent them. It is by sea, not by land, that we will need to perform our diplomacy, trade, and expansion.
omani_heritage: Our sailors are used to navigating far and wide upon the seas, but control of the gulf surrounding us is what allows such travels. We must always stand ready to defend our waters against any foreign threat.
local_merchant_preference: Theoretically a merchant can be a citizen of the world, sailing to and from whichever port he pleases. We are going to give advantages to home merchants, for example, priority for loading and unloading of cargo, to ensure that our merchants have every incentive to bring their products home.
association_with_unbelievers: There are those who feel that we should not associate with unbelievers at all. We have done much to quash this, as only through association with heathen nations will we be able to trade with them.
port_security_improvement: To reap the full financial potential from trade, we need ships and any cargo they carry to be safe when docked in our ports. We must ensure that any areas that merchants consort in are free from petty crime.
end_of_shipbuilding_guilds: As long as ships have been built in Arabia, there have been guilds who control the production. Although they may have performed a valuable service in keeping shipbuilding traditions alive, they now stand in the way of progress. We must open up the shipbuilding industry to all with talent.
skilled_captains: We must ensure that our captains meet the highest standards of seamanship and nautical knowledge, ensuring that they will be able to use every advantage in all situations.
expansion_of_trade_contacts: We must ensure that our merchants are always welcome wherever they go. Thus, we will use any means possible to make sure that all rulers we know about welcome our merchants.
omani_ambition: Despite not being an island, our land is factually isolated from the rest of Arabia due to the surrounding deserts. As such, we have learned how crucial it is to have access to the sea, and how useful it will be for us if we take that option away from our enemies.
ori_bulwark_of_the_hindu: The Muslim faithful have invaded India and subjugated many Hindu residents under their gruesome rule. Yet, Orissa stands unflinching against the warriors of Islam. We are the bulwark of Hinduism, and we shall defend our traditions and culture against any foreign invader!
ori_anka_year_system: The Anka system is our method of documenting the regnal years of our rulers. Years ending in 6 or 0 are skipped, except for year 10, which is retained. The count begins at year 2, not year 1, and always starts on the Sunia, our fiscal new year.
ori_lord_of_elephants: Horses are not native to Orissa, and the lands here are unsuitable for raising them. Our jungles are, however, famously teeming with elephants. In the dense jungles of Eastern India, well-executed tactical cooperation between elephants and infantry can be just as deadly as a cavalry. Let us further increase the size of our elephant corps and refine their tactics, so that we will be known as a true Gajapati, 'Lord of the Elephants'.
ori_servitor_of_jagganath: Worship of Jagannath, the Lord of the Universe, is what unites our people. Previous rulers of Orissa were even considered to be the scions of Jagannath. Our current ruler might not be one of his descendants, but we must imprint on all that our leader is the servitor of Jagannath, and that any disobedience to them equals treason against Lord Jagannath himself.
ori_parikshas: Orissa has long been divided among many different princes, but their time is over! We will take control of these lands, and appoint regional governors — parikshas — instead of allowing these petty princelings to dilute our imperial authority.
ori_odia_militarization: The Muslim threat never ceases, nor does it ever rest. We must ensure our military is ready to face and combat invaders at any and all times.
ori_patronize_temple_construction: The glory of past dynasties is reflected by the grandeur of the temples they left behind. We should improve our many magnificent temple complexes, and construct new ones to further the development of Kalinga architecture.
ori_refined_cloth_production: Orissa has been famous for its high-quality textiles since ancient times. Let us further encourage the textile guilds of Orissa to refine their methods of producing their fine Kalinga Cloth.
ori_encourage_salt_trade: The high-quality Salt of Orissa is in demand all over India. Let us do whatever we can to encourage the Salt trade so that we may grow rich from it.
ori_expansion_of_infrastructure: As technology advances, so does the number of people in our realm. Industrialization has driven significant population growth, and as such, we must expand our infrastructure to accommodate these growing communities.
pal_palatine_lion: Originating from the dynastic coat of arms of the Wittelsbach family, the Palatine Lion is the centerpiece of our legitimacy. Displayed with a red crown, it signifies our role as the Imperial Vicar and Arch-Steward of the Holy Roman Empire. As long as the Palatine Lion is proudly displayed on our crest, our legitimacy will not come into question.
pal_castles_on_rhine: By erecting multiple castles in key positions along the Rhine, we will be able to exert and expand our control over both the river and the trade flowing through it.
pal_cultivate_vineyards: Although our territory is small, the sunny banks of the Rhine are perfectly suited to cultivate vineyards and orchards. With some effort, these could sustain our local economy by producing wine.
pal_protection_of_exclaves: By virtue of having our territories disperse, we are vunerable to attacks from several foreign powers. Constructing many fortified outposts within our lands will buy us time to raise an army and repel any attempt to take over one of our many disconnected territories.
pal_fractured_territory: Our administration is skilled in handling multiple disconnected territories without losing our grasp on them. With that, we can build a strong bureaucracy capable of handling even the most difficult tasks.
pal_a_just_ruler: The only effect of bloodshed is to cause further bloodshed. Therefore, we need to be a forgiving ruler, and reconcile with our enemies to establish a lasting peace in our territories.
pal_heaven_of_tolerance: No matter their denominations, all Christian people must be welcomed in the towns and cities of our lands. While others may decide to suppress their religious minorities, our tolerance will ensure a steady stream of immigrants into our territory, and we shall benefit from their presence.
pal_mildness_to_the_commoners: When our peasantry rises up against our nobility, they unmistakably rise up against our own rule. However, we should not excessively punish those who revolt. With mild consequences, everyone will be more in alignment with our authority.
pal_humanist_court: To govern well, our rulers must receive a comprehensive education in humanist ideas. To this effect, we must hire renowned humanists for the education of our rulers and heirs, while also focusing our court on these principles.
pal_heidelberg_catechism: The Reformation has created many discussions around the nature of our faith. We should invest into a comprehensive catechism, to which our people will be able to adhere.
pal_bilbiotheca_palatina: Rich in theological scriptures of several Christian denominations, the Bibliotheca Palatina is one of our most prized possessions. Protection of the knowledge and the cultural value contained within must be a high priority, so that we are able to keep relying on its documents.
palatinate_romanticism: A significant part of the Romantic movement is centered around Heidelberg. We should capitalize on this phenomenon, and support these and other artists in order to bolster our global recognition.
kasztelanowie: Castellans represent the voice of the monarch across our domain. They are in charge of gathering taxes and enforcing the rule of law, and may even execute justice in the name of the Crown.
land_of_promise: The fertile lands of our domain are a coveted destination for many migrants, primarily those of lower status, seeking a better and more prosperous life.
statute_of_kalisz: Known as the General Charter of Jewish Liberties, this legislation contains articles that allow all Jews in our realm the freedom to worship, trade, and travel. The statute also attempts to reduce the number of blood libel accusations against Jews propagated by the Catholic Church.
corona_regni_poloniae: This legislation establishes the kingdom as an indivisible, collective entity, owned not by any single dynasty or monarch but by the entire noble class. Rulers serve the realm, they do not own it. This concept of collectivity is deeply entrenched in our society.
krakow_grosz: In an attempt to reform our monetary system, we will introduce a new currency, the Kraków Grosz. Minted from silver, these coins are destined to challenge the power of the Bohemian Prague Groschen and help establish our realm as pioneers of centralized taxation.
stone_and_brick: For centuries, we have used wood to build our towns and defenses, but we will now systematically upgrade our infrastructure by replacing more vulnerable wooden structures with stronger ones. We have inherited wooden towns, but we shall leave them fortified with stone and brick.
folwark_system: The Folwark System was a system of production that emphasized creating agricultural surpluses. Peasants were encouraged to work through either the use of rents or through compulsion. This system formed the bedrock of our economy.
council_of_three_lands_advance: Our country has a long-standing history of accepting destitute, persecuted Jewish people. To that end, a council that will look after their needs and advocate for their rights will benefit the stability and spiritual strength of this realm.
polish_renaissance: Inspired by the ideals of the Italian Renaissance, we are experiencing a cultural golden age. Our literary achievements, architectural splendors, and cultivated atmosphere of religious tolerance have all led to a blossoming of culture across our land.
granary_of_europe: The fertile fields of our domain are home to Europe's richest grain crops, in part thanks to the Folwark System. Through our grace, we supply the markets beyond our borders, ensuring our people continue to prosper and never go hungry.
winged_hussars_advance: The hussars were originally light cavalry troops used for scouting, but with the decline of the old feudal army, we have switched over to professional regiments, the core of which shall be made up of these heavier, armored hussars. The fear of these winged warriors shall make our enemies tremble in the night like children!
wojsko_komputoe: The 'Compute Army' was based around an annual budget calculated and approved by the Sejm. The idea behind this was to provide the Commonwealth with a stable standing army for defense.
late_winged_hussars_advance: The evolution of Polish hussars entailed the adoption of heavier armor with red and white colors. They used a longer lance of around six meters, which made their charge incredibly devastating, often breaking the morale of their foes and causing them to rout.
komisja_edukacji_narodowej: Our government's need for capable administrators has led to systematic education reform. We will establish the first education ministry in Europe, devoted to spreading literacy throughout our population, which will hopefully lead to an increase in qualified candidates to staff our expanding administration.
szkola_rycerska: By establishing the 'Knight's School' to train noble youth in military science and their patriotic duty, we will forge generations of capable, dedicated military and civil personnel.
great_sejm_reforms: If we are to survive and continue to prosper, our governmental mechanism must run efficiently and be based on robust foundations. The parliament shall adopt modernized procedures and strengthen its authority. The goals of this evolution are to curtail the power of the nobility and mitigate the escalating abuses of serfdom.
por_establishment_portuguese_navy: In 1317 King Dinis appointed the Genoese merchant Manuel Pessanha as Almirante-Mor of Portugal, charging him to defend the coast against North African corsairs and to build a national fleet from imported expertise. Pessanha brought Genoese pilots, naval architects, and accountancy methods with him, founding the base from which the Portuguese voyages of the next century launched. The royal naval foundation puts a maritime administration of Mediterranean standard in Portugal almost two centuries before any Atlantic neighbor builds an equivalent.
alv_almadraba_fisheries: The almadrabas (great labyrinths of nets fixed off the Algarve coast to trap the bluefin tuna on their spring migration) have yielded an immense seasonal harvest since Phoenician and Moorish times. Our fishing towns from Lagos to Tavira salt and barrel the catch for sale across the peninsula and crew, in the off-season, a fleet that doubles as a nursery of hardened seamen. This maritime economy feeds both the kingdom's tables and the trained manpower its ships and voyages require.
por_battle_ourique: At the Battle of Ourique in 1139, Count Afonso Henriques defeated a numerically superior Almoravid force in the contested borderlands of the Alentejo. The victory was sanctified by his troops' acclamation as king on the field, the rumored vision of Christ before the battle, and the eventual Manifestis Probatum of 1179 in which Pope Alexander III recognized Portugal as a kingdom. This founding triumph anchors Portuguese royal legitimacy in divine endorsement and battlefield achievement rather than dynastic descent, distinguishing our kingship from the rest of Iberia.
por_cistercian_clearance: The white monks of Cister (at Alcobaça, Bouro, and Tarouca) drain the marshes, clear the scrub, and plant the granges of the Estremadura and the Alentejo in the wake of the Reconquista. Their lay brothers and the settlers drawn by monastic forais turn empty borderland into wheat fields, vineyards, and orchards. This Cistercian husbandry feeds the young kingdom and fixes a Christian peasantry on land barely wrested from the Moor.
por_estimulate_rural_areas: The plagues and emigration of the fourteenth century have left the Alentejo and Trás-os-Montes underpopulated, with abandoned villages and uncultivated fields draining the kingdom's tax base. We will reissue royal forais to repopulate hamlets, exempt new settlers from manorial dues for a generation, and import Galician and Castilian laborers willing to clear scrubland for sharecrop tenancies. This rural recovery will restore the food-producing heartland to productivity just as Portugal's overseas ventures begin to demand reliable inland provisioning.
alv_sagres_school: On the windswept cape of Sagres, under the patronage of Prince Henry the Navigator, pilots, Genoese cartographers, astronomers, and shipwrights gather to systematize the knowledge of wind, current, and star needed to sail the open African Atlantic. Our captains learn to reckon latitude by the Pole Star and the sun, to handle the lateen caravel, and to press south beyond Cape Bojador where others had always turned back. With navigational learning gathered at Sagres, the Algarve reaches down the African coast farther than any rival port.
por_lisbon_entrepot: Lisbon, at the broad mouth of the Tejo, grows into the great entrepôt of the western seaboard, where the salt, wine, and cork of the interior meet the cloth and metals of the north. Genoese and Flemish factors house themselves along the riverfront, and the crown's customs swell with the traffic of two seas. This Tagus emporium makes the capital the commercial heart of the realm well before the first caravel rounds Bojador.
por_pursuing_waves: Under Prince Henry the Navigator, the maritime school at Sagres gathers Genoese pilots, Catalan cartographers, and Portuguese shipwrights to systematize the navigation of the African Atlantic. Gil Eanes rounds Cape Bojador, the caravels reach Sierra Leone, and Bartolomeu Dias clears the Cape of Good Hope, each voyage extending our charts a hundred leagues further south. This sustained royal investment in exploration positions Portugal as the only kingdom in Europe with the patience to wait two generations for an oceanic reward.
por_bombardeiros: The Portuguese caravels and naus that round the Cape of Good Hope face Indian Ocean fleets composed of larger but lightly armed vessels. To turn this disparity into a decisive advantage, our shipwrights shall reinforce the upper decks and gun ports of the new naus to mount heavy bronze cannon cast at the Lisbon arsenal under the direction of Bombardeiro-Mor João Anes. This reinforced gun platform doctrine will give Portuguese fleets the standoff firepower to destroy the Mamlūk navy at Diu and secure the spice route for a century.
alv_lagos_emporium: The port of Lagos, first staging ground and homecoming of the African voyages, grows into an emporium where the gold dust, ivory, malagueta pepper, and enslaved captives of the Guinea coast are first landed, taxed, and sold. Its customs house and merchant factors tie the small kingdom directly into the lucrative new trade of the south. The entrepôt brings the Algarve a commercial reach and a flow of revenue out of all proportion to its size.
por_carreira_da_india: The Carreira da Índia (the annual round voyage from Lisbon to Goa and back around the Cape) becomes the longest regular sea route in the world, its great naus beating south on the volta do mar and home laden with pepper and cinnamon. Our pilots master the monsoon timetable and the deep ocean navigation the run demands. The India run extends the realm's maritime reach and fills the treasury with spice revenue out of all proportion to its size.
por_feitorias: The Feitorias (fortified trading factories established along the African and Asian littorals from the late fifteenth century) combine warehouse, garrison, customs house, and chapel under a single royal Feitor. Beginning with São Jorge da Mina and extending to Sofala, Hormuz, Goa, Malacca, and Macau, the network monopolizes choke points along the spice routes without requiring large inland conquests. Through this model of fortified trading posts Portugal controls a vast share of global commerce with remarkably few occupying troops, sustained by maritime supremacy alone.
por_the_bandeirantes: The Bandeirantes (armed expeditionary bands ranging out of São Paulo and São Vicente starting in the late sixteenth century) penetrate the unmapped Brazilian interior in search of indigenous captives, escaped slaves, and rumored mines. Domingos Jorge Velho, Antônio Raposo Tavares, and Fernão Dias Pais Leme all push the Tordesillas line steadily westward through campaigns lasting years, mapping the Mato Grosso and Goiás highlands as they go. This continental-scale colonization extends Portuguese sovereignty far beyond the original treaty line and establishes Brazil's modern continental footprint.
alv_dryland_orchards: The dry limestone barrocal behind the Algarve coast is planted with fig, almond, and carob, drought-hardy trees whose dried fruit keeps for years and travels well by sea. Generations of terracing, grafting, and careful husbandry have made our figs and almonds a staple export to the markets of northern Europe. This orchard economy turns thin, sun-baked southern soil into a reliable and renewable source of trade and rural settlement.
por_monopolio_das_especiarias: The Crown claims a monopólio over the pepper, cinnamon, and clove passing through ports, licensing which merchants may carry them and levying its fifth on every cargo that lands. By binding the spice trade to royal charter rather than to whichever captain returns first, the treasury turns the gamble of the sea into a steady and predictable source of revenue.
por_ordenancas: The Ordenanças reform of King Sebastian organizes every Portuguese township into companies of armed citizens led by elected Capitães-mores, drilled monthly and obliged to muster for any royal proclamation of arms. The Filipine reforms standardize equipment, fortify the muster rolls, and require every male between sixteen and sixty to enroll in his parish company. A universal militia system keeps a permanent reserve of trained manpower that can be mobilized for colonial campaigns or domestic defense without the cost of a standing army.
por_colonial_governors: The seventeenth-century reform of the colonial administration replaces the patchwork of feudal donatário captaincies with appointed royal governors and viceroys answerable directly to the Conselho Ultramarino in Lisbon. The Viceroy of the Estado da Índia at Goa, the Captain-General of Angola, and the Governor of Brazil at Salvador each command a salaried bureaucracy of Crown officials, magistrates, and treasury inspectors. This unified administration tightens royal control over distant possessions and dramatically increases the proportion of colonial revenue reaching the metropolitan treasury.
alv_sotavento_salt: Along the lagoons of the eastern sotavento (Tavira, Castro Marim, and Faro) sun, tide, and patient labor are worked into salt pans that crystallize sea salt by the shipload through the long dry summer. Our salt cures the tuna and cod of the Atlantic fleets and fills the holds of the Hanseatic and Biscayan traders who carry it north. This salt trade is a quiet but constant and ancient source of the kingdom's wealth.
por_restoration_of_independence: The realm casts off the long union with Castile and acclaims a native dynasty, opening a generation of war along the Alentejo frontier. New bulwarked fortresses rise, fresh regiments are raised from every parish, and the alliances that guarantee its sovereignty are sealed. This restoration of independence rallies the whole nation behind the legitimate crown as no foreign or formed claimant ever could.
por_royal_absolutism: After two centuries of contested compromise with the noble Cortes of Évora, Lisbon, and Coimbra, the Crown moves to consolidate executive authority on the model of the French and Spanish monarchies. King Joseph I and his chief minister the Marquis of Pombal abolish the surviving feudal privileges, expropriate the Jesuit estates, and reform the royal council into a streamlined cabinet of professional ministers. This concentration of authority lets the Crown drive reform programs through with the speed required by the new commercial economy, free of the obstructionism that aristocratic assemblies had previously imposed.
por_vinho_porto: On the steep terraced slopes of the Douro Valley, the grapes that produce a fortified red wine of unusual longevity have been cultivated since the seventeenth century. Following the Methuen Treaty, English merchants house themselves in Porto, the Real Companhia das Vinhas do Alto Douro is chartered by the Marquis of Pombal, and Vinho do Porto becomes a protected denomination governed by the first formal demarcation of a wine region in history. This regulated luxury export generates a continuous stream of British silver in exchange for Portuguese wine, sustaining the kingdom's positive trade balance through the entire eighteenth century.
alv_coastal_fisheries: The harbors of the Algarve fill with fábricas de conservas, packing houses that cure sardine and tuna in salt, oil, and brine for markets across Europe and the colonies. A growing coastal workforce and steady demand turn the once-seasonal catch into a year-round trade. This coastal fishing industry carries the kingdom's oldest livelihood, the harvest of the sea, to a new scale.
por_administrative_reforms: The crown overhauls its government with professional secretariats of state, a reformed treasury, and a streamlined cabinet of salaried ministers answerable directly to the king. Old feudal jurisdictions give way to appointed magistrates, and the overseas revenues are routed through a single council. This administrative modernization lets the crown drive reform with a speed the old conciliar tangle could never allow.
por_royal_military_academy: Queen Maria I establishes the Academia Real de Fortificação, Artilharia e Desenho at the Castle of São Jorge in Lisbon, succeeding the seventeenth-century military classes of Luís Serrão Pimentel. The curriculum unites Vauban-style fortification, Frézier descriptive geometry, and the modern artillery doctrines tested by French and Prussian engineers, taught by Manuel de Sousa Ramos and the royal engineer corps. A unified military academy trains the Portuguese army's officers to a continental European standard, preserving the kingdom's technical credibility through the wars of the coming century.
capetian_house_of_anjou: A potent mix of Capetian dignity and Angevin ambition courses through our blood. Though we no longer wear the crown of Jerusalem, we remain heirs to a legacy of kingship that once stretched from Anjou to Albania. With careful diplomacy and planning, we may yet revive the grandeur of our forefathers and claim what was unjustly taken from us.
lords_of_the_rhone_corridor: The Rhône Valley has always been our artery of power, and our castles stand watch over it like sentinels of stone. These fortifications are some of the sturdiest in all of Europe, a steadfast sign of our military and engineering prowess, forever watching over our domain.
angevin_heraldry: The golden lilies and double-headed eagles of our banners speak to ancient rights and royal ambitions. Claims that stretch across Italy, reaching as far as Albania and Jerusalem, still echo in our hearts. Let the House of Valois-Anjou rise higher than ever before!
le_livre_des_tournois: Penned by royalty, the 'Book of Tournaments' is more than a manual; it is a statement of courtly pride and chivalric identity. Our nobility trains not only for war but for spectacle, and in doing so preserves martial discipline and prestige across the realm.
statutes_of_aix: A series of loosely consolidated laws and statutes form the legal backbone of our governance. These statutes blend Roman jurisprudence with local customs and Angevin tradition, allowing us to manage a patchwork of regions as one cohesive domain: a true composite monarchy, where the parts are diverse, but the crown is indivisible.
rade_of_toulon: Toulon's natural harbor offers the ideal staging ground for our naval ambitions. While Marseille thrives as our commercial jewel, Toulon shall be the armory of Provence, and the launching point of a future maritime power.
piqure_de_marseilles: Across the workshops of Marseille, artisans stitch delicate boutis quilts in the Provencal style, treasured across Europe for their quality and charm. Much like our duchy, works of art created in our realm are composed of many parts stitched into a unified whole: a quilted land, rich in texture and culture.
teutonic_legacy: The knights who carved this land from the wilderness left something behind, a tradition of service, discipline, and arms as a way of life. Our noble houses carry that tradition still. They do not merely own the land; they are sworn to defend it.
double_electorate: Governing two territories separated by foreign lands demands more than ordinary administration. We will ensure our laws reach the far corners of our realm and that every magistrate answers to the same authority, however distant from the capital he may be.
junker_officer_corps: In Prussia, a commission is not purchased, it is owed. Our nobles are expected to lead, and to lead well. Men who grew up on the land know how to march across it, and how to keep their soldiers alive along the way.
generalkriegskommissariat: Waging war cannot wait on the consent of our estates. We will establish a permanent organ of military finance, empowered to levy what the army requires. Our estates may not approve, but a well-funded army wins wars they cannot afford to lose.
preussische_tugenden: Our court will not be a place of idle luxury. Every ducat saved is a ducat for the army; every hour wasted is a march not made. We ask nothing of our soldiers that we do not first demand of ourselves.
army_professionalism: As we learned from the Persian invasion of Greece so long ago, a small army can defeat a larger one — as long as they have iron discipline and the proper training. We must elevate our own army to meet these extraordinary standards.
standing_army: Other nations raise armies when war arrives and dismiss them when it ends. We cannot afford that luxury. Our army will be permanent, always trained, always ready, and the storehouses to sustain it will never run dry.
soldier_king: Most states are countries that have an army. Prussia, on the other hand, is an army that has a country! The many Kings of Prussia were soldiers as much as monarchs; each concluded their reign not only by reforming the state but also leaving a lasting impact on the army.
cantonment_system: Every boy born in Prussia is born into a regiment. Each province will supply its own soldiers to its own officers, who will know their men by name. When war comes, we will not scramble to fill the ranks, they will already be there.
prussian_grenadiers: The Prussian Grenadiers are elite troops of the Prussian Army. Their role as vanguards in sieges and assaults requires them to be fearless fighters, recruited from among the strongest men in our country.
goose_step: Although it looks rather odd, the 'goose step' is specifically designed to facilitate our men holding their line as they advance towards the enemy. This provides our armies with a tangible advantage on the battlefield.
auftragstaktik: Auftragstaktik, or 'Mission Tactics'. is a system by which our subordinate leaders are informed about the objectives of the battle or the war by their commanders, and then are allowed to act on their personal initiative. This system allows our battalions to develop a tighter relationship with their leaders, yielding better results.
scharnhorst_reforms: Shortcomings due to overconfidence and arrogance can lead to great failures and defeats. Defeat is a teacher, if we are willing to learn. We will purge our army of its complacency, noble birth alone will no longer open the officer ranks, and every soldier must understand not just his orders, but the purpose behind them.
sav_alpine_identity: Nestled in the high Alps, We are a mountain people before we anything. Their therrain and the passes crossing them are our inheritance, our livelihood, and the mountains themselves are our protectors. Generations of living inside the Alps have given our people an unmatched understanding of their heights and geography.
sav_house_of_savoy: Savoy has been ruled by a stable line of dynastic counts ever since its creation. By ensuring the unity of our ruling family and maintaining a strong connection to local representatives, we keep our land from being fractured.
sav_savoyard_flexibility: Due to our precarious location between greater powers, we must rely on our diplomatic skills for survival. By maintaining diplomatic relations even with our most dangerous foes, we will be able to shift our alliances to ensure the endurance of our country.
sav_the_shroud_of_turin: Our realm is in the possession of a most holy artifact, a piece of cloth that bears the face of Jesus of Nazareth. Naturally, it has attracted numerous pilgrims, all clamoring to see and venerate this extraordinary relic. This constant stream of pilgrimage brings a great deal of wealth into our territory, which is all very much to our advantage.
sav_alpine_pass_control: The passage over the Alps is troublesome at the best of times, and can be outright impossible with carriages or a larger entourage. By maintaining good pathways, shelters, and waystations, we will be able to dominate the difficult terrain and ensure a steady exchange of merchants throughout our territory.
sav_embrace_the_vaudois: We have embraced the teachings of the Waldensian movement and are dedicated to protecting this faith from the vicious Catholic Church, which seeks to eradicate its ideas.
sav_fight_the_vaudois: Our lands have long suffered under the heretical preaching of the Waldensians. By the force of our will and with the support of the divine, we have been able to contain their influence, and we shall continue to defend the one true faith from these dangerous ideas.
sav_repopulate_the_valleys: Many people in our realm leave the alpine valleys they were born into to settle in the urban areas on either side of the mountain range. This depopulation leaves the small villages of lesser valleys in a precarious, politically unstable position. We must ensure that the valley lands are sufficiently populated and can be adequately maintained.
unlock_gallowglass_advance: Heavy infantry fitted with mail and wielding two-handed axes, the fearsome Gallowglass descend from Norse sea raiders who settled along the Atlantic coast.
unlock_reformed_gallowglass_advance: The gradual influence of continental-style warfare has led to better-equipped and more cohesive units of Gallowglass.
unlock_late_gallowglass_advance: A blend of old and new, these Late Gallowglass are heavily-armored troops outfitted with a medley of modern weapons such as arquebus guns to complement their traditional greatswords and axes.
scottish_salmon: Our rivers and coastlines are rich in salmon. With careful attention and strict legislation, we will be able to harness this resource and shape our local economy towards export of this highly sought-after fish.
scottish_morale: Since the start of our war against English tyranny, we have preserved our independence through the valiant efforts of the courageous Scottish people. The memory of brave men like William Wallace will motivate our armies to defend and protect Scottish independence for all time!
scottish_longbowmen: Now that our ties to England have been strengthened, we shall incorporate some of their military tactics, refining our units into fearsome forces.
peel_towers_advance: Peel Towers were developed to mitigate the dangers of life in our borderlands. They serve as protection against incursions of hostile raiding parties, sheltering both people and valuable livestock, and are a fast way to alert neighboring towns of approaching hostile armies by being a high place to light signal fires.
scottish_highland_tradition: The clans of the Highlands have always moved and fought differently from lowland armies. Raised among the glens, lochs, and steep braes of the north, our clansmen are naturally comfortable engaging in terrain that would exhaust and disorient outsiders. This intimate knowledge of the local landscape is passed down from father to son, and no foreign conqueror has ever truly mastered it.
scottish_tenacity: War can be a long and tiring affair. If we are to defend our independence, we need to be prepared to endure hard times. Luckily, our people are as tenacious as the land they call their home, and resist foreign invaders to their last breaths.
influx_of_english_nobles: Securing peace with our southern neighbor has led to a steady influx of English aristocrats entering our administration. This makes it possible to exert our control over our country more effectively.
scottish_trade_connections: Our country is situated at the far edge of Western Europe and is sparse in resources. If we are to thrive economically, we need to invest and expand our trade connections to further regions. The North Sea can connect us to rich markets and business opportunities, provided we learn to harness its potential.
comets: We have recently received a rather curious new tome. It is called On the True Significance of Comets against the Vanity of Astrologers, and it is positively filled with vital information on these highly suspicious entities. We have decreed that all in the realm should be aware of its contents.
modernized_royal_scots_navy: Since the Wars of Independence, we have been looking at reinforcing and updating our navy. Previously, we had used feudal obligations to bulk out our fleets with crew and ships, but we will now create a modern fleet, owned by the King and based in our port of Newhaven.
royal_revenue: If Scotland is to continue its independent existence, we must secure stable sources of income. By tightening our control over the obligations owed to us by royal estates and feudal properties, we can increase our rightfully received taxes. Through these methods, we can ensure the Crown has sufficient funds to enact their will without relying on other sources of money.
scottish_education: Having sent our brightest scholars to be educated in foreign universities for many years, it is time to improve our domestic education, and provide a place here in Scotland where the greatest minds of our nation can learn and grow. Our people should strive to acquire valuable knowledge and skills in their home country rather than wasting their money on expensive travel and their time on foreign institutions.
act_of_revocation: It has long been the custom to gift parts of the Royal Domain to our nobility as a reward for their services, but this system cannot be sustained if we want to ensure the integrity of our domain. From now on, we will insist on renting these lands instead of outright giving them away.
scottish_diplomacy: For centuries, we relied on diplomacy and contact with foreign powers on the continent to ensure our independence. It is time to formalize this practice, and secure the endurance of our bonds for centuries to come.
scottish_highlander_advance: Recruiting regiments from the people who live in the Scottish Highlands can be a crucial measure for our military efforts.
scottish_whisky: While distilleries have existed in Scotland for a long time, we should ensure these industries are finally put under the purview of the state. This supervision will allow us to establish ourselves at the forefront of liquor production, and expand our exports industry.
scottish_enlightenment: Rapid advancements in philosophy, political economy, and medicine have led to a plethora of accomplishments by our fellow countrymen that will propel Scotland to the forefront of global innovation. This period of Scottish Enlightenment can be a very powerful tool for us on the world stage.
serbian_zaduzbina: The Serbian elite and commoners alike are bound by the tradition of the Zadužbina, the 'endowment for the soul'. This cultural drive to build stone churches and monasteries creates a permanent, physical landscape of our presence across the Balkans. These buildings serve as more than religious centers; they are repositories of history, art, and literacy that define the Serbian 'living space'. This architectural obsession ensures that our culture is physically anchored to the land, providing a sense of permanence and historical continuity that inspires the people to defend their 'holy ground' at any cost.
hum_a_sheep_surrounded_by_wolves: We exist geographically wedged between the soaring ambitions of more powerful enemies. To survive this predatory encirclement, our lords have mastered the art of setting our neighbors at odds, wherein we perpetually offer vassalage to the distant wolf to deter the one at our doorstep. By playing the Catholic West against the Orthodox East and the Bosnian Krstjani against both, we ensure that no single hegemon can fully digest our lands without triggering a massive intervention from their rivals. This culture of sophisticated political duplicity transforms our perceived weakness into a survival mechanism, as we grant trade concessions and military access to whichever power currently guarantees our internal autonomy, effectively keeping the greater wolves at each other's throats while we remain the undisturbed masters of the Neretva.
serbian_mining: The deliberate invitation of Sasi miners from Upper Saxony and the Harz Mountains has fundamentally transformed our primitive surface pits into sophisticated industrial engines. By granting these Germanic experts their own autonomous courts, the right to follow their own mining codes, and religious freedom, we have successfully unlocked the vast, deep-seated silver and gold veins of Brskovo and Novo Brdo. This influx of technical expertise provide us with the immense quantities of hard bullion necessary to hire the finest Western mercenaries, build monumental stone endowments, and mint the high-quality silver Matapan imitations that have come to dominate Balkan trade and Mediterranean commerce.
mimic_the_phoenix: We eagerly embrace the ways of Byzantium, aiming to mirror their laws and overall style. Drawing from the rich tapestry of Roman influences, we strive to infuse our governance and legal system with their essence, in a conscious effort to emulate the grace and sophistication of Byzantium within our realm.
tro_zupa_administrative_reform: Under previous rulers, the traditional Slavic Župa (district) of Travunja was reorganized to better collect the Soj (land tax). The ruler appointed Kephale (heads) to oversee the Trebišnjica Valley, ensuring that the wealth from the fertile plains reached the central treasury. This proto-bureaucracy allowed our past rulers to fund their wars by squeezing wealth from the productive agricultural output of the hinterlands. We shall continue with this tradition.
zta_maritime_fiefdoms_of_the_adriatic: Our identity is forged at the violent meeting point of the high limestone mountain and the salt of the sea. By maintaining firm control over the strategic coastal towns of the coast, the lords of Zeta act as the indispensable maritime gateway for the entire Serbian interior, controlling the flow of salt, silk, and silver. We utilize the considerable wealth generated from Mediterranean trade and customs duties to fund our independent-minded mountain clans and build massive stone fortifications that guard the shoreline. This ensures that Zeta remains a maritime power in its own right, projecting influence far beyond the rugged cliffs of the hinterland.
home_of_hussars: Although light cavalry formations are an old concept, the first Balkan hussars (or gusars) appeared as auxiliary units of Byzantium, recruited mainly from Byzantine-held Serbia in the 10th and 11th centuries. Even after Byzantine power dwindled, this tradition remained, and was further refined over the following centuries.
hum_the_kosaca_iron_fist: Inspired by the Kosača dynasty, the Principality has started centralizing the military under a single dynastic banner, the state has moved away from fragmented feudal levies toward a professionalized core of heavy infantry and mercenary crossbowmen. This military consolidation allows us to defy our enemies, turning the rugged landscape of our lands into a power broker in the southern Dinaric Alps.
ser_vitestvo: We will encourage Viteštvo, a unique Serbian chivalric code, that will blend the heavy-armored traditions of the West with the stoic warrior ethos of the East. This culture of knighthood will not be restricted to the highest nobility but trickle down into the lower classes of free soldiers. It will emphasize personal bravery, loyalty to the True Faith, and a specialized mastery of both the lance and the saber. This military culture will produce a population that is naturally predisposed to warfare, viewing military service as the highest form of social and spiritual achievement.
rallying_the_troops: Our realm has developed various methods for swiftly amassing troops, so no enemy can catch us unprepared. This edge has helped us stand tall, despite all odds being against us, and we are prepared for battle. United, we march forward, resolute in purpose and ready to defend our honor and homeland!
tro_the_defensive_network_of_klobuk: To counter the expansion of our enemies, the state will rebuild the fortress of Klobuk into a modern citadel. We will introduce a system of 'Signal Fires' across the Popovo Polje, allowing the garrison at Trebinje to alert the entire hinterland of an invasion within hours. This will create a zone of control that will make the region impossible to bypass.
zta_the_italian_condottieri: We have mastered the lucrative and dangerous art of the international mercenary contract. By providing elite Zetan mountain infantry and veteran sailors to the italians for their various overseas wars, we secure access to modern Western armaments, gunpowder, and a powerful naval ally in the Adriatic. This connection ensures that our realm's independence is protected by powerful friends, while we simultaneously maintain and sharpen our ancient warrior traditions at home. It provides us with a professional military edge that few other Balkan states can hope to match.
serbian_serbian_epic_poetry: Serbian people have developed a 'living history' through epic poetry. The Guslar, a wandering bard, is the primary guardian of the national soul. The Guslar recites thousands of verses accompanied by the gusle. These songs preserve genealogies, legal precedents, and moral imperatives. Serbian culture ensures that even the most illiterate shepherd has an understanding of ancestral rights and a shared identity. Every village gathering becomes a session of historical indoctrination.
hum_the_viticulture_of_the_sunny_scree: The limestone-rich, sun-drenched slopes of the Herzegovinian valleys produce a distinct, high sugar grape that is the envy of the Adriatic. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of Žilavka and Blatina wines, we can create a luxury trade that bypasses the volatility of the grain markets. This 'Liquid Diplomacy' allows our court to maintain a lifestyle that rivals the Italian city-states, using high-end wine exports as a diplomatic lubricant to secure favorable treaties with the Republic of Venice and the Kingdom of Naples.
ser_the_transcribers_of_resava: In an era of conflict, the Serbian people turns to the pen to preserve what the sword can not. The Resava School of orthography will standardize the Serbian-Slavonic language, creating a cultural 'republic of letters'. This obsession with linguistic purity and the preservation of chronicles will ensure that our history is never lost to the fog of war. It creates a highly literate elite who acts as the memory of the nation, keeping the records of our dynasties alive in every monastery scriptorium from the Danube to the Adriatic.
keepers_of_the_gate: Serbia's rugged terrain has birthed a formidable network of defenses, epitomized by the imposing Smederevo Fortress. These enduring fortifications safeguard our nation, making invasion a daunting prospect. From the sprawling mountain ranges to the strategic river valleys, Serbia's defenses stand as a testament to our resilience and indomitable spirit.
tro_the_trebisnjica_bridges: Following the model of Roman engineering, the local lords will invest in massive stone bridges to ensure that the 'Silver Road' from the interior never closes during winter floods. This investment in infrastructure will allow for the year-round movement of heavy trade caravans between the mountains and the coastal towns.
zta_the_retreat_to_the_karst: The coast may be temporarily lost to the shifting sands of imperial power, but the karst mountains remain our eternal and impregnable fortress. Our monastery stronghold of Cetinje, nestled high in the Lovćen mountains where the air is thin and the slopes are steep, is the core of our nation. This city embodies a long-term national strategy of 'Mountain Isolation', where we deliberately trade the wealth and vulnerability of the ports for the absolute security of the high peaks. By entrenching ourselves in the rock, we effectively make the Zetan state impossible for any imperial power to fully annex or govern.
serbian_the_icon_of_saint_sava: The cultural foundation of the Serbian people is defined by Saint Sava. By blending Byzantine spirituality with local Slavic customs and a fierce commitment to the Serbian language in liturgy, Sava created a national church that is inseparable from the people's identity. This anchor resurfaces again among our people and ensures that all Serbians, whether nobles or peasants, view themselves as part of a distinct, sacred community that remains unified even when political borders shift or collapse, providing an internal stability that resists foreign cultural assimilation.
hum_the_humite_chancery_records: To manage our state, we have centralized our administration into a mobile but highly organized Chancery. By maintaining precise records of land ownership, clan lineages, and tax obligations even during wartime, we prevent the social disintegration that often follows foreign occupation. Thanks to these records, the state can resume full operations the moment an invader is repelled, with a clear and unbroken chain of command that stretches from the ruler's palace to the smallest mountain hamlet in the high karsts.
the_rebirth_of_the_patriarchate: Through incredible savvy and political maneuvering within the complex imperial administrative systems of our neighbors, we have successfully negotiated the restoration of our national Patriarchate. This diplomatic victory grants us spiritual and legal jurisdiction over all Serbian populations stretching from the Adriatic coast to the middle Danube, effectively allowing the Church to act as a 'Guardian of all Serbs'. It enables the maintenance of a shadow administration that collects tithes, manages local education, and keeps the flame of our traditions alive among a population that remains unified by a single, powerful faith.
reform_the_ecclesiastical_authorities: We will issue royal charters to the guilds of the Morava Valley, and encourage the development of large-scale leather working, weaving, and metal finishing workshops along the river's transit points. By exempting these guilds from certain internal tolls in exchange for providing standardized equipment to the royal armies (such as saddlery for the cavalry and uniforms for the infantry) the state will create a self-sustaining domestic industry. This move will reduce the realm's dependence on expensive foreign imports from outside and create a prosperous, urban middle class that serves as a loyal counter-weight to the rural power of the nobility, significantly broadening the state's taxable economic base.
tro_the_aqueducts_of_popovo_polje: Utilizing the unique hydrology of the Trebišnjica river (the world's longest sinking river), the state will build a series of stone aqueducts and mills. This will allow for intensive agriculture even in the dry summer months, making the state self-sufficient in grain and able to withstand long maritime blockades.
zta_the_vladika_sovereignty: As the secular noble dynasties fade under the pressure of continuous war, the Prince-Bishops (Vladikas) of Cetinje have taken up the heavy mantle of national leadership. This unique Theocratic Monarchy unites spiritual authority and temporal power in a single, celibate office, effectively preventing the dangerous fragmentation of our lands among rival feudal heirs. It turns the struggle for mountain independence into a perpetual holy war that every clan member is religiously bound to fight. The Vladika is not just a ruler; he is the living symbol of our resistance, ensuring that the cross and the sword are never separated in the defense of the Black Mountain.
serbian_seobe: The Serbian people have mastered the art of 'mobile identity'. It is the ability to move entire communities to new lands without losing cultural cohesion. Such mobility ensures that the 'Serbian Hearth' is not a fixed geographic point, but a portable and indestructible social contract; wherever the Serbian community strikes its staff, the old laws and the traditions of the Slava are immediately re-established. Such endurance makes our culture impossible to behead, as the nation can abandon scorched valleys only to reappear as a fully formed, military society on a new frontier, waiting for the opportune moment to strike back at the heart of their ancestral lands.
hum_the_ponor_storage_system: We have mastered the climate-controlled secrets of the Trebišnjica river system, the world's longest losing stream. By utilizing the stable temperatures and dry upper galleries of the ponors (sinkholes) during the summer, we have established a national network of subterranean granaries. This 'Hidden Reserve' ensures that our grain supplies are immune to the scorching Herzegovinian heat and, more importantly, invisible to the foraging parties of invading armies. While our enemies starve in a scorched valley, our forces remain well-fed by tapping into the earth's own cool depths, allowing us to maintain a high-morale standing army even during multi-year blockades.
