bavarian_legitimacy: We have been granted the rulership of Bavaria directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of Bavaria, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.
bavarian_imperial_knights: Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the Holy Roman Empire. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.
exploit_the_alpine_trade: Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade Salt, Silver, and Livestock in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.
bavarian_brewing_expertise: Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.
bavarian_culture_buildings: With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over Europe, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of Europe.
bavarian_stem_duchy: We once were ruled by Bavaria, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new Bavarian state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.
bavarian_zelousness: We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.
bavarian_hofkriegsrat: Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.
bavarian_flexible_diplomats: No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep Bavarian interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.
foundation_of_bavarian_army: Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.
bavarian_coinage: Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.
bavarian_purity_law: The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.
vij_city_of_victory: Vijayanagar — the 'City of Victory' — is the heart of our state, and will one day become the heart of the entire Hindu. Let it shine as a beacon of culture and tradition even as it fends off the Muslim invaders!
vij_an_army_for_city_of_victory: For the City of Victory to be worthy of its name, we must have an army that can bring about these namesake triumphs. We will ensure our troops are well-trained and take great pride in their service.
vij_arab_horses: Horses from Arabia are far superior to our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply for our military.
vij_first_indian_artillery: The military application of gunpowder is not yet widespread, but it has the potential to mold the future of warfare. We must explore the utility and benefits of gunpowder.
vij_the_bunds: Our society is built on agriculture in the rather arid Karnakassala area. The bunds, also called anecut, provide our cities and fields alike with much-needed fresh water.
vij_adroit_diplomacy: The numerous invaders of our Hindu people have shown time and time again the same weakness: the tendency to fight amongst themselves. We must be ready at all times to exploit this to our own ends.
vij_promotion_of_trade: Our territory is situated on one of the key trade routes from East to West. We must ensure that our ports are safe and secure so that visiting captains will land there... giving us the opportunity to tax them.
vij_carnatic_music: We must resist the Muslim invasion on all fronts. The musical traditions of the Northern States are already showing signs of foreign influence. This is blasphemy, because we all know that music is a divine art form that originated with the Devas and Devis themselves. We will show the Hindu people that we are committed to defending this holy art form.
vij_cultural_integration: The cultural diversity of India is one of our defining traits. By allowing our various settlements to rule by their own customs, we will assure their loyalty and integration into our society.
vij_rule_in_accord_with_dharma: Dharma is a major pillar of our religious and social values. Our state can only be just and virtuous if our rulers themselves embody and live in accord with dharma.
vij_harsh_penal_code: Harsh punishments — including being put to death — are how we uphold law and order in this society. By establishing and strictly enforcing a harsh penal code, we ensure criminals fear the consequences of their actions, creating stability through the certainty of punishment.
vij_decentralized_rule: As our state grows, so do our administrative burdens on the government and the risk of revolt. To counteract this, we shall establish a system of decentralized rule, where settlements can manage their own minor issues, only seeking intervention from the central court for severe matters.
vij_indian_throne: India has been subject to Muslim threats for far too long. Heathen empires claim their rule from Delhi in the north, yet their beliefs and government are in direct opposition to what our people want. No, a new seat of power must be established — and Vijayanagar shall be the new Throne of India!
arabia_felix: Ever since antiquity, Yemen has been known as 'Arabia Felix', the Fortunate Arabia. Blessed with a temperate highland climate and fertile soil in a sea of desert, it remains one of the most naturally prosperous regions of the peninsula. Let us nurture that prosperity and use it as the foundation of a thriving realm.
coffea_arabica: Though others have attempted to transplant our beloved bean, the Coffee of Arabia remains unmatched in flavor and fame. From the bustling port of Mocha to the courts of faraway rulers, the world's desire for our drink is insatiable.
zaydi_scholarly_traditions: The highlands of Yemen have long been home to the Zaydī imamate, a center of learning and piety. Rooted in Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and rationalism, our scholars have ensured the rule of law and the moral integrity of our governance for centuries.
rasulid_bureaucracy: The Rasulid dynasty brought unprecedented administrative order to our lands. With census records, tax systems, and a robust cabinet structure, they transformed Yemen into one of the most efficiently governed realms in the region.
control_of_the_red_sea: Any and all trade from India and Africa must pass through the strait called Gate of Grief. Let us enforce our dominion over this maritime chokepoint and turn every passing ship into an opportunity.
yem_unite_the_tribes: From the Tihāmah coast to the Ḥarāz mountains, our realm is home to countless fiercely independent tribes. While they have long resisted centralized authority, they are also our strength. By uniting them under a single cause, we can better utilize them as a workforce.
port_of_aden: The port of Aden has been a nexus of trade for millennia — its natural harbor welcoming ships from India, Egypt, and East Africa. If properly supported, it can once again become the cornerstone of our maritime economy and the pride of the Red Sea.
palm_tree_masters: We may not have a very robust manufacturing industry, but one thing we do have in abundance are palm trees. Sturdy enough to support construction and shipwrighting, but flexible enough to be shaped by our artisans, mastering the use of this unique lumber will help us expand our seafaring activities, improve production, and ultimately line our pockets.
bantu_and_perso_arabian: Ever since our descent from Arabia and Persia, we have established communities across the Swahili Coast that integrate the local Bantu in an effort to maintain social order and make way for the rise of new architectural and cultural advances.
kilwan_trade_network: Attracting merchants from as far away as Persia and Arabia, our capital has become a bustling commercial hub, facilitating business from the horn of Africa all the way to the shores of China.
the_dhow: Known for their slender and elongated hull design, the Kilwan Dhow is famous for being the backbone of our maritime trade that connects our ports to faraway lands. The ship itself is a manifestation of our mastery of shipwright, as our workers utilize palm trees for a sturdy body as well as locally-grown cotton for the sails.
the_kilwan_zambuc: The Kilwan Zambuc is a smaller variation of the Kilwan Dhow, and it is primarily used for local trade, transportation of goods and pottery between the various city-states across the Swahili Coast, as well as serving as trustworthy faring vessels for short distances.
zanj_taxation: Originally a term to describe the inhabitants of inner Africa, particularly those of Bantu origin, these folk make up a substantial portion of our demographics. While they have many liberties and responsibilities, they are taxed accordingly in order to preserve these privileges. Their peaceful, relatively autonomous place within our legal framework has led to the organic development of linguistic phenomena and new cultural traditions.
zan_food_imports: The dawn of a new age in seafaring has given us new opportunities to seek sustenance for our people. Whereas once we would only trade with the interior of Africa to procure crucial supplies of Sturdy Grains, Livestock, and Rice, we can now access new ports where food may be cheaper and more readily available.
zan_kilwan_latitude_staves: Our superior ship technology allows us to sail further and for longer than any of our competitors, giving us a significant edge in any seafaring activity.
shirazi_legacy: Our ancestral founder came from Širâz, son of the 'Amīr of Persia, which makes our right to rule undeniable.
zan_gold_trade_of_africa: Our abundant reserve of Gold from many sources across East Africa is the cornerstone of our economy. We must take full advantage of our reserves, and use our wealth to support and disseminate a strong currency. This will help us develop as a trading hub.
zan_diplomacy_through_trade: We are uniquely positioned at the confluence of wealth coming from China, India, and Europe. This not only benefits us financially, but it gives us great influence in the diplomatic game between Empires and foreign powers...
zmw_experienced_cattle_herder: Herding animals requires some skill, and is crucial for our survival. If we want to stabilize and expand our rule, we should expand our herding and grazing grounds as well.
zmw_stone_builders: The astonishing stone buildings of Zimbabwe impress many visitors to our great country. Continuing our architectural traditions will allow us to expand our great cities of stone, which shall stand tall for centuries.
zmw_encourage_new_settlements: Beyond our borders lie vast expanses of land, studded with resources and herding grounds waiting eagerly to be claimed by our people. We must encourage settlement in these territories, and establish new towns.
zmw_rekindling_the_royal_fires: Our subordinate chiefs must prove their loyalty to us and the gods by traveling to the capital once a year, and using our flames to rekindle their own local fire. Once a year has passed, our army will extinguish their fire, and they will have to make a new journey.
zmw_strict_gold_regulations: The land provides us with plenty of goods that foreign merchants have a keen interest in, but our abundant reserves of Gold shine brighter than any other. While such riches are a blessing, the state must tightly regulate all trade and ownership of Gold in order to help prevent the destructive effects of human greed and skullduggery from affecting our bottom line.
zmw_spokesman_before_the_dead: Our ruler is not only our leader in the temporal sense, but is also expected to speak on our behalf before the spirits of the dead. Prior to any campaign or harvest, he will communicate our respect and needs to the spirits of our ancestors through ceremonies or dances. Without a diligent ruler to maintain the royal graves and keep in close contact with our dead, things might go awry very quickly.
zmw_elected_administrators: Traditionally, all of our administrators, even on the local level, have been direct relatives of our ruler. As our empire has grown and matured, however, it is time we show deference to the local knowledge of our subjects, and allow them to select their own administrators.
zmw_discipline_and_traning: Discipline, preparation, and training are the factors that win battles. With this in mind, our commanders have successfully pioneered elaborate new tactics and organizational improvements. Let us make good use of these innovations by dividing our warriors into regiments and having them train regularly with their bows, assegais, daggers, and axes. Practice will also allow them to fight in formation without fear, defeating many more numerous enemies.
zmw_merchant_taxes: With the arrival of new traders in the Zambezi area, the need has arisen to assert our authority. Anyone who wishes to trade here, and carry our precious Gold and Ivory to other shores, must first be approved by our ruler and pay a tax in order to be granted access. Should payments lapse, all foreign merchandise will be confiscated by our state.
zmw_controlling_the_mutapan_riches: Western travelers have named our land 'Ophir', and the riches of our gold mines and the Zambezi trade have made many visitors envious of us over the centuries. Let us leverage our control over these riches, and build permanent trade posts which can grow into sprawling cities.
zmw_empowering_the_rozwi: Our lands are home to many skilled warriors. Among them are the Rozwi, disciplined fighters who stand ready to defend our people against any who would dare try to take our rightful lands from us.
zmw_cow_horn_tactics: Adapting to the ever-changing tactics of war is no easy task. Against potentially superior enemies, we should rely on our own mobility over everything else. If we are able to pin our foes into a melee fight and send a regiment to flank and encircle their troops, we will be able to inflict devastating casualties.
army_country_movement_speed_advance: Through the use of mounted scouts, we can check the terrain lying ahead of armies, and plan how to maneuver around any difficulties. This allows us to travel at a faster rate than other armies could in that same location.
army_country_casus_belli_advance: Our professional diplomats and spies excel at fabricating credible pretexts to justify almost any action we might take on the international stage.
army_country_integration_speed_advance: Our people are fearsome warlords who wish to spread their legacy to every corner of the world. As a means of integrating and managing our ever-growing domain, we have decided to mostly respect the way conquered locals conduct themselves, and not to interfere excessively.
army_country_looting_advance: Raiding and looting is fundamentally how our army sustains itself. Everywhere our troops go, they pillage as much as they can.
army_country_diplo_range_advance: Our army is feared far and wide. Despite our reputation, we should still establish diplomatic relations with nations that have the same goal as ourselves: the destruction of our common enemies. By sending well-armed and escorted envoys to foreign courts, we can ensure our diplomatic reach will not suffer under outbreaks of violence.
minting_trade_range_trad_building: Trade with foreign countries is the lifeblood of our nation. By meticulously planning out the trading routes and stockpiling supplies for each voyage, we can reach markets further from our bases.
minting_income_factor_building: There are many types of currency in circulation, but the one that bears our seal is the most widely accepted as trustworthy.
trade_center_building_country_advance: With clever techniques, we can easily make our controlled markets more attractive to foreign merchants, increasing the amount of money we earn in the process.
minting_trade_range_disc_building: The growing demands of international trade will need to be accounted for in the planning of our trading endeavors. With this expansion of our trade depots, we can reach new shores without risking our valuable cargo.
export_building_country_advance: Our customs officials have grown more agile at monitoring and taxing the goods that leave our ports. By tightening enforcement on foreign merchants trading through our markets, we make it harder for other countries to export efficiently from what we control.
counter_espionage_building_country_advan: It is well known that our activities attract unwelcome attention. If we wish to keep our plans hidden from these curious gazes, we should encrypt our communications.
rgo_build_time_advance: The great edifices and grand statues erected in the past still stand proudly. It is undeniable that the construction techniques used to design and erect them were sophisticated and well-developed. There is still much we can learn from studying them.
albanian_the_kanun: In the absence of a central crown, our social order is maintained by the Kanun, a sophisticated code of customary law. This legal framework governs everything from property rights to the sacred duty of Besa (the sworn oath). The Kanun provides a bedrock of stability and honor that foreign administrators can never fully dismantle.
albanian_prokletije: The Accursed Mountains that rise in the heart of our lands are as much a part of our people as the Kanun itself. Even the humblest villager knows which passes are passable in winter, which ridges offer shelter from ambush, and which valleys lead nowhere. Invaders who march into these mountains find themselves trapped in a maze by the terrain long before they meet our warriors.
alb_the_arberian_principality: As the power of our foes wanes, our great houses have united to ensure the survival of our nation. By making the most of our position between the Catholic West and the Orthodox East, we have become masters of maritime diplomacy and coastal trade. This strategic autonomy allows us to navigate the rivalries of neighbors to our own benefit.
alb_angevin_legitimacy: Our latest crowned heads can be traced directly to the lineage of the Capetian House of Anjou, specifically established by Charles I of Naples to serve as his gateway into the Byzantine heartlands. This connection grants us a unique Western prestige among the fragmented Balkan lords, allowing us to claim a seat at the table of the great Catholic monarchs of Europe. By upholding the honors and heraldry of the Lily, we distinguish our sovereignty from that of mere tribal chieftains.
ant_born_in_the_highlands: Our ancestral home in the highlands of our nation is a natural citadel of jagged peaks and narrow ravines that is nearly impossible for a conventional army to navigate. We have further fortified every strategic pass and mountain peak, ensuring that any enemy invader must pay a staggering price in blood for every inch of our territory they attempt to occupy.
mtr_the_masters_of_the_karavasta: Our domain is protected by the labyrinthine Karavasta Lagoon, where our people have mastered navigation through mudflats and hidden channels. This watery landscape serves as a natural fortress that is nearly impossible for heavy foreign armies to map or conquer, providing a sanctuary that no cavalry charge can reach.
mzk_the_agricultural_wealth_of_the_devol: The fertile valleys of our heartland allow us to fund a lavish court and a highly trained cavalry force through advanced irrigation. The Devoll's harvests feed our political ambitions and fill the ranks of a large professional retinue.
thp_french_blood_claims: We assert a prestigious, albeit disputed, descent from the French Royalty, granting our diplomats a unique standing in the courts of Europe. This perceived noble pedigree allows us to negotiate as peers with the Italian city-states and the Papacy, securing alliances that would be denied to common Balkan warlords.
albanian_the_stradioti_tradition: The poverty of our mountains has turned our men into the finest light cavalry in Christendom. These Stratioti are sought after by every major power from Venice to France for their unparalleled skills in skirmishing and reconnaissance. By exporting our martial prowess, we bring wealth back to our hills and ensure our soldiers are the most experienced in Europe.
alb_eastern_and_western_heritage: Our urban centers continue to operate under both the sophisticated principles of Byzantine Law and the modern bureaucracies of the West. This legal continuity provides a stable framework for contracts, property rights, and inheritance that attracts foreign merchants and scholars to our courts. A predictable legal system is the foundation of our growing administrative strength.
alb_the_national_arsenal: As the primary port for Western intervention, we have modernized the shipyards of Durrës to maintain a permanent fleet of galleys. This infrastructure allows us to project power across the Adriatic, ensuring that the sea lanes between Naples and Albania remain open for reinforcements and trade. Our control of the harbor makes us the undisputed masters of the western Balkan coastline.
ant_the_iron_mines_of_the_interior: The rugged mountains of central Albania under our control are rich in high-quality iron ore essential for the tools of war. We have established state-sponsored smelters to provide our clans with a constant supply of superior steel blades and armor plates, ensuring we are never dependent on foreign imports to equip our growing armies.
mtr_lagoon_fisheries: The biological wealth of our coastal waters provides a stable food supply that supports a larger standing militia even during regional famines. By monopolizing the harvest of the lagoons, we ensure that our population remains healthy and our granaries full, fueling our state's survival.
mzk_the_despots_of_berat: Ruling from the Castle of Berat, the 'City of a Thousand Windows', we represent the peak of Albanian urban sophistication and Byzantine-style administration. Our court serves as a magnet for scholars and artisans, turning our capital into a beacon of culture that rivals the grand cities of the East.
thp_the_lion_of_thopia: Our house has risen to preeminence by masterfully navigating the clashes among the clans, positioning the Thopia family as the arbiters of Albanian sovereignty. By weaving together a complex web of alliances, we will secure the first true Princeps Albaniae title recognized by both the East and the West. With the lion of our crest flying over the ramparts of the coast, we have established a professionalized administrative core that outpaces the primitive feudalism of our rivals, ensuring our house remains the foremost power of the Adriatic shore.
albanian_the_sacred_oath: The concept of Besa has evolved into a national institution of trust and hospitality. An Albanian's word is his bond, and this reputation for unwavering loyalty makes us the most trusted guards and mercenaries in the Mediterranean. In a world of shifting alliances, our word is our most valuable currency.
alb_the_champion_of_christ: Despite our communities being divided by faith, our nation is devoted to Christ, earning us the title of Athleta Christi. Our relentless faith has drawn the eyes of the Papacy and the Patriarchs, securing us financial subsidies and military volunteers. We fight not just for our land, but for the very survival of the 'Word of Christ'.
alb_the_catholic_bulwark: Positioned as the easternmost outpost of the Roman Church, we have become the primary shield against both Orthodox schismatics and Turkish heathens. Our sacred duty brings an inner peace that infuses the entire realm and turns our struggle into a crusade for our soul.
ant_arianitis_defiance: Following the heroic example of our leaders, our house is known as the first to rise and the last to surrender against our foes. This legacy of unyielding resistance has forged our people into a nation of warriors who see struggle as a sacred duty rather than a burden.
mtr_marshland_guerillas: We specifically train our levies to lure enemy units into the deep bogs where their armor becomes a liability. In these environments, our light, unarmored infantry reigns supreme through ambush tactics, turning the very earth into a weapon. Our ability to adapt to any terrain and move fast in the worst conditions makes us a dangerous foe.
mzk_the_muzaka_chronicle: Our family keeps meticulous and grand records of our history and territorial rights, ensuring our ancient claims are never forgotten. This literary tradition preserves our high Byzantine titles, overawing local rivals with our imperial dignity and historical depth.
thp_a_centralized_levy_system: We have moved away from loose clan associations toward a semi-professional core of infantry based in our central cities. Where tribal levies gather slowly, ours answer a threat quickly and in good order.
albanian_the_transhumance_networks: The seasonal movement of livestock (Transhumance) allows our people to utilize the high summer pastures and the warm winter plains of the coast. This mobile lifestyle makes our population difficult to pin down and provides a resilient food supply that cannot be easily burned by a scorched earth campaign. Our wealth walks on four legs, always ready to move to safer ground.
alb_the_arbereshe_diaspora: Over time, a good number of our people have emigrated abroad and formed Arbëreshë communities. These 'Albanians across the sea' maintain our language and traditions while gaining influence in their new homes. They serve as permanent diplomatic envoys there, constantly lobbying for support for the homeland.
alb_diplomacy_of_the_two_shores: Our position allows us to act as the essential bridge between the Italian city-states and the rugged Balkan interior. Our diplomats are trained to navigate both the Venetian Senate and tribal councils, making our mediation indispensable for trade and war.
ant_patronage_of_the_faith: By providing significant land grants and funds to our monasteries, we maintain the spiritual loyalty of the nobility and the peasantry. These sacred sites serve as the cultural heart of our principality, where our victories are celebrated.
mtr_the_trade_monopolies: By controlling the river mouths and coasts, we can successfully dictate the flow of timber and grain from the interior to Venetian galleys. We have positioned ourselves as the indispensable middlemen of the Adriatic trade, ensuring no merchant can bypass our tolls.
mzk_silk_road_waystations: Our land sits on the primary trade routes from the interior; by taxing the silk caravans, we maintain a full and prosperous treasury. This revenue allows us to patronize the finest calligraphers and icon painters, turning our domain into the cultural capital of southern Albania.
thp_mecenas_of_the_arts: We have funded the construction of grand cathedrals and fortifications, blending Gothic and Byzantine styles to showcase our wealth and piety. This architectural splendor serves to legitimize our rule in the eyes of the Church and our subjects, turning our cities into symbols of permanence.
albanian_the_fortified_kulla_houses: Throughout the countryside, the nobility and wealthy farmers have constructed Kulla, fortified stone tower houses. These structures serve as miniature citadels, protecting families from both blood feuds and enemy raids. They represent a society that is permanently mobilized for defense.
alb_the_albanian_merchant_class: The merchants of our coast have become the primary carriers of trade between the Balkans and the West. By utilizing the Greek language for commerce and Albanian for loyalty, they dominate the markets from Venice to Constantinople. These merchant marines are the lifeblood of our modernizing economy.
alb_the_expansion_of_the_regnum: We will not rest until the borders of the ancient Kingdom are restored to their greatest extent and beyond, reclaiming our place as masters of the Balkans. This centralizing mission allows us to integrate newly conquered territories with little resistance as we restore 'rightful' rule.
ant_the_eternal_resistance: We have sworn an eternal oath that so long as we breathe, the heart of the rebellion will continue to beat. Our troops are drilled with a fanatical devotion to our ruling house, ensuring they maintain discipline even in the face of overwhelming imperial numbers.
mtr_reclamation_engineering: We have begun the process of draining parts of the Myzeqe marshes to create even more fertile farmland. This engineering feat not only increases our tax base but allows us to construct permanent roads through what was once impassable bog.
mzk_literary_patronage: We have turned our capital into a center of culture, preserving the wisdom of the East and the West for future generations. This intellectual prestige makes our court the destination for the finest minds of the Orthodox and Latin worlds alike.
thp_princeps_albaniae: Our name has become synonymous with the state itself, allowing us to integrate various ethnic groups under a single banner. By promoting the most talented individuals regardless of their origins, we have created a meritocratic bureaucracy that outshines our feudal rivals.
albanian_the_albanian_alphabet_commissio: Scholars and patriots are working tirelessly to standardize the Albanian language using a unified Latin alphabet. By establishing national schools and printing newspapers in the vernacular, we are breaking the cultural hegemony of foreign tongues. Literacy in Albanian is the first step toward true independence.
alb_the_spirit_of_the_rilindja: Our 'National Rebirth' or Rilindja has ignited a fire in the hearts of Albanians everywhere, from the mountains of the north to the diaspora in Italy and Egypt. This cultural and political movement has unified all Albanians under the common banner of 'Albanianism'. We are a nation reborn, ready to take our place among the sovereign states of Europe.
alb_enlightened_albanian_absolutism: Following the European trend, our monarchs have centralized power, stripping the old clans of their feudal privileges in favor of a modern state. This move has allowed us to implement universal taxation and a national judicial system, turning the kingdom into a streamlined machine of war.
ant_the_professional_highland_grenadiers: We have evolved our traditional skirmishers into elite mountain grenadier units, specialized in heavy assault and siege warfare. These troops combine their ancestral mountain agility with the devastating firepower of modern explosives, making them the terror of any fortress garrison.
mtr_the_mataranga_port_authority: We have unified all coastal harbors under a single administrative authority, streamlining the collection of dues and customs. This centralization has made us the most efficient trade administrators in the Adriatic, drawing the gold of foreign merchants.
mzk_the_muzakan_industrialization: We have introduced the large-scale cultivation of cash crops in our most fertile valleys, fueling a new domestic industry. By processing our own raw materials into high-value products, we have created an industrial base that supports a wealthy and loyal urban population.
thp_the_thopia_merchant_marine: We have expanded our commercial influence by offering state protection to all merchant vessels flying the Thopia banner. This naval security has turned our ports into the preferred hubs for Levant trade, siphoning wealth away from the decaying ports of our rivals.
pukara_advance: The Pukara is a building placed in hill or mountainous terrain, and serves both as weapon storage and as a defensive fortification. They incorporate the difficulty of the terrain into their design, making them comparatively cheaper and easier to construct and maintain than regular forts.
terraces_advance: The Terraces are sloped areas for the purpose of effective farming in the complex terrain of the Andes. Constructed on different height levels, the terraces can provide prime soil for many different crops in a close area.
incamisana_advance: The Incamisana is a temple in honor and worship of water and the divine patrons of it. As a combination of architectural beauty and technical ingenuity, the Incamisana has a dual purpose of being a religious building and an irrigation system.
a_bedouin_cavalry_advance: The Bedouin are a wandering people who travel through the desert regions of the Arabian Peninsula, North Africa, the Levant and Mesopotamia. Through their nomadic lifestyle, they have mastered their riding skills, and the usage of the Arabian horses makes them a formidable cavalry force.
arm_legacy_of_hayk: Hayk, descendant of Noah, founded our kingdom at the base of Mount Ararat after defeating the Babylonians, and thus became the patriarch of our nation. All our people know this story, and all are proud to belong to such an ancient lineage.
arm_mount_ararat: Mount Ararat, where Noah's Ark came to rest after the Great Flood, is where our nation first formed. As a result, our people resist with a particularly holy fervor when the sanctity of our territory is threatened.
arm_apostolic_church: Armenia was the first nation to declare Christianity as its state religion. As such, our religious traditions, especially those of our clergy, are a major component of our identity.
arm_land_reclamation: Armenia has been ravaged by war for centuries. By reclaiming the lands lost in these struggles, making them suitable for inhabitation, and restoring ruined churches and fortresses, we can improve the lives of our people and take firmer control over our territory.
arm_border_nation: Since ancient times, Armenia has been the reluctant battleground between larger nations. Even after regaining our sovereignty, remaining neutral is extremely difficult — it is not impossible to appease everyone, but it is not easy, either.
arm_melikdom_organization: As one of the few bastions of an independent Armenian state, Armenia is governed by feudal suzerains called meliks, as the old system of Nakharar Titles collapsed after the Mongol invasions. The relationship between meliks and their subordinates is that of a military commanding officer and junior officer, and not of feudal lord and a serf.
arm_mountain_armies: Armenia is a mountainous land. Our people have adapted to this terrain over the centuries, and we have developed many ways to use those mountains to our advantage. Our armies will gather readily when called, confident in the additional protection our unique environment provides.
arm_nakharar_titles: The Nakharar system of titles was in continuous use in Armenia from its inception until the times of the Mongol invasions, when it collapsed. Although the titles themselves are no longer in use, certain characteristics of that system persist, enhancing the abilities of both our nobles and armies.
arm_greater_armenia: In our long and illustrious history, Armenian kingdoms spread over a large territory, and so did our Armenian people. By emulating these bygone realms, we become a beacon of all Armenian people, who will happily unite under our leadership.
arm_highland_fortresses: Our fortresses are a brilliant emblem of our resilience and fortitude, built to endure not only the difficult local climate, but also any foreign invader foolish enough to mount an attack into our unforgiving territory.
bng_bengali_vassal_system: During the reign of Delhi, the Bengali people served their overlord as productive vassals. The Dehlavi system shall serve as the foundation for our own vassal systems for the years of Bengali sovereignty to come.
bng_bengali_paik: The paiks are the backbone of our military. While other states have the Paik System active and use paiks as their general levies, our state maintains smaller, but very well-organized paiks, and provides them with sufficient military support.
bng_bengali_architecture: A mixture of ancient urban architecture, Muslim engineering influences, and traditional Bengali roof-building techniques, the unique Bengali architectural style is used for religious and cultural buildings of all kinds. Due to our expertise in this style, constructing such buildings is significantly easier and more affordable for us than other nations.
bng_habshi_generals: Abyssinian slave-soldiers play a significant role in our military as elite infantry. Those who excel as leaders shall be given greater levels of command, while those who demonstrate exceptional loyalty shall make up the palace guard.
bng_war_elephants: Although slow, the maneuverability of elephants in the riverine terrain of our country is crucial to quickly resupplying our military. Additionally, war elephants will aid our troops on the battlefield with their imposing stature and terrifying strength.
bng_rupees: The lack of a widely adopted standardized currency is stunting our commercial development. As one of the foremost economic powers on the subcontinent, we are in a good position to begin minting a new silver coinage with standard weights, which we shall call the rupee.
bng_bengali_traders: The Indian Ocean connects our local markets with those of South East Asia and China. We shall therefore greatly emphasize maximizing our presence in these markets via sea routes, and through this increase our trade profits.
bng_bengali_poetry: The written word is one of the most influential and enduring forms of art. Bengali poetry shall tell the tales of epic conquerors, relatable dramas, and engaging philosophical questions, all of which shall further the spread and reputation of Bengali culture.
bng_religious_pluralism: India is home to many religions: Hinduism for the majority, Islam as the preferred faith of the ruling classes, and a few remarkable minor religions such as Buddhism and Jainism amongst the working minorities. Promoting one religion over another will cause inevitable chaos and unrest. Thus, we should aim for religious pluralism, and neither favor nor discriminate against any religion in our state.
bng_artillery_corps: Cannons are an impactful asset to military campaigns. We must ensure an efficient artillery corps that specializes in dealing damage to the enemy's rows before they even start to clash with our soldiers on the field.
bng_bengali_trade_fleet: The Bengali trade fleet brings exotic goods from foreign lands, as well as precious Gold and Silver, to the markets of the Ganges Delta. Our merchants are well renowned in far-flung parts of the world, thanks to our impressive trade fleet.
bng_shipbuilding_industry: Maritime trade is vital to our state. Our trade and our warships are some of the most important aspects of our economy, and therefore we focus heavily on supporting the shipbuilding industry.
bng_bengali_industrialization: Bengal is uniquely situated in India to start a revolution unlike any seen before. Muslin — the special cotton fabric Bengali spinners are famous for — is a prime trade good for industrialization. We stand poised to exploit new developments in our already world-class textile industry. Let us begin an industrial revolution!
ara_a_maritime_realm: The Counts of Barcelona have inherited a Mediterranean-facing realm shaped by the trade traditions of Roman Tarraco and the Carolingian Marca Hispanica. Our merchants on the long Catalan coast, from Tarragona and Barcelona to Sant Feliu and the ports of the Empordà, drive the maritime economy of the early Crown, financing royal campaigns in exchange for privilegis of trade. This commercial and naval orientation makes Catalonia the engine of every Aragonese eastward expansion from Mallorca to Sicily.
anr_pau_dels_dos_coprinceps: The Pau dels Dos Coprínceps (the perpetual peace agreed between the Bishop of Urgell and the Count of Foix in the paréage of 1278) establishes Andorra as a dual sovereignty in which neither prince may act in our valleys without the consent of the other. Our diplomats learn from the start that every external relationship must be balanced against the watchful eye of a second prince, breeding habits of careful drafting and patient negotiation rare in courts that answer to a single sovereign. This dual-headed sovereignty teaches our envoys to extract more from foreign courts than the size of our delegation alone could ever justify.
cat_principatus_cathaloniae: The formal designation of our territory as Principatus Cathaloniae within the Crown of Aragon makes Catalonia not a mere county or appendage, but a sovereign principality with its own laws, currency, and Corts. The Count of Barcelona styles himself Princeps to underline the legal parity of our institutions with those of the Aragonese kingdom proper. This constitutional dignity raises the standing of our court before Christendom and binds our nobility to a project larger than any single comital house.
mll_carta_de_franquesa: The Carta de Franquesa granted by King Jaume I in 1230, in the very year following the conquest of Mayūrqa, establishes the bedrock of Mallorcan liberty: the freedom of the new settlers from servile dues, the right of the universitat to elect its own jurats, and the exemption of our merchants from the harshest royal levies. Each of the foranes, the rural communities scattered across the island, receives these privileges alongside Palma's burghers, binding the entire repopulation under a single charter rather than a feudal patchwork. Under the founding charter every Mallorcan household has a direct stake in defending royal authority, and our envoys speak abroad with less strain of a kingdom under law.
val_llibre_repartiment: The Llibre del Repartiment (the master register of lands, orchards, and houses assigned to the Christian repopulators after the 1238 conquest of Balansiya by Jaume I) fills page upon page with plots distributed among settlers from Catalonia, Aragon, Navarre, and southern France. This book will remain the definitive title document for centuries to come, cited in inheritance disputes and royal grants alike, and establishing the system of landholding of the entire kingdom from the first decade of Christian rule. This authoritative land record lets every Valencian estate be farmed with confidence and frees our peasantry from the boundary disputes that plague less well-surveyed realms.
ara_fleet_ordinances: The Crown of Aragon's diverse galley fleets draw crews from Marseille to Sicily, and no single port city statute can govern conduct on multinational vessels in foreign waters. Bernat de Cabrera, under Peter the Ceremonious, has therefore codified the Ordinacions sobre lo Fet de la Mar (Ordinances on What Happens at Sea) one of the earliest naval military codes in Europe. This code consistently regulates the duties of admirals, captains, and crews drawn from every Aragonese realm, turning the Catalan-Aragonese fleet into a coherent fighting institution at a time when other powers still rely on city-state contingents that fight only when paid.
anr_sis_parroquies: The Sis Parròquies (Canillo, Encamp, Ordino, La Massana, Andorra la Vella, and Sant Julià de Lòria) each send representatives to the Consell de la Terra to deliberate on taxation, public works, and the customary law that governs our valleys. Decisions taken in council bind every parish equally, and the parishes in turn administer their own commons, irrigation, and dispute resolution without sending matters to the co-princes for routine governance. This parish level self-government keeps the costs of administering our Crown remarkably low and gives every household a direct voice in the policies they live under.
cat_generalitat: The Generalitat de Catalunya is a new institution emerging from the old Corts, with the Diputació del General established as the standing executive office that collects our realm's general taxes and represents the Corts between sessions. We will channel public revenue through the Generalitat's accounting system, issuing censals and violaris, perpetual and life annuities on Catalan tax revenue, at rates the older Genoese and Florentine houses cannot match for sovereign borrowers. A standing public bank gives our Crown a stable income and a market in public debt, a thing no other peninsular realm possesses.
mll_escola_cartografica: Our Escola Cartogràfica Mallorquina gathers Jewish and Christian map makers around the Cresques family of Palma (Abraham and his son Jafudà) who produces dozens of working portolan charts for the courts of Aragon, France, and Castile. Their workshops standardize the conventions of compass roses, rhumb lines, and named ports that every Mediterranean and Atlantic captain will rely on for two centuries. This concentration of cartographic learning raises the prestige of our Crown across Christendom and seeds a printing tradition in our presses that nourishes scholarship well beyond cartography alone.
val_primera_impremta: The first printing press in the Iberian Peninsula was installed at Valencia by the German master Lambert Palmart, who issued the Obres e trobes en lahors de la Verge Maria (a volume of Marian verse composed for a literary prize) as the inaugural book of Hispanic typography. From that workshop the trade spread rapidly: Spindeler, Hagenbach, and Rosenbach established their own shops at Valencia within twenty years, producing Bibles, legal compendia, and the great chivalric prose of Tirant lo Blanch. Our printing primacy seeds workshops across the kingdom and gives our culture a head start in spreading texts, which other Spanish realms must buy from us.
ara_valencian_golden_age: From the conquest of Valencia by James I in 1238 through the fifteenth-century mercantile boom, the city has become the cultural capital of the eastern Crown of Aragon. Joanot Martorell's chivalric novel Tirant lo Blanch, the love poetry of Ausiàs March, and Isabel de Villena's Vita Christi have established Valencian as a literary language equal to Castilian or Tuscan. Our cultural standing earns our realm prestige in courts as far as Naples and Cyprus, and marks the Crown of Aragon as a producer of European culture rather than a mere consumer.
anr_questia: Our annual tribute to the co-princes, the Questia, is paid in alternating years to the Bishop of Urgell and the Count of Foix, a sum that has remained nominally fixed for centuries while our valley economies have grown substantially. The modest scale of the sum, combined with the deflation of its real value over time, allows our parish councils to fund themselves through local revenue. This favorable fiscal settlement frees court spending for public works and the ceremonial obligations of statecraft rather than on tribute paid to outside powers.
cat_remenca: The remença ties Catalan peasants to the land through the six Mals Usos, the 'evil customs' that bind serfs to their fiefs until they purchase their own freedom. Under reformed terms negotiated through the Sentence of Guadalupe, peasants gain proprietary rights over their plots while continuing to pay reduced dues, releasing rural labor and capital throughout the Principality. This agrarian settlement establishes a productive yeomanry in Catalonia decades before any other European kingdom resolves the lord-peasant question.
mll_corsaris_mallorquins: Royal patents de cors authorize our captains to arm fast galleys and brigantines at private expense for raids against Barbary and Genoese shipping, as well as any other commerce hostile to the Crown. The corsair fraternity at Palma maintains its own rolls of veteran helmsmen, gunners, and boatswains that the royal navy draws upon in time of war, blurring the line between privateer and naval reservist into a single pool of seafaring manpower. This deep reservoir of trained crews fills our fleets faster than any state-recruited navy can and lets our squadrons reach distant station before any peer Mediterranean force has cleared harbor.
val_germanies_valencianes: The germanies of Valencia (sworn brotherhoods of weavers, dyers, blacksmiths, and the dozens of other guilded trades that fill our city walls) extend beyond their craft business into mutual aid funds, militia musters, religious processions, and parish welfare. Membership in a germania is the central social identity of an urban Valencian alongside parish and family, and the brotherhoods provide the trained levies and ready supply chains the Crown calls upon in every campaign. Bound so closely together, our towns keep manpower in reserve and civic discipline in the streets.
ara_chartered_merchant_companies: Free-for-all competition among Catalan merchant houses dilutes profits and weakens our negotiating position with foreign powers. The Crown therefore charters consortia such as the Compañía de Navegación de Levante and the Compañía de Filipinas, granting them temporary trade monopolies on specific routes in exchange for renewable royal levies and an obligation to defend our convoys with armed vessels. This regulated mercantile system channels Catalan capital into ventures that can compete with the Genoese, Dutch, and English chartered companies operating from the same basins.
anr_sindic_procurador_general: Our Síndic Procurador General presides over the Consell de la Terra and acts as the executive face of Andorra before the two co-princes, negotiating on behalf of the parishes without ever surrendering the council's ultimate sovereignty over their own affairs. The síndic is chosen by consensus among the parish representatives, typically a respected churchman or notable, and serves as a permanent buffer between local interests and external pressure. This neutral mediator role keeps both clergy and nobility committed to the council's decisions and limits the factionalism that more partisan executives produce.
cat_els_segadors: The Reapers' War, when the Catalan harvesters of the Corpus de Sang rose against the lodging of Castilian tercios and the violation of our constitutions, proved that our peasantry can muster a fighting force capable of holding the Principality against the largest army in Europe for nearly two decades. The folk song Els Segadors preserves the memory of that mobilization, and every Catalan child learns the verses from the cradle. A deep tradition of peasant soldiery gives our Crown a manpower reserve that needs no professional recruiters or foreign mercenary captains.
mll_torres_costaneres: A network of torres costaneres, squat circular watchtowers of marès stone, rings Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza, and Formentera. The towers are within sight of one another, manned by parish levies who light signal fires the instant a Barbary sail appears on the horizon. Each tower is paired with a fortified parish church and a refuge cistern, so that no coastal community is more than an hour from defensible walls and stored water. This island-wide defensive lattice raises the cost of any amphibious assault on our shores and lets a smaller garrison defend a longer perimeter than the establishment of any peer realm could match.
val_seda_valenciana: Our silk industry, the seda valenciana, clusters in the parish of Velluters and around the Albufera, drawing on mulberry groves planted across the Vall d'Albaida and Vall de Càrcer to feed the silkworm hatcheries each spring. The Col·legi de l'Art Major de la Seda regulates the looms, sets quality standards, and apprentices new weavers under masters whose lineages reach back to the Morisco artisans the kingdom never wholly displaced. This silk complex, which holds every stage from orchard to hatchery, reeling shed, and loom, gives our Crown luxury cloth that no other Iberian region can match.
ara_constellation_cities: The Crown of Aragon has always been less a kingdom than a federation of capitals: Zaragoza for the Aragonese, Barcelona for the Catalans, Valencia for the Valencians, Palma for the Mallorcans, and Cagliari for the Sardinians. Each metropolis preserves its own Generalitat or Diputación del Reino, its own currency, and its own commercial bourse, exchanging consular agents and ambassadors among themselves under the king's nominal authority. This web of rival capitals makes the Crown remarkably hard to cripple: losing any one capital never paralyzes the realm, and the rivalry among them keeps trade restless and alive.
anr_via_dels_passos: The high passes connecting our valleys to French Ariège and Catalan Urgell (the Port d'Envalira, the Coll de la Botella, and the Port de Cabús) are maintained year-round by parish corvée labor that clears rockfalls, marks the snow stakes, and stocks the refuge huts that allow military and commercial traffic through. Centuries of mountain road building have produced a corps of parish engineers who can move men and supplies across alpine terrain in conditions that defeat lowland armies. This command of the high passes lets our small forces concentrate against intruders faster than any flatland army can reposition.
cat_principat_constitucionalista: The memory of our Principat Constitucionalista endures in legal manuscripts, civic statutes, and the patient scholarship of our jurists. Each generation copies the constitutions, debates them in the universities, and quietly extends their principles into municipal practice wherever the enforcers of these decrees do not look. This persistent constitutional memory tempers the centripetal pull of the court and gives every Catalan municipality a vocabulary of self-government that revolts and reforms can later draw upon.
mll_industria_lapidari: The pale marès limestone of Mallorca and the dark slate of Menorca feed an organized indústria lapidària that supplies Iberian construction sites from Palma's cathedrals and Catalan coastal forts to American colonial churches. Our quarrymen in Santanyí and Felanitx work seasonally under contract to royal arsenals, paying tribute in cut blocks rather than coin and earning a reputation for the precision of their dressed ashlar. This organized stonecutting industry makes every Mallorcan workshop more productive and speeds every royal building project across our realm.
val_real_societat_economica: The Real Societat Econòmica d'Amics del País of Valencia draws together our enlightened nobility, parish clergy, and burgher reformers around the patient improvement of irrigation, livestock, manufactures, and primary schooling across the kingdom. The society funds prize competitions for the best designs of looms and water lifting devices, sponsors translations of foreign agronomic treatises, and dispatches expert correspondents to every village willing to host them. This dedicated reform institution turns enlightened patronage into visible improvements in the farms, workshops, and revenues of our Crown.
ara_mossos_esquadra: The Mossos d'Esquadra, the squads of countrymen organized by Pere Anton Veciana, are a permanent rural police force recruited from the local communities they protect. Operating outside the regular military chain and reporting directly to the captain general of Catalonia, they pursue bandits and smugglers through terrain that royal troops cannot effectively patrol. This local policing arm secures the trade routes of the Principality without alienating the population, providing a template that other Iberian realms will eventually imitate.
anr_neutralitat_pirinenca: Our policy of Neutralitat Pirinenca (Pyrenean neutrality) keeps Andorra clear of the great wars that consume our larger neighbors, our valleys serving instead as a refuge for political exiles, smugglers, dynastic claimants in transit, and the occasional troubadour whose sudden popularity has rendered his home kingdom's tax gatherers uncomfortably attentive. Both co-princes find the arrangement convenient enough that they spare us from any formal alignment with their wider conflicts. This neutral reputation makes our envoys welcome at conferences from which combatant states are excluded and gives our small army the time to prepare defensive positions no aggressor cares to assault.
cat_renaixenca_catalana: Our literary and cultural revival, the Renaixença Catalana, restores Catalan to the printing press, the lecture hall, and the lyric stage after generations in which our language survived only in private correspondence and folk song. We will sponsor the restored Jocs Florals poetic competitions, fund the dictionaries and grammars that codify a modern literary standard, and bring our tongue back into the press, the academy, and the public administration. This cultural rebirth raises literacy among our subjects in their native language and binds every Catalan-speaking community into a single shared culture that no centralizing state can easily absorb.
mll_escola_mallorquina: The literary flowering of our islands through the Escola Mallorquina restores Mallorcan letters to the European mainstream after generations in which our tongue survived only in private devotion and folk song. We will sponsor the Pollença and Palma poetic circles whose clear, classicizing Catalan draws on both the Greco-Latin canon and the rugged landscape of the Serra de Tramuntana, carrying their journals and verses along every shipping route between the islands and the mainland. This literary revival deepens the islanders' identification with their own language and softens the assimilation of mainland migrants, who absorb the local idiom through the school's widely read pages.
val_renaixenca_valenciana: Our literary revival, the Renaixença Valenciana, gathers around the restored Jocs Florals of Valencia and around the pastoral lyric, the verse satire, and the historical chronicles that re-emerge from the printing presses of our kingdom. We will channel royal and municipal patronage to the prize medallions of the Floral Games and the new Valencian journals, restoring our tongue to a literary stage worthy of the libraries of cultivated households across the realm. This linguistic renewal raises the prestige of our court and binds our scattered comarques into a shared cultural community no foreign administration can easily fragment.
cha_matrilineal_heritage: Women in our society are given more reverence and appreciation than in many of our neighboring countries. The birthright of any child comes from their mother's side, and women have a wide array of liberties and social responsibilities.
cha_religious_tolerance: Our society is a melting pot of different religious influences. The Buddhist ideas from China, the Hindu practices from India, and the spread of Islam in South East Asia create a unique environment where religious tolerance is paramount to keeping our society together.
cha_dharmic_presence: The Dharmic gods bless us with their presence. May their strength guide us through the most difficult of times.
cha_kshatriya: The Kṣatriya is a term adopted from Hindu societies, and describes the elite nobles of our state. Given the origin of this term, it follows that our nobility take similar roles in military and court affairs as their counterparts in India.
cha_veteran_shipbuilders: Our state relies on maritime dominance to secure its political, military, and economical presence in Indochina. As such, being able to build ships swiftly is of great importance to our survival.
cha_haluwbilau: The Haluwbilau are elite warriors who occupy key positions in both our land and naval forces. Selected for their talents and bravery, these men lead armies and ships into battle against external threats, and also mediate disputes in local communities.
cha_commercial_state: Much of our wealth comes from trade. We should concentrate on expanding and refining our exchange practices, with the ultimate goal of creating a commercial state in the process.
cha_boarding_tactics: Due to our challenging native terrain, would-be conquerors must rely on their naval capabilities when attempting to invade us. Decades of piracy in the surrounding seas have taught us valuable boarding tactics, which allow us to use an opponent's own ships against them.
cha_towers_on_water: As a maritime power, much of our wealth and power comes from the sea and our dominance over it. In order to secure this supremacy, our shipwrights have designed special large warships which are known as Towers on the Water, hybrid creations between a heavy ship and a galley.
cha_cham_cultural_influence: Although some of our neighbors see our culture as inferior, they are just in denial, as many of our cultural aspects make their way into their self-proclaimed 'civilized' courts. Cham drumming, songs, dances, poetry... all of these art forms have left a clear and lasting mark on what other nations consider artistic achievement!
corsican_the_machja: The Corsican interior, dominated by the dense, aromatic evergreen shrubland known as the Machja (Macchia in standard Italian: the Scrubland), has become the central pillar of the people's survival strategy. Rather than fighting superior maritime invaders on the vulnerable coasts, the population has developed a culture of 'Strategic Retreat' into the impenetrable granite mountains. This has created a society of highlanders who are masters of concealment and rapid movement through vertical terrain. This cultural adaptation has turned the island's geography into a living fortress for our culture, where the people can preserve their laws and customs indefinitely, safe from the naval reach of any invader.
cor_the_pievi: The Kingdom has traditionally been divided into Pievi, traditional districts centered around a mother church. These were not just religious units but the primary nodes of civil administration. The state has utilized the Pievani (parish priests) as royal registrars and judges, creating a highly localized and efficient tax collection network. This ensures that the Kingdom can mobilize resources from even the most remote mountain hamlets, turning the rugged geography into a structured administrative grid.
corsican_the_vindetta: As past occupiers of our island attempted to impose a rigid legal framework, the Corsican people responded by strengthening their own traditional justice system based on the Vendetta. While viewed as lawlessness by outsiders, this is a sophisticated social mechanism of honor and self-regulation. It creates a culture where the individual is responsible for his own protection and that of his kin, leading to a populace that is universally armed and tactically proficient. This 'Culture of the Long Memory' means that any offense is met with a generational blood feud. In a national context, this means making the cost of occupation by foreign troops prohibitively expensive in both coin and lives.
cor_the_milizia_di_u_riamu: Under our direction, the Corsican clans are formalizing their traditional levies into a structured 'Militia of the Kingdom' as a result of pressure coming from our enemy's maneuvers. This will require a cultural shift from clan-based skirmishing to a national military duty. Every parish will be required to maintain a standardized armory and conduct regular drills. This 'Nationalization of the Sword' will ensure that the island possesses a standing army of citizens who are personally invested in the defense of their homes. It will bridge the ancient gap between the north and south, creating a unified military identity that will be the precursor to modern national statehood.
corsican_the_castagniccia: Past Genoese occupation heavily promoted the cultivation of the chestnut tree, particularly in the central highlands. This has created a unique culture around the tree that provides the population with a reliable, low labor food source that is immune to the grain price fluctuations of the Mediterranean market. Such abundance gives the Corsicans incredible strategic autonomy; they can retreat into the mountains and subsist indefinitely on chestnut flour, making them immune to the standard naval blockades and 'siege by starvation' tactics employed in the past by the Genoese maritime fleets.
cor_capituli_di_corsica: We will formalize the Capituli, written agreements between the central Crown and the rugged mountain communes of the interior. These charters will grant the highlanders specific tax exemptions and the right to local self-governance in exchange for their perpetual military service and loyalty. This is a masterstroke of internal diplomacy that will trade royal authority for absolute loyalty, ensuring that the most difficult terrain on the island is held by a motivated, state-aligned citizenry rather than rebellious feudal lords.
corsican_the_corsican_baroque: A wave of Baroque church construction has hit the island, funded by the wealth of returning mercenaries and merchants. These churches are characterized by an 'Austere Grandeur', reflecting the rugged and pious nature of the people. Culturally, this is a display of civilizational defiance, a statement to our neighbors that Corsica is a wealthy, cultured society capable of producing grand monuments. These churches will serve as the primary centers of communal life, where the community gathers to celebrate their distinct identity through choral polyphony and theatrical religious ritual.
cor_guardia_corsa: For decades, Corsicans have been seeking service as elite guards for the Papacy and the kings of France, among others, earning a reputation for unyielding loyalty and ferocity. We will use this by rewarding these veterans to return and train the local militias. This will create a culture of the 'Professional Returnee', where the nation's defense is led by men who have mastered the latest European tactics. This influx of expertise will turn a nation of irregular mountain skirmishers into a disciplined, modern infantry force.
corsican_lamentu_and_voceru: The Corsican culture of oral poetry, specifically the Lamentu (Lamento in standard Italian: mourning songs) and Voceru (Vocero in standard Italian: songs of vengeance), has become the primary vehicle for preserving national memory. These songs act as a living archive of the people's struggles and the names of their martyrs. Culturally, this ensures that the spirit of resistance is ingrained in every child from birth, making it impossible for an occupier to 're-educate' or assimilate the population. This oral tradition functions as a powerful psychological weapon, maintaining a state of perpetual high morale and cultural defiance even during the darkest periods of foreign military occupation.
cor_u_ginnasiu_corsu: To reduce dependency on foreign-educated officials, the Kingdom will establish its first secular gymnasiums and colleges. This will foster a home-grown class of state jurists who are experts in the specific geography and common law of our land. This intellectual boom will be the cradle of the Corsican Enlightenment, producing a generation of administrators who prioritize rational governance and the 'Rights of the People' over ancient clan traditions, preparing the state for modern constitutionalism.
corsican_chjame_rispondi: During the long years of foreign military pressure, the Corsican oral tradition of Chjam'è Rispondi (Call and Response) evolved into a sophisticated tool of social cohesion. This improvised poetic competition allowed the people to debate politics, honor their fallen heroes, and mock their occupiers through coded metaphors in the town squares. This all has ensured that the principles of the Enlightenment and the memories of the Revolution remain accessible to even the illiterate segments of society. By encouraging this we will create a unified cultural narrative that is immune to censorship, ensuring that the flame of Corsican identity remains burning bright through every situation.
cor_the_corsican_constitution: Under our ruler, Corsica will adopt the world's first modern written constitution, which will grant universal suffrage to all property owners. This will foster a culture of 'Enlightened Citizenship', where the Corsican people view themselves as the vanguard of European liberty. This political maturity will allow the state to establish powerful national institutions. The Corsican Constitution will become a 'Beacon of Liberty', influencing revolutions to come and providing the people with a sense of immense pride and historical purpose that will transcend our geographical size.
dalmatian_the_maritime_commune_spirit: Our culture is defined by the Commune, where every citizen's honor is tied to the prestige of their city. This spirit of urban competition drives our people to build more beautiful cathedrals and faster ships than their neighbors, creating a culture of extreme local pride and innovation. This 'City-State' mentality ensures that our people are highly invested in their local governance and defense, fostering a population that is exceptionally resilient and self-reliant, capable of managing its own affairs even when the central crown is distant or weak.
dal_comune_privileges: To secure the loyalty of the coastal cities against Venetian encroachment, we will issue privileges that guarantee the internal autonomy and Latin laws of those comunes (a unit of government). By allowing these cities to elect their own priors and manage their own local taxes, we create a loyal urban class that views us as a protector rather than an oppressor. This decentralized urban defense ensures that the coast is a patchwork of loyal, fortified comunes that can hold out against maritime raids, bringing the coasts and inner lands together.
rag_the_statute_of_1272: To reassure the merchants who risk their fortunes in our ports, Ragusa has codified its laws into a comprehensive legal framework that defines property rights and maritime codes. By limiting the power of any single noble and establishing the Consilium Rogatorum, we create an orderly market that attracts the wealthiest traders of the Mediterranean. This legal clarity allows a small city-state to punch far above its weight, turning a rocky outcrop into a sanctuary of Libertas that no feudal lord can easily subvert or ignore.
dalmatian_the_cult_of_the_local_patron_s: Every Dalmatian city is anchored by the intense veneration of its own unique patron: Saint Chrysogonus in Zadar, Saint Domnius in Split, Saint Tryphon in Kotor. These saints are not just religious figures; they are the 'Foundational Sovereigns' of the city. Their feast days are the primary social and political events of the year, uniting all classes in a shared ritual that reinforces the city's independent identity. This intense localism ensures that Dalmatian culture is a mosaic of fiercely independent urban identities, making it impossible for any foreign power to culturally dominate the entire coast at once.
dal_the_union_of_the_two_souls: The Dalmatian culture has matured into a truly bilingual society where Latin is the language of the law and Slavic is the language of the heart. This linguistic flexibility allows our people to navigate the complex social strata of the Renaissance Adriatic with ease. By mastering both tongues, our merchants and sailors become the indispensable intermediaries for all trade between the Italian city-states and the Slavic interior. This bilingualism creates a 'Dalmatian Bridge' culture that is uniquely adapted to international trade and diplomacy, ensuring that our people are always at the center of Mediterranean commerce.
rag_the_lazzaretto_system: Facing the recurring devastation of the Black Death, Ragusa has pioneered the world's first mandatory maritime quarantine system on the islands of Mrkan and Bobara. By isolating incoming crews and goods for forty days (quaranta), we protect our urban population while maintaining the functionality of our port when other Mediterranean hubs are paralyzed by plague. This scientific approach to public health ensures that the Republic remains a reliable and clean port of call, preserving our manpower and mercantile networks during even the most lethal periods of European history.
dalmatian_the_guild_of_the_stone_master: The abundant, bone-white limestone of the coast has birthed a culture of master stonecutters who view the karst as a canvas. Our craftsmen have developed a 'Gothic-Renaissance' style that is world-renowned for its structural innovation and delicate carving. This is not merely art; it is a physical statement of our permanence. By building every church, palace, and city wall from local stone, our people create a landscape that is both beautiful and indestructible, fostering a national pride that views the Dalmatian town as a sacred, eternal monument to our skill that no sea-borne empire can truly erase.
dal_the_soldato_dalmantine: As we consolidate our rule, we have turned our population into the 'Sword of the Nation'. Our men are recruited into elite Schiavoni (Slavic) regiments, serving as the frontline heavy infantry for our wars. This military service provides our people with professional training and exposure to the latest European warfare techniques, creating a culture of career soldiers. While our cities may lose their mercantile edge, our people become the most respected warriors in the Mediterranean, ensuring that our military tradition remains unbroken even under foreign administration.
rag_the_arsenal_expansion: Our shipyards have become famous for producing the argosy, massive carracks capable of surviving the Atlantic and the Indian Oceans. By standardizing our shipbuilding techniques and securing high-quality oak from the Bosnian forests, we ensure that the Ragusan merchant marine is the most technologically advanced in the Adriatic. These vessels carry vast cargoes and bristle with guns, allowing our merchants to dominate the spice and silk routes while flying the flag of Saint Blaise in every major port from London to Goa.
dalmatian_the_high_chancery_style: The Dalmatian patriciate has adopted the 'High Dalmatian' literary standard for their private correspondence and diplomatic registries, emulating their Italian Peninsula counterparts. Turning away from the medieval Latin towards the refined vernacular aligns the coastal cities with the heart of the Italian Renaissance. Shared taste creates a seamless intellectual bridge with the Venetian Studio, allowing our poets and lawyers to participate in the most exclusive humanist circles of Italy. This 'Linguistic Refinement' ensures that our diplomats are regarded as cultural peers in any Western court, providing a diplomatic shield based on shared civilization rather than raw military force.
dal_adriatic_oak_galleys: Recognizing that the Mediterranean is becoming a sea of fire, we have commissioned a new class of heavy, oak-reinforced oared vessels built in our best shipyards. By utilizing the iron-hard timber of the coastal mountains, these ships can withstand heavier broadsides and are designed to navigate the shallow, rocky karst inlets where large Venetian galleys founder. This superiority allows us to police our own waters and defend our coasts from any enemy.
rag_the_collegium_ragusinum: To maintain our status as a center of refinement, we have established the Collegium Ragusinum, a Jesuit-led institution of higher learning that attracts the sons of Balkan and Italian nobility. By producing a class of highly educated diplomats, scientists, and poets, we ensure that Ragusa's leadership is never outmatched in the courtrooms of Europe. This intellectual investment turns our small city into a center of culture, where the fusion of Latin logic and Slavic spirit produces the scholars who will define the cultural awakening of the entire Adriatic littoral.
dalmatian_the_accademia_degli_oziosi: Modeled after the Italian literary academies, the intellectuals of our cities have founded societies like the Accademia degli Oziosi to discuss physics, astronomy, and classical poetry. These 'Idle' scholars are anything but idle: they serve as the scientific advisors to the naval admiralties, applying the new Baroque rationalism to cartography and ballistics. This cultivated curiosity ensures that the Dalmatian urban centers remain the 'Scientific Watchtowers' of the Adriatic, preserving the coast as a hub of European Enlightenment even as the interior of the Balkans remains locked in traditionalist cycles.
dal_morlach_frontier_levies: We have integrated the Morlachs, the fierce Vlach and Slavic shepherds of the interior, into a permanent military reserve. These irregulars are granted land rights in exchange for constant readiness, serving as the eyes and ears of the nation. Their intimate knowledge of the karst geography allows us to conduct deep strike ambushes and night raids that paralyze the enemy's logistics. This creates a 'Nation in Arms' culture in the Dalmatian hinterland, where the boundary between civilian and soldier is entirely erased in the name of our defense.
rag_the_ragusan_porto_franco: As the wars between our neighbors intensify, we have declared our city a strictly neutral Porto Franco (Free Port). By refusing to host foreign warships while offering high-quality repairs and storage to all merchant vessels, we ensure that the conflict only serves to increase our profits. This 'Economic Non-Alignment' makes Ragusa the only safe harbor in a burning sea, allowing us to capture the trade routes that our rivals have abandoned in their pursuit of military glory.
dalmatian_mediterranean_cosmopolitanism: Centuries of maritime trade and bilingualism have produced a culture of Cosmopolitanism, where our people are at home in any port from Venice to the Levant. This cultural openness allows us to absorb and adapt the best ideas from across the globe, creating a society that is uniquely flexible and resilient. Our people are the 'citizens of the sea', possessing a worldview that is far broader than that of the landlocked interior. This cosmopolitan spirit ensures that the Dalmatian culture remains vibrant and commercially successful, serving as the 'window to the world' for the entire Balkan Peninsula.
dal_dalmatian_olive_pacts: We have pivoted our economy toward intensive agriculture, taking advantage of the climate of the Dalmatian coast. By establishing state-monitored 'Agricultural Pacts', we have reclaimed the coastal hills for large-scale production, turning our rugged land into a green garden of exports. This economic diversification reduces our reliance on the maritime trade and provides a new source of wealth for the coastal nobility, funding the construction of grand summer villas and urban theaters that rival those of the Italian mainland.
rag_the_ragusan_maritime_insurance_code: We have moved beyond mere shipping to the world of high finance by formalizing one of the first sophisticated systems of maritime insurance. By pooling the risks of our merchant families through the Monte di Pietà, we allow our captains to undertake daring new voyages to the Americas and the Far East with minimal personal risk.
