This bureaucratic efficiency allows the Voivode to squeeze every ducat out of the Danubian trade while maintaining a complex network of spies in our enemies' capitals.
mol_the_chronicles_of_grigore_ureche: A transformative era of intellectual self-awareness has dawned! Our high boyars have begun to systematically document the history of our people in our native Romanian for the first time. By scientifically documenting the Latin origins and linguistic heritage we share with our Romanian brothers, we shift the state's foundation from a purely religious identity to a modern linguistic and historical one. This cultural awakening strengthens the internal legitimacy of the Prince and provides our diplomats with the historical arguments needed to assert our sovereignty among the European courts. History has become a weapon of the state.
rmn_cartea_romaneasca_de_invetatura: We have issued the first printed collection of laws in our nation, the Carte Românească de Învățătură. This monumental work seeks to unify the legal practices of our realm and align them with broader European jurisprudence. By professionalizing the courts and standardizing punishments, we have reduced the arbitrary power of the local boyars and strengthened the central authority of the throne, making our state a model of Eastern Orthodox legalism and order.
tra_the_edict_of_torda: In a Europe increasingly torn apart by bloody and fanatical religious wars, Transylvania has bravely issued the Edict of Torda, the first law of universal religious tolerance in the Western world. By allowing Catholics, Lutherans, Calvinists, and Unitarians to coexist within a single legal framework, we have prevented the internal social collapse and civil strife seen throughout the Holy Roman Empire. This unprecedented peace makes our principality a safe haven for displaced scholars, scientists, and merchants, rapidly accelerating our adoption of modern administrative reforms and diverse cultural influences. Tolerance has become our greatest strategic asset.
cunning_diplomacy: Under the visionary leadership of our rulers, we will achieve the geopolitical impossible: the unification of all Romanian lands under a single banner. This 'Great Idea' will ignite a latent national consciousness that will transcend ancient feudal borders, proving to the world that a unified Dacia can stand as a European Great Power in its own right. This vision will set the legal, military, and symbolic precedents that will provide us with a permanent, historical claim to regional hegemony and the eventual gathering of all Romanians.
romanian_the_romanian_renaissance: Due to the influence of our wealthiest families, our lands are undergoing a cultural blossoming known as the Brâncovenesc style, which we must support. This period of high culture will lead to the construction of grand palaces and the patronage of humanist scholars who will emphasize the Roman origins of the Romanian people. This intellectual movement will solidify our identity as the 'Latin island' in a sea of Slavic and Magyar influences, boosting our diplomatic standing in Western Europe.
mol_the_moldovan_enlightment: Dimitrie Cantemir has ascended to become a polymath of European renown, bringing the radical principles of the early Enlightenment directly into our court. By mapping the intricate history, music, and geography of our region for a Western audience, we have gained a profound strategic advantage in the shifting sands of Eastern European politics. We have transitioned from a medieval frontier march into a scientifically managed state that looks increasingly toward the modernized reforms of the West for its political and military inspiration. Knowledge is the new currency of the Moldavian throne.
rmn_the_bible_of_bucharest: The publication of the first complete Bible in the Romanian language has fundamentally shifted our cultural identity from the liturgical Church Slavonic to the living vernacular. This monumental work acts as a linguistic unifier, standardizing the dialects of Wallachia, Moldavia, and Transylvania into a single literary tongue. By making the sacred texts accessible to the common man, we have laid the foundation for a unified national consciousness that transcends the political borders of the three separate principalities.
tra_the_vauban_transylvanian_bastion_syn: As the age of gunpowder reaches its peak, we have adopted a unique school of military architecture that adapts the latest Italian and French Trace Italienne designs to the rugged, limestone geography of the Carpathian interior. Our major administrative centers have been refortified with low-profile, angled bastions capable of absorbing heavy siege artillery fire. Unlike the massive stone walls of the past, these modern works of earth and brick are designed for active defense, featuring interlocking fields of fire for the principality's growing artillery corps. This defensive doctrine ensures that any invading army is bled dry in a series of prolonged, costly sieges before they can ever threaten the state's heartland.
wal_the_diplomat_schools: Under the patronage of high officials, we have established the Princely Academy of Saint Sabbas, bringing Italian and Greek professors to our capital. This investment in high education has created a generation of 'Philosopher-Diplomats' who are as comfortable discussing Latin rhetoric as they are negotiating secret treaties with our neighbors. By turning our capital into an intellectual beacon, we have ensured that our administrative elite remains the most sophisticated in the Balkans, capable of outmaneuvering anyone at every turn.
romanian_the_scoala_ardeleana: This intellectual movement born in Transylvania has successfully combined Enlightenment rationalism with a fierce national pride, proving the Latin origins of our people through rigorous cultural and linguistic studies. By creating the first modern Romanian grammar and history books, we have provided the ideological fuel for a true nationalistic spirit. The school has convinced the Romanian people across all provinces that they are a single, Western-descended nation destined for sovereignty, effectively ending the era of medieval provincialism.
mol_the_cotnari_and_odobesti_wines: Vineyards have remained Moldavia's greatest treasure, with the sweet white wines of Cotnari rivaling Tokay in the courts of Europe. We have already codified the first wine classifications, establishing a state interest in the export of 'Perle de la Moldavie'; now it is time to pass to action. This luxury trade will provide the Princely court with significant hard currency from neighboring markets, funding the lavish palaces in our capital.
rmn_the_pandur_militias: Our nation has seen the rise of the Panduri, a highly motivated irregular infantry force drawn from among our free peasantry and petty gentry. These soldiers specialize in guerrilla warfare and rapid movement through the Danubian marshes, proving that a native, ideologically driven force could challenge both enemy and Boyar retinues. The Pandur tradition will become the blueprint for the first professional and modern native Romanian national army.
tra_the_national_mining_academy: We have established world-class scientific institutions to oversee the intensive extraction of gold, silver, and salt from the multiple mountain ranges of our nation. By applying the latest mineralogical and chemical techniques, we have turned Transylvania into the primary treasury of the region. This industrial focus has created a new class of professional engineers and technocrats who manage the state's resources with scientific precision, ensuring long-term economic stability.
wal_the_abolition_of_serfdom: Under the reformists in our nation, we have taken the radical step of legally abolishing serfdom, before many of our neighbors. By transforming the peasantry from 'chattel' into 'taxable subjects', we have centralized the state's fiscal power and broken the absolute control of the rural boyars. This social revolution brings the Voivode closer to the people and frees a more mobile, economically active population able to support a modernizing central administration.
guj_hub_of_the_indian_ocean_trade: Due to the nature of the monsoon tradewinds and its specific location, Gujarat has long served as the hub of the East-West trade in the Indian Ocean, connecting the Red Sea, Egypt, and Malacca. Due to this, Gujarat merchants were important middlemen bringing such precious goods as spices from the Maluku Islands and Silk from China, and then selling them to the merchants coming from the west.
guj_garba: Originating out of the worship dances done by women in praise of the Hindu goddess Ambaji, our people have refined a new and very graceful form of dance called the Garba. The basics of the dance are singing and clapping rhythmically in a circular formation. Today, our men and women use this dance to celebrate any occasion with great fervor, coming together as a community and wearing exquisitely embroidered outfits. All of us together, young and old, peasant and prince, Muslim and Hindu, dancing in an ever-growing circle.
guj_jain_routes: Jainism is an ancient way of life, shaped into its current form by Mahavira. For a thousand years, Gujarat has been the stronghold of the Jain community and faith, with many holy sites and temples. Royal dynasties have patronized the religion, forming a community with the Hindu people. Muslim invasions from the west by Mahmud Ghazni and Mohammad Ghori, oppressed the Jain community, vandalizing temples or converting them into mosques, as well as burning Jain libraries. However, the Jain people of Gujarat have survived, adapted, and prospered, using their connections with Jain communities across the world to serve as a hub for both faith and commerce.
guj_gujarati_lipi: The Gujarati Lipi is a new script and writing system developed by mercantile interests. Also known as the saraphi (bankers), vaniasai (merchants), or mahajani (traders) script due to its association with commerce, its use has rapidly become widespread throughout Gujarat, Kutch, and Sindh for writing regional languages and studying Sanskrit. The Zoroastrianism community has also adopted it as a writing system for Avestan. This common writing system unites diverse communities, facilitating both practical communication and a common identity.
guj_gujarati_merchant_diaspora: Our people trade on every shore, pursuing commerce and following the trade winds. Our fleets sail constantly in pursuit of new opportunities, and our merchants understand both the craft of shipbuilding and the value of building good, hardy ships on a limited budget.
hassaniya_maqil_migrations: The Banū Ḥassān and the wider Banū Ma'qil Arab clans push west out of upper Egypt across generations, mingling with the Sanhaja Berbers of the western Sahara and imposing their Arabic dialect, our Ḥassāniyya, on the conquered camps. Our shayḵs adopt the genealogies of the incoming Arabs, our scholars trace the line of every ruling family back to Banū Ḥassān founders, and the older Berber tongues retreat into a substratum of vocabulary preserved only in pasture songs and place names. This blend of Arab and Berber gives the Bidhan a tribal and genealogical order that binds the western Sahara into a single cultural sphere shared with no neighboring people.
hassaniya_azalai_salt_caravans: The great twice-yearly azalai caravans assemble at the Wadan rendezvous and run south to Walata and the Niger bend, hauling slabs of rock salt cut from the western Saharan quarries of Ijil and the sabḵa of Ijil down to the markets of gold and grain of Mali and Songhai. Our caravan masters hold hereditary leases on each salt source, our pack camels marshal in their hundreds for the southbound run, and our return convoys carry Sudanese gold dust, Hausa cloth, and kola nuts back to the northern entrepôts. This cycle of salt traded for gold, anchored at the western Saharan source, gives the Bidhan treasury a mineral income that no neighboring economy can substitute for from local rock.
hassaniya_mehari_warbands: The mehari (the tall, white, riding camel of the Sahara) carry our Hassan warbands four hundred kilometers in three days across terrain that no horse cavalry could traverse, striking caravans, settled enemies, and rival tribes before any retaliation can be organized. Our young warriors train from boyhood on these animals, learning to ride in line for the desert charge, fire bows from the saddle, and disperse into the dunes when pursuit appears. On our home terrain, camel-borne raiders move faster than any neighboring military system, Maghrebi, Sudanese, or Saharan.
hassaniya_sharr_bubba: The Šarr Bubba, the long struggle that finally separates the Hassan warrior tribes from the Zawaya scholarly tribes, ends in a binding caste line truce that each side accepts as the price of an end to the slaughter. The Hassan retain the monopoly on bearing arms and collecting tribute; the Zawaya retain the monopoly on Quranic teaching, judicial mediation, and inter-clan diplomacy; the tributary Lahma and freedmen Haratin accept their settled stations under both. A formal caste settlement steadies our Bidhan society with a clear division of labor, and inter-clan feuding struggles to reignite.
hassaniya_qadiriyya_tariqa: The Qādiriyya tariqa, the elder Sufi brotherhood of the western Sahara transmitted through the Kunta scholarly lineages and the great zawaya of Wadan, Shinqit, and Walata, anchors the moral and judicial authority of the Bidhan religious caste from the Atlantic coast to the Niger bend. Its silsila of initiation binds Quranic scholars across tribal lines, its lodges mediate the inter-clan disputes that no warrior could settle by force, and its loyalty oaths bind subordinate tribes to their patron zawaya. The entrenched Sufi network lends the Bidhan emirates a religious legitimacy and a web of personal loyalty that no later brotherhood can readily displace.
hassaniya_shinqit_libraries: The manuscript libraries of Shinqit, Wadan, Tichitt, and Walata, preserved by the great scholar families of the western Sahara, catalog tens of thousands of volumes in Mālikī jurisprudence, Maghrebi grammar, classical Arabic poetry, Sufi mystical commentary, and the local genealogies of every Bidhan clan. Our manuscript copyists train new generations in the cursive Saharan script, and binders preserve the older codices in tooled leather. Scholar merchants ship duplicates to libraries in Cairo, Fez, and Tunis. A concentrated culture of the book has earned the western Sahara a textual and scholarly reputation, the Bilād Shinqīṭ, which imported books alone could never give an Atlantic settler society.
haudenosaunee_tradition: The legendary Hiawatha, renowned among the Haudenosaunee people as a great speaker and leader, has set a very high precedent for what a diplomat should be. We will honor him by following his example in our diplomatic relations.
haudenosaunee_heritage: It would be a mistake for our enemies to regard us as weak based on our diplomatic strength. Our warriors are as fierce and proud as those from any militaristic society, and underestimating them is the leading cause of death among our rivals.
tree_of_peace: The Tree of Peace is the legacy of the Great Peacemaker, and is a symbol of our commitment to unity among the different tribes, as well as a representation of the chiefs themselves.
kainerekowa: We must always honor the work of Hiawatha and the Great Peacemaker, the Great Law of Peace, which united our five nations under a single purpose, and gave us our rules of governance.
mourning_wars: It is a long-established tradition of our people to adopt captured warriors into our tribe. But to replenish our numbers and ensure our defensive and offensive strength, we should seek to adopt entire tribes into the Haudenosaunee, not just individual fighters.
haudenosaunee_present_giving: The basis of our trade interactions is represented in the form of gift exchanges. As our people come together and work for the benefit of the whole, the act of gifting is guaranteed to be followed by another gift in return.
warriors_unity: We may not be the largest tribe in terms of sheer number, but our tribal nature gives us something that others lack: unity! Our warriors fight as brothers and stand together on the field of battle. So long as we maintain this tradition, we cannot lose!
captives_in_war: We fight wars mainly to take captives, which replace our own losses. However, not all those captives need to be adopted into our tribe, and some can be used for labor instead.
haudenosaunee_ambition: The Haudenosaunee Confederacy has become a model for success. All nations around us are awestruck by our excellent rulership!
swiss_oath_of_rutli: Let us recite the vow of this new union: We shall be one nation of brothers, and no trouble or danger shall separate us. No foreign tyrant shall ever rule over our realm!
swiss_halberd_infantry: When we defended our freedom in the Battle of Morgarten, we had a very important advantage over the cursed Habsburg invaders: the halberd, a simple yet lethal weapon that can repel any foe with ease. Training our troops to use halberds with skill will give us an advantage against our foes, even if they have superior numbers.
swiss_alpine_passes: The great mountains of the Alps are not mere obstacles to us, they are our home. Their great passes — the Gotthard, the Simplon, the Grimsel — are our streets. Generations of pilgrims, merchants, and armies marching through these treacherous heights have made our people intimately familiar with every route, shelter, and shortcut in them. No foreign army will move through our mountains as swiftly as we do.
swiss_eternal_alliance: We have forged an eternal alliance with our friends in the neighboring Cantons. Had it not been for this treaty, we would have surely succumbed to the Habsburg invaders and fallen under the rule of foreign tyrants yet again. These alliances will ensure our survival for centuries to come.
swiss_mercenaries: Our troops are widely recognized as exceptional combatants. Fortunately for us, we are not permanently in need of their services, which allows us to rent them out to foreign powers, earning extra revenue and providing them with valuable combat experience.
the_swiss_confederation: Every member of our confederation contributes valuable resources to our cause. Our decentralized approach to governing this alliance of states serves a greater purpose, so we cannot break into civil war when disagreements arise between towns, cities, or our cantons.
swiss_reislaufer: Some of our countrymen elect to travel into foreign lands and earn their keep as mercenaries for foreign rulers. Once these return to their home, these men are veteran soldiers and some of the best fighters of Europe. We should form regiments from these veterans and employ them in our own armies.
swiss_recovery_and_prosperity: Past conflicts have shown that repelling invaders is not our only concern. The valleys of our cantons are devastated with each battle; careful steps must be taken to bring prosperity back to our land.
alpine_defensiveness: The Swiss landscape is dominated by rough terrain, mountains, and valleys. We must find a way to overcome the challenges our environment presents, and to find a way to use it as a weapon against any potential invaders.
swiss_religious_refuge: While others exile religious minorities and disruptive figures, we will gladly offer them a home. In Switzerland, they will be able to establish a new life for themselves, and as a result will be inclined to praise our rule.
swiss_tolerance:
Why must we kill each other over obscure issues of transubstantiation and predestination, when we could spend that energy turning our mountain home into a realm united once more?

For that reason, every Canton of Switzerland will have the ultimate jurisdiction over religious matters in their region. While this will not eliminate all religious strife in our country, it will at least ensure that no matter what someone believes, our people will be able to find a place where they are not persecuted.
swiss_clockwork: Some fools think that clockwork is for timekeeping alone, but when one witnesses the power of rotating gears, it is obvious that clockwork can do just about anything one wants it to do. Maybe the Creator of the Universe Himself wound up existence like a clock and let the gears spin on their own, ticking away the centuries. Be that as it may, Swiss clockmakers are the greatest masters of the art — barring God Himself, of course.
swiss_ambition: We do not need to construct a unique identity for our country, since our people readily rally around the banners of their cantons and the ideals of our confederacy. But by funding our most enlightened scholars of our time, we will be able to shape a new age for the Swiss people, and solidify the unique traits of our Eidgenossenschaft. This Helvetism forms the foundation of our Enlightenment.
swiss_banking: We are a sanctuary, not only for persecuted people from other countries, but also for their wealth. In large vaults, hidden away behind strong walls and protected by our most trustworthy soldiers, we will be the best place for every citizen of the poor, war-torn countries of the world to stash their valuables.
paik_system_advance: The Paik System is a corvée labor system where capable adults, the so-called Paiks, are obligated to serve in the state militia in exchange for farmland.
samanta_advance: Sāmanta — neighbor — is a term denoting vassals and tributary chiefs alike. It is a feudal system that has for centuries acted as one of the pillars of our society. While this arrangement is currently losing prominence, it remains a foundation of our political structure.
kalaripayattu_advance: Kalaripayattu — the Practice in the Arts of the Battlefield — is an old Indian martial art with its origins in the Malabar. Warriors of our state shall be trained in the arts of Kalaripayattu to ensure their hand-to-hand and melee prowess.
paik_regiments_advance: Paiks are foot soldiers of India who are renowned for their offensive and defensive versatility and their skill in archery.
advanced_paik_system_advance: Paiks are foot soldiers of India who are renowned for their offensive and defensive versatility and their skill in archery. As the weapons develop, so does their portfolio of skills. Thus, the bows of the early eras have been replaced by the modern musket, yet their versatility still prevails.
celtic_raiders_advance: For millennia, our ferocious and agile guerilla warfare has harried our foes, besting them with a devastating succession of evasive skirmishing and blood-curdling charges.
irish_booleying_advance: In Ireland, cattle rearing is our way of life. The noble bovine is not only a source of food, but a symbol of wealth. By booleying, a system of moving our herds from one distant pasture to another, we can grow that wealth.
irish_monastacism_advance: Although we are now aligned with Roman Catholic practices in principle, religious life in our islands still puts a great focus on lay clergy.
irish_travelling_bards_advance: Traditional poets trained in courtly ways crisscross our lands looking for some likely lord to hire them.
guards_of_the_shannon_advance: The fortress of Athlone, standing astride the mighty river Shannon, is the key to controlling the heart of Ireland. The O'Kellys of Hy Many, long-standing lords of these lands, have fought fiercely to defend their holdings against Norman incursions.
hiberno_norman_keeps_advance: Our Norman forebears built splendid towers to maintain their grip on the hostile interior of Ireland.
irish_frontier_settlement_advance: The land we have seized from the Irish is ripe for exploitation. We just need to ensure that only the right sort of people migrate here to settle these cheap crofts.
ple_irish_viking_towns_advance: The ancient trading ports founded by the Ostmen are still bustling hives of mercantile activity where the canny can get rich.
ple_pale_defenseworks_advance: Our boundary is defined by light defensive works of dykes and palisades designed to deter our unruly neighbors from launching their irritating raids.
ire_grand_jury_system: County grand juries levy the cess for roads, bridges, and courthouses. With judges riding the assizes, oversight tightens in every county.
ire_irish_establishment: A permanent army in Ireland (and controlled from Ireland) keeps garrisons ready and costs down. For our regular soldiery, this means regular pay. For our logisticians and quartermasters, it means a growing network of barracks that keeps the costs in hand.
ire_irish_volunteers: Citizen corps are raised for home defense and coastal watch. Drilling at their own expense, they rouse public spirit and stiffen the line.
cel_defensive: Centuries of living under the shadow of conquest have taught our warriors the art of patience and resilience. We can rush headlong into danger, but we can also endure, defend, and strike only when the moment is right.
cel_western_shore: For millennia we have fished, traded, and fought along the wild Atlantic coasts. From these harsh waters, we have learned seamanship unmatched by any rival.
cel_the_wests_awake: After long centuries of silence, the ancient spirit of the Celtic peoples stirs once more, ready to reclaim its place amongst the great civilizations of the world.
cel_celtic_nations: Our union is founded on the ideal of uniting the diverse peoples of the Celtic world under a shared banner. Through cooperation, we aim to preserve our heritage, promote our values, and ensure that the Celtic nations thrive together in the face of external pressures and changing times.
cel_celtic_diaspora: From crofter to chieftain, many have left our shores through hardship or hope, weaving a far-flung web of kinship that carries our language, customs, and pride to distant lands.
cel_pan_celtic_nationalism: Our vision of a united Celtic world is more than an ideal - it is a rallying call to all who share our heritage. Together, we forge bonds that reach beyond borders, making our identity as enduring as the hills and seas we call home.
jap_bushido: Although never formally codified into specific rules, the way a warrior should behave is clear: A warrior's duty is to fight and win in battle, and to expand the glory of one's own clan, regardless of the methods needed to achieve that.
jap_land_of_the_rising_sun: Japan has a long and glorious history. Our unique cultural traditions, our brave soldiers, and our unconquerable geography make us stronger than many other states in our region. The time has come for the Land of the Rising Sun to take its place among the great nations of this world!
jap_ancestral_legacy: The ancestral lineage of our clan is well-known, and our reputation is a pillar of our identity — one that we strive at all costs to uphold, as our history both defines us and ensures our right to rule.
jap_shinobi: Information is key to gaining the advantage in any situation. To that effect, we have long since used spies and infiltrators to gather reconnaissance. These Shinobi no Mono are usually from the samurai class, although they can also be recruited from the local peasant population, and are sent into enemy territory, where they blend in and establish networks of informants.
jap_head_hunting: The achievements of a warrior in battle are only truly noteworthy if they can be proven. To that end, samurai will collect the decapitated heads of enemies they have slain to present them later to their general. The more numerous and more important the heads that a samurai takes, the better the rewards he will receive.
jap_ichiban_yari: Drawing first blood in battle is an honor and a good omen, and thus our warriors are eager to land the first strike whenever they have the opportunity to do so.
jap_ashigaru: Warfare has always been the domain of the mighty samurai. Recent developments, however, have proved the need for more substantial reinforcements, and thus our battlefields now also include peasant troops. These ashigaru will not be just common rabble, however, as their rigorous training and ample battle experience makes them formidable fighters, on equal footing with the samurai.
jap_daiku_construction: Traditional carpentry techniques, or daiku have been used in Japan since the earliest days of our history. Our wooden buildings are resilient yet flexible, and admired by many for their beauty and skillful construction. From the lowliest hut to the most elaborate palace, wood is our most universal building resource.
jap_wandering_ronin: It is fairly common for samurai to wander the country in search of the best employment opportunities, switching their allegiance to whoever pays them the most. These warriors come and go like the errant waves, but we can always make use of them.
jap_reformed_land_holding: Traditionally, we assessed land value based on size, but this failed to take into account that not all land is the same. From now on, it will be valued according to how much Rice can be grown there. This will streamline related economic actions and make it easier to get the best outcomes from our agricultural ventures.
jap_jokamachi: Turbulent times are gravely dangerous for our people, so for safety, they tend to settle around the security of fortified places. These huddles eventually turn into cities, which of course provide commercial and cultural assets in addition to physical protection for those who huddle behind the walls.
jap_terakoya: These private schools provide basic education to commoners, promoting literacy, numeracy, and moral values. Terakoya play a vital role in fostering a more educated and socially aware populace, contributing to national stability and progress.
jap_codified_bushido: The expected behavior of a warrior is becoming increasingly idealized, with values such as honor and loyalty being given more importance than their actual utility in real battle. This romanticized and codified version of Bushidō, however, will improve how our armies are perceived, even if it is not how they actually behave.
jewish_group_diaspora_firms: Our merchant families maintain commercial partnerships that span the diaspora: branch offices in Fustat, Aden, Mahdia, and Lucena exchange letters of credit, agency contracts, and family firm capital across regions that few non-Jewish merchants traverse. Trust is anchored in kinship, marriage, and shared customary commercial law; our partners in distant cities know one another's signatures and seals. A kinship-based web of trade carries our crown's influence where formal contracts alone, and the rain-fed agricultural economies, could never go.
jewish_group_court_physicians: Our physicians serve at host courts from Iberia to Yemen to Malabar: Jewish-educated medical specialists holding court patents as private doctors to sultans, kings, and emperors. Their offices come bundled with diplomatic missions, court ceremonies, and influence over royal succession crises that no purely mercantile minority could secure. Our physicians sit close to the inner councils of foreign courts and bring our crown a steady channel of news from the highest circles.
jewish_group_hidden_communities: Our communities have learned to wear the religion of our host states publicly while preserving family ties, professional networks, and customary practices in private: Iberian conversos, Persian Mashhadi families, Mallorcan Chuetas, and the assimilated Kaifeng households maintain household kinship and trade firm relationships across what should be a religious divide. Inquisitorial pressure rarely succeeds at severing these communal connections because they are anchored in marriage, partnership, and oral memory rather than in any institution the state can dismantle. The hidden bond between our communities makes a people that cannot easily be unsettled from outside, closer than any purely public minority.
jewish_group_maritime_diaspora: Our merchant houses follow the sea routes of every Jewish-cultural reach: Sephardim along the Atlantic corridors, Mustaarabi across Levantine ports, Cochini along the Malabar spice run, Teimani through the Red Sea, Salonican families through the Adriatic. Our ships' captains may be of any host culture, but the bills of exchange, shipping contracts, and warehouse keepers at every major port are members of our family firm network. Our specialization in maritime networks carries our crown's trade routes across every navigable basin, beyond the reach of any single-region commercial power.
jewish_group_court_financiers: Our family firms serve the absolutist courts of multiple empires: Habsburg Hofjuden financing Imperial armies, Ottoman court agents brokering loans for sultans, Malabar merchants funding regional rajas, Persian-era financiers managing royal mint contracts. These positions are precarious yet enormously lucrative: one provider supplies grain and powder for an entire campaign season, the next handles the royal treasury through a single intermediary. Our role in high finance at court gives our crown leverage at the heart of host state administration, which no purely mercantile family firm possesses.
jewish_group_civic_emancipation: Our community status transforms across the modern era as host states extend civic rights to their Jewish populations: the revolutionary French emancipation decrees, Habsburg patents of toleration, Ottoman Tanzimat reforms, and the gradual liberalization of the British and Russian regimes. The old corporate minority status (chartered quarters, ghetto walls, restricted professions, communal taxes) gives way to individual citizenship and open access to education, the bar, the medical schools, and the civil service. The civic transformation draws our Jewish population into the modern professional classes, no longer confined to historical occupational niches.
mounted_people: Our people have thrived on horseback for centuries, and these majestic creatures are an integral part of our culture and power. We take immense pride in our unrivalled skills in our equine husbandry and talent for mounted archery, both of which contribute to our supremacy on the battlefield.
falconry_mastery: Deeply rooted in our culture, falconry represents a bond forged between our people and these magnificent birds of prey, and we have finely honed our skill in this ancient art. Our falconers are renowned for their ability to train these majestic raptors to hunt and capture prey.
rich_lands: Our lands are rich with fertile soil and abundant resources from the prairies to the dense forests, ready to be transformed by our hardy men and women. We will use every tool at our disposal to wisely manage the land we have been gifted, and thereby bring prosperity to every household.
jurchen_honor: Our people are enthusiastic about feats of strength and other demonstrations of skill, as each Jurchen feels that by showing off their abilities they earn the respect of their peers. This well-earned self-respect makes our warriors immensely brave, ready to fight anyone.
unite_the_tribes: Since the birth of our nation, the Jurchen people have been unified and divided into multiple tribes and alliances, and not always friendly ones. This dynamic has been constant for as long as we can remember — as has the urge to unify all our tribes under a single banner. The time has come to satisfy this long-cherished desire!
leader_under_sky: Our people have been divided for too long, and we need someone strong enough to unite them and make the world tremble at our feet. The Sky will direct the acts and thoughts of this leader, and guide us to a bright future.
foraging_our_way: We are hunters and live in communion with nature, even those of us dwelling in cities. It is in our blood to find the correct path in a dark forest; to know which of Nature's gifts to take with us. This wisdom lets us survive everywhere without difficulty.
the_eight_banners: The Eight Banner System is the core of our society and military. Through hereditary membership and grants of land and income, the Banners are granted elite status, and for good reason — from the conquest of our neighbors to future campaigns, our dominance depends on their might.
deliberative_council: Originally called the 'Council of Deliberation', this body evolved from informal institutions that promoted collaborative governance among the leaders of the realm. The Council's structure has been transformed, focusing on collective aristocratic governance and policy deliberations, mainly in foreign and military affairs. Membership is restricted to military leaders from outside the imperial clan, ensuring elite participation while maintaining the ultimate authority of the ruler.
manchu_script: The Manchu alphabet has emerged, combining Classical Mongolian characters with Jurchen phonetics. This unique writing system facilitates left-to-right vertical column writing. With diverse letter forms and contextual adaptability for initial, medial, final, and isolated positions, it preserves the most subtle nuances of our language.
a_new_dawn: Our nation has been reborn. The old ways of living are gone, like dreams melting into the morning light. It is time for us to face the world as a fully modernized nation.
manchu_reborn: As our nation has undergone fundamental transformations, so will our army. The world has opened itself to us, and new challenges will appear on the horizon. If we want to survive in this new paradigm, we have to be ready to act.
bah_arabian_horses: The climate of India is suboptimal at best for breeding and raising horses. The horses of Arabia, however, are superb mounts that outclass our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply of these horses for our troops.
bah_amir_rebellion: Our state was born from the rebellion of Amir Hasan Gangu against the pathetic rule of Delhi. The victory against the Dehlavi Sultanate still lives on in the minds of our own nobility and military to this day.
bah_nobility_hindu_expansion: Although at times a challenge to the sovereignty of the ruler, the noble class is nonetheless useful to our government, as they are crucial in administrating our vast properties. With winning our independence from Delhi, we gained rulership over almost exclusively Hindu subjects, while our Muslim nobles are a small minority, unable to manage the masses. We must expand and stabilize our aristocracy by promoting promising Hindu candidates into their ranks.
bah_gharbians:
Cutting ties with Delhi to found our own kingdom has loosened our connection with the Muslim-dominated northern parts of India. As our state lacks any form of entrenched Muslim aristocracy, we are in a precarious situation, and we could end up entirely at the mercy of local Hindu nobles.
Fortunately, our reputation precedes us. Tales of the riches of the Deccan are told and retold all over the Muslim world, and many ambitious fortune-seekers make the sea voyage to our ports. By using the vast riches of India to attract talented westerners, or Gharbians, to our court, we can ensure that our country shall never lack able minds to lead our armies, collect our taxes, and rule our subjects.
bah_legacy_of_gisu_daraz:
India in general, and our state in particular, has a history as a center of Sufi teachings. The efforts of our rulers to attract and patronize Sufi sheiks from all over the world are a testament to the piety and the great spiritual strength of our monarchs and our court.
The state adopting the Sufi concepts of spiritual sovereignty and the inclusive nature of the Sufi teachings themselves will help create an environment where the diverse religious faiths of Gharbians and the natives of Deccan alike can mix and thrive without clashes or unproductive quarrels.
bah_meltpot_of_languages: Deccan is a region of many languages and cultures; the great influx of people of Iranian, Turkic, Afghan, and Arabian descent into these lands has accentuated the cosmopolitan nature of our state. While historically the Persian language fulfilled the needs of our predecessors, a new mix of local languages — as well as Persian and Arabic — has grown increasingly common. This mixture of languages has even become a source of cultural inspiration for emerging artists.
bah_karimis:
For centuries, the Indo-Egyptian trade has been dominated by Egypt-based groups of traders and captains known as the Kārimī. Instrumental in the day-to-day business of Indian Ocean trade, this merchant organization is now both wealthy and powerful. From the Tamil coasts and the ports of the Swahili trading cities to the Lower Egyptian port cities past the Gulf of Aden, sultans, nobles, and commoners alike come to buy exotic goods or borrow money for their projects from the Kārimī.
This organization has lately taken a very active interest in our state, and we only stand to gain from cultivating our relationship with them further.
bah_takht_e_firoza: The first thing any guest in our royal audience chamber notices is the Turquoise Throne of our dynasty. This unique piece of royal furniture was originally donated to us by the defeated Telugu Raja Kapaya, and it is in many ways the ultimate symbol of our dynasty. Exquisite and splendidly unique, it embodies the riches of the Deccan and the unusual combination of styles that is the hallmark of our cosmopolitan state.
bah_bahmani_primogeniture: Our unusual practice of always passing the throne to the eldest son of the current ruler has at times created some instability in our realm, as power-hungry regents and opportunistic nobles initially showed little hesitation in trying to take advantage of a child ruler or in supporting an envious relative's claim to the throne. By now, however, the practice has become firmly institutionalized, and when the time for succession comes there are very few who would oppose the true heir of our dynasty.
bah_madrasa_of_mahmud_gawan: For many years now, our state has drained able men from the greater Muslim world, while also incorporating the best of the states that came before us. This has created a rich cosmopolitan culture that is not entirely Farsi, Arabian, Marathi, Telugu, nor Kannadiga in nature. Creating a major madrasa in our capital would serve to further the development of learning this multitude of cultures and also allow the world to see the greatness of our state.
leonese_asturian_inheritance: Our kingdom traces its unbroken political descent from the Christian remnant kingdom of Asturias, the only Iberian realm that never submitted to the conquering Umayyad caliphate after 711. We carry forward the legitimist banner of the Reconquista along with the codes, monasteries, and noble lineages that the Asturian dynasty preserved through two centuries of mountain refuge. This deep dynastic continuity legitimizes every act of our Crown and binds the populations we absorb to a story they cannot easily refuse.
atu_cradle_of_reconquista: At Covadonga in the Asturian mountains, the noble Pelayo's defeat of an Umayyad column around 722 is remembered as the first Christian victory of the Reconquista and the spark from which the Kingdom of Asturias, and every Iberian crown descended from it, would grow. We carry the prestige of being the unconquered remnant, the rock against which the tide of conquest broke. This founding legend lends our crown a moral authority and a claim to legitimacy older and purer than any rival's.
lon_kingdom_from_oviedo: Around 910 our court relocated from the mountain stronghold of Oviedo to the open plain of León, signaling that the Reconquista had pushed far enough south for the kingdom to govern from a proper city again. This move reorganized the royal household, the chancery, and the army around new logistics suited to plains rather than peaks, and gave the realm its enduring name: the Regnum Legionense. The relocation allows the Crown to coordinate its expanding territory with a speed that mountain-bound rivals struggle to match.
lon_order_of_santiago: The Order of Santiago, founded in 1170 under the patronage of the Leonese crown, raises a brotherhood of warrior monks sworn to guard the pilgrim roads and press the Reconquista frontier. Its commanderies hold vast estates and field disciplined heavy infantry and the engineers to storm Moorish strongholds, answering to the Grand Master rather than to any quarrelsome count. The order is the Leonese crown's standing armored fist, stronger than any secular vassal could field.
leonese_gothic_art: Our cathedral of León, the Pulchra Leonina, crowns the kingdom with the most expansive stained-glass program in Christian Iberia, its master stonemasons and glaziers trained in the ateliers that completed Chartres and Reims. We will sponsor new collegiate churches, royal foundations, and Cistercian abbeys on the same compositional principles, providing steady employment to the lineages whose techniques sustain the tradition. This architectural and artistic culture deepens our cultural influence and reduces the cost of every monumental building our Crown commissions.
atu_cantabrian_fisheries: The harbors of the rugged Cantabrian coast send out fleets after hake, sardine, and the right whales hunted from open boats in the Bay of Biscay. Our fishing villages breed the boldest and most weatherly seamen of the northern shore, men whom the royal navy and the merchant fleets alike compete to recruit. This hardy maritime population is a standing reserve of skilled sailors far outweighing the province's size.
lon_canada_leonesa: The great cañadas, the droving roads of León, carry vast flocks and herds on their seasonal march between the summer uplands of the Cantabrian sierras and the winter pastures of the plains. The crown charters and protects the transhumant routes, taxing the livestock and binding the herding towns to royal favor. The pastoral economy brings the realm a steady wealth in meat, a food surplus the rain-poor meseta could not otherwise yield.
lon_cortes_de_leon: In 1188 our king Alfonso IX summoned not only the bishops and great nobles, but also elected representatives of the cities, to the Cortes de León, the earliest parliamentary assembly in European history. These Cortes review royal taxation, deliberate on war and succession, and codify the privileges of the towns whose militias the crown depends on. This institutional partnership between crown and burghers makes our administration more efficient and our subjects more willing to grant the extraordinary taxes our wars require.
leonese_pendon_morado: The Pendón Morado (the purple banner with the silver lion that has marched at the head of every Leonese muster since the creation of the realm) carries a continuity of regional identity that survives every dynastic merger our kingdom undergoes. By placing it ceremonially at every concejo meeting and every parish festival, we knit together the towns, valleys, and pastoral commons under a single visible emblem that no centralizing decree can erase. This symbolic continuity prevents our provincial identity from fading and gives every Leonese a stake in defending what the banner stands for.
atu_mountain_fastness: The Picos de Europa and the Cantabrian Cordillera wall Asturias behind ramparts of rock pierced by only a handful of high, defensible passes. Our mountain militias hold these defiles as their ancestors held them against Moor and Frank, making the province all but impregnable to any invader. This natural fortress lets a small and poor realm defy powers many times its strength.
lon_frontier_expansion: Since the founding of our state, our armies have made consistent pushes to the south against the taifa kingdoms, reaching the Duero under Alfonso III, the Tagus under Alfonso VI, and Extremadura under Alfonso IX. Each new conquest is met with planned repoblación (colonist charters, exemption from manorial dues, and parish foundations) that transforms conquered land into Leonese territory faster than our rivals can manage. This proven method of expansion turns every Reconquista conquest into a permanent integrated province rather than a temporary military possession.
lon_tierra_de_campos: The Tierra de Campos (the rolling clay plain between the Cea and the Pisuerga) is the granary of the Leonese crown, its open fields of wheat and barley feeding the cities of the north. Royal grants and the labor of the monastic granges keep the plough turning across estates that stretch to the horizon. As the granary of the realm, the Tierra de Campos supplies a grain surplus and a prosperity in the towns and cities beyond what the mountain provinces around it can rival.
leonese_textile_industry: The wool from our Tierra de Campos sheep (long-stapled, weather-hardened, and abundant) feeds a network of workshops in León, Astorga, Salamanca, and Zamora that produce the rough cloth our peasants and our infantry depend on. We extend royal protection to the cloth guilds and standardize measures along the Paños de León trade that runs from upland pasture to the Medina del Campo spring and autumn fairs. From wool to finished cloth, the whole chain stays in our hands and weathers every swing in the price of wool.
atu_cider_orchards: The damp green valleys of Asturias are planted thick with apple orchards whose fruit is pressed and fermented into sidra, the everyday drink of every village and the center of its social life. Our pomaradas and llagares sustain a rural economy of smallholders independent of the grain trade of the meseta. Orchard culture lends the Asturian countryside a prosperous, distinctive, and enduring livelihood.
lon_adelantado_mayor_de_leon: The hereditary office of Adelantado Mayor de León, held by the Quiñones lineage from the fourteenth century, consolidates judicial, fiscal, and regional diplomatic authority across the Leonese realm into a single magistracy answerable directly to the Crown. We will channel correspondence with the great houses of León, the tax assessments of the merindades, and the appellate pleas from the corregimientos through this office, bypassing the slower channels of the central Castilian council. Concentrating regional authority in one office extends our administrative reach across the León territories, farther than any Castile-wide office can.
lon_maragato_arrieros: The maragatos of the Astorga hills make themselves the master carriers of the realm, their mule trains hauling salt fish, colonial wares, and royal silver between the Cantabrian ports and the markets of the interior. Tight-knit and trusted, these arrieros run a network of credit and carriage reaching every fair in León and Castile. The carting guild carries the realm's inland commerce and merchant reach far beyond its modest towns.
leonese_provincial_academies: Across our principal cities local enlightenment circles have founded Sociedades Económicas and learned academies that publish memoirs on agriculture, manufacturing, and natural history. These bodies operate without Crown subsidy by attracting clergy, nobles, and burgher subscribers who treat patriotic improvement as a duty of their station. This provincial intellectual network raises literacy across our region and produces a steady supply of administrators competent enough to serve Crown projects far beyond our borders.
atu_coal_basin: Beneath the central Asturian valleys lies the richest coal field in the peninsula, worked in the deep seams of Mieres, Langreo, and the Caudal and Nalón valleys. Our mining towns swell with workers drawn from the surrounding hills and from beyond the mountains, served by new railways cut down to the coast. This coal makes Asturias the fuel and energy heart of the nation's industrialization.
lon_bierzo_vineyards: The sheltered valleys of the Bierzo, ringed by mountains at the western edge of León, ripen the Mencía vines the Camino's monks have tended since the Middle Ages. Terraced slate slopes yield a vintage prized in the markets of the north and shipped down the pilgrim road. Our vines turn land too steep for the plough into a valuable export.
lon_real_casa_moneda: Our royal mint operates as a permanent crown institution, contracting silver and copper supplies through long-term agreements and producing the coinage that pays our garrisons and tax collectors. The Real Casa de Moneda earns the treasury a handsome profit on every coin struck while letting the crown control the silver content of every coin in circulation. This sound coinage lets us borrow on easier terms and keeps money flowing where more disorderly monetary systems run dry.
leonese_industrial_revival: The coal seams of Asturias and the iron deposits of the Bierzo and Vega de Riosa power a regional industrial revival that brings our mountain valleys back into the European economic mainstream after centuries on the margin. Foreign engineers partner with local capital to open minas and fundiciones that transform raw ore into pig iron, rail, and shipplate. This industrial base diversifies our economy beyond pastoral wool and dairy and gives our skilled labor better wages that draw migrants back from the Atlantic emigrant ships.
atu_steel_works: At La Felguera, Mieres, and the mouth of the Nalón, blast furnaces and rolling mills marry local coal to imported ore, turning out the iron and steel of a modern economy. Our metalworks supply the rails, machinery, ship plate, and armaments that the whole country demands. This heavy industry remakes the old mountain refuge of the Reconquista into one of the great workshops of modern Spain.
lon_leonese_collieries: The coal of the Bierzo and the deepening pits of the Laciana and the Nalón feed the forges and railways of an industrial age. Mining towns swell across the León mountains, served by the new lines cut down to the meseta and the coast. This coalfield makes the old kingdom of the Reconquista a fuel house of the modern economy.
lon_modern_brigades: The infantry regiments raised from León and Asturias have always been considered among the steadiest in the Spanish army, and we now reorganize them into modern brigade structures with integrated artillery, light cavalry screens, and combined arms training. Our Brigada Artillada de León and supporting field batteries adopt the latest doctrines for the combined engagement of infantry and guns on industrial battlefields. This modernization makes our brigades among the most capable formations in any campaign the kingdom undertakes.
ligurian_coastal_seafarers: Every community along the Ligurian Riviera (from the fishing harbors of Ventimiglia to the hillside villages above La Spezia) has for centuries sent men to sea in small coastal boats, mastering the currents, hazards, and weather of one of the most demanding coastlines in the Mediterranean. This tradition of practical seamanship produced sailors of unusual quality long before any of our cities built deep-water warships, and the cabotage trade that these men sustained carried goods between ports that no inland road could reach as efficiently. Our seafaring heritage gives our merchants a natural edge in coastal and regional trade, and any galley fleet we put to sea is crewed by men who already know the water.
genoese_maritime_diplomacy: We have built our republic on the twin pillars of commerce and credit, pioneering instruments of debt and exchange that have funded our trading posts from the Levant to the Black Sea since the early Middle Ages. Our colonies and comptoirs across the Mediterranean are as much diplomatic outposts as commercial ones, granting us a reach that no purely military power could match. This network of finance and statecraft ensures our bankers and envoys work as one, reducing the cost of credit and keeping more ambassadors in our service.
ligurian_merchant_diaspora: The merchants of our coast did not wait for the great trading cities to invite them in; they established colonies, agencies, and partnerships in every port they could reach, from the Black Sea settlements of Caffa and Pera to the counting houses of Seville and Lisbon. These Colonie operated on networks of trust and kinship that made Ligurian credit as reliable in Alexandria as at home, and the information that flowed along those networks gave our merchants an advantage in every market they entered. This diaspora turns geography from a limitation into an asset, extending our commercial reach far beyond what the size of our fleet alone would justify.
bank_of_saint_george: Founded to consolidate the mounting debts of the republic, the Casa di San Giorgio has become one of the most sophisticated financial institutions in Christendom. Private creditors and the state share in its governance, channeling Genoese wealth into ventures abroad while keeping the cost of borrowing low. United, public and private capital can finance our ambitions on a grand scale.
ligurian_spirit_of_navigation: The Ligurian coast has produced navigators out of all proportion to its size: Cristoforo Colombo, who opened the western Atlantic to Castilian ambition, Giovanni Caboto, who mapped the northern coast of the New World for the English crown, and a generation of pilots whose skills carried them into every ocean that European ships reached. This tradition of producing men willing to sail beyond the horizon with imperfect charts has given Ligurian seamanship a reputation that attracts investment and patronage from courts that would otherwise never look at our small coast. This culture of navigation elevates our standing among foreign powers and draws skilled settlers and fortune seekers to our harbors from distant lands.
genoese_flexibility: In the turbulent years of the early sixteenth century, Andrea Doria restructured our republic, consolidating the old noble factions into twenty-eight great houses, the Aberghi (Alberghi in standard Italian: great houses), and granting us a political stability we had long been denied. That same pragmatic spirit reshaped our fleet, redirecting our naval expertise toward service across the Mediterranean rather than tying us to a single strategic posture. This reinvention allows us to maintain our navy at reduced cost and to convert our war galleys to lighter vessels when the moment demands it.
ligurian_artisan_craft: The workshops of the Ligurian coast have developed a tradition of decorative craftsmanship: silver Filigrànn-a (Filigrana in standard Italian: filigree) from the city's goldsmiths, maiolica fired in the kilns of Albisola, and intricate velvet weaves that our weavers first perfected in the fourteenth century, goods that found buyers wherever wealthy patrons sought something finer than the common market could supply. This artisan culture thrived in the same workshops that produced the less glamorous goods of daily commerce, giving our craftsmen a flexibility that purely luxury-focused guilds could not match. This tradition of decorative excellence attracts the most skilled artists of the age to settle among us and ensures that the work they produce commands premium prices wherever it is sold.
the_age_of_the_genoese: The great banking fairs of Piacenza have made Genoese financiers the indispensable creditors of the Spanish crown and the arbiters of European capital flows for generations. The immense wealth that passes through our hands finds its way into the palaces and villas of our merchant nobility, who have built the most far-reaching commercial network in the Mediterranean world. This supremacy over European finance makes our merchant network more efficient than any rival's, and the trade it channels through Genoa fills our treasury with returns drawn from every major commercial circuit in Europe.
ligurian_communal_councils: The self-governing communes that had managed Ligurian harbor life for centuries were gradually formalized and rationalized, replacing informal custom with written charters, elected committees, and standardized administrative procedures that smoothed the work of local government. These reformed councils gave the merchant class a structured forum for managing the affairs of their communities without dependence on noble patronage or distant judicial authority, embedding a civic competence in the institutions of every Ligurian town. Our administrative tradition gives our government an unusual depth of trained civic talent and makes our institutions more responsive to the burghers who sustain our commerce.
genoese_school: The prosperity of centuries of trade has made Genoa a city of collectors and patrons, and from this milieu there has emerged a distinct Genoese School of painting celebrated for its mastery of dramatic light and rich texture. Artists nurtured in our republic have carried Genoese taste and prestige to courts and collections across Europe. This flourishing of artistic culture deepens our traditions and extends our influence far beyond what politics alone can achieve.
ligurian_enlightenment: The philosophers and jurists of Liguria have engaged as deeply with Enlightenment thought as any school in Europe, arguing that the principles of reason and natural law demand a wholesale rethinking of how states govern and laws are made. We draw on this tradition to reform our institutions from within, replacing custom and privilege with codified procedure and bringing the best administrative minds of the age into public service. This commitment to rational governance makes our laws clearer, our reforms cheaper, and our state harder to destabilize.
gen_free_port: As the great Atlantic trade routes have drawn commerce away from the Mediterranean, we have answered by declaring our harbor a Porto Franco, a free port open to merchants of all nations, exempt from the duties and restrictions that weigh down our rivals. Ships that once bypassed Liguria now put in at our quays, and the city fills again with foreign factors, warehouses, and coin. This openness to all comers turns our harbor into one of the busiest entrepôts of the western Mediterranean, drawing trade and people in equal measure.
milanese_tradition: The cities of Lombardy have governed themselves through elected consuls and independent courts since the time of the Lombard League, building a tradition of civic law that no emperor has managed to fully dismantle. We draw on this legacy by codifying these municipal liberties into a formal charter, granting our towns a recognized degree of self-governance in exchange for their loyal contribution of taxes and troops. This compact between the crown and the city keeps our urban population engaged and invested, reducing the friction that bleeds other states dry whenever they need to call on their subjects.
milanese_heritage: The coiled serpent of the Visconti has become the most recognized symbol of power in Northern Italy, stamped on our coins, our seals, and the gates of every city that answers to us. By making the Biscione the official mark of the ducal state, we tie the region's loyalty to our dynasty rather than to any one noble faction. Such visual authority makes it far harder for rivals to question our rule, and the serpent on our ambassadors' credentials opens doors that stay shut to other Italian lords.
patron_of_music: Lombard merchants and bankers have established themselves across European cities for generations, lending to courts and trading houses that find no more reliable source of credit anywhere else. By formalizing this reputation through regulated exchange houses and letters of credit with fixed terms, we make our financial network a deliberate instrument of the state rather than a scattered collection of private ventures. This reach into foreign treasuries gives us a voice in the courts of Europe that our military strength alone could never secure.
renaissance_prince: The Veneranda Fabbrica del Duomo has maintained a permanent workforce of stonecutters, engineers, and master builders in continuous employ for generations, treating the Cathedral not as a project with an end but as an institution that trains craftsmen and refines technique for as long as the work demands. We have extended its remit and its funding, ensuring that the knowledge it preserves flows outward to every construction site in our territory. This institution turns Milan into a school of practical building, and the craftsmen it trains are sought across the whole of northern Italy.
age_of_condottieri: The canal network that threads through the Lombard plain started as a simple irrigation system but has grown into the arteries of our entire regional economy, connecting Milan to the Po and carrying grain, timber, and finished goods at a fraction of the cost of road transport. We have invested in widening and deepening these waterways, building new locks that allow heavier barges to move year-round without depending on seasonal water levels. This network cuts the cost of supplying our cities and moving troops, making Lombardy one of the most efficiently administered territories in Italy.
lowered_power_of_barons: A breastplate made in our workshops commands a price that craftsmen in Cologne or Toledo cannot match, and our armories supply courts and captains from Portugal to Poland. We formalize the armorers' guilds under ducal oversight, setting standards that protect our reputation and keep the technical knowledge, and the profit, within our walls. This monopoly on premium military equipment brings us steady revenue and keeps our own troops better equipped than any enemy who has to import their plate from elsewhere.
merchant_princes: Michelangelo Merisi, born in a small town near Bergamo, developed a way of painting light and shadow so direct and brutal that it made the work of every other school look artificial by comparison. His followers spread the Chiaroscuro technique from our cities to Rome, Naples, and Madrid, and patrons have started to commission works explicitly in the Lombard manner. This reputation turns our cities into destinations for collectors and scholars, and the artists we train are in demand everywhere they go.
encouragement_of_philosophers: Carlo Borromeo's administration of Milan became the most closely studied model of institutional reform of the age: rigorous reorganization of local hierarchies, standardized training for officials, and regular inspection visits that reached every village in our territory. We adopt his model wholesale, using every institution at our disposal to extend education and discipline throughout our realm. This reform builds a population that is both more literate and more tightly bound to the institutions of the realm, making civic order far easier to maintain.
lombard_silk_masters: The mulberry groves and silk workshops of Lake Como and the Lombard plain supply the courts of Europe with the finest silk cloth available, and our weavers have refined the production process to a degree that foreign competitors struggle to replicate. We protect this advantage by regulating the export of raw silk and the techniques of our master weavers, ensuring that the value-added work stays within our borders rather than leaving as cheap raw material. This control over the full production chain turns silk from a local trade into a steady source of revenue that holds its value even when other commodity prices fall.
rulership_of_enlightened_principals: Our city produced Cesare Beccaria, whose treatise on crimes and punishments has become the most-read legal text in Europe, arguing that laws should deter crime through certainty rather than cruelty. By reforming our criminal code along these lines (replacing torture and arbitrary sentencing with proportional penalties and open courts) we create a legal system that the urban population sees as fair rather than predatory. This makes our cities easier to govern and more appealing to merchants and investors who know their disputes will be resolved by law rather than by bribes.
lombard_the_manifattura: In the foothills around Bergamo and Como, English spinning frames and power looms are replacing the old cottage workshops, and the mills running off Alpine streams have begun producing cloth faster and cheaper than any handweaver can match. We have invested in this transition by building company towns and bringing in foreign engineers to train our workers, turning what was a scatter of family looms into a modern industry. This manufacturing base makes Lombardy the productive heart of Italy, and the wealth it generates flows into every corner of our territory.
milanese_ambition: We have raised a theater on the site of the old church of Santa Maria alla Scala, large enough to seat two thousand and fitted with stage machinery that no other house in Europe can match. The first night drew every ambassador, merchant prince, and noble family who could claim a connection to Milan, and within a season premieres here were being discussed from London to Saint Petersburg. This stage makes our court the cultural arbiter of the continent, and the artists who succeed at La Scala carry our city's name everywhere they travel.
nair_military_advance: The Nairs are a diverse group of Hindu castes from Malabar and have a long history of involvement with the military. Their experience, as well as their role for the Kalari, will be of great value in our current conflicts.
maltese_the_rahal_watch: The Maltese landscape has become defined by the Raħal (the village), centered around a fortified parish church. Unlike European feudal manors, the Maltese village is a tightly knit kinship network where the common people manage their own local security. This fosters a culture of the 'Watchman State', where every villager is trained to spot sails on the horizon and retreat to the Dejma (local militia) posts, turning the islands into a decentralized, self-repairing defensive grid.
maltese_the_korsa: With the rise of Mediterranean piracy, Maltese commoners are joining the fray. By granting letters of marque, we can benefit the realm by creating a class of 'Sailor-Merchants' who see the sea as a battlefield for both profit and faith. This will turn us into the 'Vikings of the South', experts in boarding actions and coastal raiding. This maritime aggression will ensure the coastline is guarded by a fleet of aggressive, privately funded coast guards who know every hidden cove.
maltese_the_bajada: Our culture has produced a specialized class of 'Night Runners,' or Bajada. These are men with deep knowledge of the area who can navigate the island's rocky karst and sheer cliffs in total darkness. In a military context, they are the ultimate tactical couriers, slipping through enemy lines or swimming between harbor forts during blockades. This culture of stealth will allow us, if institutionalized, to develop an army of spies that no enemy can detect.
maltese_the_modernized_dejma: In the wake of the new threats, the informal village watch known as the Dejma is in need of modernization. We will develop a national militia system where every male between 16 and 60 is assigned a specific post. This will create a culture of the 'Soldier-Peasant', where the agricultural cycle is intertwined with military drills. This widespread martial literacy will ensure that the islands can never be taken by a surprise landing, as the entire countryside functions as a high-readiness reserve force that supports the professional soldiers of the realm.
maltese_the_festa_ritualism: Our identity is centered on the Festa and religious processions, which are organized with military precision. These elaborate celebrations, characterized by grand processions, ornate street decorations, and communal banquets, serve as the primary glue for Maltese society. This culture of public piety and shared ritualism transcends class barriers, uniting the urban burghers and rural farmers in a common identity of intense religious devotion. By channeling their resources into the aesthetic and spiritual life of their local communities, the Maltese foster an incredible level of internal cohesion and social harmony, ensuring that the archipelago remains a unified and culturally vibrant society even under the pressures of external threats.
maltese_center_of_the_mediterranean: As our island lies in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea, our maritime culture has shifted toward industrial ship repair and global logistics. Our Grand Harbor will become the premier naval dockyard of the world as local artisans adapt their ancient stoneworking and carpentry skills to the era of steam and iron. This industrial seamanship will turn the islands into a global coaling station and repair hub, ensuring that our fleet remains technologically superior to those of our rivals.
maori_ta_moko_advance: With the intricate curves and spirals of Tā Moko, we ritualistically etch pigment into our very skin, transforming our bodies into living tapestries of honor and history.
maori_ceremonial_haka_advance: The ground shakes as our warriors perform the Haka, their fierce cries and synchronized movements echoing across the battlefield. This intimidating ceremonial war dance emboldens the heart of every warrior, granting a significant morale boost to land forces.
maori_whakapapa_advance: Strength and unity come from knowing one's Whakapapa, the intricate web of genealogical connections that binds an iwi together. This deep understanding of collective ancestry fosters a united front against all adversities.
maori_te_reo_advance: We know that by preserving and nurturing Te Reo, our sacred language, we maintain a vibrant connection to our culture and traditions.
maori_rua_kumara_advance: By perfecting the art of growing and storing kūmara tubers in specially-constructed rua, or storage pits, we can ensure that our bellies are filled even in the harshest of winters.
maori_he_whakaputanga_advance: The so-called 'Declaration of the Independence of New Zealand' is a document that once and for all establishes a unified Māori state that is independent. With the wording fully understood by all sides, our chieftains may finally unite, and be free from foreign interference.
mhr_tradition_of_military_service: Marathi cavalrymen have a long tradition of service as 'Bargirs' for the Deccan sultanates. The increased militarization of the Deccan due to the many wars fought in the area has made our cavalry one of the most dangerous forces in India.
mhr_peasant_soldiers: The villages of the Desh are full of able men who would be more than willing to serve in our armies. Let us recruit the Marathi-speaking members of our population into our military.
mhr_ashta_pradhan_advance: Ashta Pradhan - Modern Council of Ministers - is the system of ministerial delegation used by the Marathi people. The council is tasked with guiding the administration of the state, overviewing matters of the military, finances, diplomacy, and religion alike.
mhr_office_of_the_peshwa: The Peshwa Shall be our chief minister, entirely devoted to both civil administration and overseeing military operations. This consolidation of power will make us versatile enough to expand quickly and efficiently.
mhr_forts_of_maharashtra: In these hilly and densely forested lands, maintaining a series of forts is an offensive necessity as well as a defensive one. Meticulous maintenance of our fortifications should therefore be a top priority.
mhr_encourage_brahmin_ties: Our financial sector is dominated by Brāhmaṇa banking families. Let us integrate them further in our administration by hiring them as tax collectors, and creating regulations to strengthen their rights and protect their traditions. We will have gained the favor of our financiers as well as access to learned and able administrators.
median_lo_statuto_del_comune: Before most of Europe had thought to write its customs down, the cities of our region had already codified their laws, established their councils, and set out the duties of every citizen and magistrate in the pages of the Statuto. From Ancona to Viterbo, these documents were revised, contested, and renewed by each generation, creating a living tradition of civic argument that neither feudal lords nor passing conquerors could wholly extinguish. This heritage of written law makes our institutions resilient and our burghers invested in the city they help to govern.
pap_head_of_the_church: The Bishop of Rome holds a position unlike any other in Christendom: not merely the highest-ranking prelate but the Vicarius Christi, whose pronouncements on matters of faith bind every Catholic ruler and kingdom whether they welcome them or not. We cultivate this authority as much through spiritual relationship as through institutional power, presenting ourselves as the father of all the faithful rather than simply their ecclesiastical superior, which gives rivals pause before they choose open confrontation with the See of Rome. This dual standing as institutional head and spiritual father generates a continuous religious influence across Europe and makes antagonizing us a costly act for any ruler who depends on the loyalty of Catholic subjects.
pea_fontana_maggiore: Before we had painted our greatest canvases or trained our most celebrated condottieri, we had already declared our ambition in water and stone: the Fontana Maggiore, sculpted by Nicola and Giovanni Pisano and fed by a new aqueduct the whole commune funded, rising at the heart of Perugia as proof that no city in central Italy was richer, prouder, or more capable of collective ambition. The fountain gathered every saint, every trade good, and every classical virtue into a single monument and said with marble what no charter could say as well. This civic statement draws pilgrims and merchants to our center and tightens our hold over the streets they fill.
spl_duchy_of_spoleto: We are the inheritors of the great Duchy of Spoleto, the Lombard dominion that once stretched from Umbria to the edges of the Mezzogiorno, and where other communes forgot their martial origins we kept the garrison tradition alive in every hilltop tower and every lord's keep across our lands. The memory of that broad territorial authority shapes how our nobility thinks about defense and how our peasants think about obligation, producing a social compact organized around the protection of altitude and stone. A legacy of distributed fortification and soldierly culture lends our armies discipline and our territory an enduring strength, beyond any city-state built from trade alone.
median_studio_generale: The university at Perugia, founded in 1308, placed itself under civic rather than ecclesiastical authority, and the schools that followed across our region trained the lawyers, notaries, and administrators who carried the business of the Italian commune forward. Our cities offered the libraries, the patronage, and the debating culture that drew men of learning from across the peninsula, making legal and philosophical training as natural a product of central Italy as any craft. Learned governance prepares our officials in law and argument as their counterparts in more purely feudal regions are rarely prepared.
pap_the_word_of_the_lord: When the Papacy speaks in matters of faith and governance, it speaks with an authority that no secular ruler can claim: the force of divine mandate expressed through the Bulla Papalis, a formal pronouncement that carries the weight of scripture to every Catholic court in Europe. We reinforce this with a legal tradition that stretches back to the donation of imperial authority itself, giving us not only the prestige of God's representative but the documented right to intervene in worldly affairs, sanction wars, and call the powerful to account before a higher court than any king commands.
