This standing as both spiritual voice and legal arbiter means that when we recognize a cause as just, allies gather faster and rivals hesitate longer than they would for any purely secular power.
pea_scuola_del_perugino: Pietro Vannucci, the Perugino, built the most admired workshop in Umbria within our walls, and his students fanned across Italy carrying the grace of the Umbrian style wherever commissions took them. Raphael came here to learn at his feet before Rome claimed the greater man, and the city that taught the teacher of Raphael carries an artistic reputation no rival in our region can easily dismiss. This tradition of workshop teaching and intensive apprenticeship makes our city a magnet for painters, patrons, and the steady flow of commissions that follows wherever skilled hands gather.
spl_lippi_frescoes: We invited Filippo Lippi to paint the apse of our cathedral, and what he gave us was the Stories of the Virgin, one of the most luminous and tender fresco cycles of the fifteenth century, left unfinished only by his death in Spoleto itself, where he was buried with honors in the church he had transformed. His tomb in our cathedral turned a patronage arrangement into a permanent pilgrimage point for the cultivated and curious across all of Italy. This artistic legacy deepens our intellectual reputation and draws the learned visitors whose presence sharpens the quality of inquiry throughout our city.
median_bastioni_e_rocche: The Italian Wars proved that medieval curtain walls could not stop artillery for more than a morning, and our hill towns responded by turning their greatest natural asset (the ridge, the spur, the ravine) into systems of angled bastions and compact Rocche that made each town a distinct tactical problem. Architects and military engineers rebuilt our defenses in stone and rammed earth, positioning artillery platforms at the angles that most terrified attacking batteries. This tradition of fortification adapted to terrain makes our territories harder to overrun and far costlier for any invader to hold.
glory_of_rome: The great popes of our age have transformed Roma from a city of medieval ruins into the most magnificent court in Christendom, commissioning artists, architects, and scholars to fill the Vatican with beauty that will outlast any dynasty and draw the eyes of Europe to the Apostolic See. We build on the bones of the ancient empire deliberately, wrapping our spiritual authority in the prestige of classical civilization and ensuring that every ambassador who enters our city understands he is visiting a power with roots older than any kingdom he serves. This investment in permanent magnificence means our prestige does not diminish with the passing of individual popes, because what we have built speaks for itself long after the man who commissioned it is gone.
pea_the_griffin_companies: Our city's emblem is the Griffin, and nowhere has it been carried further than on the banners of the Baglioni condottieri who sold their swords (and won wars) across the length of the peninsula. Perugia produces soldiers the way Florence produces painters: in quantity, at quality, with an instinct for command honed by centuries of factional street fighting and seasonal raiding. This martial tradition breeds officers who inspire loyalty and soldiers who hold their nerve when less experienced men break.
spl_ponte_delle_torri: The ancient Ponte delle Torri (part Roman aqueduct, part fortified bridge) strides across the Tessino gorge on ten great piers, giving us control of the main Apennine passage between Umbria and the Marche. Merchants who wish to cross the mountains must cross our bridge, and we have never been reluctant to collect what that privilege is worth in tolls, intelligence, and deference. This structure makes our territory a natural chokepoint, pulling trade inward and making any would-be aggressor calculate the cost of that crossing before they march.
median_baroque_sacred_patronage: The religious upheavals of the age demanded a visual response, and our cities answered with an explosion of chapels, altarpieces, and sacred facades that transformed every urban skyline into a theater of piety. Confraternities, civic councils, and wealthy patrons competed to commission the most luminous images, the most dynamic sculptures, and the most persuasive devotional paintings their treasuries could afford. This tradition of sacred patronage sustains our artists, fills our streets with devotional imagery, and signals to every visitor that our culture lives at the center of a confident and expressive spiritual life.
centralize_the_states: The Council of Trent has reformed doctrine and sharpened the institutional boundaries of the Church, but the Papal States themselves remain a patchwork of cities, lordships, and client territories whose local princes have long treated our authority as negotiable. We act now to close that gap, absorbing the revenues, appointments, and legal jurisdictions that local lords have quietly accumulated over generations, and placing them under direct administration from Rome in the manner that the reformed Curia demands. With crown authority consolidated over our territories, the Papacy has the financial and administrative foundation that the Counter-Reformation's ambitions require.
pea_guerra_del_sale: When the Pope imposed his salt monopoly, our people took up whatever weapons lay to hand; hence the papal mockery that named our uprising the Guerra delle Forche, the War of the Forks. We lost that war and were humiliated (the Baglioni expelled, the Rocca Paolina built directly over their palaces as a stone declaration of contempt) yet the defeat calcified into something more durable than pride. This bone-deep suspicion of outside authority makes every Perugian hill a natural fortress and every invader understand that whatever they take from us will cost more to hold than any strategic advantage can justify.
spl_cardinals_bulwark: Cardinal Albornoz built the Rocca Albornoziana not as a gesture but as a declaration, a fortress of such impregnability that every petty lord between Rome and Perugia understood that central power had returned in earnest, and that Spoleto stood as its most fortified instrument in central Italy. We have inherited both the structure and the institutional role it embodies, maintaining our city as the most orderly and disciplined administrative center in the region through every upheaval of the age. This combination of military solidity and civic order keeps our population unified, our burgher class literate in their civic duties, and our walls resistant to the storms of revolt and rebellion that trouble less well-governed territories.
median_jubilee_economy: The Holy Years that Rome declared every quarter-century brought pilgrims from every corner of Latin Christendom onto the roads of our territory, and the Grand Tour that followed brought a second wave of wealthy and curious northerners willing to pay generously for comfort, guidance, and company. Our inns, markets, and workshops learned to serve an international clientele, and the money they left behind flowed through every level of our economy. This tradition of hosting the faithful and the curious makes our cities prosperous far beyond what local production alone could sustain.
ecclesiastical_primacy: The Peace of Westphalia has excluded us from the diplomacy of princes, but it has not settled the question of who speaks for the Catholic Church within each Catholic kingdom, a question now pressed with dangerous urgency by those who would make the Church a department of the crown. We assert our primacy over the bishops of France, Germany, and Austria not as a formality but as a living doctrinal reality, condemning the propositions of Gallicanism and forcing clergy who have drifted toward national loyalties to account for the authority they owe to Rome. This reassertion of the Pope's exclusive right to define doctrine brings wavering churches back under the orthodoxy of the Holy See and restores the flow of tithes and ecclesiastical revenues that national rulers had begun to redirect toward themselves.
pea_umbrian_academies: Long after our political independence was absorbed into the Papal States, the Accademia del Disegno and the learned societies we maintained under papal patronage kept our intellectual and artistic culture alive, training the officials, theorists, and artists who staffed institutions far beyond our own borders. Every great power on the peninsula knew that Perugian training produced reliable men, and the steady demand for our graduates made our academies prosperous even as our influence diminished. This tradition of practical learned culture sharpens every instrument of governance we exercise and ensures our city punches above its political weight in the councils that matter.
spl_the_spoletine_silk: The mulberry groves of our valley have fed silkworms that supplied the finest weavers in the Papal States for centuries, and the resulting Spoletine silk reached the altars of Rome and the wardrobes of courts as far as France and the Habsburgs. Our merchants built a prosperous burgher class on the back of this trade, one with enough surplus to educate its children and enough political sense to keep the guild networks running through every succession of papal governors. This luxury craft tradition fills our treasury from foreign demand and sustains the middling commercial class whose stability is the surest foundation of our peace.
median_enlightenment_civic_reform: The rationalist currents of the eighteenth century found in our communal tradition a soil already prepared to receive them, cities long accustomed to debating their own governance, recording their decisions, and holding their magistrates to account in writing. Reform-minded governors and learned academies pushed for clearer codes, more orderly urban plans, and more predictable administration across the towns and countryside we govern. This embrace of rational governance makes our institutions more efficient and our subjects more inclined to see the state as a partner in civic life rather than an obstacle to it.
pap_the_concordat: The political earthquakes of revolution and war have stripped away much of our temporal power, yet the fundamental need of states for religious legitimacy has not diminished, and it is precisely this need that we turn to our advantage in the formal treaties we call Concordats. We negotiate with each sovereign power separately, trading some degree of independence in administrative matters for legally binding recognition of Church rights, the security of our seminaries, and the formal standing of Catholic clergy within their borders. This system of bilateral agreements transforms every Catholic state from a potential adversary into a partner bound by treaty, giving us a diplomatic reach that no army could have preserved.
pea_the_old_university: When revolution swept across Italy, our ancient university responded not by retreating into its medieval privileges but by opening its doors to the sons of merchants and artisans who would carry the new politics forward. The faculty of the Università degli Studi di Perugia produced the lawyers and pamphlet writers who made the Risorgimento possible in Umbria, turning a scholastic institution into an engine of civic transformation. With such a gift for turning learning into organization, no reform our government wishes to pursue will lack educated men who know how to carry it out.
spl_vale_of_spoleto: The broad agricultural valley cradled between our hills has been the material foundation of our prosperity since antiquity, and we have spent the revolutionary era improving it: drainage canals, systematic crop rotation, and the redistribution of marginal land into productive holdings that sustain our laboring population through the economic shocks that less prepared states cannot absorb. The Vale of Spoleto now feeds our city, supplies our markets with surplus, and generates the agricultural capital that any serious industrial ambition requires as its foundation. This inherited fertility, carefully tended and rationally improved, turns every season into a buffer against the disruptions that ruin neighbors who have spent their resources on less durable investments.
mercantile_spirit: Naples, inspired by the influential maritime republic of Amalfi, boasts a vibrant culture of trade. Strategic ports, including the city of Naples itself, served as vital hubs, connecting the kingdom to distant lands and fostering economic prosperity through commercial exchanges and the flourishing exchange of goods and ideas.
university_naples: Founded in 1224 by Emperor Frederick II, the University of Naples is one of Italy's oldest public institutions. Embracing a secular ethos, it has provided generations of students with a comprehensive education and contributed to intellectual advancements across various fields.
consolidate_the_royal_domain: We have inherited a wealthy realm, but we have been stymied from achieving true prosperity by the constraints of archaic laws and customs. Previous rulers balanced noble privilege with economic power, but we must bring attitude and regulations into the modern era. By strengthening courts of the nobility and consolidating their landholdings, we will create a clearer legal hierarchy. Simultaneously, we will empower cities as centers of royal authority and encourage the proliferation of urban trade and craftsmanship.
academia_pontaniana: For a long time, Naples has striven to be a center of modern learning, attracting the great minds of the age and spreading the light of the Renaissance. Under the leadership of Giovanni Pontano, these discussion circles have been given structure and organization. It is only fitting that we name the academy after its industrious leader.
crush_the_barons: Local barons still exert a large degree of power over the Neapolitan countryside. If we wish to continue centralizing our kingdom, we must crush the power of these barons, or risk them conspiring against us.
encouraged_city_living: We have inherited an exquisite city from our predecessors. We must continue to beautify and improve this metropolis of the Mediterranean so that it can continue to grow and prosper. No longer can we content ourselves with merely repairing and maintaining the port and buildings; we shall make holistic improvements that better sustain our people by also building aqueducts, draining wetlands, and paving more roads.
city_of_artists: Through patronage of the world's greatest artists, the glory of our city will become known throughout the world. All will marvel at the greatness of our painters, poets, singers, and actors. Let Neapolitan culture be the mark by which other centers of art are measured!
expanded_arsenale: For centuries, the Arsenale of Naples has been the center of our ship production and our main naval installation. However, it needs to be expanded and modernized to remain effective against hostile Mediterranean fleets. Let us expand both the commercial and military strength of our port, building a greater Arsenale to maintain a larger, more powerful fleet.
a_central_power: Our advantageous central position in the Mediterranean enables effortless access to any shore. We should capitalize on this asset to seek alliances, forge new friendships, and expand our borders. With the sea as our gateway, opportunities abound for growth and prosperity in our quest for greater influence and security.
institutional_reorganization: By abolishing the Collateral Council and establishing the Real Camera di Santa Chiara, we will implement important legal reforms in Naples. Ongoing projects will aim to reorganize the legislative complex, consolidate laws into the Codice Carolino, and implement the Onciario Cadastre for tax reform.
neapolitan_army_reforms: Our nation needs to undergo sweeping military reforms, modernizing its armed forces to meet the challenges of the changing battlefield. These reforms will sharpen our tactics, simplify our chain of command, and improve our training, making us a formidable force in our region.
neapolitan_industrialization: Naples has witnessed a gradual industrialization process over the past decades. Key sectors such as textiles, shipbuilding, and ironworks have experienced significant growth, fueled by investments and technological advancements. This shift towards industrialization will play a significant role in transforming Naples into a major economic center.
npl_himalayan_homeland: Our people have lived since time immemorial in the shadow of very mountains that sustain the Heavens. The high passes, the steep ridgelines, the deep-cut river valleys — these are not obstacles to us but the very fabric of our homeland. Even the air itself is different than that of the lowlands, and no army from the plains can expect to move through these lands as our soldiers do.
npl_the_divya_upadesh: The Divya Upadesh lays out nine principles that form the core of political and national life in Nepal, as well as guidelines for successful foreign policy. It encapsulates centuries of Nepali thought on governance, war, and peace. Following these principles, Nepal shall be able to avoid the subversion of nearby empires and marauding foreigners.
npl_gurkhas: Gurkha are troops of Nepali origins (as their name are quite interchangeable) who are infamous for their unbreakable bravery and discipline in combat.
flemish_cloth_making: The Late Middle Ages saw the birth of a powerful textile industry in the Low Countries. Manufactured from imported English and Castilian wool, fabric of the highest quality were exported to all of Europe.
polders_advance: The Low Countries are highly susceptible to flooding, and the many disastrous floods that happened between the 11th and 14th centuries led to the creation of the Zuiderzee. This excessive flooding also caused coastal soils to become uselessly salinated. Thankfully, we now have the technology to reclaim this damaged land and use it productively for agriculture.
netherlandish_ship_building: As the Low Countries are home to some of Europe's greatest port cities, it is only fitting that they should also boast some of Europe's greatest shipyards. Being able to employ skilled local craftsmen dramatically reduces the costs of acquiring new merchant fleets.
nomadic_legacy: Our people are born in the saddle, free to roam the world without the need to put down roots.
piedmontese_the_ricet: Specially linked to the Piedmontese countryside, villages have traditionally developed the Ricetto (in standard Italian and Ricèt in Piedmontese), a fortified area within the town used to store the community's grain and wine and provide refuge during raids. This is not a lord's castle, but a communal asset managed by the villagers. So the peasantry has survived the frequent wars between the various nations of the area, and the state's farms and workshops remain intact even during invasions.
mfa_the_paleologue_dynasty: The ancient blood of the Paleologue gives our marquisate a dignity and legitimacy that commands respect from the greatest courts of Europe. This lineage connects us to a world of ceremony and diplomacy that most smaller states can only admire from afar. We carry this heritage as a shield as much as an ornament, using it to open doors that our armies alone could never unlock.
pie_ordinanza_piedmontese: For generations, our mountain lords levied troops on custom and season, calling men to arms when the harvest was done and sending them home before the first snow. We have replaced this improvised tradition with a formal ordinance that fixes the size, equipment, and training standards of our infantry and binds our cities and rural lords to consistent obligations that can be called on at any time. This Ordinansa Piemontèisa (Ordinanza Piemontese in standard Italian: Piedmontese Ordinance) gives our army a professional core that holds its cohesion between campaigns, advancing the discipline and tradition of arms that lesser levies can never maintain.
piedmontese_le_fere_del_piemont: The Piedmontese cities have been formalizing great trade fairs across the region. By providing state protection and tax exemptions for international merchants, the state will turn the Alpine crossings into corridors of wealth. This will bring us riches, providing the necessary funds to purchase the loyalty of independent lords.
mfa_casale_monferrato: We have made Casale Monferrato the heart of our state, a city that grows in commerce and craft under the shelter of our rule. The merchants and guilds of the city bring life to its streets and revenues to our treasury, and its position on the roads between great powers makes it a natural gathering place for trade. This city is our richest possession and the proof of what sound governance can build.
pie_cavalleria_piemontese: The plains of the Po where they open onto our territory have long supported a class of lesser noble horsemen whose wealth depended on the quality of their horses and the reputation of their lance arm. We have organized these scattered men-at-arms into a formal cavalry, standardizing their equipment and training in coordinated maneuver rather than the individual charge that served in an earlier age. This Cavalleria Piemontese can screen our flanks, pursue a broken enemy, and fight in the loose formations that modern battlefield conditions demand, setting our armies free of the pace of infantry.
piedmontese_the_piassafort: Recognizing our position as the gateway to Italy, we will begin transforming our cities into Piassafòrt (Fortress-Cities). This will require a cultural reinforcement toward living under constant threat, where city planning is dictated by the needs of artillery and garrisons. This engineering excellence will make Piedmont the most difficult region in Italy to conquer, forcing foreign powers to negotiate rather than invade.
mfa_the_court_culture: Our court has become a gathering place for artists, scholars, and musicians drawn by the patronage and refined taste we offer. We prize the Arts of the Court as instruments of prestige, and the works produced under our roof reflect well on our name wherever they travel. This investment in culture returns in reputation what it costs in coin.
pie_via_delle_gallie: The ancient road descending from the Alpine passes into the Po plain once carried the legions of Rome; it has never ceased to carry merchants, envoys, and armies for whom the Piedmontese corridor is the most direct route between Italy and the north. We invest in the maintenance and security of these roads, building waypoints and toll stations that bring reliable revenue and ensure that goods in transit can move faster through our territory than through any rival route. This control over the Via d'le Gàlie (Via delle Gallie in standard Italian: Road of the Gauls) makes us an indispensable link in the chain of European commerce, enlarging our markets and giving our envoys natural openings at the courts that depend on the roads we manage.
piedmontese_the_nebbiolo_vigne: While cultivated since antiquity, we will implement a scientific approach to viticulture in the vineyards of our region. By supporting the modernization and standardization of the vineyards and regulating the production of high-value wines (Nebbiolo), the state will ensure a luxury export that fills the treasury. These measures will provide the treasury with a stable income that is immune to the fluctuations of the grain market.
mfa_the_casale_citadel: We have transformed Casale Monferrato into a fortress city whose walls and bastions are among the most formidable in the peninsula. The citadel's deep ditches and angled walls are designed to exhaust any siege and bleed any attacker who thinks to take it quickly. This fortification has made our seat of power into one of the great military prizes of the age, too costly to assault and too important to ignore.
pie_citadel_system: A generation of engineers trained on the latest Italian treatises on fortification has surveyed every significant town in our domain and begun the work of converting the old circuit walls into a network of modern bastions, angled, low, and wide enough to mount artillery while denying the enemy any approach that our own guns cannot cover. We tie these citadels together by road and signal, so that a garrison threatened in one valley can expect support from the next. This Sistema delle Cittadelle transforms Piedmont into a country that cannot be overrun but must be taken fortress by fortress, a prospect that gives even the most determined aggressor pause before crossing our borders.
piedmontese_the_canal: Our administration will undertake a titanic effort to tame the waters of our main rivers: the Po, the Dora, and the Sesia. By constructing an intricate network of stone canals and sluices, we will transform the flooded plains and abundant marshes into the most productive rice and grain fields in Southern Europe. This will provide the region with a massive, reliable food surplus, allowing the population to grow and sustain a permanent standing army unaffected by foreign grain imports.
mfa_the_marquisate_resilience: We have survived between greater powers through the arts of flexibility and careful friendship, never placing our trust entirely in any single alliance. By maintaining a reputation for reasonableness and good faith, we have made ourselves useful to those who might otherwise simply absorb us. This Diplomatic Resilience is our oldest strategy and our most reliable one.
pie_enlightened_court: The generation of reformers who have gathered around our court have convinced us that the task of government is not merely to preserve what exists but to discover what works better and systematically replace the old with the new. We open our administration to men trained in the academies and experimental societies of the age, commission reports on everything from agricultural yields to judicial procedure, and fund the education of a class of administrators who can read a budget as readily as a treaty. This Còrt Ëluminà (Corte Illuminata in standard Italian: Enlightened Court) produces a state whose institutions are continuously improved by reason rather than paralyzed by custom, making our government faster, our research more productive, and our subjects more literate.
piedmontese_the_setajoj: Piedmont will become the silk capital of Europe, characterized by massive silk factories (Filatoi) that will utilize advanced hydraulic machinery. This will create an early industrial culture in our towns, where a new class of technical artisans and merchants will emerge. These investments will provide the region with the capital needed to fund modern roads and canals and military improvements, linking the Piedmontese economy directly to the wider world.
mfa_the_monferrato_agricoltura: The rolling hills and fertile valleys of our marquisate yield harvests that sustain our people and support a growing population of farmers and rural craftsmen. Through careful management and investment in our lands, we have expanded the reach of our agriculture into slopes and terraces that once lay idle. This Agricultural Transformation brings new settlers to our countryside and new revenues to our state.
pie_industrial_base: The combination of water power from our mountain rivers, a growing population of skilled artisans in our cities, and the raw materials of the Alpine foothills has created the conditions for an early industrial transformation that no other region of Italy can yet match. We invest in the hydraulic mills, the standardized workshops, and the credit institutions that allow this productive base to expand systematically rather than grow by accident. This Base Industriale generates income from activities that were once invisible to the treasury and draws workers from the countryside into our towns, building the urban population and the taxable wealth of our state together.
pun_breadbasket_of_india: The five great rivers — Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, and Sutley — penetrate the lands of the Punjab area, granting the soil the blessing of unmatched fertility. Apart from allowing us to export food and cotton to our neighbors, this also allows our many cities to grow and encourages all sorts of specialized production. We must do our utmost to encourage the growth of agriculture and to defend our farmers from the bandits and brigands in the adjoining areas.
pun_encourage_indo_persian_trade: Situated on the westernmost border of India, the Punjab has always been at the crossroads of economic and cultural exchange between India and Persia. The ancient Grand Trunk Road, which connects eastern India to the Farsi world, runs right through our lands before heading up into the Afghan mountain passes. These passes are, however, plagued by tribal raiders and bandits. We should encourage the traffic along this ancient and vibrant route and do everything in our power to look after the wellbeing of these traders by constructing caravanserais and policing these roads.
pun_gurmukhi_script: The Gurmukhī script is an abugida developed in the lands of Punjab, and is highly favored by our Sikh gurus. Our clergy is using this script in order to record Sikh texts.
pun_foundation_of_the_khalsa: Sikhism, a religion native to the Punjab, is spreading rapidly in our lands. Members of this faith come from all castes and backgrounds, and will defend their state regardless of their former professions.
pun_punjabi_textile_industry: The Punjab is a major center for textile production. Cloth from our weavers is specially made for markets all over Asia and Europe, and our weavers are among the most productive in India.
pun_strength_of_the_misls: The administrative system of the Misl states of Punjab allows them to field impressive cavalry forces. In times of need, we may call upon these forces to fight a common enemy.
pun_reforming_the_punjabi_army: The ways of our forefathers were sound, and have served us well over the years. But in order for our armies to continue to triumph on the battlefields, we must create a more professional military. By studying the way other countries organize their armies and adapting their methods when prudent, we may create a more efficient Punjabi army while still retaining the unique qualities of our current military system.
raj_militaristic_society: There is almost no division between civil and military society among the Rajputs. Our nation is a host, defined by its people rather than by the land we control, and its people are warriors. We must ensure that military divisions properly meet our administrative needs as the host expands.
raj_combat_training: Every soldier is trained for battle, but our people start combat training at a much younger age, granting them skills surpassing those of other green soldiers.
raj_clan_loyalties: The influence of our clan extends far beyond our own borders. We are able to draw from other Rajput groups from all over northern India when filling the ranks of our armies.
raj_monumental_architecture: What purpose does victory serve if there is nothing to immortalize our achievements? Monuments, such as an awe-inspiring Tower of Victory, shall be erected, so future generations will know of our greatest battles and be appropriately inspired.
raj_marwari_horses: Like their masters, Rajput cavalry horses are meticulously trained to perform on the field of battle. It is said that a Marwari horse will only leave the battlefield under one of three conditions - victory, death, or when carrying a wounded master to safety. By taking good care of these divine beings, we will ensure the everlasting dominance of our horsemen on the battlefields of India.
raj_reorganized_rajput_regiments: Traditional clan structures are an excellent foundation for a modernized regimental system. Existing hierarchies based on kinship and unconditional loyalty can be easily translated into an organized and formal chain of command.
raj_martial_smiths: Wars are not only won through tactics and bravery, but also through weaponry. Our blacksmiths shall forge the finest martial weapons for our warriors to wield in defense of the Rajput people.
raj_fortress_architecture: The rise of Delhi, and the invading Muslim warriors of the past, were wake-up calls. We must always be prepared for foreign invaders, and thus, we must hire the most skilled architects to design impregnable forts throughout our realm. The immensely long walls that will be needed to protect our land make this an ambitious project, but our determination to defend our people shall ensure that it is done.
raj_expanded_artillery_arm: Sieges are what win wars. We must experiment with ways of creating bigger and better cannons to bring down the many forts of our enemies, both within India and outside it.
raj_the_purbias: The Rajputs have spread themselves throughout northern India in their pursuit of glory. The Purbias, elite Rajput soldiers who venture as mercenaries, are renowned for their combat ability, and as such spread our fearsome reputation.
raj_mandatory_firearm_drilling: Many Rajput soldiers are experts in the use of personal firearms. We should put these hardened veterans to work training the next generation of soldiers, rather than risking the loss of their expertise in battle. All of our soldiers must be drilled in firearms tactics before they are expected to meet our enemies on the front line.
raj_painting_school: Rajput painters already have an excellent reputation, but it could be even better. We must encourage our artists to develop their skills and add to the glory of our dynasty by creating a school of painting particular to our state.
raj_rajput_resistance: Rajput poet-musicians tell stories of our people's many battles against foreign invaders, and how our ancestors would rather die than admit themselves defeated. We must encourage this spirit of unity, and give our musicians reason to write new ballads of bravery in the face of death.
raj_martial_ethos: The upbringing and traditions of Rajput warriors ensure a wide base for recruiting officers to lead our armies. In order to capitalize on this, we should formalize career opportunities and advancement paths to encourage these promising young fighters to serve as officers in our forces.
romagnol_al_teri_dlesarchet: Romagna has preserved a unique legal artifact of the Byzantine Exarchate of Ravenna. Unlike the Lombard-influenced north, Romagnol culture has retained a deeper layer of Roman-Byzantine administrative law. This has fostered a differentiated culture, where even the smallest towns claim ancient imperial privileges. This administrative complexity makes the region a nightmare for large empires to centralize efficiently, as every valley is protected by its own Roman web of exemptions and local statutes.
rav_the_pineda_di_classe: The vast coastal pine forests (the Pinedi) of the Adriatic coast are managed as strategic state assets. Our people have developed a culture of sylviculture and salt, harvesting timber for shipbuilding and managing the vast salt pans of Cervia. By reinforcing these traditions, our people will provide a non-agrarian source of wealth that is immune to crop failure, giving us the liquid capital necessary to face any challenges.
urb_the_montefeltro_seignory: We rule these hilltop towns and valleys as lords whose authority is ancient and whose right to govern has never been successfully challenged. Our people know that the Montefeltro have always defended their lands and their customs, and that loyalty has built a bond between lord and subject stronger than any decree. This seignory is not merely power over a territory but a compact that both sides have chosen to honor.
romagnol_mura_malatestiani: Romagnol towns, caught between the Papal States and Venice, have become laboratories for defensive architecture. The region has pioneered the use of the Roca (Rocca in standard Italian: the Fortress), a fortress with rounded towers that deflect fire from primitive cannons. These fortifications mean that every village is a tactical strongpoint. They will force invaders into a slow, attritional style of warfare, allowing the small Romagnol states to punch far above their weight in Mediterranean power politics.
rav_mosaics_of_ravenna: No city in the Western world preserves the art of the Mosaic as we do; our basilicas and mausoleums are clad in tesserae that glow with gold and deep blue, images that have survived centuries of war and neglect without losing their impact. These works attract scholars, pilgrims, and artists who come to study what the ancient world looked like before it was lost. This tradition of extraordinary craftsmanship deepens our cultural heritage and lends our state a prestige that no contemporary rival can easily replicate.
urb_the_hill_fortresses: The hilltops of our domain have been fortified over many generations, turning every elevated town into a position that would take a determined army weeks to reduce. Our soldiers learn their craft on these steep approaches and defend positions where a small garrison can hold off a much larger force. The Hill Fortress network of our territory is both our shield and the school in which our military tradition is trained.
romagnol_the_sangiovese_viticulture: The Romagnol hills are dedicated to the cultivation of the Sangiovese grape. This is not just agriculture; it is a 'Warrior's Wine', robust and hearty. The state will set strict rules for winemaking to ensure a high-calorie, durable product for the infantry. This will also provide a reliable and valuable trade good that ties the rugged Apennine peasants to the urban market, ensuring rural loyalty through economic prosperity.
rav_battle_of_ravenna: Ravenna has long been a prize worth fighting for, and the fields outside our walls have witnessed battles of extraordinary ferocity that have made our name synonymous with the hardest kind of fighting in Italy. We harden the walls of the city and steel the soldiery against the shock of pitched battle, drawing on the lessons that only ground stained this often can teach. This martial tradition forges an army that is difficult to break and a city that is difficult to take.
urb_the_ideal_court: Our court has been called the most perfectly ordered in all of Italy, and men of learning and artistic ambition travel great distances to take part in its life. The conversations, performances, and works of art we foster here have inspired accounts of what a Perfect Court might look like, and those accounts have spread our reputation far beyond our borders. This refinement of governance and culture is the greatest thing we have built.
romagnol_the_stampa_dpopul: Romagna will become a center for broadside printing, cheap, popular pamphlets in the local dialect. This will create a public narrative, where news, prophecies, and folk songs are disseminated to even the rural population. This literacy-based mobilization will ensure that the state can communicate its decrees rapidly and effectively, fostering a highly informed and politically active populace.
rav_byzantine_legacy: Our city is a living archive of a civilization that has vanished almost everywhere else: the gold leaf apses, the intricate stonework, the iconographic traditions of the Byzantine world survive here in a concentration found nowhere else in the west. Artists and patrons who come to study these works carry their influence outward, raising the reputation of everything produced in our workshops. This custody of a unique heritage turns our past into a source of lasting cultural and commercial value.
urb_the_mathematical_school: We have nurtured a tradition of mathematical and philosophical inquiry that has made our city known throughout Europe for the precision of its thinkers. The Mathematical School of our court has produced translations, commentaries, and original works that advance the sciences and win us admiration from the finest universities. A commitment to learning opens our citizens' minds and sharpens our ability to understand and shape the world.
romagnol_the_agricultural_academies: Following the trends of the late Baroque, every major Romagnol town will establish an Académia focused on improving agricultural yields. These local scientific societies will study the drainage of the Vâli (marshes) and the selection of disease-resistant vines. These agronomy projects will turn the region into an experimental farm, leading to a surplus of crops that will fuel the regional manufactories and provide the state with high-value trade goods for the Adriatic markets.
rav_bonifiche_ravennati: The marshes and lagoons that surround our city are both our shield and our burden; they protect us from armies but flood our fields and breed disease. We commit to a systematic program of drainage and embankment, digging channels and raising dykes that push back the water and claim new agricultural land from the swamp. This transformation of the wetlands into productive territory feeds our growing population and expands the taxable estate of the state.
urb_the_ceramics_guilds: The potters and painters of our city have developed a tradition of tin-glazed maiolica whose vivid colors and intricate scenes are sought by collectors and courts across the continent. Our ceramic guilds guard and transmit their techniques across generations, ensuring that the quality which made our name endures. This craft industry exports our culture in every painted dish and decorated vessel that leaves our workshops.
romagnol_la_streda_rumegna: The state and local communes will unite to undertake the radical modernization of the ancient Via Romea coastal road. By building new stone bridges and drainage systems, we will reconnect the Romagnol coast to the Venetian and Papal markets. This plan will turn the coastal towns from isolated fishing villages into significant trade hubs, facilitating the movement of Romagnol agricultural products and providing the strategic mobility necessary for any future war that threatens our soil.
rav_the_new_ravenna: After generations of stagnation, we invest in our city's renewal, clearing old districts, building new roads and market squares, and offering incentives to artisans and merchants who settle within our walls. The city that results is more open, more prosperous, and more capable of absorbing the growth that comes with a reforming state. This reinvestment in our urban fabric makes Ravenna a place people want to come to rather than one they are merely stuck in.
urb_the_enlightened_university: Our university has endured through changes of government and the upheavals of the ages, continuing to draw students and scholars to our city by the reputation of its teaching. The long tradition of learning established in our most glorious days has become a living institution that carries that spirit forward into a new era. This continuity of scholarship is our gift to the future and our connection to the greatness of our past.
veche_advance: The Veche is a popular assembly with its origins in ancient tribal councils, which themselves existed long before the time of the Rus'. It is the highest judicial and legislative authority of the state.
russian_integration: The East Slavic are vast and diverse in their culture. To unify them like the rulers of old once did, we should promote our shared history and forge an unbreakable cultural bond between the different groups.
russian_resiliance: The Mongol invasions of the past left a strong determination within the East Slavic to resist foreign rule. We can utilize their zeal to reinforce our troops.
land_of_the_rus: Reunification of the Rus' is a common goal among the East Slavic rulers, and aspiring conquerors can use this as a justification of conquest.
the_mestnichestvo_advance: The Mestnichestvo is an ancient system that assigns positions of state to people based on the antiquity of their lineage and the seniority they hold within their families. The most tangible demonstration of this system involved the seating order of Boyars at the Tsar's table, which reflects their individual rank and precedence.
voivode_advance: The Voivode is a military leader with regional administrative authority, defending territory and maintaining order. A voivode can be useful in overcoming the challenges posed by the limited means of communication available, as they have the authority to make crucial decisions without waiting for approval.
siberian_frontier: The distant wastes of Siberia call to us. We must clear a path to its frozen heart, and let our Cossacks go forth and claim land for the Russian people.
ostrog_advance: The Ostrog is a small, wooden fortification which is constructed in remote territories of Russia. Due to their reliance on lumber, Ostrogs are relatively inexpensive and swift to construct.
russian_artillery_yard: Superior firepower is what determines who wins the sieges of today as well as the pitched battles of tomorrow. We must build a state-of-the-art artillery yard in the heart of our country, to ensure our armies are never without cannons nor ammunition.
table_of_ranks: The abolishment of the Mestnichestvo was the first step toward creating a more meritocratic state bureaucracy. The Table of Ranks further codified this principle, making military advancement conditional on performance rather than noble birth.
russian_legitimization: The East Slavic people have occupied and ruled these lands for centuries. It is only natural that a East Slavic ruler should govern their own people. The more East Slavic we present ourselves to be, the easier the people will accept our leadership.
flexible_loyalty: Our nation is caught in a conflux between the warring religions of Europe and a variety of foreign threats. The only way we can ensure our survival in this storm is to take a flexible stance towards cooperating with local mercenary bands.
heritage_of_the_rus: The lands of the Rus' shattered into fragmented states long ago, but the memory of our once-great empire, ruled from Kyiv, burns brightly in us all. If we style ourselves in the old fashion, and highlight our connection to our ancestors, we will be able to carve out a distinctive set of traditions for our people.
mother_of_russian_cities: Kyiv was once the shining capital of a great empire spanning from the northern forests of Novgorod to the southern shores of the Black Sea. After suffering the dissolution of the Rus' and the invasions of the Mongols, little remained of it. But the time has come for our revival, and no matter what our cities have endured, we vow that they will recover and prosper for centuries to come!
international_influences: Many foreign merchants and travelers frequent our roads, bringing vast wealth to our land. We could convince some of these avid traders to permanently settle in our towns and cities, if we assure them they will not face persecution for their beliefs.
reuniting_rus: We are the true heir of the Kievan Rus', and those lands must be reunited under our banner!
united_faith: No matter our situation, we must ensure the unity of our faith. Only if our clergy is aligned, and no discord exists between factions of the faithful, will they be able to focus on their primary function of guiding and aiding our population.
east_and_west: Our strategic position between eastern and western empires has given our merchants the opportunity to act as essential middlemen for lucrative regional trade routes.
ruthenian_state_advance: In the past, we bowed to foreign influences, and were obliged to adapt to their customs to ensure friendly relations. But times have changed, and now we must affirm our own customs, or risk falling into the sphere of foreign influences again.
ruthenian_rural_buildings: Much of Ruthenia is rural, empty land. While our great cities like Kyiv serve many important purposes, we cannot neglect the remote lands or small villages that provide us with crucial supplies of food and raw materials.
ruthenia_commoner_education: By establishing local schools, we will ensure that our population is well-educated at all levels of society.
sardinian_the_barbagia: The central mountains (the Barbagia) have remained a 'Land of Barbarians' to every Mediterranean invader for centuries. The culture here is defined by the S'Ard (Sardinian) identity, a fierce, isolated pastoralism that rejects any form of external taxation or conscription. This has created a cultural redoubt where the ancient Nuragic spirit of independence is preserved. An invading state can master the coastal cities, but the heart of the island will remain a forbidden zone, ensuring the survival of our customs through pure geographical and social defiance.
sar_the_giudicati: Our island was once divided into four self-governing judgedoms, the Giudicati, each with its own court, its own laws, and its own traditions of governance built entirely from within. Though that era has passed, the habits of independent administration it instilled run deep in our institutions and our people. Our tradition of sovereign self-governance gives our state a legitimacy that every subject feels rather than hears proclaimed from above.
sardinian_the_artizanu: In the cities and towns, a distinct class of Sardinian artisans and silversmiths is emerging, blending foreign aesthetics with indigenous motifs. These guilds are fiercely protective of their liberties, often coming into conflict with foreign merchant monopolies. This creates a vibrant urban culture that is both Mediterranean in outlook and Sardinian in soul, providing the state with a literate and skilled middle class that can manage the complexities of maritime trade.
sar_the_stamenti: Our parliament, the Stamenti, is one of the oldest representative assemblies in the Mediterranean world, dividing legislative counsel among the church, the military nobility, and the royal towns in three distinct chambers. This structure gives every major constituency a recognized voice in how the island is governed, channeling disputes into procedure rather than conflict. This culture of structured representation keeps our merchant and burgher classes invested in the stability of the state.
sardinian_the_ademprivio: Sardinian culture remains anchored in the Ademprivio: the right of the people to use feudal lands for grazing, woodcutting, and water. Despite attempts to privatize land, the Sardinian peasants have maintained their culture of 'Sacred Commons'. This prevents the total impoverishment of the rural classes, and ensures a high level of internal stability, as we recognize that the stability of our lands rests on the shared prosperity of these pastoral communities.
sar_university_of_cagliari: The foundation of a university in our capital brings the institutions of learning that have long been enjoyed on the mainland to the people of our island. Lawyers, physicians, and administrators trained here no longer need to seek their education abroad, and the talent they represent stays in our service rather than enriching distant courts. This commitment to education raises the literacy and ability of our governing class and prepares our island for the demands of a more complex world.
sardinian_the_turres_costeras: To combat the pirate threat, our people will construct a chain of coastal towers. This will give rise to the 'Coastal Vigil', where entire families will move from the shore to the hills while maintaining a permanent rotation of watchers. This culture of 'Horizon Scanning' will turn the entire island population into a strategic state asset, ensuring that the Mediterranean's most vital sea lanes are constantly monitored by a populace that views defense as a daily ritual.
sar_sardinian_tercios: Our foot soldiers have earned a reputation across the battlefields of the age for a tenacity that makes them exceptionally costly to break; they hold ground that others would abandon and press attacks that others would not dare. We formalize this tradition by organizing our infantry into disciplined formations trained in pike and shot, building on the fighting qualities that have always distinguished our men. This military culture produces an army of exceptional morale that serves as the backbone of any campaign we undertake.
sardinian_the_hymnu_sardu: As a modern national consciousness begins to emerge, our culture is shifting from feudal loyalty to a new 'Patriotism of the Kingdom'. This is expressed through a boom in Sardinian literature and political pamphlets that demand a 'Sardinia for the Sardinians'. From this movement rises a new, modernized administrative class that seeks to reform our ancient feudal laws into a modern sovereign constitution.
sar_the_cavalcadores: The Sardinian interior, particularly the plains of the Campidano, has developed a world-class horse culture. The Sartiglia and other equestrian tournaments are not mere games, but displays of extreme horsemanship and military readiness. This culture will provide the state with elite light cavalry units (the Cavalleggeris de Sardigna) who are famous for their speed and ability to navigate the treacherous karst terrain, making them the premier scouts for our armies.
sardinian_the_industrial_transition: With the discovery of new lead and zinc veins, our traditional pastoral culture is beginning to merge with the industrial era. We will establish the first modern mines and foundries, staffed by Sardinian workers who bring their traditional 'Guild Discipline' to the contemporary age. This mining culture will provide us with the raw materials needed for modern warfare and public works, turning the island into the forge of our rising state.
sar_enlightened_reforms: A generation of administrators has concluded that our potential has been constrained by outdated laws, uneven taxation, and a literacy gap that leaves too many of our subjects unable to participate in the life of the state. We commit to systematically reforming these institutions, codifying the tax rolls, expanding education, and replacing exemptions with a clearer and fairer legal framework. This administrative modernization increases our revenues and prepares our population for the demands of a transforming world.
scandinavian_fishing_privileges_advance: This location has been granted exclusive rights over nearby fishing grounds and the trade in dried and salted fish. Norwegian coastal towns organized around these privileges supplied Fish across Northern Europe.
scandinavian_bergslag_privileges_advance: The Crown has recognized this location as a mining community (bergslag), granting it collective rights over local ore extraction, its own court, and freedom from military conscription. The Commoners of the mines hold a stronger legal standing than in ordinary towns.
scandinavian_thing_rights_advance: This location has been granted formal assembly rights (tingsrätt), giving its inhabitants a recognized legal forum for governance and justice. Royal authority is curtailed in exchange for a more orderly and loyal population.
scandinavian_tar_privileges_advance: This location has been granted rights to harvest and export Tar and Naval Supplies from Crown forests. These forest industries are the backbone of Baltic shipbuilding supply chains.
legacy_of_the_normans: Forged in the crucible of conquest, the Sicilian Norman army blended the unstoppable charge of Norman knights with the strategic sophistication of Byzantine, Arab, and Lombard warfare. Masters of both battlefield ferocity and tactical flexibility, they carved a kingdom at the crossroads of civilizations.
sic_constitions_of_melfi: Emperor Frederick II, the Hohenstaufen King of Sicily, drafted a legal code for Sicily known as the Constitutions of Melfi, or Liber Augustalis. Still in use centuries later, it represents a solid foundation for the governance of our state, regulating public law, judicial procedure, and feudal, private, and penal law.
sic_naval_vigilance: Constant raids from Barbary pirates and Ottoman ships have forced Sicily to maintain a vigilant coastal defense. Its galleys and forts became critical for protecting southern Europe.
sic_studium_generale: Founded by King Alfonso V of Aragon, the University of Catania was the oldest in Sicily and one of the few southern institutions granted full Studium Generale status. Unique for its royal charter and blend of scholastic and legal education, it produced jurists, theologians, and scientists who served both Church and Crown in a culturally diverse region.
sic_sicilian_silk: In the time of Frederick II, Silk was Sicily's major export. Although our Silk industry has declined in the intervening centuries, Sicily's productions having been outstripped by that of the northern Italian states, there is no reason why it should not rise again. By investing in our Silk production, we can see our weavers and craftsmen flourish anew.
sic_the_court_of_the_royal_patrimony: We will create this specialized court to manage the royal properties and the Secretias (customs offices). By professionalizing the collection of export duties on silk, tuna, and grain, the state will significantly reduce corruption and 'leakage' to local barons. This administrative rigor will turn our lands into the Crown's most reliable source of income, funding our wars across Italy and the Mediterranean.
sicilian_the_cult_of_the_santuzze: The religious identity of Sicily has for a long time been tied to powerful female patron saints, who are believed to protect cities from plague and lava. The massive, theatrical processions (like the Festino of Palermo) associated with their worship serve as a release valve for social tension, and as a display of communal unity. These rituals are the heartbeat of Sicilian public life, reinforcing social cohesion.
sic_licentia_populandi: To increase harvests and tax revenue, the state granted Licenses to Populate to the nobility. This will allow lords to build brand-new towns in the desolate interior of the island, attracting peasants with promises of land and lower taxes. This internal colonization effort will transform the Sicilian landscape, turning wild hinterlands into a patchwork of profitable agricultural communities.
sic_sicilian_enlightenment: Though distant from the great salons of Paris or Wien, Sicily has fostered its own Enlightenment. Intellectuals challenged feudal privileges, promoted science, and advocated legal reforms, building a tradition of critical inquiry that navigated the tensions between faith and reason. These ideas laid the groundwork for modernity in the shadow of monarchy and tradition.
sic_sicilian_baroque: Our island trembles often, causing many buildings to collapse. In order to replace these old structures, the state will orchestrate one of the most ambitious rebuilding programs in human history. Rather than simply repairing old ruins, the government will redesign entire cities using the theatrical, earthquake-resistant Sicilian Baroque style. This will demonstrate the state's incredible ability to mobilize labor and capital in the face of total disaster.
sic_sicilian_reforms: As time passes, our institutions become obsolete or just inefficient. Reforms are necessary if we want our nation to prosper and thrive. Our best minds will work hard to ensure that no waste happens, and that our processes are as efficient as possible.
sic_the_marsala_wine_industry: Thanks to foreign investors, Sicilian wine will be transformed from a local peasant drink into a fortified luxury good that can survive long sea voyages. The culture of the 'Vineyard Estate' (the Baglio) will be the new symbol of Sicilian wealth and sophistication. It links the island's ancient agricultural traditions to the modern, industrial world of global commerce.
slovak_the_urban_syncretism: Following the devastation of the Mongol invasions, the state encouraged the arrival of Zipser German settlers to rebuild the shattered economy. Unlike many other colonial movements, these settlers integrated deeply with the local Slavic population, resulting in a unique cultural and legal syncretism known as the 'Saxon Law'. This blending of traditions created a multilingual and highly skilled urban middle class that combined Slavic agricultural resilience with German technical expertise in mining and metallurgy. This atmosphere of shared knowledge fostered a culture of innovation, where the exchange of ideas between different linguistic groups accelerated the spread of new technologies and administrative practices, making the Slovak towns some of the most progressive in the region.
slo_the_law_of_the_seven_towns: Recognizing the immense strategic and financial value of the northern territories, King Charles Robert of Anjou bypassed the unruly local barons by granting special 'Royal Free Town' status to the primary mining centers, such as Banská Štiavnica and Kremnica. These settlements were removed from the jurisdiction of local lords and placed directly under the Tavernicus (the royal treasurer), creating a direct financial link between the mountain mines and the throne. This legal framework has fostered a loyal, urbanized tax base and a German-Slavic merchant class that has operated independently of feudal land rights. This administrative shift has ensured that our nation has a reliable source of ready coin, funding the central government's efforts to stabilize the realm and professionalize the royal bureaucracy.
slovak_the_slovensky_vernacular: The local Slavic vernacular, distinct from Czech or Polish, has begun to appear with increasing frequency in official town records and legal documents, most notably in the Žilina Book. This development may signal the birth of a formal Slovak administrative language if we support it, allowing the local government to communicate more effectively with the peasantry and the lower nobility without relying solely on Latin or German. By codifying local speech into a written administrative format, the state will make its courts fairer and swifter and strengthen the bond between the common people and the government. This early linguistic standardization will give us a sense of nationhood, making it harder for foreign administrators to override our ways.
slo_the_slovak_castle_system: Faced with threats from all sides, we will establish a formalized military border along the Danube and the Carpathian foothills. We will empower the Zeman (the lower, land-owning Slavic nobility) to act as a permanent, hereditary frontier guard. These warriors live in Curias (fortified manor houses) and are exempt from certain taxes in exchange for their constant readiness to mobilize. This will create a resilient social class of warrior farmers who are intimately familiar with the local terrain, providing the state with an inexpensive and eager defensive screen that will be able to absorb the shock of foreign invasions before they reach the heart of the realm.
slovak_the_slovak_rome: The city of Trnava has become the intellectual and spiritual sanctuary of Slovakia. This has led to a dramatic boom in High Baroque architecture, with the city's skyline filled with grand churches and academic halls. The printing of Slavic-language books is flourishing here, making Trnava the primary engine of intellectual resistance against heretics and heathens. By strengthening this cultural concentration, we will ensure that the Slavic population remains deeply anchored in a sophisticated, literate, and religiously unified identity during a period of extreme existential threat.
slo_the_universitas_istropolitana: We are at the height of the Humanist movement, meaning that we have a great opportunity to found a university in Bratislava (Academia Istropolitana) to become a magnet for the brightest minds of our era, including scholars from Italy, Poland, and the German states. The curriculum will emphasize the new sciences of astronomy, mathematics, and Roman law, modernizing the state's diplomatic and legal apparatus. This intellectual boom will ensure that the ruling elite are educated in the latest European political philosophies, allowing the state to navigate the complex international relations of the Renaissance with professional skill. The university will also serve as a center for astronomical research, placing the Slovak lands at the forefront of the scientific revolution that is beginning to sweep across the continent.
slovak_the_slovak_sappers: The deep-mining culture of the Slovak Ore Mountains has produced the most skilled subterranean engineers in Europe. The state has begun drafting these Slovak Miners (Banskí Chlapi) into specialized 'Sapper and Miner' regiments. Their cultural familiarity with black powder, tunneling, and structural bracing in the dark will make them terrifyingly effective in siege warfare. They can collapse enemy bastions from below or build fortified trenches in half the time of standard laborers. This 'Miner-Soldier' identity will turn the Slovak workforce into a strategic military asset, making the capture of Slovak mining towns a high priority for any empire seeking to master the art of 17th-century siegecraft.
slo_the_mining_captancy: Our mountains are full of ore, so the state will formalize the central management of the 'Seven Towns' through the Bergkammer (Mining Chamber) in Banská Štiavnica. By appointing a royal Berghauptmann (Mining Captain), the government will seize direct control over the extraction and smelting of silver and gold, stripping local feudal lords of their ancient mineral rights. This professionalization of the industry will allow for the implementation of advanced drainage technologies and deeper shaft mining, ensuring a constant flow of bullion to the royal mints. This steady flow of silver and gold will fill our treasury, making the Slovak Ore Mountains indispensable to us.
slovak_the_highland_architecture: A unique architectural culture is emerging, wherein the sophisticated stoneworking of the Germans meets the ancient Slavic tradition of heavy timber construction. This results in 'Articular Wooden Churches'. Culturally, this represents an 'Architecture of Resistance': buildings that can be constructed rapidly in the mountains, but are designed with hidden defensive features, like reinforced oak shutters and elevated entrances. This cultural aesthetic is born from a need for beauty in a state of permanent distrust, creating a landscape of cultural supremacy. By learning from this lesson, we can capitalize on these techniques for the glory of our nation.
slo_the_social_banditry: For decades, the cultural figure of the Zbojník (Highland Outlaw), epitomized by Juraj Jánošík, has become a military ideal in the minds of our people. This is the 'Culture of the Forest', where young men flee into the mountains to wage a guerrilla war against feudal oppression. While we have viewed them as bandits, the populace sees them as defenders. This cultural archetype has fostered a partisan mindset in the Slovak psyche: a distrust of central authority and a mastery of the scorched earth and mountain ambush tactics that can serve us well if we manage to nationalize.
slovak_the_slovak_romanticism: A new generation of Romantic intellectuals is shifting the linguistic base to the Central Slovak dialects, creating a version of the language that is becoming the standard. This is not merely a literary shift but a radical political movement, as they are using poetry, folk songs, and journalism to elevate our identity. This Romantic fervor will turn every cultural production into a call for national greatness, unifying the peasantry and the burgeoning middle class in a shared vision of national pride.
slo_the_hron_valley_industries: The discovery of massive iron ore deposits and the rapid advancement of steam technology have led to the birth of the first modern industrial zones in the Hron and Váh river valleys. Our state must heavily subsidize the creation of ironworks and textile factories to reduce our dependency on foreign imports. This drive for industrial sovereignty will transform the traditional agricultural landscape into a manufacturing powerhouse, providing us with the tools to compete with the other powers. As labor concentrates in these new centers, the social dynamics of the region will begin to shift, creating an urban working class that will become a new political force in the century to follow.
slovene_the_freising_fragments: Drawing upon the ancient traditions of the Freising Fragments, the Slovenian peasantry and local clergy have maintained a distinct linguistic identity, which has survived within the ecclesiastical structures of the Holy Roman Empire. This early vernacular tradition serves as a silent but resilient cultural anchor that distinguishes the Windisch speakers from their Germanic and Italian neighbors.
cli_the_counts_ambition: Through a masterclass in marital diplomacy and unwavering loyalty to the Holy Roman Emperors, we have risen from local lords to Princes of the Holy Roman Empire. By securing marriage ties to the thrones of our neighbors, we have positioned ourselves as the indispensable 'Shield of the South'. So meteoric a rise lets us demand respect from the greatest of European houses.
slovene_the_dukes_chair_tradition: The ancient ritual of installing the Dukes of Carinthia in the Slovenian language symbolizes a unique contractual relationship between the ruler and the ruled. This custom reinforces the idea of a free peasantry with specific legal rights, preventing the total disenfranchisement of the rural population. This social contract fosters a stable and productive agricultural base across our domains.
cli_the_sanneck_condottieri: Before we were Princes of the Empire, the House of Cilli was defined by the sharp blades of the Sanneck knights. By leading elite mercenary companies for the Hungarian and Imperial crowns in the fields of Dalmatia and Italy, we have turned the 'contract of war' into a tool for dynastic elevation. This tradition of professional military service allows us to field superior sellswords at a fraction of the cost.
slovene_the_tabor_defense_system: As a border nation, we have always been in a dangerous position against our enemies, so our people have developed the Tabor, fortified church enclosures where villagers can retreat with their livestock and valuables. This decentralized defense system turns every village into a minor fortress, forcing any invader into a grueling war of attrition they cannot win.
cli_the_last_counts_legacy: Following our deep involvement in the successions of our neighbors, we formalize our legal claims to oversee the southern frontier of the Empire as the primary protectors of the realm. Even as our rivals attempt to absorb our lands, the administrative structures and 'Imperial Immediate' status we have secured ensure that our territory remains a privileged hub of regional governance.
slovene_the_catechismus_and_abecedarium: The soul of our people has found its voice through the printing presses. Primož Trubar has published the Catechismus and Abecedarium, the first books ever printed in the Slovenian language. This is far more than a religious act; it is a political earthquake that standardizes our various dialects into a single literary tongue. By giving the common folk the tools of literacy in their own language, we have forged a unified national consciousness that transcends the borders of old feudal duchies. This intellectual awakening accelerates the adoption of modern administrative institutions and allows the light of new ideas to spread rapidly from the pulpit to the plow.
cli_the_windic_march_arsenal: As the primary lords of the southern frontier, we have transformed our estates into a permanent military supply chain. By patronizing the ironworks of the Savinja Valley, we ensure our heavy cavalry and border guards are equipped with the finest plate and firearms forged in Inner Austria. This localized military industry reduces our reliance on foreign armaments and keeps our regiments battle-ready at all times.
slovene_the_glory_of_carniola: Following the lead of Janez Vajkard Valvasor, we have undertaken a monumental effort to map the geography, history, and customs of our lands. With this survey the state knows its resources and people as never before, and can tax them fairly and put new inventions to work quickly.
cli_the_marble_palaces_of_celje: To reflect our status as Princes of the Empire, we have invited Italian architects to redesign our urban centers in the grand Baroque style. These sprawling palaces and public squares are not merely for show; they serve as centralized administrative hubs where the state's bureaucracy is professionalized. The sheer splendor of our capital serves to overawe foreign diplomats and domestic rivals alike, cementing our legitimate right to rule.
slovene_the_zois_circle: Baron Sigmund Zois, a wealthy mineralogist and patron of the arts, has started organizing a circle of intellectuals who spearheaded the Slovenian National Awakening (Preporod). This group promotes the use of Slovenian in high culture, science, and politics, effectively transforming a 'peasant tongue' into a language of modern statehood.
cli_the_modernization_of_a_nation: Our ancestral valleys have been transformed from a feudal pastoral land into the industrial heartbeat of our realm. We have seized this momentum by establishing massive industries, alongside modern steam-powered mills that process the raw timber and iron of the surrounding mountains. This rapid modernization has created a new class of skilled laborers and engineers, turning our capital into a center of technological innovation that propels the entire state into the industrial age.
religious_melting_pot: Many different religions have influenced our people, from their traditional folk beliefs to Hinduism and Buddhism, both from India and China. Over time, our people have developed some degree of religious syncretism, mixing some beliefs with others and not fully disregarding any.
akson_thai: Originally based on ancient Khmer script, Thai writing has evolved to be quite distinct from its original form to accommodate the complex phonology of our language. Having a unique written language has certainly contributed to the development of our unique culture.
father_governs_children: Our rulers are famed for their close connection to the common man. May our people always live free and happily under the guiding light of their majestic, heavenly rulers!
thai_war_elephants: War elephants have been used in Indochina for generations, both for cavalry and as personal mounts for the kings, who would then engage in elephant duels with the opposing side's leader.
thai_royal_poets: What is the point of winning wars if no songs are sung about our victories? Our court shall be a haven for poets, and our history shall be their source of inspiration.
trading_links: Our country has been a crossroads of trade since ancient times. Our proximity to India and China has allowed trade to flow through our lands, and with it relationships and interactions with the many different countries around us.
foreign_mercenaries: We have recently received an influx of barbarians from foreign lands. Some are merchants but some are fighting men. Let us make use of them in our armies.
toi_muay: Taught to our soldiers for use in combat, it is an unarmed martial art featuring punches, grappling, and ground-fighting techniques. Proficiency in this art allows our troops to remain deadly in battle even if they lose their weapons.
trading_embassies: The numerous trade ships coming in and out of our waters have familiarized us with many distant realms. By establishing permanent trading embassies with these far-off places, we can transform casual commerce into formal relationships.
photduang: Our currency may feel strange to outsiders, but Photduang have served us well for centuries. Roundish balls of silver and stamped with official marks, they serve as the basis of our economy.
personal_executions: From now on, the most heinous criminals will be executed personally by the ruler. With this, people will know that we are an orderly nation committed to justice, and they will show the appropriate obedience to the law.
close_subjects: For us, our subjects are not something separate from the nation, but rather an integral part of it. We keep close ties with them, and they are fully integrated into our bureaucracy and administration.
birthplace_of_renaissance: Our dedication to fine arts, cultivating artistic talent, and innovative thought have led us to be regarded as one of the foremost leaders of cultural, philosophical, and scientific advancements around the world.
florino_d_oro: Since 1252, the gold Fiorino d'Oro struck at our mint has been the most trusted currency in Christendom, accepted without question from the counting houses of London to the bazaars of Alexandria because its weight and purity never varied through the ambitions of a dozen kings. Merchants who trade in florins trade in our reputation: every exchange carried out in our coin is a quiet advertisement for the solidity of Florentine governance and the reliability of the institutions that stand behind it. This universal confidence in our currency smooths every transaction conducted in our courts, and keeps the treasury supplied with the tax revenue that only a genuinely trusted medium of exchange can consistently generate.
luc_the_silk_republic: We have long woven the finest Lucchese Silk Brocade in all of Italy, and our looms have made our city prosperous beyond its size. Our weavers' guilds protect the secrets of the craft and ensure the quality that commands high prices in distant markets. This mastery of cloth transforms raw threads into the foundation of our republic's wealth.
pis_maritimes_legacy: For three centuries, Pisa stood among the dominant sea powers of the western Mediterranean, its galleys reaching every harbor from Sardinia to the Levant and its naval victories over the Saracens earning the city privileged access to markets that lesser powers could not enter. The defeat at Meloria in 1284 diminished our fleet, but could not erase what those centuries of seaborne commerce built; our captains know these waters, our traders know their counterparts in every port, and the routes that made us great are still routes that we can sail. Our seafaring legacy gives our merchants an edge in the Western trade over any landlocked rival, and the memory of maritime greatness drives us to rebuild what was taken from us.
sie_artists: The art of painting has flourished in Italy since the beginning of the Renaissance, but no artists can match the elegance of those trained in Siena, where the Studium Senese, one of the oldest universities in Europe, ensures that painters and scholars alike are nurtured by the same tradition of civic patronage. Sienese art is otherworldly and refined, with a heavy focus on the miracles performed by Biblical figures and Saints. This unity of learning and artistry defines the Sienese school, securing its reputation for centuries to come.
a_land_of_banks: Tuscany is the center of banking in Europe, with many powerful financial institutions headquartered in its major cities. From these bases, their influence extends across Italy and into northern Europe through extensive trade networks and lucrative partnerships.
florentine_school: The workshops of Florence (Giotto, Brunelleschi, Masaccio, Botticelli, and Leonardo) have redefined what painting and sculpture mean to an entire civilization, each generation expanding the boundaries of what the human eye and human hand can achieve in stone, pigment, and bronze.
