ach_villehardouins_valor_advance: Geoffrey of Villehardouin, marshal of Champagne and eyewitness chronicler of the Fourth Crusade, composed one of the earliest vernacular histories in Old French, immortalizing the deeds of his companions and the astonishing capture of Constantinople in vivid, heroic prose that circulated widely among the nobility of Western Europe. His chronicle served not only as a record but as propaganda and inspiration, rallying fresh knights and pilgrims to reinforce the beleaguered Latin states, while fostering a shared sense of chivalric brotherhood among the scattered Frankish lords who continued to view themselves as crusaders holding God's frontier against schismatic and infidel alike long after the original host had dispersed. It is time to recover that spirit for the challenges of our army.
arg_the_curia_of_the_two_benches_advance: In a daring move toward social stability, the Lordship has reformed the high court of Nauplia into the Curia of the Two Benches. This judicial body requires that every civil case involving land or inheritance be heard by a panel consisting of one Frankish judge and one Greek Demogeron (Elder). By institutionalizing this 'Shared Justice', we have effectively ended the centuries-old legal friction between the Latin and Orthodox populations. This governance model has created a unique 'Argive Identity' that is fiercely loyal to the Lordship, protecting the state from the revolutionary fervors sweeping through the rest of Europe.
ath_the_attican_gunpowder_mills_advance: Our artillery is now the finest in the world, benefiting from the metallurgical secrets of the world's renowned master smiths and the chemical innovations of our local alchemists. The 'Thunder of Athens' is heard across the Balkans, as our cannons are prized for their range and reliability.
bod_the_oeta_riflemen_advance: In the age of gunpowder, the rugged woodsmen of the Oeta mountains have been organized into specialized light infantry corps. These riflemen excel in hit-and-run tactics, using the steep terrain to harass invading columns with lethal precision. They are the nightmare of any general attempting to force the northern passes of Greece.
cep_the_ionian_merchant_experts_advance: We have granted extensive privileges to our local merchants, allowing them to form self-governing trade companies that manage the most lucrative exports and imports. This mercantile autonomy has fostered a wealthy urban class that bankrolls the County's modern administrative reforms.
crt_academy_of_the_stratioti_advance: The fierce Cretan mountain dwellers have been integrated into a professional light cavalry corps, blending Western discipline with the hit-and-run tactics of the Balkan frontier. We have established permanent training grounds where the sons of the local nobility and the Latin settlers learn the art of the Saber and Carbine to protect the island's interior. These units are now exported as elite mercenaries to many states, providing a steady stream of military prestige and revenue.
lat_the_order_of_the_star_of_the_east_ad: The Emperor has established a high-tier order of merit that replaces hereditary titles with service-based nobility, ensuring that the Empire's leaders are chosen for their talent. Membership in the Order is the highest honor in the land, granted to generals, diplomats, and scholars who have expanded the glory of the Latin Throne. This system creates a loyalist elite that is entirely dependent on the Emperor's favor, cementing the monarch's control over the state.
nax_the_aegean_hydrographic_bureau_advan: In an age of global exploration and precision, the Dukes of Naxos have established the premier center for Mediterranean cartography and maritime science. By employing the finest astronomers and clockmakers to map every reef, current, and wind pattern of the Cyclades, we have made our navigational charts the most sought-after tools in the world. This scientific mastery ensures that Naxiot captains can navigate the treacherous Aegean at night or in storm, granting our merchant and war fleets a decisive advantage in speed and safety over any foreign interloper.
neg_the_glassworks_of_chalkis_advance: Using the high-quality silica sands of our beaches and the soda ash from our coastal plants, we have established a glassmaking industry that rivals Murano. Our mirrors and stained glass are exported to the great palaces of the Latin Empire and the West, bringing immense wealth to the island. The taxes on this luxury trade pay for the upkeep of our massive coastal walls in an age of gunpowder.
neo_the_academy_of_administration_advanc: Neopatras needs to replace its hereditary 'Captain-Governors' with graduates of a dedicated Administrative Lyceum. Candidates are tested on their knowledge of our civil law and the latest techniques, ensuring that the nation's officials are as comfortable with a quill as they are with a sword. This shift from 'Birthright to Merit' has turned Neopatras into the most efficiently governed territory in Central Greece, capable of precise census taking and rapid tax levying.
pat_the_port_of_sanctuary_advance: Our ports have been declared 'Neutral Holy Ports', where merchants of all nations (Catholic, Orthodox, or otherwise) may trade in safety. This sanctuary status has turned our ports into the primary neutral ground for Mediterranean commerce. Even in times of total war, the trade of Patras continues to flow, protected by the Archbishop's ban.
sao_the_legacy_of_the_alpha_protector_ad: The 'Wolf-Pacts' have reached their logical conclusion: the Hegemony is the recognized 'Alpha' of the Eastern Mediterranean. We no longer justify aggression. We simply exercise our natural mandate to 'police' the Levant. This projection of power ensures that the Greek seas remain a private lake for the merchants of Salona.
the_the_university_of_thessalonica_advan: Thessalonica has founded a royal university dedicated to the study of a diverse array of matters, blending Italian theory with local Balkan experience. This institution produces the finest students in the Frankokratia, capable of marvels. Our graduates are in high demand across the Latin world, making the Kingdom the intellectual center of innovation.
noble_knights: Supporting cavalry requires an economic system that produces a large number of surplus horses. If we were to guarantee the privileges of our nobility, not only would they be much happier, but they would do much of the work to produce the much-needed horses. Our court fool described it as 'service guarantees serfs.'
serfdom: Being a foot soldier in the army is not exactly a dream career, what with the poor food, low pay, and virtually nonexistent medical services. Therefore, recruitment attempts are often a fruitless affair. If we were to tie our peasantry to the land, however, we would always know exactly where to find recruits.
feudal_de_jure_law_advance: De jure - 'by law' - is a description of legally acknowledged practices regardless of the reality of its practice. The systems of a feudal society are built on this very concept.
salic_law_advance: The rulership of women is not always respected — nor even permitted. As such, it is not uncommon for governments to pass laws directly barring women from inheritance, rejecting them in favor of their male siblings or cousins.
semi_salic_law_advance: By the right of the Salic Law, only men are allowed to inherit the throne. This practice leads to a succession crisis in cases where the male bloodline dies out, and the monarchy gets thrown into chaos. In order to avoid such disturbances, the rights of women shall be expanded to include eligibility to rule the nation, should no suitable male heir exist.
partition_inheritance_advance: Rivalries among royal offspring are not uncommon, as each one would like to be the ruler one day. To avoid such in-fighting, some monarchs choose to divide their territories and titles among all their sons, so that all of them are satisfied with a more or less equal share of the inheritance.
aristocracy: Aristocracy is a key part of any monarchy, as the nobles surrounding the royal dynasty are precisely what gives justification to the monarch. In the end, the concept of royal blood cannot exist without the corresponding concept of noble blood. As such, the aristocracy supports the monarch, but they expect to have some privileges in exchange for their loyalty, as they must never be confused with the common rabble.
local_nobility: The nobles know they are simply better than other people, and will only give their loyalty to those they deem worthy. If we affirm their privileges, they will of course remember our generosity, and be more resistant to the temptations of foreign powers.
military_traditions: The nature of war is constantly evolving, and we must ensure that perceptions of our military evolve with it. By encouraging a tradition of service amongst our nobility, we shall entrench the idea that high social status is earned through glory on the battlefield. While bravery and combat skill remain important, true military excellence now lies in professional expertise rather than nebulous things like personal valor.
noble_officers: The choice of who leads our troops is a crucial one, and our nobles wish to ensure that preference is given to them when it comes to filling these roles. It will give them a chance to show their valor by giving the enemy cold steel, and we will allow them to do this.
noble_resilience: The various mercenary groups on this continent are often headed by lesser nobles. By befriending the aristocracy, we can use their network of contacts to seek out more — and larger — groups of mercenary soldiers.
international_nobility: International relations is a tricky business. Some say that the merchant class, who are used to dealing with foreigners, are best suited for this. Those who say so, however, ignore the kindred ties that our noble families have established through the years. We should take advantage of these ties to help our cause diplomatically.
bill_of_rights: By granting the citizens certain fundamental rights, we will reduce the likelihood of a peasant uprising.
republican_foundation_law_advance: Our Republic is founded on the principle that power should be in the hands of the people, not a single absolutist ruler. Yet as with any government, its laws and decisions must be respected and obeyed to maintain order, necessitating the creation of complex administrations in order to govern.
plutocracy: Wealth and power are not synonyms, but they are certainly related: Not only can power make someone wealthy, but wealth can also grant someone power. We understand that well, as our wealthiest members of the population are also the ones who occupy the seats of power in our country.
abolished_serfdom: We know from reading ancient Roman accounts that a citizen army of free men is far more willing to fight than those who are forced. We should give our peasants a relative amount of freedom; they will then fight more fervently to defend their homeland — and those privileges.
republican_election_law_advance: Elections are the cornerstone of our republic, ensuring that there are reasonable limits on those in power while giving the people the ability to select rulers that best serve their interests.
republican_electorate_law_advance: Elections are the foundational concept of our republic, and as such, the most important factor in determining the course of the Republic is deciding who is eligible vote in those elections.
tradition_of_payment: It is always tempting to be a little late paying soldiers of fortune — after all, you never know what sudden expenses might come along. But we will not do that; we shall pay our mercenaries exactly on time, and mercenary captains will know this and remember this.
free_merchants: In more reactionary and hidebound societies, merchants are looked down upon as somehow being less than those who own land. Well, this foolish attitude is not for us; we know that wealth is power regardless of where it comes from.
republican_power_law_advance: As any government, the Republic must not only make decisions, but also act upon them. To do so, it needs a way of exercising its executive capabilities so that they reach even the furthest areas of the country.
free_cities: Giving our cities self-governance in matters of trade will allow us to open new, profitable trade routes.
principle_of_administration_law_advance: The natural evolution of our complex government dictates the adoption of new laws pertaining to our administration.
free_subjects: Although giving a servant a damn good thrashing might be satisfying, it is surprisingly not the best way to make them work harder. Some natural philosopher has stumbled upon the idea of making profit the prime motivation for working people. If we replace monetary rents with payment in kind, our peasant laborers will be incentivized to produce more.
emancipation: For a long time, we have restricted land ownership to only those we felt were trustworthy enough. If we were to lift these restrictions, then land holdings could be consolidated. This in turn would create a pool of seasonal labor for whom the army life might be worth pursuing.
horse_lords: Our people and horses share an inseparable bond. Children grow up alongside foals, learning horsemanship from infancy. The careful breeding and exhaustive training of these mounts is our greatest pride, and we are recognized far and wide as the greatest horse-lords in the world.
kurultai_advance: Upon gathering leaders from each warrior band beneath one tent, we will elect the Khāghān who will lead our hordes to victory. In this kurultai, the fate of our people is decided, and leaders will be chosen from among those who think themselves worthy of leading us.
beyond_the_sun: The age of the Great Hordes is not over yet. We have learned from the mistakes of our enemies and will now rise wiser, and stronger. All the land where the sun lives and dies must be ours.
steppe_slave_raiding: Our raiding parties move as fast as the wind, hitting and running almost before anyone is aware of our presence. Looting the settlements we attack is in itself lucrative, but any prisoners we capture can be sold for a high price as well.
caravanserai_advance: Trade routes appeared in Central Asia over the last millennium, creating the network known as the Silk Road. Key to this was the flourishing of Caravanserai, places where merchants and their caravans could stop and rest along the way.
borjigin_blood: We share the blood of the Borjigin, of Genghis Khān himself. All countries bow in recognition of our heritage, and all territories of the steppes shall recognize us as their own.
turco_mongol_tradition: Although the Borjigin dynasty has a Mongolian origin, the territories conquered by Genghis Khān in Central Asia were mainly hose of Turkic populations. As a result, a distinct blended culture emerged between those two groups.
yams_of_the_great_khan: In order to ensure that messengers could travel fast enough to keep up with Mongol armies, Genghis Khān instituted a system of relay stations or yams, which were set up every 30-60 km to provide food, shelter and spare horses for Mongol army messengers. This allowed messages to travel as fast as a horse can gallop, with fatigue no longer slowing the speed a messenger could travel. By these means, our empire was able to overcome the logistical problems caused by the vast scale of the Pax Mongolica - at least temporarily.
mandate_of_the_khan: As the Khān commands, gods do. The unity of our people comes from their loyalty to our great leader. Only someone capable of bending the will of those loyal to the ruler is worthy of our devotion.
there_shall_be_no_grass: Where our horde has passed, the grass will never grow again; the land will no longer feed our enemies. Day and night will pass, and the ground will stay silent, no crops to be collected. Some hungers you cannot escape.
slavery_before_death: Razing and the destruction of cities are part of warfare. In the past, our warriors would go on a rampage, destroying and looting every item they could find, and killing those who stood in their way. While it strengthened their morale, their actions were far from economical. With this new approach, we can ensure to at least enslave those capable of work instead of blindly beheading them for the skull throne.
horde_loyalty: The loyalty of our people is unquestionable. No soul who has lived under the thriving rule of the Khān would think of ever leaving it.
horde_loot_discovery_advance: Raiding has always been part of our identity. Pillaging and plundering are how our people learn to fight and obtain much of their personal fortune. There is no harm in fomenting even more raids — at least, no harm for us.
trampling_horde: Genghis Khān made the world tremble with his conquests, and we will do the same. The world will learn to fear the sound of galloping hoofbeats as our riders approach!
watchers_of_the_silk_road: We do not build, we do not trade. We take what we need... and sometimes more. Our warriors have kept an attentive watch upon foreign merchants and their passage, and we now know the safest paths for transporting our goods.
logistics_of_khan: People forget that the conquests of the Great Khān were as much due to superior logistics as military strength. We must emulate the techniques of the Great Khān while updating them with modern knowledge. This will give us greater scope for conquest.
populating_the_steppes: Just as we bring destruction to our enemies, we must bring peace to the many who reside within our borders. By upholding internal stability and encouraging talented men and women from all over our empire to plan and populate new and great cities, we will tame the steppes.
a_magnanimous_empire: The Great Khān was not only known for his fearsome sword, but also for the exceptional generosity towards those who wisely bent the knee to him. Those who welcome the rule of our tolerant empire shall be treated as part of it.
horde_ardor: Our horses are almost as fierce and terrifying to our enemies as their riders are. The sight of our cavalry marching to war is like watching an unstoppable force of demons from hell.
servants_of_god: Being a cog in this heavenly machine is a great honor; our people find deep purpose in serving God's will. This belief that we collectively serve divine purpose makes the heart of our people beat with thunderous acclaim.
by_the_grace_of_god: The world was created with flames, and in flames shall we all end. Our god has gifted the fire of life to us humble mortals, burning our souls in the process and making us see the truth of its danger. Thou shall not be afraid.
state_of_clerics: The nature of a theocracy is held in its proximity to the divine. To achieve this closeness, many actions of our government are carried out by the clergy, combining religious ritual with the bureaucratic duties of administrators.
friends_in_high_places: There is only one path that will lead us to undying, everlasting happiness. To know the divine is to also know its sacred agents on this Earth, who will help us find that path.
flesh_is_weak: The flesh may be weak and corruptible, but the soul is not. Our armies have learned to fight as if they shared the same soul, and thus their morale can never be broken.
alpha_and_omega: Our faith is the beginning and end of all things. The voice of our god shall be the only sound that our enemies hear above the screams of the battle; the words of our faith shall lead them to the truth.
printing_of_religious_texts:
Establishing procedures to print, commercialize, and distribute religious texts are the necessary next steps towards increasing our piety and literacy!

Unlocks the Sponsor Printing of Religious Texts privilege.
conviction_of_sin: Those who have done wrong will fall to their knees under the heavy weight of their own wickedness! Their evil deeds shall haunt them forevermore, and they will not sleep until they have atoned for the devious nightmares they themselves have caused.
martyrs: A martyr is someone who understands that dying on behalf of their faith is the highest of honors. The people of our land keep their faith close to their hearts, and are always keen to join our cause. If they die as martyrs, it is an honor and not a tragedy.
divine_passion: Times are changing. Faith was once the most important thing in our lives, but now, ideas once seen as blasphemous are spreading among the common folk. In the face of an evolving world, our clergy finds solace in their unshaken dedication to our cause.
kgk_omi_genji: We are the Ōmi-Genji, descendants of the Uda Genji branch of the Minamoto family, who have governed Ōmi as hereditary Shugo for generations. Our well-established position gives us unquestioned legitimacy to defend and rule our ancestral domain.
akt_march_of_akita: Akita, our fief in northern Dewa Province, was an ancient zone of conflict against northern 'barbarians'. The border of Japan has expanded far into the North, but the spirit of our ancestors still lives in our blood — let any who dare stand in our way!
asa_legacy_of_emperor_keitai: Many centuries ago, emperor Keitai launched his campaign to take the imperial throne from Echizen. Like him, we must not hesitate to project power beyond our borders and to launch invasions into neighboring realms when the situation calls for it.
cba_lineage_of_taira: The Chiba clan is an old branch of the Taira, having split from them in the late Heian period. This gives us more power and influence than our political situation would otherwise indicate.
cba_katori_jingu: Katori Shrine is dedicated to Futsunushi no Kami, a patron god of martial arts who is revered by every warrior in Japan. By becoming the shrine's primary patron and encouraging our samurai to train there, we will assert our legitimacy while also strengthening the morale and abilities of our warriors.
csk_clans_of_tosa: Our home province Tosa has always been divided between powerful clans. If we wish to expand our holdings, we must join forces with these other clans — they will help us rise up, and in return we will increase their power.
dte_fujiwara_hokke: As one of the branches of the northern house of the Fujiwara, the legitimacy of our rule is impeachable.
htk_hatakeyama_heritage: Some consider our clan leaders to be rebellious troublemakers due to the stigma attached to our clan name. However, this enmity is naught but a symbol of our resilience. We have been reborn; we will never surrender, and will fight for what is ours no matter who may oppose us!
hsk_rising_clan: Although our origins are relatively humble, even compared to other clans descending from the Ashikaga, we have managed nonetheless to grow our influence considerably. Our clan is decidedly on the rise, and our ascension must not be hindered!
isk_sanindo_gate: The province of Tango is the gate to Kyōto in San'indō and a place of crucial economic importance. By firmly establishing and expanding our presence there, we can take advantage of such prosperity.
ito_gokenin_family: Our ancestors helped Minamoto no Yoritomo during the foundation of the Kamakura Shogunate. As a reward for this contribution, we were ranked as his Gokenin, and awarded a fiefdom in Hyūga Province. This is an honor few families in Kyūshū enjoy.
kkc_disinguished_family_in_kyushu: Unlike other powerful clans in Kyūshū, our family settled here before the establishment of the Kamakura Shogunate. Our achievements are well known, and our name is respected.
ktb_southern_court: We supported the Southern Court during the Imperial schism, showing loyalty to the Chrysanthemum Throne despite their struggles. This reputation for loyal service grants us more prestige and moral authority than many of the lesser houses that now dominate Japan.
kno_shugo_of_iyo: Since the late Heian Period, we have been the biggest naval power in the Seto Inland Sea. In fact, our navy is how we became Shugo of this province.
mri_descendant_of_oe_hiromoto: Ōe no Hiromoto, a scholar and politician who made great contributions to the establishment of the Kamakura Shogunate, was the ancestor of our clan. To this day, his spirit is embodied in our people, and we take pride in effectively administering the lands he secured for us.
nbu_genji_in_the_north: We are originally a cadet branch of the Kai Genji; our founder was given a fief in Ōshū Province as a reward for loyal service to the Kamakura Shogunate. Over time, we have grown accustomed to this region with its harsh winters, and know how to utilize these conditions to our strategic and tactical advantage.
oda_uninspiring_clan: Despite having an illustrious lineage, our clan is not considered particularly relevant, threatening, or interesting to outsiders. Their underestimation of our strength and cunning will soon prove to be their undoing...
ogs_ogasawara_ryu: Traditional forms of many things are highly valued in our society. We have formalized the official system of martial arts and etiquette for samurai since the founder of our clan, Ogasawara Nagakiyo, originally developed a special school, where all samurai should go to learn the proper techniques.
otm_lord_of_bungo: We have been the Shugo of Bungo since the Kamakura era. These lands are known for their highly fertile soil, and the rich harvests from this region allow us to feed larger armies than many other Daimyō can support.
ouc_descendant_of_baekje: Our chronicle says we are descendants of Prince Imseong of the royal house of the ancient Baekje Kingdom, which once ruled in Korea. This legendary connection means we hold a prestigious position in East Asia.
stk_hitachi_genji: We are one of the oldest Minamoto lines in the Kantō region, and have fought for our clan's glory in eastern Japan since before Minamoto no Yoritomo founded the Kamakura Shogunate. Our position as Shugo of Hitachi is therefore never in question.
sba_multiple_shugo: We have been made Shugo of multiple provinces. Administering all this land will make us rich from revenue generated by our fertile rice paddies and the workshops of the region's most skilled artisans.
smz_satsuma_shugo: We have always traditionally held the title of Shugo of Satsuma; its name has become synonymous with our clan. Our warriors are proud of this, and therefore always ready to defend our territory.
shn_vice_minister_of_dazaifu: As the name of our clan shows, we come from the appointed vice minister of the Dazaifu in Chikuzen province. This institution has since antiquity been the diplomatic and military center of the region, and we traditionally govern Northern Kyūshū as representative of the Emperor.
soo_tradition_of_wakou: While we appreciate lawful and peaceful trade, we also need to be prepared for tense military situations. Fortunately, the local tradition of piracy could help us solve certain combat-related issues.
tkd_kai_shugo: We are descendants of the Genji of Kai, and have been traditionally appointed as its Shugo. As such, we are intrinsically associated with it, and the famous horses from the province are already synonymous with our cavalry.
tki_genji_in_mino: As the head of the Genji in Mino and its appointed Shugo, we have led other local samurai for generations. Our domain occupies an advantageous position from which to control the neighboring regions.
ues_strong_dynastic_ties: Our family descends from the prestigious line of the Fujiwara, and we also have strong ties to the Ashikaga, as the mother of Ashikaga Takauji was a member of our clan. These dynastic ties will prove invaluable for our prosperity.
utn_fujiwara_descendant: Our genealogy shows that the ancestors of our clan were originally members of the Fujiwara family from Kyōto. This kinship to such an ancient and revered dynasty is very useful for making diplomatic connections to the Imperial Court and with the other clans.
ymn_descendant_of_nitta: We are descendants of the Nitta clan, ancient rivals of the Ashikaga family. To some this is proof of the depths of our loyalty, while to others this makes us a natural enemy. We must cleverly utilize our lineage as a diplomatic weapon.
kgk_emerging_clan: Despite our impressive ancestry, our clan is very new, as our split from the Sasaki clan is relatively recent. Our people are eager to prove their worth as scions of an independent name.
akt_ezo_kanrei: The position of the Ezo Kanrei, or administrator of Ezo, has been assigned to our clan since the time of the Kamakura Shogunate. We are in charge of managing the island as a place of exile for criminals, necessitating constant communication across the strait.
asa_control_of_buddhist_sects: Echizen is home to many important temples representing different sects, such as the Eiheiji of the Sōtō tradition and the Heisenji of the Tendai tradition, among others. If we could bring all of them under our control and establish religious peace throughout the province, it would be the foundation of an ideal religious policy for our entire nation.
cba_dream_of_masakado: Taira no Masakado, a great warrior and close kinsman of our clan, once tried to become the Emperor of Eastern Japan. Sadly, Masakado could not fulfill his ambition, but his dream of founding a new nation of samurai should be our guiding star.
csk_god_of_arts: The ancestral founder of our clan, Hata no Kawakatsu, was highly admired as the patron god of all art, from traditional dances to theater. Our clan must live up to his legacy if we are to earn the respect we deserve.
dte_oshu_shugo: As an honorable clan dating back to the early Kamakura period, we have a strong claim to rule over the entire Ōshū province. Fortunately for us, what land Ōshū exactly covers is not well-defined.
htk_shogunate_ties: As a clan descending from one of the branches of the Ashikaga, we have particularly strong ties to the authority of the Shogunate. As long as we maintain this association, our clan will continue to be held in high regard.
hsk_branches_and_retainers: Our widespread clan controls rich territories through a network of loyal kinsmen and retainers. By maintaining internal harmony in our dynasty, our clan will become one of the most powerful in Japan.
img_claim_to_shogunate: As our clan is descended from the Ashikaga family, we have a strong claim on the position of Shōgun, should the main line perish. Even if the Bakufu is not threatened, it would still be in our best interests to remind everyone of our legitimacy. Just in case it ever becomes relevant...
isk_minister_of_samurai_dokoro: We are one of four powerful clans traditionally appointed to be the chief of military and police in the Samurai-Dokoro. It is thus our responsibility, and our privilege, to keep the peace in the capital and other important places.
kkc_resistance_against_foreign_intervent: Our contributions to defending the country against the Mongol invasions are well known. Kikuchi Takefusa's achievements in repelling the invaders are widely lauded, and all our troops aim to fight as bravely as him.
ktb_control_of_ise: From the wealthy south to the densely populated urban north, we have extended our control over the entire province of Ise. This will allow us to fully exploit provincial resources to further the growth of our clan's influence.
ktb_blessing_of_amaterasu: As the keepers of the holiest of Japan's shrines at Ise, we are blessed by Amaterasu, goddess of the sun and the universe. We must rise to be worthy of the task of maintaining and caring for this national treasure, which will earn us the respect of the Japanese people.
kno_ruler_of_inland_sea: The Seto Inland Sea has a special importance for trade routes of Japan, and maintaining naval dominance here could make or break our clan. We must ensure that we always have a strong navy with which to control maritime trade.
nbu_fight_against_famines: Due to cold winds in the late autumn and heavy snows until the early spring, our people often suffer from severe famines and hunger. We must build reserves of food and look into how we can improve the lands under our control to counter future catastrophes.
ogs_shinano_shugo: Our clan belongs to a sub-branch of the Minamoto, and rules Shinano Province as its Shugo. Our land is mountainous and unwelcoming to many. For our people, however, it has for a long time been an integrated part of our defenses against outsiders. Let us take this experience with us wherever our armies go, and make sure to always obtain thorough information about the terrain in any region where we do battle.
suw_suwa_taisha: Suwa Taisha at Lake Suwa is one of the oldest shrines in Japan, and highly adored throughout the country. Its most important festival, Onbashira-matsuri, proves the bravery of our people as they carry the sacred logs from the mountain to the shrine.
otm_domination_of_kyushu: We have been designated Shugo of Bungo, Hizen, and Hyūga. This positions us perfectly to claim all of Kyūshū for ourselves!
ouc_korea_trade: Due to our location, we are the clan trading most actively with Korea, and as a result we have a near-monopoly on many exotic goods. We must do what we can to retain this favorable position, and leverage it to out-compete any upstart that might challenge us.
stk_kashima_jingu: Kashima Shrine is one of three most important shrines in the Kantō region. This shrine is dedicated to Takemikazuchi-no-O-no-Kami, who is the god of thunder and swords, and also the patron god of Sumō wrestling. Our custodianship of this shrine strengthens the resolve of our armies.
sba_access_to_northern_japan: Ōshū Province is our second home and where our clan originated. We must make use of our ties to Ōshū to procure some of the strong war horses native to that region.
shn_defender_against_mongols: As a prominent samurai family from Northern Kyūshū, we have bravely fought against both Mongol invasions. Should the need arise, we will once again rise to defend both Kyūshū and the realm at large from outside invaders.
soo_fight_for_tsushima: Lying between Asia and the islands of Japan, our homeland of Tsushima and its surrounding waters are where countries clash and fight hard. May our own fleets be strong, so that we can not only defend our country, but also expand it!
tkd_takeda_ryu: Traditional forms of martial arts have been practiced in our family for generations. Among them, there is particular emphasis on horse riding and mounted archery, making our mounted troops much more effective soldiers than those from other clans.
tki_banner_of_bellflower: Having been its Shugo for generations, our emblem is already synonymous with Mino. All who live there will fight under our banner.
ues_double_shugo: We have been appointed Shugo of both Kōzuke and Tango Provinces. Their plentiful lands are the perfect starting point for our expansion.
utn_legacy_of_nasu_no_yoichi: Shimotsuke was once the home of Nasu no Yoichi, who was famous for his abilities as an archer during the Genpei War. To this day, the warriors of Shimotsuke hold him in high regard; we are proud to be called 'the best archers in Kantō' and to carry on Nasu no Yoichi's legacy.
ymn_mediate_succession_disputes: As many of the other clans squabble within themselves over who is the rightful heir to whom, they turn to us to mediate their disputes. Doing so puts us in a unique position of power and trust, making it easy for us to make new allies and contacts — and to destabilize our rivals.
akt_ainu_trade: We are among the first Japanese to have established permanent trade with the Ainu. Our ships go back and forth between their lands and ours, greatly benefiting both communities.
csk_unification_of_shikoku: Shikoku is seen as a poor, isolated land by the rest of Japan, where nothing of importance happens. Let them continue thinking that and overlook our unification of the island until it is too late.
hsk_control_of_izumi_sea: Our clan's territory has traditionally been situated around the Kii Channel. Taking control of trade entering the mainland through that point will bring us massive profits, and we shall flourish immensely.
img_supreme_ruler_of_tokaido: The Tōkaidō is the most important trade route between Central and Eastern Japan. As our ancestral lands are in the middle of all this trade, it would behoove us to take control over the entire region, so as to reap the most benefits from local commercial activity.
ktb_the_march_of_kitabatake_akiee: Our honorable ancestor Kitabatake Akiie proved that even the long march from Ōu to central Japan can be undertaken rapidly if one has enough determination. We must learn from this feat and train our armies in swift maneuvering, so that we can quickly move from one front to another as needed.
nbu_northern_horses: Mutsu has ranches, from which horses were sent to Kyōto in ancient times. The tradition of horse farming continues until today, and is one we should cultivate, as it allows us to raise cavalry more easily than many of our neighbors.
oda_generals: Obsession with birth and privilege has made this country weak, and the rise of self-made powerful clans throughout the realm has clearly proven how useless such notions can be. Let us take this lesson to heart, and allow success and skill be the guiding principles for who should rise to command our armies. Strong leadership is a requirement for rapid expansion.
ogs_kiso_uma: Horses from the Kiso area are our preferred breed. They are not as high nor as fast as other types, but they make up for it with high stamina, and are sturdy enough to survive in the mountains.
otm_nanban_trade: Others may denounce foreigners as barbarians, but we recognize the benefits and advantages of trading with them. Let it be known that they will always be welcome in our ports — and we will be able to expand our trade network further than our rivals.
ouc_fight_against_wokou: In order to retain good relations with nations on the continent for the sake of our traders, we must mount constant sea patrols. As long as pirates and smugglers are common in our waters, foreigners will not trust us, and may even act against us.
sba_shiba_retainers: We have talented, but ambitious vassals in our clan. They are a frequent cause of familial friction, and we would be wise to rein them in. Then again, close supervision and lavish, yet strategic rewards could turn these powerful families into the greatest assets of our rule.
smz_tsurinobuse: Tsurinobuse, 'lure and ambush', is our most effective tactic. This strategy enables us to beat enemies when we are vastly outnumbered, which is of course a very valuable skill. We must make this a central tactic of our armies, and give the dull-witted commanders of rival clans a little surprise.
shn_diplomacy_through_tsushima: Thanks to our presence in Tsushima, we have a wealth of experience in negotiating with Korea. This way, we have always been able to keep a channel open to the outside world, even during times when official relations were forbidden.
soo_bahan_ship: Our privateer ships fly the flag of Hachiman, spreading terror wherever they go. No one would dare attack a fleet protected by the god of war himself!
tki_flood_control_of_three_rivers: In our home province, the three big rivers of Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi often cause serious flooding in our rice fields. We should control this overflow, and use it to increase the yield in all provinces under our rule.
ues_eastern_power: Although we have been granted territory in both eastern and western Japan, it is in the east where we will truly be able to flourish. Our territories there are rich, and we can attract many skilled local warriors to fight for our cause.
utn_mediator_of_kanto: As one of the oldest clans in Kantō, we have a keen insight into regional politics, and have worked as a mediator between different factions on many occasions. This same comprehensive understanding of our home region allows us to expand our territory effectively without provoking others.
ymn_leader_of_western_army: Let us forge a great western army to unite the squabbling states of Japan. Skillful generals, well-trained soldiers, and ironclad bravery will easily force the Easterners to their knees!
ask_defender_of_the_imperial_court: When the Kamakura Shogunate fell, we were the ones who protected the Emperor and the Imperial Court. This has afforded us a position at the forefront of all clans in Japan, as the true protector of the Empire and its courtly traditions.
ask_bugyoshu_and_hokushu: We must strengthen the authority of our administrative officials, such as the Bugyōshū magistrates and the Hōkōshū commanders. A strong bureaucracy can sometimes be the only thing that stands between us and an open civil war.
ask_higashiyama_culture: Built around the ascetics of Zen, Higashiyama culture sees beauty in simplicity. It has promoted development of the formal tea ceremony, ikebana flower arrangements, theater, and art. This blossoming of culture has brought great prestige to those who practice the arts, and will reflect well upon our realm.
cba_irrigation_of_southern_kanto: Large parts of our domain is marshland that cannot support intensive agriculture. Recent developments in irrigation technology, however, make it possible to drain marshes and cultivate new arable lands. Let us undertake a grand project of developing these otherwise useless lands; we stand to profit enormously.
csk_expand_the_navy: Japan is a nation of islands, and as a result, a strong navy is an absolute necessity. Tosa is an ideal place to begin building an armada of our own.
dte_dragon_of_oshu: Our might and power will be the envy of our enemies. Our name will forever be associated with the Dragon of Ōshū.
htk_clan_spread: Our clan is not content to occupy a single location, and we do our utmost to project our influence all over the country. No matter how far it may spread, our clan authority must be unquestionable in all our holdings.
img_unlikely_alliances: Sometimes, the best way to defeat an enemy is to make them your friend. Securing our rule through strategic marriages will not only pacify our foes and gain us new allies, but will also ensure that we can ultimately dominate our rivals through blood.
ito_sympathy_to_foreign_faiths: Foreigners coming to our land bring with them foreign beliefs. We must of course make sure that this is harmless to our traditional belief systems, but as long as there is no risk to us, we see no reason to disallow people from choosing their own faith.
kno_murakami_suigun: The Murakami clan is well-known for committing piracy in the Seto Inland Sea. Let us integrate them fully in our own clan, and send these fearsome privateers after our enemies!
mri_munakata_three_goddesses: The three daughters of Susanoo-no-Mikoto are patron goddesses of the sea and navigation. Their blessings will make our navies unstoppable.
oda_tenka_fubu: It is clearly our destiny to hold all the country within our grasp. None shall resist our authority, and all under Heaven will bend to our military might.
oda_triple_firing: The advent of firearms has and will continue to revolutionize warfare in Japan, and through mastering these new weapons, we can dominate any battlefield. In order to increase the rate of their fire, our arquebusiers will form ranks, allowing one line to fire while two others reload.
ogs_improvment_of_nakasendo: The Nakasendō is one of the most important routes between central and eastern Japan. Controlling it also means controlling the trade that flows through it.
otm_christian_conversion: Our increasing interactions with foreigners have sparked an interest in Christianity for many in our clan. The Christian people have many powerful advocates among our lords and vassals, and few are as zealous as recent converts. Let us make good use of these Christian converts, regardless of which route our own clan takes, and use their influence and zeal to further our own agenda.
ouc_welcome_missionaries: As our trade network expands, we come in more frequent contact with foreigners and their strange habits and faiths. Regardless of what they believe, their coin is good enough; we should appear to be open to their ideas as we are to their business if we wish to secure repeat commerce.
stk_eastern_coalitions: Regardless of the hostile clans around us, we have always presented ourselves as a reasonable third party for other clans to attach themselves to for protection against invaders. This tradition of eastern coalitions will serve us well, as long as we make sure that the clans who rely on us never have to worry about protection.
smz_shimazu_charge: Even when surrounded and outnumbered, our soldiers will keep marching forward until they reach the other side of the enemy lines. The charge of our troops will be legendary!
smz_tanegashima: The Westerners who first landed on Tanegashima brought with them new and interesting weapons. These arquebuses are becoming an increasingly common sight all over Japan, but nowhere have they been available for as long as here.
tkd_tiger_of_kai: Strong leaders are better at safeguarding their domains than any number of imposing castles. Our generals must train hard, and earn the right to be called the 'Tiger of Kai'.
tkd_fuurinkazan: 'Swift like the wind, gentle like the forest, aggressive like fire, immovable like a mountain.' The words of the great war master Sun Tzu shall be permanently etched into our family's history, and shall serve as our motto.
ues_dragon_of_echigo: Our clan has fostered such an extraordinary spirit of courage and justice that it intimidates our opponents on the battlefield. We will declare the strength of our leaders to all the world, and everyone will quake with terror at the thought of the Dragon of Echigo!
ymn_isolated_heartland: Our homeland is mountainous and isolated. Fortunately, this also means that any potential conquerors would find our territory almost impossible to reach! Let us build our defenses so that they complement the natural protective strength of our geography — any invader will bitterly regret the day they turned their greedy eyes to our possessions.
ask_shugo_system: Shugo are important vassals for the Shogunate, administrating the lands in name of the Shōgun. Thanks to them, we can administer our lands better and more efficiently.
dte_intensive_domain_development: Many dismiss Ōu as poor due to its harsh weather and mountains, yet the region holds great potential. Through infrastructure investment — new towns, waterways, expanded cultivation — and by abolishing stifling tolls and taxes, we can substantially improve our heartland and make our subjects wealthy.
img_march_to_kyoto: In these dangerous times when Japan and Kyōto are mired in political chaos, anyone could march into the capital and seize power. As close kinsmen of the Ashikaga, it is our obligation — and our right — to ensure the stability of the country.
oda_influential_strongholds: Japan is a land of castles and fortifications. It is through the construction of strong defensive positions that one can assert influence both over the political realm and the routes vital to military campaigns. This learning is one we must take to heart. It is also through our castles that we impose our presence and power upon the common people. At all times, we must prioritize the reduction of enemy fortifications and the erection of our own in strategic locations.
oda_patronization_of_the_west: Western missionaries brought many ideas and techniques to our land, and unlike the Buddhist sects of old, they have no previous ties to corrupt landowners or rebellious cities. We should welcome these foreigners into our cities, and see what benefits they could bring to our court.
smz_early_westernization: Thanks to frequent early contact with Western countries, we have learned a lot about foreign technology and other innovations. Using this knowledge, we can carry out reforms in economy, industry, and education that will help gain an edge over other clans.
slave_raiding_wars: Slaves are the cornerstone of our economy. Attacking and raiding our neighbors to capture their population and enslave them is therefore the lifeblood of our country.
nomadic_tendencies: Many of our people have lived their lives as nomads, as our custom has been to travel from one habitable place to the next. Even now, as everything changes and we build a city for our people, some retain their nomadic traditions, and continue to wander.
land_of_the_ancestors: Land is not property, nor is it mere dust; it is our connection to our great forebears. From the better lands beyond, they watch over us. We must never let the connection between us be severed, and we must care for these lands in honor of those who first settled them.
wandering_scholars: Communities of learned scholars of many faiths live in our lands, offering religious instruction to all who will listen.
community_of_the_faithful: Our Empire is home to people from hundreds of different backgrounds. They speak a multitude of tongues, and come from all the directions of the horizon, but each in their own tongue pays homage to our ruler, binding us together.
bound_by_service: We are one people, and we have one army. By bringing troops from across all of our territories together, and pressing conquered peoples into military service, we can better integrate them into our society, and also increase their acceptance of our rule.
regnal_chronicles: We should record the history of our splendid rulers and their illustrious deeds in great chronicles, so that they may be passed down across the generations and always remembered.
expanded_slave_trade: The demand for Slaves from external traders grows greater by the day. Our position in Africa makes us the ideal middlemen for this trade. Let us encourage those that seek slave markets to do so in our lands, and to make their business in our marketplaces.
gifts_and_hostages: While our people are now united, the act of bending the knee to a common overlord has not come easy to them. By summoning all subjugated rulers to the capital, we can employ them as prestigious royal envoys. Some would call this a policy of hostage-taking; we simply see it as a way to remind our more independent-minded subjects of their loyalties.
people_of_ornaments: Our artisans are renowned far and wide, and it is said that they cannot leave a surface undecorated. Let us make the most of this reputation, and promote their creations as much as possible.
courtly_competition: A preoccupied noble is a well-behaved noble. There are so many courtly titles in our realms that some say half of our men have one. Let us make sure our courtiers spend their time competing with one another for attention and visibility; they will be too busy to plot against our rule.
overnight_army: Our capital and other cities are built using army camps as a model. They have wings, vanguards, and fronts. In ensuring that military thinking permeates daily life, we will improve our overall combat readiness.
mining_tradition: Our land is rich in rare materials, ready to be ripped from the earth and sold to foreign merchants for large profits. We would be foolish not to exploit this.
intercontinental_trade: Our merchants frequently bring back fascinating things from the courts of faraway countries. Perhaps it would be possible to reach even further shores?
expanded_grazing_grounds: Our territory has plenty of land which is well-suited for grazing animal herds, making it easy for us to expand our output of Livestock.
african_sturdy_grains_advance: A stronger focus on agricultural production will help our people thrive. Thankfully, we have the ample space and fertile soil necessary to grow a number of crops.
hand_cannon_guild_advance: Primitive metal tubes which were a lesser form of later, more advanced guns. First developed in China, the early hand cannon spread to Goryeo and Japan in 1270.
saquiyah: The Sāqiyah is a mechanical device designed to ease the transportation of water to higher elevations. Also known as the Persian wheel, tablia, rehat, and tympanum, the wheel is crucial in the irrigation systems in areas with little to no flowing water.
riches_of_asia: Asia is famous around the world for its riches. From the bountiful cities of Persia and India, to the highly-sought luxury items produced in China, to the almost mythical Spice Islands in Indonesia, the luxurious goods coming from Asia are highly prized worldwide.
silk_road: Be it the land route crossing the Gobi Desert and Persia, or its ocean counterpart through the Indian Ocean and Indonesia, the lands of Asia have been for centuries traversed by merchants seeking profit on the famous Silk Road.
exchange_of_ideas: Not only do coin and profit move along the Silk Road, but ideas and knowledge also follow the ebb and flow of the merchants traveling along its path.
legacy_of_great_empires: From the Dragon Throne of China, to the various empires of Persia, to the powerful Hindu and Buddhist dynasties of India and South East Asia, Asia has been home to many mighty empires throughout history.
arduous_terrain: Asia is home to some very inhospitable lands, from the high peaks of the Himalaya, to the arid span of the Gobi Desert, to the dense jungles of India and South East Asia. And that does not even include the monsoon and typhoon seasons, and the almost constant present of earthquakes! Its people have learned to live in such an unwelcoming environment, but invaders will not find it so easy.
fertile_lands: In general, the lands of Asia are blessed with plentiful rain, and many rivers cross its territories even in areas with less precipitation. Except for some of the most arid areas of the desert, our land provides ample food to our population. Even in those regions where it does not, the people living there are able to do much with what they have.
crossroads_of_religions: Hinduism, Buddhism, Islam, and even Tengrism are religions that have expanded into parts of the world very far from their places of origin. Asia has witnessed this exchange of beliefs for centuries, and in many cases the blending and syncretism that has happened among them.
religious_syncretism: Interaction between beliefs sometimes results in synthesis rather than rejection. Foreign thoughts and practices should therefore not be seen as hostile threats, but opportunities to learn, and possibly incorporate valuable elements into our own traditions.
source_of_knowledge: While foreign nations pride themselves on being at the forefront of knowledge and development, some of their recent 'inventions' have been known in Asia for centuries. From the technological prowess of China to the ancient literature of India, there is nothing for the East to envy from the West.
structured_society: Religious and philosophical traditions, particularly those of Hinduism and Confucianism, have historically influenced social organization in parts of Asia, emphasizing proscribed role fulfillments within social hierarchies. The rigidity of living within these systems is offset by the relative ease with which social order is maintained.
incense_preeminence: Incense has been a staple of life in Asia for centuries, maybe more so than anywhere in the world. Although other religions also use it for their rituals, its near-ubiquity in Hindu and Buddhist ceremonies, as well as its everyday use by Islam people, give it a constant presence anywhere in Asia.
incense_trade_route: The high demand for Incense, not only in Asia but also beyond it, requires the establishment of many trade routes dedicated to its commerce. Akin to the more famous Silk Road, this trade of Incense links the East with the West.
wake_of_the_mongol_horde: There is almost no place in Asia that has not felt the influence of the Mongol conquests. After the fall of the once-great empire forged by Genghis Khān, the land is finally recovering from being trampled by his horses.
cultural_melting_pot: Asia is a highly diverse region, home to a wide variety of cultures. This diversity, and the cultural exchange and blended influences that result from it, has empowered our countries and allowed them to flourish in every domain from architecture to music to horticulture, and beyond.
rise_of_great_individuals: History proves that the most extraordinary individuals are the ones who rise to prominence and achieve great things. Time and again, empires have been forged or destroyed by the hand of a single ruler, and such achievements are to be respected and admired.
sepak_takraw: Having been practiced all over South East Asia for a long time since its adaptation from the ancient Chinese Cùjū, and also known as Sepak Raga, Takraw, Chinlone, or Sipa depending on the country, Sepak Takraw is not just a game. Although the objective is to kick a ball between players and keep it in the air, it is also a way to have regular physical exercise, and thus played not only for entertainment but as military training for the army.
three_teachings: The Three Teachings are a philosophy originating from China which combines the teachings of Confucianism, Daoism and Buddhism into a harmonious, singular teaching. Confucianism represents the ideology of the law while Daoism is the worldview of the radical intellectuals. These two opposite ends of the philosophical spectrum would then be connected with the philosophies of Buddhism.
baghlah_advance: The Baghlah is a large deep-sea sailing vessel which is used as a merchant ship. It has its origins in the Arabian Peninsula, but spread as far as the Spice Islands as a used ship type.
expansionist_ambitions: As the Balkans fractured, many rising powers looked outward. Ambitious rulers pursued integration of diverse lands under a single, stronger crown, taking advantage of Byzantine weakness.
poklisars: Since the earliest days of our nation, we have often cast our gaze beyond our borders, be it to establish profitable trade routes, placate formidable neighbors and build alliances, or even to forge robust partnerships against common adversaries. Poklisars are the ambassadors who carry out these missions in our name.
vojvodstvo_advance: Among the South Slavs, the Vojvoda serves as a high military commander, leading the nobles into battle and administering frontier lands. The title is preserved through generations of war, carried by princely warlords and resistance leaders alike.
balkan_hajduks: As the central authority of medieval kingdoms fractures under the weight of imperial expansion, the social vacuum is filled by the Hajduks. Originally simple cattle drovers (hajtó) and seasonal laborers, these men have transitioned into a semi-mythical class of guerrilla fighters and highwaymen. They operate in small, disciplined bands (cheta) led by a Harambaša, governed by strict internal codes of conduct that emphasize loyalty and the protection of the local peasantry (the raja). In our eyes, they are nothing more than brigands; to the commoners, they are the only shield against the depredations of foreign tax collectors and unruly invaders. By codifying their presence within our military structure, we empower a force that thrives on the very lawlessness of the frontier.
cro_pandurs_recruitment: The state must harness the ferocity of the frontier without succumbing to its chaos. The Pandurs, once mere night watchmen and local security, are reorganized by charismatic leaders into a professionalized light infantry. These soldiers are a terrifying sight on the European battlefield, accompanied by their own bands of martial music. They are the masters of skirmishes, specializing in raiding supply lines, screening the main army, and psychological warfare. Their discipline may be erratic and their love of plunder great, but in a ruler's hand they are a flexible tool of intimidation.
voievodate_advance: Across the Carpathian basin, the Voievod stands as both sovereign ruler in Wallachia and Moldavia and as a high crown office in Transylvania and the Hungarian kingdom. The office binds the ruler to a powerful nobility through ancient custom and elective right.
eastern_african_trade: The lands of East Africa are at the crossroads of great trade routes. From the land of Egypt and the ports of the Mediterranean through the Red Sea, to the riches of the East accross the Indian Ocean, and southwards along the Swahili Coast, the bustling movement of goods and people is constant. The countries in these lands are thus also accustomed to exchanging goods and valuables as a means of establishing diplomatic relationships.
ukrainian_farmlands: Ukraine, or the 'borderlands' in language, is one of the most fertile regions in Europe. The lands along both banks of the great rivers are renowned for their rich black soil, yielding abundant harvests of grain, legumes, and fiber crops. Whoever holds these territories commands a significant agricultural advantage, supplying their realm's granaries and the markets of Europe.
cas_the_reconquista: The Reconquista is the campaign by which the Christian kingdoms of Hispania shall reclaim Iberia from the successor states of al-'Andalus. Iberian arms carry the heaviest share of this effort, from the joint victory at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, to the taking of Córdoba in 1236, Valencia in 1238, and Seville in 1248. This permanent state of holy war has produced a military culture, a chivalric ethos, and a frontier social order that no other European kingdom can match.
tercio: Tercio infantry were developed principally by the brilliant general Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba, called El Gran Capitán, during the Italian Wars. It is a mixed infantry formation of pikemen and musketeers. Because of this combined arms approach, it simultaneously uses both the rigidity of its heavy infantry and the long-range firepower of its musketeers, making it ideal for both defense and offense.
catalan_galley: The Catalan Galley is a larger version of the ancient Greek galleys that once dominated the Mediterranean Sea.
early_iberian_caravel: Originally of Iberian origin, the first caravels were small but very fast ships that were used for offshore fishing and coastal trade. Their use in Iberia is so widespread that the region can easily boast of possessing the most advanced caravels.
iberian_caravel: The need for faster and more reliable caravels has driven our shipbuilding experts to make improvements to their design. While caravels have become common across Europe, the Iberian models remain superior in both innovation and speed.
early_iberian_galleon: An early, but powerful ocean-going vessel, the Early Iberian Galleon is an original invention from Iberia that has a lower forecastle and a long hull, making them especially stable and resistant to headwinds.
square_rigged_caravel: By combining the Iberian Caravel and the Carrack, a new ship has been born: fast, strong, and exactly what we need help us dominate the seas.
iberian_galleon: The Iberian Galleon is a more stylized version of the Early Iberian Galleon. They are tremendously powerful vessels that absolutely crush any opposition on the high seas.
spa_naval_reforms: The Iberian peninsula's coastline spans three different seas (the Bay of Biscay, the Atlantic approaches, and the western Mediterranean) each with its own maritime tradition built up over centuries by the different Iberian cultures' fleets. We will consolidate the historical patchwork of peninsular naval commands into a unified professional Armada under centralized captain general authority, standardizing recruitment, signal codes, and provisioning across every shipyard from coast to coast. This union of the peninsula's fleets lets our Crown crew, maintain, and send out the fleets for two oceans that the coming centuries of global empire will demand.
lieutenancy_advance: As the Crown of Aragon's possessions grow to encompass realms scattered from the Pyrenees to Sicily, the king's physical absence from any one territory becomes a permanent feature of governance. The office of Lloctinent is institutionalized in the fourteenth century, with a senior noble or royal relative deputized to hold court, dispense justice, and command troops in the king's name during his absence. This institution allows a composite monarchy to function as a single political unit across distances that would otherwise fragment it into warring viceroyalties.
spa_viceroyalties: The vast Castilian and Portuguese territories conquered after Hernán Cortés took Tenochtitlan and Francisco Pizarro took Cajamarca require a level of royal supervision that no medieval feudal arrangement can supply. We will establish the Virreinatos (first the Viceroyalty of New Spain at Mexico City under Antonio de Mendoza, then the Viceroyalty of Peru at Lima under Blasco Núñez Vela) each headed by a viceroy holding the king's full personal authority over governance, justice, finance, and defense. The viceregal system is a model of distant administration that successfully holds together the largest contiguous empires in human history.
ara_almogavars: Almogavars are a class of light infantry soldiers originating from the Crown of Aragon. These quick-moving warriors serve as frontier defenders and foot soldiers. In addition to their role in the Reconquista, they have also found employment as mercenaries in Italy, the Frankokratia, and the Levant.
ara_catalan_crossbowmen: Some of the fiercest and deadliest crossbowmen in the Western Mediterranean, the Catalan Crossbowmen compete against the Genoese Crossbowmen for supremacy in this field.
ara_late_almogavars: The Almogavars, embracing new innovations, have undergone remarkable adaptations to enhance their efficiency on the battlefield. Integrating cutting-edge weaponry and strategic advancements into their traditional tactics, these formidable warriors have become even more formidable. With a blend of ancient expertise and modern tools, they stand as a prime example of the seamless fusion between tradition and innovation in warfare.
cas_lanzas_de_castilla: Inspired by the Moorish jinete, the Lanzas de Castilla ride lighter than a knightly lance but fight heavier than a skirmisher, closing to break a formation where a true light horseman would only harass and withdraw.
por_cacadores: Nicknamed the Fighting Cocks, the Caçadores are an elite light infantry unit in the Portuguese Army who wear brown uniforms to distinguish them from regular soldiers.
indonesia_outer_islands_archipelago: Maritime connections naturally play a huge role within our society, as we are surrounded by waters. Our reliance on maritime trade and transport makes traversal of the seas a trivial task for our people.
indonesia_naval_supremacy: Our political relevance within the archipelago almost solely relies on the strength of our naval forces. By improving our shipwrighting techniques and crew training, we will ensure our domination over the lesser states of Indonesia.
indonesia_trading_hub_of_the_east: No matter their origin or destination, every trader in Asia will eventually have to cross our lands, bringing both precious goods and tales of their travels with them.
indonesia_archipelago_of_many_faiths: Our islands are home to many different people, speaking different languages and believing in many different gods. Only if we establish a common understanding and tolerance between them can we secure a prosperous country.
italy_great_families: After the foundation of our unified Italian state, we have absorbed many great noble families into our country. We should utilize their prestige and reputation to improve our own, while keeping those capable people busy.
italian_condottieri: Our nation is renowned for producing great military minds, whether they serve their own interests or are sworn in loyalty to the state. We should ensure that these adept intellects are willing to serve us first and foremost.
genoese_crossbowmen: Genoese Crossbowmen are a respected military unit that was used by the Genoese during the First Crusade up until now. Equipped with Genoese crossbows and the pavise, these infantrymen serve as the protection of their home as well as mercenaries in Europe.
genoese_galley: The Genoese Galley is the backbone of the Genoese navy. Lighter and longer than other galleys used in the Mediterranean Sea, this ship is able to achieve unmatched speed while also having a significant cargo advantage at the cost of maneuverability and durability.
city_of_scholars: Our Maghrebi madrasas (the Qarawiyyīn of Fez, the Zaytūna of Tunis, the Tashfīniyya of Tlemcen) have drawn students and teachers from every quarter of the Maghreb since the thirteenth century. Our jurists train in the Mālikī fiqh under masters whose chains of transmission run to Córdoba, and our astronomers, physicians, and grammarians correspond with peers from Cairo to Fez. A sustained intellectual life makes our courts intellectual capitals of the central and western Maghreb.
slave_raid_advance: Our Maghrebi ports license the ra'īs, corsair captains who sail under our flag to cruise the western Mediterranean and the Atlantic approaches, taking Christian shipping for prize money and Christian crews for our slave markets. We will arm light xebec and galley squadrons in our harbours, channel a share of every haul into the Crown's treasury, and let the Trinitarian and Mercedarian friars ransom back the captives our captains hold. This corsair economy funds our state through prize and ransom revenues on a scale that no regular taxation of our coastal provinces could ever match.
mor_marabouts: The marabouts, Sufi shayḵs of the Qādiriyya, Shādhiliyya, and Tijāniyya ṭarīqas, have planted zāwiya lodges across the rural Maghreb, where they teach, arbitrate disputes, and channel popular religious feeling. Their tombs become pilgrimage sites, their living successors hold moral authority that rivals the jurists of the cities, and their endorsement of a ruler legitimizes that ruler with the tribal countryside. A rural network of Sufi authority gives every state a religious presence in every village, without requiring direct administrative penetration.
trans_saharan_trade: The northern termini of the trans-Saharan caravan routes (Sijilmasa, Ouargla, Tlemcen, Ghadāmis, and Tripoli) sit on our soil, gathering the Bambuk and Buré gold dust, Slaves, and ivory of the Sudan into our markets. Our jallāba merchants finance the desert crossing, our mints strike golden dinārs from the inbound gold under royal monopoly, and our re-export trade redistributes Sudanese goods to Mediterranean and Atlantic buyers. This commanding position over the northern half of the Saharan economy gives every Maghrebi state both a trade route revenue and a minting prestige that no purely Mediterranean kingdom can match.
slave_soldiers: The Hafsid sultans of Tunis or the Zayyanid emirs of Tlemcen have built up corps of ghulām and mamlūk-style retainers since the fourteenth century, purchased from Black African markets, taken in raids on Christian Iberia, or born into the institution as the children of earlier slave soldiers. These troops swear personal loyalty to the ruler rather than to tribe or region, making them the reliable counterweight to the unstable Banū Hilāl levies that no Maghrebi sultan can fully trust in succession disputes. A system of military slavery gives our state infantry and cavalry that are politically reliable, as no purely tribal army can be.
hispano_moresque_style: Andalusian craftsmen fleeing the Christian frontier have settled in our Maghrebi cities for two centuries, bringing their tilework, woodcarving, and stuccowork into our mosques, madrasas, and palaces. The Almoravid pulpits of our great mosques, the lacework arches of our royal courts, and the funerary cupolas of our shrines all bear the unmistakable Hispano-Moresque signature. The influx of Andalusian artistry lends the Maghrebi courts an aesthetic that rivals Granada itself and sets the standard for the Maghreb's high culture.
tuareg_veiled_cavalry: The Tuareg Veiled Cavalry are the indigo-veiled camel-and-horse riders of the deep Sahara, grown out of the into a heavier arm that can hold ground as well as raid. They carry the straight takouba broadsword and the long allagh lance, taking payment from the caravans they escort and plunder from those they do not.
rais_of_the_navy: Our corsair captains, the Ra'īs, are more than just pirates: they are seasoned naval commanders, and their experience at sea feeds a deep well of maritime tradition that strengthens our navy's proud heritage. Our admiralties train every promising young captain under a veteran Ra'īs's command, perpetuating a body of practical seamanship that no formal naval academy could replicate. A concentration of professional captaincy gives the Maghrebi states a naval officer corps that no inland treasury could finance through formal training alone.
andalusi_arquebusiers: The Andalusi Arquebusiers are firearm infantry trained by the Andalusi exiles who filled the Maghrebi cities after the fall of Granada, keeping the gunpowder craft of the Nasrid emirate's last decades. They fought as shock troops at the Battle of the Three Kings.
maghrebi_galiots: The Maghrebi Galiot is the swift small-galley of the Maghrebi corsair shipyards. Built on Mediterranean galiot lines but shallower and lighter-gunned, it trades firepower for speed and oar-power, slipping into coves that heavier Christian war-galleys cannot reach. Our captains raid Christian merchant shipping and screen our own traders.
maghrebi_xebec: The Maghrebi Xebec is the fast lateen-rigged warship of the Barbary corsair states, blending a galley's maneuverability with the windward sailing of the lateen rig, gunned enough to threaten a convoy yet shallow enough to slip into coves no war-galleon can follow. Our shipyards at Algiers, Tunis, Salé, and Tripoli build them by the fleet.
subsaharan_musketeer_corps: The Sub-Saharan Musketeers are the black musketeers of the Saadian armies, men brought north across the desert as captives and put to the matchlock in the garrison towns of Merrakš and Fas. The sultans prize a musket line with no clan behind it and no stake in a succession quarrel.
zayyanid_ghulam: The Zayyanid Ghulām are the mamlūk-style slave retainers of the Zayyanid emirs of Tlemcen, bought from the Saharan caravan trade and Genoese factors at Oran, trained from boyhood, and sworn to the emir alone. They garrison the Mechouar fortress and form the emir's strike force when the tribes threaten the throne.
hafsid_ghulam: The Hafsid Ghulām are the slave-soldier corps of Hafsid Tunis: Black African captives from the trans-Saharan markets, Iberian prisoners from corsair raids, and children of earlier ghulām born to the institution and bound to the throne. They are the disciplined counterweight to the restless Banū Hilāl tribal levies.
algiers_ojaq_janissaries: The Algiers Ojaq Janissaries are the musketeer ojaq of the Algerian Regency, an Ottoman-trained Janissary garrison founded after the Barbarossa brothers took Algiers and steadily reinforced with Anatolian recruits. They hold the Kasbah and the coastal forts and elect their own Aga, who shares power with the Dey.
black_guard: The Black Guard is an elite corps of slave soldiers: enslaved men, haratin, and free Muslims raised from childhood to a strict religious creed and drilled in archery, horsemanship, and musketry. They form the backbone of our army.
three_sisters: Our land is plentiful, with many crops, but the method of cultivating maize, beans, and squash together is one of our greatest agricultural achievements. Grown together, these crops have a better output than they do when planted separately.
moundbuilding_advance: The ceremonial mounds built by our ancestors are monuments to their sophisticated earthwork engineering skills. By incorporating these mounds into the planning of our infrastructure, we will preserve a defining tradition of our civilization.
medicinal_infusions: The healing properties of certain plants have helped our people overcome different diseases for centuries. Infusions of certain leaves have even been said to lengthen the lives of our people.
canoe_travels: Lightweight canoes are perfectly adapted to the waterways of North America. These vessels can navigate shallow rivers and are light enough to portage — carry overland— when necessary. In this way, we can turn disconnected waterways into full trade routes, making it much easier to direct the flow of commerce and people.
seasonal_economy: In troubled times, we must learn to endure life, and life is synonymous with nature. The change of seasons necessitates a change in our lifestyles; villages must be adaptable and mobile.
fishing_habits: Sometimes it is difficult to believe that some of our people were born on land and not in the water, for their bodies swim with such agility that it is nearly impossible to distinguish them from the current of the river. As a result, we are experts at fishing.
whale_hunters: Whales, porpoises, walruses, seals... everything the sea gives us, we hunt.
maple_syrup: The many maple trees in our country produce great quantities of sap, which can be collected and boiled to create a delicious sweet syrup and other confections.
stickball_game: The ancient tradition of playing the stickball game has been part of our culture for ages. Used for ritual purposes or to settle disputes, hundreds of warriors gather in a field with wooden sticks and a single ball, which must be directed towards a marked goal. This practice not only brings our people together, but keeps our warriors in prime condition.
north_american_warrior_societies: Our people have long organized into warrior societies, brotherhoods bound by oaths, shared rituals, and a common duty to defend their kin. By formalizing these traditions into Warrior Lodges, we can train a new class of dedicated fighters whose skill and resolve will keep our communities strong long after European weapons arrive on our shores.
bison_hunters: Bison are a crucial resource for our people. We use every part of the animal as a tribute to its sacrifice. We feed our people with its flesh, we use its bones for tools; we use its fur to protect ourselves against the cold and its hides for our clothes. Even the animal's soul has symbolic meaning for us. Such is the importance of the bison to our culture that we would feel lost without them.
federal_constitution: We should unite with other groups of our kin to form a federation, which will put mutual trust and development as its first priority.
shared_knowledge: Innovation can come in many forms and if we want to stay ahead of rival tribes, we will need to explore every advantage we can get.
slash_and_burn: An agricultural technique that involves strategically cutting and burning the vegetation to obtain a nutrient-rich layer of ash that fertilizes underlying soil, making it excellent land for planting crops. We have learned that the land becomes stronger after this method, as a bone becomes stronger after being broken.
council_of_elders: Our tribal government ensures that everyone in it has a voice and an equal say in crucial decisions. This collaborative administration encourages us to consider new perspectives.
experienced_fur_hunters: Trading Fur with other tribes and foreigners is an essential part of our economy. We take great pride in our hunting abilities, and therefore are able to provide the best quality pelts.
wampum: A mix of white and purple beads made from different kinds of shells, wampum are used for many purposes, such as recording treaties and oral histories, facilitating diplomacy, and functioning as a system of exchange in trade. Wampum appears wherever our people tread.
